The Romantic Girly-Girl. A believer in love, pink accessories, polished manicures, glossed lips, romantic blockbusters and anything sparkly wrapped in a satin bow.

Stay is the evolution of Close. It's a lighter, fresher scent for the woman who already loves Close. Stay is still sexy and feminine, but has a more "daytime" sensibility.

Designed to conjure the warmth of an affectionate embrace and the tenderness of a soft caress, the white, luminous oriental scent is gracefully tailored - this enchanting scent captures the story of an intimate, unforgettable moment.

By contrasting the above and below, light and shade, we imagine the shifting state of the sea, its intensity, the allure of its dark depths. A fragrance for the intrepid: challenging preconceptions of what ‘Aquatic' truly means.

description: In the dark forest of black and white, the cunning snakes and murmuring birds are embedded in the ferocious eyes by the metal fence. Inspired by lush landscapes, it captures the essence of aromatic herbs and verdant vegetables, evoking the refreshing charm of the Mediterranean breeze in every spritz.
A fragrance curated for the man who wanders solo and is fierce in his might.
A harmonious scent with sparkling accords to lift your spirit up.
Whispers of Seduction exudes a remorseless sensuality, brazen and bold, providing a playful and primal olfactory journey. Disclaimer: It will provoke an instant rush of euphoria.
Light, fresh, but utterly unique. Club de Nuit Milestone will capture your heart with its delicate, sophisticated composition. Absolutely ideal for everyday wear.

High above the city, London is home to countless hives of diligent honeybees. A whoosh of fresh honeyed floralcy leads you to the crisp green privet of a hidden rooftop garden. The hazy yellow sun warms new flowers, notes of pollen and seed buds dance lazily.

Here, the ylang-ylang flower takes centre stage, as it does on the island of Moheli in the Comoros archipelago, where the star-shaped yellow flower flourishes alongside luscious vegetation. It has never been smelled this way: green, spicy, slightly woody, without languor or opulence.
The small black pepper is born on the mountain and resembles the fruits of a tropical tree. The rejuvenating essential oil from the fruit of this tree offers a fresh and uplifting scent.
A unique fragrance with a precious vanilla absolute and a hypnotic floral accord that give shape to an enveloping and intriguing creation.

Bright, complex, incredibly modern, Le Parfum de Therese was created in the early 50s by Edmond Roudnitska, one of the greatest perfumers of the Twentieth century. The fragrance was never commercially produced and remained a well-kept secret because Thérèse, Roudnitska's wife for whom it was created, was the only person allowed to wear it. Considered a masterpiece because its water fruit accord is 40 years ahead of its time, this complex fragrance is also reminiscent of glorious perfumes of the past.

Dana Buchman luxury is a radiant floral fragrance that captures timeless glamour and relaxed elegance. Designed to be the finishing touch to your wardrobe, Dana Buchman Luxury is a fragrance to wear anytime, anywhere, because your scent is both inherently female and classically stylish.
Pure Bloom is luminous and sensual creation; a tribute to the irresistible urge for an adventure that awakens the senses and the soul.

Inspired by the most powerful colour, Red Leather expresses engagement, Italian easiness and sensuality. For the man who explores his own desires, makes his personal choices and unapologetically embraces his authenticity.

Agua de Colonia 1916 was created in 1916 by the Russian perfumer Meisonier. Originally intended for women, it ended up being very popular among men, thus creating the concept of colognes for the whole family.

A refreshing, energising scent with powerful accords.

A delicate and sparkling Eau de Toilette. Its subtle and harmonious freshness transports you to a sun-drenched garden in the softness of spring.
A rich and persistent olfactory composition. Intoxicating and unmistakable.

Platinum threads of power and passion. Deep desires seek satisfaction in a thousand nuanced ways, and every one of them has a story to tell. Subtle, seductive and assertive, simple yet reassuring. Paris C'est Chic is a refined fragrance for the new generation.

Veil is a complex and addictive perfume, but not suffocating. It is more like a flash of clarity in the middle of every expanding cosmos. A disconcerting electric symphony. A summer storm in a garden from another galaxy. Veil is a further observation of that, for avant-garde perfumery, the only limits are the laws of physics.

In this Wet Garden, time is as important as place. Our Wet Garden takes place at in Spring… the flowers, young shoots, buds, after a hard rain. The combination of flowers, rain, oils from the rich spring soil comprise this fragrance.
Bad Boy Cobalt celebrates the bond of brotherhood, inspired by the strength of cobalt and its powerful pigmented hue.
A perfume created for the modern and demanding man. A fragrance that combines the freshness of green notes with the potency of spices. A seductive and original union.
For those who are protagonists of their own stories.
Imagination in Bloom. A sweet surprise of vibrant violet blossoms.

Wrapped in kraft paper like a small parcel post and stamped with the postal code of the perfume capital of the world, 06130 for Her is an ode to the land of flowers.
This cheerful and refreshing scent will awaken your femininity and well-being.

Celebrating the strength and empowerment of the contemporary woman. This unique limited-edition symbolises Yardley London’s legacy and expertise in creating exquisite fragrances for discerning generations of women the world over.
A delicate scent to express your natural charm.

Demeter's Cotton Candy captures that fresh, warm scent of cotton candy just made at the fair on a warm summer day. If there is a more pleasant childhood memory to be had, we have yet to find it.

Inspired by English style and grace, this scent exudes femininity.
A fragrance of sparkling, freshness and vitality, dazzling swirls of cheerfulness and joy. A fantastic anti-stress parfum.
La Opale, the unsaid desire.

A captivating, sensual blend of rose, patchouli, and candied fruit all enveloped in a very rich musky character.
A vibrant scent with refreshing and energetic notes.

This light fragrance is a great match for those wanting to wear something lavish and festive.

Mimosa, the flower of the sun, is the first flower blooming in winter, reminding the light coming back after the darkness.

name_perfume: Bvlgari Eau Parfumée Au Thé Noir Intense
description: Inspired by millennial Chinese Black Tea, an intense luxury fragrance for men and woman. Bvlgari's Eau Parfumée au Thé Noir Intense imprints itself indelibly on the skin with its sensual and captivating notes.
An intense and memorable composition with a soft and sensual embrace.
Much like a moment stolen from eternity, this Eau de Toilette is specially created for the Jean Honoré Fragonard museum.
Fleur d’Oranger & Néroli is a delicate and elegant fragrance that evokes the sweetness of summer and walk through an orange grove.

Called the stone that sees all, the Tiger's Eye draws its energy from the vibrations of the earth and sun. Like the name of the fragrance, this bright stone is inspired by the majestic feline, and conveys the fiery courage, action and mental power of the great Indian warrior Shivaji.
Anything can happen When in Rio. Sparkling and seductive, this warm fragrance comes alive like the energy of a bright-hot night.
The sea and its essences; the water that gently caresses the skin, instantly providing a sensation of peace and tranquillity.

Sail away one last time this sunny season with the vibrant notes of Paris - Santorin, an ode to Figue in all the nuances that nature can bring, uniquely blends the juicy side of the fruit with its fresh green leaves.
The iconic edgy scent in a 2023 collector bottle to celebrate in style.
Rouat Al Oud is a harmonious perfume with woody and spicy notes.
1947 Dahlia is a daring and original sublime interpretation of the mysteries of seduction through a floral oriental fragrance featuring a profuse bouquet of elegant and narcotic flowers.

SOLE is a radiant, vibrant, and discretely charismatic fragrance; a tribute to the rays of the sun nourishing the earth. The noble temperament and the graceful scents of the composition speak of a thousand bright arrows that cross the air at sunrise to reach the ground and to caress the flowers, the fruits, and our skin. Endless imaginary lines trace a perfect bridge between earth and sky while offering a taste of summer.
This fragrance expresses the need to reconnect with nature for strength and tranquillity. It is now more important than ever.
Escape to a vibrant orchard of hanging flowers. Experience delicate sweet notes at the top, followed by the luscious heart of cherry blossom. Finally, feel at peace with the unforgettable woody base.

A burning and intense sweetness, an exotic and seductive magma that unleashes the volcanic soul of a lush archipelago born of fire and eruptions. Born from Fire is an olfactory recreation of the smell of the legendary black sand beach of Honolokani in Maui, Hawaï.
Magnetic and bewitching, the Eau de Parfum Noir Absolu combines the sensuality of gardenia and musk with the exquisite refinement of natural Oud wood. An olfactory trap that soon becomes addictive.
A bold and sensual fragrance for free-spirited women seeking the excitement of their next adventure.

Delicate rose petals suspended in a delectable jelly. The charm of these blushing pink petals inspires a prized preserve, prepared for the great British summer fete. Vibrant basil and a juicy note of lychee add a modern twist to this soft floral scent, cocooned in the embrace of white musk.
A re-interpretation of the house's emblematic raw material: patchouli reveals itself in a new light, a serene and luminous evocation of the sweetness of Mediterranean living.
Designed not only for lovers of sailing and the sea, but also to those who daily choose to live their lives with passion and depth.

Genetic Bliss belongs to the collection "Next Generation", which started with the perfume #hashtag. The leitmotiv is the intrinsic desire of today's generation to be unique, unrestricted by all social constraints and expectations to follow an individual path.
Call me Mademoiselle. A daring fragrance blended with sensual notes, for the chic woman.

A fragrance with powerful and captivating accents but subtle. This fragrance is inspired by Saffron, a precious and rare spice, unfolding its deep, intoxicating notes, associated with the Rose with the "hundred leaves" of Grasse of which only the depth has been preserved, underlined with a trace of freshness.
Leather Rouge is a provocative and inviting perfume, conjuring the embers of a fire and the tactile richness of leather.

Levitation White Gold will make you feel free and eager to travel the world, as its fragrance, in combination with the particles of white gold and the Diamond Quartz, will fill you with the most amazing feeling of liberty. Let yourself be carried away by its notes of wood and leather.
The incredibly ambivalent character of Arabian Musk can be cool and warm at the same time. A masterpiece of balance and uniqueness that appears masculine and feminine.
Marked with its provenance and period, each fragrance recreates moments and olfactive memories, triggering images that echo the collective unconscious as well as our own personal history.

Inspired by the vibrancy and boldness of neon orange, Pitada de Humor brings a fun reading of a peach drink. A juicy and energetic fruit that joins notes of amber and jasmine, with a touch of storaque, an ingredient of Amazonian biodiversity. A super irreverent and cheerful mix. After all, a dash of humor makes life much lighter and more colorful!

For the daredevil who has it all and knows no limits. Introducing Michael Kors Extreme Sky, the gravity-defying new men’s scent that captures the heart-pounding sensation of conquering the sky and soaring high above it all.

This is an adaptable cologne that showers your body with fresh joy. It's whatever you want it to be, and you make it your own. It's an easy pleasure, a scent for everyone, to splash on all over and wear everywhere. A gentle invitation into our subversive world.

name_perfume: Primavera En El Mercado De San Miguel
description: Just like its namesake in Madrid, Primavera En El Mercado de San Miguel from Loewe is an explosion of sensations and colours that merge under a marvellous iron structure. A favourite spot for Madrilenians and tourists alike, El Mercado de San Miguel inspired this exhilarating for a refreshing sensory experience.
Absolutely….floral and seductive! Its personality? Flamboyant, vibrant and luscious. A pure jewel inspired by Liv Tyler's blossoming sexiness.
A floral-fruity fragrance with sparkling, gourmand top notes of citrus and berries, followed by a very feminine heart ending in a soft woody touch.

This heavenly sophisticated scent stands out because of its unique blend of exotic spices and rich wood. It evokes the fragrance of sizzling scent oil flowing down the balmy leaves of a sacred tree. It's an opulent and sensual fragrance for those not afraid to expose their love of wide-open spaces that epitomise the Australian dream.

A perfume dedicated to melding femininity with sensuality. Rose Valley is both captivating and elegant. A true feminine fragrance, this perfume is highlighted by the velvety flowers and juicy fruits. A floral bouquet marks the heart, both charming and creamy, while the drydown, demonstrates a beautiful blend of powdery accents, and is sensually warmed by the precious woody notes.
A scent that smells like a floral bouquet on a sweet spring day.

We chose the most fragrant and striking flower to be the star of this eau de parfum. The Jasmine raises the olfactory level for their strength and femininity. Already Patchouli, ingredient as used in fine perfumery and in the international market, it is within this creation in the form of jewelry because it contains its most premium and pure fraction, ensuring the sophistication of the fragrance.
Néonatura Souffle evokes the radiantly heated sensuality of a warm breeze caressing the sand.
A timeless scent where sparkling notes blend with the noble spirit of inebriating essences.
What is happening tonight? A dazzling moment. The prediction was right. Who would have thought. The effect on you. You just can't explain. I am Redmoon.
Vigorous and embracing, Oudrageous has a powerful and vibrant olfactory signature. A continuum of spicy and woody notes, harmoniously alternate to create a woody and spicy accord.
It's for the birth of her grandchildren, that Martine Micallef had the desire to create a collection dedicated to toddlers. Delicate and sophisticated, these scents are alcohol-free perfumed water.

Elegantly handcrafted from precious natural ingredients, this spicy floral fragrance has been specifically created to commemorate our 20th anniversary in 2015. Highlighted the rose, the most romantic, opulent and quintessentially beautiful of all flowers, it memorably encapsulates the very essence of modern femininity.
Secret Woods is the portrait of an adventurer. Escaping from ordinary life, he takes a journey to find himself. He is looking for a new inner balance made of peace and comfort.

Mister Giordani captures the youthful spontaneity of being seduced by life's unexpected moments; taking the city by bike, savouring a sumptuous espresso; enjoying an ice cream date at the nearest fountain. This is the scent of spontaneity with a sensuality that lingers. Like an irresistible smile, its charm is elegant and addictive.

Unfolding tender floral notes open this fragrance. At its core, woody accents strengthen this fragrance, finishing with gourmand and musky tones that honour this sensual and charming scent from start to finish.

A high from a dangerous lover. Boozy vanilla, heated skin, and a smoldering spliff will have you coming back for more, much more. A functional fragrance with calming properties, Midnight Toker contains hemp-derived CBD oil in each bottle.
This fragrance has a dazzling, sparkling opening, an aromatic heart and a sensual trail.

Green Garden is a fragrance that reflects the elegance of the castle garden with a variety of roses: beguiling with a slight freshness. The light evening breeze envelops the festive dresses with the fragrant notes of the rose garden.
An exclusive long-awaited take on the cult and ever-popular "Visa" fragrance. V. Intense is deep, enigmatic and opulent. Take a journey into unknown fragrance territory.

The ultimate fragrance for men for whom luxury knows no bounds. Launched as a tribute to the refinement of Celtic art, this scent is inspired by the famous steel cable, the iconic signature of the House of Charriol.
A sensory journey through an oasis in the middle of the desert.
An elegant scent with a sensual trail.
Zanzibar is an enigma, like a mirage in the desert. Sweet and herbal, the fragrance creates a blend that is both daring and unusual.
Powerful, dark, mysterious, oud has become the grail of perfume creators. Its power is hidden here behind the sensuality of jasmine and patchouli.

"I wanted to evoke the carefree age of youthful folly. The scent is sharply sweet like a cranberry. Sparkling, almost insolent, at its fresh floral heart are jasmine and ylang-ylang. It's the perfume of a lovable woman and has the taste of happiness," François Demachy, Perfumer-Creator.
A smooth yet sensually appealing scent, Junoon Oud appeals to those harboring an appreciation of the best that life has to offer. This is your time to shine!
Wear Molecule 02 and you will notice a fresh, almost mineral smoothness which subtly expands to envelope the wearer.
Celebration time Five years represented by five main elements: exuberance, brightness/joy, glamour, solemnity and emotional. Just in time to celebrate the 5th anniversary of Bloomingdale's Dubai.
Rise combines the dignified attitude and unique energy of the megastar. ”Rise is designed to encourage women to be all that they want to be,” Beyoncé.

I'm Going is a rush of spontaneous energy and determination pushing you towards a goal. The outside world has no meaning and you exist only for this moment of challenge. You are empowered by the thrill of the game.

This fragrance bursts with invigorating and uplifting freshness while purifying with a mysterious essence. The energetic drive rushes forward, adding a sensuous facet to the fragrance. The trail develops into a refined masculine alchemy, the ideal balance of relaxed sophistication.
Experience a sunny state of mind no matter what the weatherman says with Pure Grace Endless Summer.
Nawaf is a fragrance that takes you to the highest echelons. It's the scent of status and eminence. The scent of class.
A bold yet hedonistic fragrance for those who harbour a rebellious inclination.

Salado is the scent of sunbathed skin speckled with dried salt crystals left behind from a summer ocean dip in waters the colour of blue tourmaline. It's crisp and refreshing like a soft Mediterranean breeze that skims across the deck of a sailboat docked at sea.
A captivating and magnetic fragrance full of passion, sexiness, lust and audacity.
A refreshing scent with a sweet trail.
Wildly feminine, alluring, and potent, Rose Cut unleashes the power of a velvety, intoxicating aura.

While strolling through the forest, we imagine knights, centuries earlier, galloping among ancient trees. We can still smell the leather of their boots and the scent of wet earth. Between the strong and the gentle, the refined and the sensual, Duel celebrates contrasts and invites us to defy the ordinary.

Passing old car wrecks and decrepit diners, any man travelling along Route 66 is left to his own devices on the seemingly endless road. Nostalgia is in the air. Confident in its

own allure, the fragrance exudes a balance of strength and coolness, masculinity and independence.
Hollister's Free Wave for Her is a reflection of endless summer days!

The bright fresh citrus sit atop this fragrance giving it a sparkling and effervescent confidence. The heart captures the light hearted bouquet. As it dries down, layers of warmth reflect your strong conviction.

Cherry Blossom is a tribute to the freshness of the cherry blossom, the symbol of spring, beauty and the joy of love in Japan. Arising from the olfactory emotion and talent of Jean-Paul Guerlain, this delicate yet rich eau de toilette with its fresh, luminous accents enthralls women and uplifts hearts.

ingredients: ['Lily Of The Valley', 'Sandalwood', 'Iris / Orris', 'Peony', 'Rose', 'Amber', 'Vanilla', 'Woody Notes', 'Blackcurrant Bud']
description: The Tracy woman has an infectious joie de vivre. Tracy was created for the woman who makes every day an adventure. Elegantly sophisticated and intensely feminine, the fragrance immerses its wearer in a sensuous journey filled with warmth and affection.

An alluring composition of woods, amber, and musks, it is mysterious and sinfully addictive. This fragrance lingers on the skin, igniting desire. Applied as a layer to other fragrances, it will enhance their mystery and their sensuality as a promise of seduction.
If it is possible to embody the very best of men and women in their creations, it is in Windsor. This scent reminds me of the many fields of wildflowers encountered on horseback.

Welcome to the world of shadows, where the positive and the negative are not defined, where they are interlinked, for if there is no negative, there can be no positive. Full of contradictory revelations, Cicatrices provokes new memories to arouse your intimacy.

Oud is revealed in Nuit des Rois as the master of a sumptuous ceremony and the initiator of a bewitching spell. In its luxurious unfolding, opulence and generosity become fragrance and mysterious oud reveals its extravagant addiction, radiance and sillage.
Explore Africa with this Terre Sacrée. It sublimates your skin with its subtle and stunning notes.

name_perfume: The Club By Playboy Black Edition
description: Bond over differences. Your club is where your friends are, where your tribe is. You write the rules to make them follow you. The world is yours.
A modern, aromatic fragrance. A fusion of fresh citrus and spices that creates a fragrance deep in character and strong in quality. A fragrance for men, women love to love.
Now you can write your own fairytale! But make sure you #KissTheFrog

Dark Vinyl Musk is the quintessence of life. The jazzy scent of black vinyl and the scent of enveloping musk combine to create a metaphor for beautiful and difficult moments, ups and downs that build us. The beginning of something unknown and exciting, like the swirling hypnosis of life.

name_perfume: Halloween Mía Me Mine Eau De Parfum
description: I am the pleasure that reverberates inside you, the pleasure that awaits you, the freedom that you have always looked for and that has always been waiting for you. I am Mía, Me, Mine. And you are also Mía.

Beautiful Magnoloa L'Eau captures an epic love story from beginning to end, daring you to dream of a lifetime of love. Aglow with happiness, your body and soul become one, letting your heart open like a magnolia in full bloom.

Roberto Cavalli describes the scent as “a hymn to a male sensuality that is finally unfettered.” An invitation to live male virility with pride, to flaunt it uncaring about conventions. No more restraints and renunciations for the man who truly likes himself. Not only an impetuous desire to live life to the full, Roberto Cavalli Man perfume sweeps the senses beyond their limits.
Imagine refined elegance, like dark blue velvet jacket. Modern, yet traditional, but always a show-stopping sophistication.

Musky rose and strawberry macaron pink is Manish Arora's religion: Indian pink, lively and vibrant! Manish loves pink so much, he wanted to dedicate a perfume to it. A pink he "tasted" in Paris, that of a singular strawberry macaron.
Clean, indulgent, natural yet powerful, this rich blend seamlessly imparts the warmth of falling in love for the first time!
The aromas of fruits, flowers and gourmand notes with a touch of vanilla make InLove a love potion!

I wanted to create the solution to all of lovers' quarrels with a fragrance to end all fighting. "Let's Settle This Argument Like Adults, In The Bedroom, Naked" is a very sensual scent with a top note that hits soft like naked skin, the result? Hot-sex in a bottle at the height of earthy and exotic.

name_perfume: Baiser Volé Eau De Parfum Collector 2021
description: The urgency of living in the present moment is the whirlwind of life. Take a moment to spritz Baiser Volé and allow it to remind you of walks through a springtime garden. Wear it for all occasions, from a day at the office to a night out in town with friends. Its refreshing aromas linger for hours, surrounding you with warmth and comfort. Now in a special bottle.

This resolutely masculine extract is dedicated to dandyish urban night owls who were just waiting for their signature perfume to come along. A fragrance so insidery, finding like-minded spirits who wear it becomes almost a game, a knowing nod among members of the same elite club.
The Malbec Club Intenso evokes what Malbec has the best, formulated with noble and pure ingredients that this man deserves.

Noblige is the contraction of noblesse oblige. A cloud of citrus that lights up thanks to the conjunction between powdery notes, and valuable elements that blend into the floral heart with sophistication. Elegance is accurate, whispered, and not ostentatious. The white, light, infinite. The pursuit of perfection that does not exist. All this is Noblige.
Fresh, effortless and undeniably feminine, Perfume No.1 is incredibly luxurious and uniquely carefree. A&F's sexy signature scent was created by one of the world's most sought after perfumers.
The relationship with water in the Nordics runs deep. Everchanging, yet always there, this vibrant watery scent will entice you into this mesmerising aquatic world with each refreshing spritz.

"Vegetables express a dimension of pleasure and comfort. I was inspired by naturopathic chef Jennifer Hart-Smith's exceptional cheesecake, in which cauliflower combines extraordinarily well with vanilla, coconut and tonka bean. The main challenge was to capture the aroma. Tonka Blanc is the first fragrance on the market to contain a natural plant extract and I am very proud of that," Alexandra Carlin, perfumer.
A perfume inspired by jasmine that evokes, like a spell, the magic of a unique island in the world.

Rain on Sylt, a frequent spectacle. The air shimmers as though electrified and heralds an imminent shower, lending the floral new strength. At once, the sun's rays flash through the clouds, the fragrance of moist grasses and wet blossoms fills the air. Keep Calm and Love Sylt 4, which captures the aura of the air after a refreshing rainfall in an unforgettable manner and know how to captivate both men and women in the process.
Ungaro Power is an olfactive creation that dazzles and strikes as neon light illuminating the skyline. A fragrance that is an emblem for young men who like to play and seduce.
Another particular version of that worn leather scent. If you love riding, or just fantasise about it, you'll love this one

Nº 5 personifies the eternal woman, it reflects her charm. Why do women adore it so? Because Marilyn Monroe wore nothing else to bed! Because it is the most cherished of gifts. Because it's a woman's fragrance, the very essence of a woman. Because it is all these things and more.
The 1 Million Man is flamboyant, and daring, and uses his charm to play with a touch of humour. He loves the feeling of exploring new sensations, his dreams and fantasies always take him further.
Zafferano Iran is a joyful, dynamic and luminous creation that combines a zesty freshness with a spicy and invigorating touch.
Sehr al Sheila is a fragrance that celebrates the Arabian woman, creating a scented vision of beauty and tradition.
A perfume of crystalline purity, with the resplendent smile of a heavenly angel that can lead to the rapture of admiration.
Smokin' Gun, love around the campfire. Heavily peated, spiced scotch in the wet woods.
Tom Ford Private Blend Italian Cypress delivers the subtle essence of Italian quality and sophistication to the very space we breathe.

Just a root? Perhaps, but it has fed a thousand tales and legends. It is said that it can divert lightning and spark love! Magical and powerful, its disturbing strangeness fascinates and inspires us. Deliciously aromatic and irresistibly mysterious, Mandragore Pourpre enchants us with its scents of star anise and patchouli.
White, weathered sands under fiery, summer sun, infinite-like, vast, deep turquoise ocean with the clear blue sky at your fingertips. What does this island smell like?
Determination is the prime characteristic of a confident man.
The stunning combination between the sky and the infinite beauty of the sea is Tentation Bleu. Elegance and modernity translate this fragrance by Fiorucci.
A fragrance by Mariel Hemingway inspired by the beauty of nature. A sea of natural essences, exotic fruits, sensual florals and rich botanicals.
The opoponax plant originated in Somalia. The Egyptians and Babylonians used it to fumigate and also to flavour wine.

Bucoliques de Provence marks the beginning of a collection of fragrances by L'Artisan Parfumeur inspired by different regions of France. Grasse is considered the spiritual home of French fragrance and, unsurprisingly, this is where the journey begins. Bucoliques de Provence pays homage to the region with its distinctive lavender fields and historic leather production.
Light and elegant. Romantic and delicate. Aire de Sevilla Rosas is a celebration of freshness.
Surprising at first smell, fall into it after weaving.
A pure perfume that belies its initial innocence with a story of intrigue and seduction, leading the wearer into a world of intoxicating excitement that will captivate and coerce.
It is a pure red rose. The essence of seduction in the 80s.

Empyr is a masculine fragrance swirled with a spicy heart and softly tempered by creamy woods. It comes in the collection's iconic all-black bottle with engraved details and gold-tone accents that match the sophisticated fragrance within.

This eau de toilette evokes the secret garden of a manor house, silently tucked away behind walls of mossy stone. Hundreds of highly scented flowers perfume the dewy dawn with their delightful earthen notes, thus conveying a sense of profound tranquility. Florals, warm woods ;and musk bring about transparency, delicacy and elegance, whilst at the same time not taking away from its infinite softness.

The ancient emperors of Japan, the royal houses of the Arabian Peninsula. Possibly the most precious and little-known perfume ingredient in the world, extracted from unique trees of Southeast Asia, with the mysterious seal of our perfumer.
Dusk on Crosby Street. A break-up. A woman stands alone in an empty apartment. She dances with abandon and is reborn in the joy of the moment.
Subtle and revitalising, Thé Vert Eau de Toilette captures the fresh and delicate aromas of green tea.

Everyone is in the mood to have some fun. Meet our sexiest, spiciest fragrance yet. Known for nightlife, art galleries, and a diverse cast of residents, Chelsea is the opposite of basic. The spirit of Chelsea is channelled into this unique fragrance that sizzles with sensuality and sophistication.
Juxtaposition of hot and cold notes compete in this vibrant scent, creating a warm leathery veil on the skin.
Etat Libre d'Orange and Roland Mouret. We're made for each other. Together, we have merged our philosophies, our attitudes and our identities, and created Une Amourette.

Ma Dame defies the conventions of fashion and gender to demonstrate her freedom, power, and self-assurance. Her sense of style is unique and highly personal. Very “femme”, with a touch of masculinity.
The House of Creed launches a limited edition bottle of the iconic Aventus fragrance in celebration of its 10th Anniversary. A sensual, audacious, and contemporary scent.
A beautiful scent with a delicate and exquisite trail.

Rich and smoky, the scent of black tea floats in plumes of indigo smoke as the leaves are dried. An aromatic landscape of narrow serpentine rivers, blue mountains and incense-filled temples condensed into a fragrance that's both comforting, energising and extremely long-lasting.

Few things encapsulate femininity as well as a flower. Its splendor emerges at precisely the right moment, It opens slowly at first, but before long, nothing can stop it. The unique magnetism of its presence commands your attention. This is Her Secret Bloom.
As free and wild as the ocean. Breaking wave and natural energy. Extreme depth, endless movement.
Desigual, because you are unique. We like you as you are, authentic, and genuine, able to create magic. This is for you.
Rediscover This is Her! through this limited edition that shines with a thousand lights to celebrate winter.
Fleur de Thé is a fresh perfume, as bright as silk. Feminine, subtle, radiant and carefree, it's the perfect fragrance for every moment of the day.

A warm, oriental and ´gourmand fragrance where the woman becomes the symbol of sensuality, provocation with sophistication, desire and passion. Rouge Royal, seducing and even more troubling, is animated by an ancestral force lying dormant and indulges herself into the conquest of the world.

An ode to chasing dreams and optimism, West is the first true citrus scent by Ellis Brooklyn. Inspired by Los Angeles writers of the ’70s, West bursts forth with the energy of a brilliant new idea and develops into a story that’s nuanced and devastatingly beautiful.
Be bright. Live with grace. Amazing Grace Bergamot.

Tall grasses quiver and rustle in the distance as bees dance. Nature vibrates with joy. The imagination takes flight. A sunny and magnetic aroma. All senses are on alert. A wonderful sense of freedom.
Sweet and addictive. Shakira Sweet Dream will evoke a sense of warmth and sweet dreams.

fragrances: Floral Fresher Lily of the Valley
description: Remember the early morning walks through Prague and its gardens as they’re slowly waking up. Praga is a clean, delicate fragrance, as fresh as morning dew evaporating from white flowers with the first rays of sunshine.
A simple yet captivating scent geared to a dynamic, progressive and distinguished lady.

The steadfast beige of stoneware, sand and earth. The soothing beige in which Mademoiselle liked to wrap herself, sheltered from the world and the chaos of life. The natural beige that enhances a glow. Timeless, it presents itself here in a voluptuous bouquet of hawthorn, honey and frangipani. A beautiful haven to get lost in and find your true self.

Hypnôse Eau de Toilette is full of a luminous and vibrating magnetism. It is a meeting between notes and convictions. In osmosis with the skin, it reveals its radiant sensuality and its mesmerising vanilla accents. Suave and light, it however remains completely addictive.

"My dearest Bianca, you have my eyes, but I do not know if you have my nose. And I can't tell if you will be a “nose” one day! Yet, I know one thing, the world of scents is one of the wonders of our planet. Scents don't lie, dear Little Bianca, they talk to your heart in the language of truth." Alberto, your Granddad

A flowering cactus sets the tone for this raw, glamorous take on the dark side of vanilla. Cool and limpid as moonlit desert air, velvety and sensuous as the midnight sky, Cierge de Lune is inspired by the scent of the mysterious night-blooming cereus flowering cactus, also known as the Queen of the Night. Originally launched in 2016.
Confronted with this diabolical indulgence, no one is safe from an olfactory obsession that can soon become a real addiction.
Distinguished and sublime Absinthe Gaïac provides an invigorating start, slightly bitter, green and full of elegance. Absinthe Gaïac is a grand and alluring fragrance.
No rules. I do a thing called what I want.

The luminous power of the poppy. A new dazzling eau de toilette, bursting with energy. A radiant floral scent a flash of emotion on the skin. Kenzo Parfums invents the scent of light and continues to cultivate its free-spirited and offbeat attitude with a perfume that smells like no other.

Material is a paradox. Through materiality, it evokes immateriality, teaching us to look beyond appearances and to realise that what matters is often unseen. An experience akin to standing in a grove and seeing in the sweltering shade a multitude of textures and manifold hues of wood and leaf and bark. All coming together into one.

"The biggest challenge working on Crazy Rich was to make sure the opulence of the creation would come through right from the top note to the last throughout the fragrance. I was creating this composition to be exuberant and decidedly in excess. I was greatly inspired by having lived on Long Island N.Y. for almost 30 years and I could therefore visualise the setting for 'The Great Gatsby', thus transforming this into an olfactive rendition of that visual," Christian Vermorel, Perfumer.
A unique and aromatic scent. Awrag is the scent to record your unforgettable memories.

Coconut and Vanilla, our two most desired ingredients, are the inspiration for Coco Extreme. Coco Extreme combines the fruits of paradise with fresh island breezes for the ideal balance of creamy sweetness, warmth and relaxed sensuality.

This modern, sexy fragrance has an addictive freshness composed of vibrant citrus and abstract floral energy, giving it a unique signature. Accented by sensual woody notes, the fragrance possesses simplicity, elegance and an edgy beauty that defies convention to convey the Gap attitude.
A fresh yet mysterious scent with a classic trail.

Chinatown carries forward the long tradition of the so-called oriental perfumes that held sway in the 20th century. But ours is innovative—it's the first to add a New York aesthetic to the mix. A sultry, mouth-watering equal-opportunity East-West bouquet.

All the women you are, all the women you can be, that's what Fame is all about. Try on as many femininities as you want. Let all your facets shine through, leaving a scent as unique and powerful as you are. Claim your fame.
Capturing the timeless essence of a bygone era in each delicate note, Edwardian Bouquet embodies eternal modernity and elegance.
This eau de parfum is like a dive in the joy of nature, an hymn to the comfort and refreshment of the wild fruits from the woods, a spiritual journey that reconnects us with the magic of our planet.
You're sure to feel sweet and fancy with this pretty perfume.

Uninhibited. Feminine. Floral. Outspoken is for the woman who needs no introduction. With her fearless confidence, she lets her true personality shine through. True to herself and her beliefs…she is Outspoken. Sexy. Fearless. Unexpected.

ingredients: ['Heliotrope', 'Orange Blossom', 'Vanilla', 'Honeysuckle', 'Lily Of The Valley', 'Violet', 'Amber', 'Coumarin (Tonka Bean note)', 'Bergamot', 'Cedarwood', 'Mandarin', 'Musk', 'Violet Leaves', 'Green Apple']
description: Ellen Tracy Bronze is a luxurious scent that will appeal to all women who appreciate authentic luxury and romance. This fragrance has a sparkling personality with a fresh sexiness and an intoxicating mood.
Natura Humor 3, a fresh floral fragrance with an explosion of citrus fruits! Delicious!
Zesty flight of lime and green mandarin. Sublimated by pink pepper and verbena. A unique sparkling freshness. Supported with elegance and refinement by iris and white musks.

Pour in the strong, long-lasting, and masculine scent of On The Rocks to keep the good times rolling. So, raise your glasses and enjoy a fragrance that’s as smooth as scotch to remind you that bad never felt so good. Cheers.
A timeless classic, composed in the true French style. The epitome of elegance and class.

Patchouli Ardent devotes a singular ode to patchouli, a noble ingredient whose sensual scrolls have transcended the borders of the East to conquer the whole world. An intense and luminous wake to intoxicate the senses.

Brilliant Jewel is a brilliant fragrance of light that shines like a diamond.
A deep immersion in the heart of your purest, most intense emotions. An expedition into a contrasted, surprising fragrance that will make you discover noble, sophisticated, genuine ingredients.
Follies are the only things one never regrets. I run. I fly. I live. I am free. Free from reason and routine. I am free as air. I am…MADLY KENZO!

For true "connoisseurs" of perfume. Intense" concentration for this new collection: more natural essential oils in each bottle for a more intense pleasure and a longer lasting effect. Presented in luxurious individual cases. An enchanting work around cedrat, a note between lemon and bergamot. Spicy and woody notes for more tenacity and long-lasting fragrance.

Adidas Dare Edition captures the nerve and audacity of the players who dream that anything is possible. With boundless potential and breath-taking talent, they are unstoppable. Invincible. They dare to take risks on the pitch, leaving their unique stamp on the game. With every spray, let Dare Edition inspire you to greatness. Dare to be bold. Dare to take chances. Dare to achieve the extraordinary.
CasaDiva is a fragrance that resonates like a celestial voice, its pure and flowery notes rise up towards the bright blue sky and explode high with fragrant floral scents!
Captivating, strong, capable, yet temptingly adventurous: this is Black Steel, a powerful scent exuding seduction, warmth and vigor.

Rose Essentielle is the richest and most sophisticated fragrance in the Bvlgari Pour Femme collection. An ultimate expression of luxury, it offers women who seek an extremely sensual floral signature, the perfect evening compliment.

Olympéa Parfum by Rabanne lets your divine aura shine to reveal your inner goddess. A hypnotic ambery green floral fragrance crafted with exceptional ingredients. A luminous vegetal accord blends with a white flower bouquet and mysterious vanilla to liberate the goddess within. Olympéa Parfum captures the most mysterious facet of her divine power.
For the woman who plays with fire and skates on thin ice. Fire Ice is a provocative, sensual and passionate fragrance, at once fresh and mysterious.

She is not only this edgy lady, nor the most glamorous, or the most intimidating, is all that, at the same time, a beauty on her own. Impossible to describe… and that's why she's so fascinating. Her perfume is mysterious and addictive, at the crossroads of modern and classic perfumery. Romeo be warned! Juliette is back, more uncatchable than ever!
Inspired by the lands of perfume, both near and far away, Oud & Rose Eau de Parfum combines a legendary flower from the region of Grasse with a precious raw material emblematic of the Middle East.
The power of the unforgettable fragrance, that is Pacha Ibiza Psicodelic!

When day slips beneath the first veils of night, iris flowers release their powdery, enchanting scent into the humid night air. On the banks of a pond, there is a fleeting, precious moment of grace that asks only to be embraced. Soft and cottony, Heure Exquise makes us await the dusk ever more impatiently.
Bergamot Oud was inspired by the sand dunes in Dubai flooded by sunlight.
Your most delicious dreams come true with this gourmand fragrance.
Recharge your life with X-Series Recharge, a thrilling and energising scent with unsuspecting notes.

With its contrasting blend of ingredients that are at once sweet and sensual, Good Girl represents every side of a woman’s femininity from light to dark, softness to strength. For this limited release, the emblematic Good Girl high-heeled shoe is entirely doused in perfectly polished gold.

Sharp was made for an art exhibition to accompany an artisanal dress with drawings carved into the material, creating a repetitive signature pattern. The precision of the artwork can be found in the essence of this scent, within the delicate layering of notes, which sharpen as the perfume is dissected.

A homage to the brave drivers who pioneered F1, the risk-takers with nerves of steel who put their lives on the line. Precious Mettle is a fresh, intense, woody fragrance with a metallic twist that drives a sense of courageousness

name_perfume: Idôle Eau De Parfum Holiday Edition 2021
description: The fragrance of a new generation of conquering women. Strong. Outspoken. Empowered. The fragrance of the leaders of tomorrow, who dare to reach the sky and open new horizons. The fragrance of the new idols, who pave the way for others. Idôle. Declare you are the future with this iconic floral perfume and be your own Idôle.
Sel Océan lets you opt for something fresh, feminine, or sweet, depending on your mood.
Dolce & Gabbana’s Velvet Black Patchouli tells the story of Italy and its open doors to the Orient, an olfactory celebration of the fusion of East and West.
Launched in 1929, this scent is intensely reminiscent of the grand return of Lawrence of Arabia to the fireside luxuries of London's most storied gentlemen's club.
Vetiris is a cool spring morning in Tuscany. Fresh notes mingle with green notes joined by spices over a dry base. A morning in Tuscany.
Clinique Happy Heart. A wealth of flowers. A hint of warmth. A deepening of emotions. Wear it and have a happy heart.

Bottega Veneta's Knot conjures an escape to the Italian Riviera. Situated in the lush hills there is a home, a sanctuary from reality, overlooking the sparkling sea. The interior is illuminated by sunlight streaming in through its windows, which open wide, usher in a bracing saltwater breeze tinged with the scent of flowers from the gardens. The redolence of citrus trees from the hills nearby and afar combine with the essence of freshly laundered linens.
Comforting and luminous, Wonderful diffuses joy, happiness and dreams around it, so that every moment is a celebration.
A perfume that pays tribute to the year the crown was granted by Queen Victoria to adorn every bottle.

Stars shed their light on nature and illuminate it with their halo. Moving in the sky, they echo the power of the universe. Inspired by their exhilarating radiance, Nuit D'Issey Bleu Astral plays on the magnetic attraction of opposites. Light and dark. Cool and warm. Sensuous and explosive.
Perfumer Vincent Schaller noted: “I imagined the fragrance to be fresh and watery. I also wanted Cool Force to be masculine, sensual and warm, since it is a Baldessarini fragrance.”
Celebrating unconditional love and the strength of togetherness, Stronger With You Freeze is a powerful, long-lasting fragrance. So Freeze the moment and make it last forever.

“Stories of how personalities like Paul Getty, Mick Jagger, Veruschka and Yves Saint Laurent all resided in Marrakesh during the 60s and 70s have always inspired me. I ́m intrigued by how they used this place for influences and escapes of all kinds: clothes, colors, music, interior and drugs. So, the fragrance of Kasbah is an appreciation to the international party scene during this era. ” -Johan Bergelin, Olfactive Director

Never be afraid to stand out in a crowd, Juicy Couture captures the cheeky boldness of a girl who marches to the beat of her own drum. Juicy Couture smells like Couture with a blend of water hyacinth, princess lily, and sweet caramel.

GHAZAL in Arabic, designates the goats of the desert. The idea behind the creation of this fragrance refers to their freedom, to their capacity to be both instinctive and wise, to their ability to live in an inhospitable environment thanks to their tenacity and stubbornness.
An afternoon in Tuscana. The upcoming sunset over the sea, and the expected evening whirl of joy.

A fragrance that contains the essence of olives. This journey leads from Gardone Riviera, on the western shore of the lake, to Sirmione, among beautiful olive groves, ancient villas and ivy towers: a real thrill of scents and colours.

Balmy sunlight trips across foamy turquoise waves, sending rippling haloes onto the coral below. On the lagoon floor, anemone and seaweed sway in unison, limbs pumping to the rhythm of the current. Hovering among the coral branches, a group of seahorses gazes shyly on. The pulsating beat calls to them and two pair off, their tails entwined in a delicate waltz. Soon their passion is spent, but the memory of the dance lives on. For the pouch of the male seahorse tenderly cradles a precious clutch of eggs.

Indulge in the rich aromatics of this signature scent inspired by saffron. Let the piquant scent surround and consume you with this dynastic, powerful, and effervescent scent, that will illuminate your senses. The perfect blend of complexity and finesse to balance mystery, strength and magnetism.
A passionate retreat in a blooming Morocco. An ode to freedom and a tribute to the bohemian way of life.
Fadeitak bottles the deep intensity of a love you would die for.
Sicily, where art and culture meet. The almonds, which are so characteristic of the area, are reproduced in a sweet caress that is Mandorlo di Sicilia.

Tourmaline is an entirely different eau de toilette. An eau de jour full of contrasts designed for radiant, relaxed, fashionable women who convey modern-day elegance and admirable know-how, naturally combining a pair of slim-fit jeans with a dressy sheer blouse and a men's jacket.
Air the fragrance of absolute femininity. A light fragrance with many facets, with a unique personality and haunting aftermath.
Aromatic, refreshing, and exhilarating.

fragrances: Floral Fresher Lily of the Valley
description: Elizabeth Arden's Eau Fraîche is light, bright and fresh.

After work is done. And food and wine and talk. After the latest movements in art. A woodsy slumber; We find ourselves silent; pinned like butterflies. Hands out-scattered above our heads; limbs too far away; swirling a hole that yawns and threatens to swallow us whole. In time, the curtain edges will grow light, and all the uneasy intricate world will begin to rouse. 'Till then, in a Separate Reality, we slip into a deeply troubled sleep.

Entre Ciel et Mer "Between sky and sea," tells a story of etesian winds, azure skies and flying over seascapes at top speed. Icy, soaring and powerful, the first whiff feels as though it had been sculpted out of the Meltem - north wind that blows over the Aegean Sea. A strikingly novel interpretation of marine fragrances.
The feeling after a crisp, energetic walk inspired Trish McEvoy to create No. 6.
Rich, romantic and positively brilliant. A brilliant jewel faceted with sparkling floral accords and the sophisticated elegance of rich woods. Luminous, pearlised bottle.
Lose yourself in this fresh, romantic and radiant fragrance. It's instant glamour in a bottle.

description: A mystical journey through the deep dark night, where two cultures combine.
Style à la Française Classique is a simple, uncluttered composition for elegant and committed gentlemen.
An exquisite romance between tradition and future.
Fiorucci Nuit Rose is an enveloping scent that enchants the romantic woman leaving a seductive trail.

"My idea was to create a fragrance that captures the essence of Mediterranean sensuality by highlighting its wonderful treasures: the ripe purple figs, the flowers, and the warmth of the sun," Marie Hugentobler, Perfumer.

Enriched with organic verbena from Corsica, lemon oil from Sicily, and grapefruit extract from Italy, this new summer fragrance tones and leaves the skin scented with an invigorating and fruity fragrance.
The ocean is at your fingertips with this breezy, sexy, irresistible scent.
Travel to the sunny Mediterranean waterfront with this solar citrus-floral fragrance.

Christina Aguilera's power can be defined as an innate confidence that radiates from within. It is something she intimately knows and exudes. Without a need for explanation, her presence alone, illuminates her inner strength.
Immersed in the romance of Violet, it is a dreamy, delicate and floral bounty infused with voluptuous notes. Reminiscent of fresh summer garden, this fragrance is as feminine as it is daring.

Eternity Summer transports you to an exotic retreat where natural beauty blends with blissful tranquility. Crystal clear waters shimmers in the summer sun. Palm leaves cast shadows and created a cool, airy elegance.

In the salon of a Parisian mansion, time is suspended while it searches for a good reason to continue. Water is bubbling on the hob, the teapot is waiting patiently. On the table, the cups and saucers are ready for this daily ritual, no Madeleine would ever miss. Like Madeleine of Proust, its sweetness and aroma bring back memories. In these gentle moments of nostalgia, the air is charged with emotion. The feeling that nothing could completely disappear.
A scent inspired by the classical artistic conception of Chinese gardens.
Grab your bags and set out for an impromptu adventure. The experience is real, it's what motivates you, it's what you become. The time is now and this time is yours.

Go just beyond reality to a place of sensual energy, powerful calm, daring discovery and intoxicating thrills. Transport yourself beyond traditional boundaries to a place that is at once familiar and mysterious. Find yourself in a unique union of fantasy, nature and technology.

Thameen’s Jewel in the Crown. Sapphire with its rich blue colours is the most precious gemstones. The Royal Sapphires adorn the Imperial State Crown and Sceptre used for British State Occasions and on display in the Tower of London. Royal Sapphire fragrance recreates the desired depth and dazzling brilliance of the crown jewels.

It is the smell of “artisanal” nights, of the countryside plowed by the tires of cars burned by improvised fires on a state road. It is that low-cost smudged lipstick, that nose placed on skimpy clothes with a strong smell of under-brand detergent, but which give sudden emotions, those of an excited youthful imagination.
R'oud Elements has a smouldering oud opening that will tingle your nose hairs, then after about twenty minutes, settles down to a velvety oud and lightly spicy woody amber fragrance.
This fragrance evokes the sweetness of divine moments in the sun. A magical, rejuvenating escape.
Spicy and ambery oriental, the intense version of the classic Sacrebleu floral has been infused with more spice and more seduction. A more complete execution of this famed floral.
All Play for Him, true to its positive image of well-being, dynamism and team sports, reveals a fragrance that is both aromatic and marine, which will accompany today's young men.

name_perfume: Fila For Woman Eau De Parfum
description: Fila for Woman is a sporting classic, ever-fresh but still unmistakenly chic and elegant.

“Midnight, the depth of the night, when the unexpected happens. Suddenly, a face appears. Someone tries to escape from the palace. The unknown shadow pulls out a shiny object… Is it a weapon? No, it's a bottle… Oud, clouds of heady smoke captive the senses, mixing majesty and allure to the mysterious character.”

With all her love, the perfumer created the true-love journey's fragrance that any charming young lady has ever dreamed of. She imagined a concentrate of passion and dressed it up with tender and loving tones.
A subtle, floral note, combining freshness with stimulating and antioxidising properties – the perfect partner of this Linden Honeysuckle fragrance.

It's true. You encounter a culture's deepest roots in its smallest towns. Today I got exceedingly lucky, it was the local patron saints day. Every little alleyway throughout all of Agrigento was abuzz with enthusiasm and delight.
Red Addict explores the floral and tasty side of saffron. A hypnotic and intoxicating seduction.

"I have a long-standing love affair with iris. The iris pallida absolue I've used here is one of the most expensive ingredients in perfumery. It's radical to put this much in a fragrance. The sillage is fantastic. This is a bomb, but a subtle bomb," Geza Schoen, Perfumer.
An intense men's fragrance with dark, powerful nuances.
Very Good Girl Glam is an ode to the power of femininity, fearless and brilliantly bold!
To capture the sensual mystery of an urbanite, the perfumer created an addictive cocktail that awakens the senses and acts as an olfactory hook that captivates you.

Boss Reflective Edition is a bold fragrance that celebrates the power of our unique reflections and spotlights the beauty in individuality. This unique scent is for the rule-breakers, risk-takers, and explorers. There is only one of you. So how will you reflect on your time?

Cool Water Ocean Extreme is the bitter and cool scent of explorers, the scent of deep water expeditions. It tries to paint the olfactory landscape of the purest salty, vast spaces and dazzling reflection of light on the deep blue ocean.

The amber soul of Mirage evokes the power of imagination, the capacity to picture through our mind's eye something that does not exist. Something so desirably real that it moves us. The graceful yet sensual and determined notes of this fragrance are like the photograph of a dream. Rapture, energy and delicious expressiveness are what best describe the character and the colorful composition of Mirage.
Palio by Lorenzo Siena, is an evocative fragrance that "transcends time".
A colourful and simple fragrance.

description: Whimsical and dreamy, this fragrance is a delicious cloud floating through the sky.
Beso Pasión evokes a fierce and passionate kiss tinted with mystery.

Stroll through Cairo's oldest souk. Under the vaulted arcades, merchants and curious onlookers rush to find treasures. Inspired by the frenzy of the place, Cuir Eternel invites you on a colourful olfactory journey.

Glamorous. Gorgeous. Golden Baby Phat Golden Goddess is a floral gourmand that captures the sensuality of a Goddess. This very sexy, divalicious fragrance allows all women to celebrate the riches that life has to offer and to experience the jet-set, glam lifestyle of Kimora Lee Simmons.

Here comes Le Male on Board, cabin boy extraordinaire, at your service. Ahoy, we're about to cast off, Le Male on Board is already surfing in fragrant sea foam. On this ship, we're all aboard, some of us are starboard, nobody is overboard and absolutely nobody is bored! On this ship, Le Male on Board is the latest recruit to the most memorable crew.
A classy, timeless scent, Musc & Néroli marries sensuality and elegance.
Embark on an exciting quest for infinity with this bold, paradoxical scent.
Autograph Pour Homme is a refined and seductive men's fragrance for the truly elegant gentleman.
Urban Sport is a fresh and clean perfume that will accompany men from morning to night whatever they choose to do.
Experience a fascinating and dangerously sensual night. Dare to stand out with this perfume for girls that will turn you into a real diva of the night.

This scent is a composition based on patchouli. This is not however an earthy, dark patchouli that would appear as base notes, but instead a luminous, fresh, energetic fragrance, as if there were a wellspring of patchouli in which you could take a refreshing dip.

Pure Grace is the clean smell of soap and water, the memory of fresh air woven into a set of crisp, white cotton sheets, a cold deep breath on a snowy winter night, the best summer morning you have ever known, the one white t-shirt that feels better than all the rest.
L'Occitane au Brésil reveals the beauty of the Amburana tree in the evening light to create a sophisticated fragrance.
Inspired by unforgettable nights that will be a part of your memory.

"I've always been fascinated by the futuristic beauty and plastic genius of some of the works of African statuary. Mysterious and hypnotic, they seem to have been shaped by extra-terrestrial hands. The meeting with a reliquary guardian figurine Fang (Gabon) made me want to explore the African theme again, ten years after Aomassai," Pierre Guillaume.

Men drawn to earthy, woodsy fragrances will be intrigued by the extraordinary scent of Castle Forbes Special Reserve Vetiver Eau de Parfum. Vetiver is a tropical grass with origins in India, well known in perfumery circles when a green earthy note is sought. Castle Forbes has sourced a premium extract of vetiver roots. Share with us a remarkable essence.
Gold asserts its riches and the Aoud its splendour with a journey through golden Arabian deserts. A hypnotic fragrance.
Scents of Bitter Orange and Grapefruit combined with spicy Ginger create an irresistible aroma with captivating notes that come together to create a fragrance leaving a sensation of pure pleasure.

The freedom of being yourself: unconventional, stubborn, vain. Unique. The courage to accept and the capacity to destroy. The audacity to live by your own rules. One song about Luca Gritti. And, now, the fragrance.
Açai Baie lets you opt for something fresh, feminine and sweet, and have you dreaming of warm summer days.

An homage to Quattro Pizzi, the most iconic palace that was home to Palermo’s most symbolic and prominent families. A perfume reminiscent of the Belle Époque era, where love, beauty and nobility entwine with secrecy and sin.
Playfully spirited, charmingly fun. The sparkling and bubbly twist of Daisy. It takes you to a place that is exhilarating and full of fun, happy and sunny.
A masculine fragrance intended as a tribute to Paris.
Bright and racy, Muskarat lands on the skin like a blooming amber and woody breath. A poetic alchemy.
If a green scent could murmur and purr, this one would. Aloe Vera is a light, almost transparent green fragrance, with a unique Aloe Vera twist that cannot easily be explained in words.

Elie Saab fashion show. Paris. With its precious fabrics and magnetic silhouettes, the collection glides across the runway as a spellbound crowd looks on. In the front row or on the catwalk, people have eyes only for her. Her luminous aura captures the attention. Her boundless energy electrifies the room. Her radiant smile brings time to a halt. Girl of Now.
“I wanted to capture the mysterious beginning of life. A cocktail of cold spices that stimulate an irresistible force radiating from start to end,” Françoise Caron, Perfumer.
Forever Mine enchants the senses with its seductive accords and exudes a touch of passion and extravagance.
The new Tom Tailor fragrance impresses with a pure male design and extracts the unique energy for every human being.
Hugo Red stimulates you, to raise the pressure and to achieve your personal best. Hugo Red is a pulsating, high-contrast fragrance of warm and fresh scents.
It is the hot wind of the Mediterranean that gives the inspiration and the impact of a charmer to Roccobarocco's fragrance, Scirocco, a perfume for men.

Esprit Infini, illustrated by the falcon, is an olfactory journey into a fairytale and prestigious world. This divine cocktail opens a strong connection between you and the spirit, a greater consciousness.
Eau du Ventoux is an invigorating fragrance for men who favour natural and exceptional fragrances.
The playful and sparkling quality of Daisy Eau So Fresh is held in a sleek and adorable pocket-sized bottle. This fresh floral excites the senses with a bright elegance and whimsical charm.
Turn a moment into a memory with a scent that captures the emotions.
The racy richness of deep, red berries with a dark heart of desolate black woods. Darkly noir. A heart-stopping thriller. Step into the night.

name_perfume: Pour Un Homme De Caron Le Matin
description: “With a surprising duo of lavandin and ginger, I wanted to offer an invigorating contemporary lift to the legendary Pour un Homme de Caron," Jean Jacques, in-house Perfumer.

Discovering a white garden refreshed by fountains; a breath of pollen floats in the air, Fleur Diamantine is aerial. Clear-cut, authentic, naive. Delicate, tender, light, opaline, floral. Creamy, downy, bed of moss.

The third daughter of Nejma. Three is a melody that is composed around floral accords, combining the floral notes with a woody note giving it a richer more modern structure. Three expresses all the exuberance of the orient without ever compromising it.

Andy Warhol declared Estée Lauder's original perfume Beautiful his "new favourite fragrance", so much so that he even wore it himself. Like Estée, Andy had a passion for flowers, capturing their beauty in bold pop art paintings. In 2020, for the first time, the two floral icons come together in the ultimate collaboration of a timeless scent to celebrate the 35th anniversary of Beautiful.

Little things such as smiling for something silly, enjoying a homely private moment, feeling beautiful for wearing something you adore, caress the face of someone you love, are the daily joys of life. Moments surrounded by an aura of tenderness, like blooming flowers, that actually hides pure emotional perfection.

Little may know that Ashura is, according to legend, the world's first dessert. Also known as Noah's Pudding, the dish was said to have first been prepared to celebrate Noah's Ark arrival at Mount Ararat.

Reborn is the call to action in and of itself. Our times are yearning for a sense of new birth. And the world has been changed already, so in a sense the planet is aching to be reborn, too. The man now goes fully and deeply into his origins within the ocean. There he re-forms, body and soul. He emerges in a burst of water and light. Being Reborn himself, he is ready to be a part of the Reborn world.

Boss Ma Vie Pour Femme was inspired by the independent spirit of a woman as she pauses to indulge in the simple moments in life; in this moment, she is at her most captivating, exuding a glow of femininity and confidence. Fresh, indulgent and fulfilling, this perfume, created around the cactus flower, invites you to take time to savour your life.

"Patchouli evokes richness and has many facets. There is always more to discover about its damp, wet, mossy, dry, almost dusty earthiness; It has power and depth. I wanted to create a new perfume for men with an accord of patchouli flowers on a deep resin, gourmand/incense body. Roses for men, why no!" Patricia de Nicolaï.

Viking, a fiery men's fragrance that bottles the fearless spirit of boundless exploration for the modern man who goes against the grain. Inspired by the incredibly crafted longships, a counter-piece of the Viking age and one of the greatest designs of the ninth century.

Soulmate Women stands for the close connection that two people share: a soulmate knows what the other person is thinking and feeling; he or she is someone who complements and understands one, without the need for long explanations or demands. The magic of a deep affinity is captured in this fragrance.
With this fragrance we celebrate the distinctive traits of the Leo: perfectionists and aesthetes, always seeking to excel, showing great discipline and a spirit of sacrifice.

Forever and a day. Radiant, enchanting love. A moment of pure happiness that will be treasured forever. A magical day in white, green and red! The emotion of the most beautiful day of your life, perfumed with the fragrance of Amarige Mariage.
Fresh but still mysterious. Modern, yet timeless. The composition of Silver Cliff is absolutely perfect both for women and men.
Freshen up in an instant and wake up your senses with Aquavibe Lemon.
A classic blend of fresh greens and warm woods combined with the modern feel of leather accords.

In the background Milan: your city, your roots. Floral and woody notes pamper you. You are an inveterate dreamer, with dreams too big to share outside your world. Always believe in your dreams, even if they are crazy, or too big.

"This sensual elixir begins with a zesty pear awakened by sparkling lemon, the heart envelops you in an unexpected accord of orange blossom and coffee to better conceal a mysterious base of felted vanilla and patchouli", Julie Massé, Perfumer.

An exchange of power and uncontrolled passion that extends to every corner of the body. Together they are even more powerful and sensual. Together they are the spirit of Water Bamboo. This is AGUA DE BAMBU HOMBRE!
An energetic and youthful scent with an addictive trail.
Her perfect love story leads to an eternal promise. With her elegant and passionate personality, she makes everyone around her fall in love with life.
The ideal perfume for the passionate and mischievous woman.
Electric fruits, a shock of pink, and lacquered appeal are at the heart of Candy Yum-Yum. The gourmand aspect of the scent makes it irresistible and addictive, creating a luscious finish.

It was the kind of moment you would want to revisit. Everyone was here, gathered on the terrace for breakfast, and the scent of fresh oranges was diffusing in the yellow heat. A symphony of their laughter and waves hitting the cliffs played in the air. Enjoy the iconic ORANGE SANGUINE in a limited edition bottle.

A mythical fragrance, symbol of extreme femininity, Opium represents a quest for the absolute on the edge of luxurious elegant eroticism. An empire for the senses, it encourages to stop time, break the rules and taboos to give free reign to mystery, dreams, and imagination. Beyond time and borders, it is a voyage to a symbolic, enigmatic and multi-faceted elsewhere. Losing oneself in its magic is a heady experience.

An attribute of immortal gods and a symbol of wealth, yellow gold offers an epic fragrance that is worthy of the Odyssey. Veni represents a voyage worthy of the greatest ancient epics and dedicated to all who have a thirst for adventure and the unknown.

Luscious lotus flowers skim the surface of a shimmering pond in the ancient Hanging Gardens. Their delicate water-splashed petals glide down the shaded walkways, sweeping over the plump, juicy figs that punctuate the bountiful trees. This light floral fragrance captures the essence of a luxuriant landscape.
Inspired by ancient tales of live-giving elixirs that grant immortality, Elixir has a pure heart with a sensual base.

Misterious Oud emits sensual and aphrodisiac notes, dedicated to the customer who loves refinement and unicity without forgetting the elegance of simplicity. This precious fragrance is refined, distinguished and elegant in the true spirit of La Martina.

Musc: the gleaming gong, the resonate echo of the most beautiful scents imagined since the birth of the word 'perfume'. In our imagination is reflected equally; beauty, refinement, cruelty. The perfect alchemy of the complexity of the senses in their most extreme contradiction. This scent captures the spirit of Kubla Khan, the successor of Gengis Khan, whose sumptuous train of living was described in The Book of Marco Polo wherein is recounted the Wonders of the World. It is the quintessence of the lavish life, a delight on the skin.

The most Mediterranean interpretation of Solo Loewe. A light fragrance, notable for its very Spanish notes and essences. Intended for a man overwhelmed with material possessions, searching inside himself for his true essence. Based on the concept of "harmony of extremes".
White represents purity and minimalism. Coffee represents one of the most appetising smells. An olfactory combination that is sweet and explosive at the same time.
This scent embarks us in the time of the dream of the creation of the Earth, a period when everything was only spiritual and immaterial for the Aborigines.

The scent of a new day. It is a vibrant, sparkling fragrance as the dawn of a new day. The desire to stay forever subjugated by the Miracle of life. The power to make every second of your life a Miracle. Today and every day, over and over again.

description: Through Uomo, Baldessarini presents a modern, seductive and masculine fragrance, inspired by the breathtaking backdrop of the Amalfi Coast and the Italian feel for life, la dolce vita. The impressive composition evokes the fresh sea spray of the coast and is gently transformed into a spicy, woody composition on the skin, with charming masculine facets.
Verveine Cactus combines the freshness of the verveine with the green, aquatic notes of cactus. A thirst-quenching fragrance.
