description: “The mystery of the name drove me to create a fragrance that seems to be all things to all people, but itself is certain and assured, whilst creating ambiguity in others,” Roja Dove.

The Modern Princess is glamourous, untamed and fiercely sensual. She uses her own free will, playing with secrets and certainties. She has never been held prisoner of anything, nor of anyone. She creates her own destiny. Her freedom is precious.

Even the most chic girl hides a mysterious side, a private territory where she takes refuge when she feels amusingly unruly. It is the place of secrets, temptations and desires. It is her irreverent soul that she discloses only to a few and with which she loves to play. Unpredictability is her emblem. Mystery is her essence.

Dedicated to Leonardo da Vinci, “A man without letters” as he himself put it, and yet someone who was to become one of the great geniuses of humanity. Inspired by the desire to celebrate this mysterious yet reserved character, who possessed a generous and passionate heart, Enygma was born, an mysterious fragrance, exciting, unusual and unconventional.
This unusual fragrance has a refreshing top note, a balmy heart, and is like a relaxing seaside walk.
This star that illuminates us and takes us into its arms is the reflection of a warm, sensual woman who seeks the passion of the senses in the sun.
M·A·C's Air of Style is a contemporary scent for a can't-be-tamed attitude with notes that get the pulse racing and make you feel unabashedly bold.

name_perfume: Life By Esprit Summer Edition Woman 2015
description: Celebrate summer with this cheerful, positive fragrance.

ingredients: ['Ylang-ylang', 'Bitter Orange', 'Incense / Olibanum', 'Jasmine', 'Lily Of The Valley', 'Rose', 'Tuberose', 'Cardamom', 'Cedarwood', 'Guaiac Wood', 'Plum', 'Sandalwood', 'Tonka Bean', 'Vetiver']
description: The narrative, olfactory evolution of this glorious fragrance, was inspired by the start of a pilgrimage in search of knowledge. A timeless classic, born of the age-old art of haute parfumerie.

Sweet-and-salty water brought back from a beach on the other side of the world. With Long Courrier, "Long distant flight", that evokes faraway destinations, beaches on the other side of the world, lazy days gorged with sea spray and the delicious scent of suntan lotion… a highly contrasted formula for a powdery, tender and sensual fragrance.
A wonderfully exotic, spicy and honeyed fragrance. Gently sweet and slightly musky, Oud Dream is a sensual and bewitching fragrance. As in a dream, this refined creation has a leathery sillage.

The essence of a green, blooming desert shimmers in the warm air. Bright, crisp notes are wrapped in sunstruck woods, capturing both the sandy heat of the day and the cool vastness of the still night.

Two white hands emerge against the light, moving so slowly that they re-define the shadows, making them look darker. The contours of the body, illuminated by a gleam of light seeping through an open door, offer contrast. She moves forward, trampling the stars beneath her feet, her smile broadens. With all the virtue of vice, this tight black dress had such a fluid shape that I could revel in its language…

The early sunshine, dipped in gold, pulls you outside to devour the day. A shower of light, a sense of yourself, space to reflect. Luminous and excited, you shine through the day at the speed of light.
A truly yummy fragrance that charms with an unforgettably intense, gourmand scent trail that will have you smelling good enough to eat.

Live in the moment for the future is what motivates us. Whispers of Time tells a tremendous tale of consciousness and reflection in equal proportions. Collections of forgotten snapshots prove patience and time produce happiness and growth.

La Selle is distinguished, sombre, smoky, a real unbridled concentration of leather. The fragrance teleports us to a vintage smoking room with precious tobacco leaves, antique books and weathered leather club chairs. Olfactory acrobatics that give the leather fragrance a good whipping.
Byzantine Amber is an intense and decadent perfume, like a great civilisation in the final phase of its splendour.
Soleil de Jeddah Afterglow is a sensual and voluptuous version of Soleil de Jeddah. A magnificent and captivating fragrance with a rich trail.
Black Amber is a sumptuous, sensual, captivating and simply irresistible composition.

The moon is the abject of our dreams and never ceases to fascinate. lts beauty has bewitched man since the beginning of time. Taking inspiration from its emblematic Luna collection, Korloff has created a perfume in its image.
Described as a juicy, delicious and very sophisticated fragrance!
Let the aroma of a sweet treat take you to the patisserie of your dreams.
“What I love about this project for Elie Saab, is the very positive air of self-assured femininity,” Francis Kurkdjian, Perfumer.

An evening in winter or just the wish to feel oneself enveloped in softness. A cashmere sweater or the arms of a loved one. To rest one's head against a welcoming and perfumed nape. To breathe and abandon oneself… to doze off.
Magnetic Wood is an energetic fragrance that invigorates the wearer, like the sun bringing forth the first flowers. Fresh and elegant, it is a sophisticated Yin fragrance that renews and enriches.

The Dahab woman creates magic, she is hypnotic, mysterious and enchanting; has a defying confidence. Her character exudes richness, with one look, she turns things into gold; she defies luxury - she IS luxury.
The perfumer has created a stimulating and exciting fragrance for today's discerning man. This powerfully expressive fragrance appeals to sporty, smart and the style conscious man.
With Honest, Helene Fischer reveals even more about herself and her remarkable character, which is reflected in her songs. The all-rounder comes across like her scent: honest, honest!
Crazy Drop invites you to say yes to the desires and pleasures of life. Above all, it creates a sense of comforting tenderness.
Jazz up your evening or pep up your day with this mesmerising fragrance! It has a secret strong lingering aroma that celebrates your every mood.

Late night on Crosby Street. A beautiful, passionate, allencompassing first kiss. The smell of salty caramel blended with sweet amber creates an irresistible,slightly intoxicating and

addictive experience. A kiss you won't forget.
An authentic, classy fragrance, for a chic and relaxed lifestyle, for the privileged, self-assured, and assertive man.
Masculinity is embodied in the lively, fruity and spicy aromtic fragrance - at once a refined classic, yet at the same time fun and ready to party.

Santal Royal, a rare and precious wood majestically rises up in the penumbra. A fragrance trail that unfolds in a play of subtle contrasts between dark leather notes, the oud accord and the delicacy of floral notes of jasmine and rose.
Dance to the rhythm of the sunset and have fun! Dancing Sunset is your perfume.
A signature of an intense fragrance. The main accord, amber, signals a long-lasting, sensual and unforgettable trail.

Signorina Libera spreads sensations of energy and radiance, inviting all women to express their unique personalities and follow their own path with the courage and confidence of being who they are, beyond any fear or prejudice, supporting each other and embracing the empowering values of joy and togetherness.

A secret liaison; a young mademoiselle escapes from her overprotective chaperones and finds a warm embrace in forbidden love. Something Gold by Oscar de la Renta is a shy yet subtly impetuous scent, filled with hidden energy and eagerness for adventure as a young woman on the cusp of meeting the world on her own.
Just like a tattoo gives confidence, this scent provides strength and well-being to those who choose it, and those who catch a wisp of its trail as well.
Axolute is inspired by the sea, by its sense of freedom, and the desire for adventure that it instills. A perfume of great glamour that touches your soul.
A chill in the back, the dusty streets of the Kasbah, the dream to escape to a new destination.
The 7 Virtues will release Patchouli of Rwanda, on United Nations Peace Day.

Based on the same philosophy as the first Crazy Hours perfume with fresh top notes contrasting woody base notes. The fragrance denotes the same emotion when you see Franck Muller's iconic Crazy Hours ‘not everything is what it seems’ watch. The number 6 also represents love and harmony.

When the night takes on its own life, the tempo changes. Take along, languorous breath. Linger till dawn, keep your head in the stars. You're suspended in time. A sophisticated and concentrated eau de parfum.

This harmonious scent is inspired by the magnificent Akoya pearls that enchant with the wonder of roundness and shades of colour. The blend evokes the iridescent hues and smooth, polished texture of a precious white pearl.

Envolée de Néroli is bright, fresh, and dynamic accords of citrus and greenery. This sparkling and invigorating scent gradually gives way to floral and powdery facets, for a delicate and sophisticated fragrance.
"I created PHILIPPE for men like me who appreciate intense yet refined fragrances, classic, timeless, chic with a modern touch. It's what I call 'the art of living the difference.'" Philippe Charriol

“For me, scent is really important and Elite Gentleman Weekend reflects my personal style. It's a classic, masculine scent with a modern twist that carefully balances woody and citrus notes. It's effortlessly wearable every day but I'm mostly looking forward to wearing it for weekend escapades in the sun.” Jamie Redknapp.
A classic fruity floral scent that makes life always interesting.
Provencial Sage has been created as a tribute to the rich heritage and lush botanical gardens of Provence in the south of France, an area known as the birthplace of perfumery.

"Inventing a way to enhance the Trussardi collection experience is an exciting adventure for a perfumer. How can one maximise a fragrance without altering its uniqueness? To create this 'primer', I had the idea of a musk cloud; a sort of musky complex that subtly intensifies fragrances. I worked with a light velvety scent that is comforting, yet addictive," Leslie Gauthier, Perfumer.
Express your love with this dreamy luscious fusion. Part of the new BE fragrance collection. Fun, daring, romantic. A scent that captures your fabulous side. Be who you want to be.
Taking the clary sage plant as its inspiration from its soft green scent right down to its velvety leaves, this fragrance is like lying on lush cool grass on a hot sunny day.

With inspiration from the movie Inception, the composition in this fragrance moves through six phases, rather than the three phases typical of traditional perfumes. The fragrance has been created much like a musician would have - the light tones first, then the deeper, providing full coverage of our feelings and senses.
Romantic and smooth, the Jequiti Larissa Manoela Love demonstrates the lovable personality of this talented teen star. Take it in your bag everywhere and rock!

The legend begins at the birth of the Dahlia Divin Goddess. Natural, free from all artifice, the Dahlia Divin Goddess bares her soul. The very essence of her divinity takes shape. Just one limpid drop of her perfume is enough to recreate her soul.

214 Violeta & Sândalo is the perfect gathering of the strength of Violet notes with the intensity of woody notes, combined with the soft and velvety touch of the Cuir Velours Chord , which refers to the most delicate facet of the leather. This surprising encounter gave birth to an authentic fragrance like his own skin.
A textured scent with sparkling and elegant accords.
This woody spicy fragrance evokes warmth and smoothness.
A bright, sparkling scent that will envelop you with its precious accords.

"L’Or de J'Adore goes back to basics, celebrating the beauty of flowers carried in a smooth and solar concentrate. The gold of J’Adore is in all its flowers,” Francis Kurkdjian, Perfume Creation Director.
Inspired by the strive between harmony and balance in life, Avon Real is a fragrance for man full of warmth and energy.

Betty Barclay Pure Style is a transparent and pure perfume that is nevertheless totally soft and feminine. Its modern and vibrant character matches the concept perfectly and successfully embodies the color 'white'.
A scent reminiscent of a time when fiery courtesans spread their spells over cities, and the secret and intoxicating dramas of love stirred the imagination.
Walk in nature, surrounded by flowers, swim in the fresh water and relax for a while. Oudh 36 is sheer purity.
A provocative contrast between a top full of freshness and a heart that beats in spicy, vibrant woods, sensual, creamy leather to embody a true modern masculine.
Volatile, manic and a little bit raw, Loud for Him is a distorted guitar riff that echoes and reverberates.
Citrus fruits bring freshness, the blend of jasmine and iris gives magnitude to the heart, vanilla, accented with balsamic notes brings an exalted sensuality.

ingredients: ['Ambroxan (Ambergris)', 'Woody Notes', 'Ethyl Acetate (Fruity notes)', 'Iso E Super (Cedarwood Note)']
description: Aetheroxyde. Far away, very far away, you vaguely smell a beautiful fresh and contemporary wood; closer, there is this strange "ether accord”, a sort of gentle steam, which approaches the skin like a breath of burning wood. An emanation of love. "And if peace had a smell ?" she asked me, a little worried. "It might be like this," I replied.
Ekos Flor Da Manhã (Morning Flower) brings the light of dawn in a fragrance that is ideal to be used during the day.

In a charming medieval Florence, a young writer and member of the Guild of Physicians and Apothecaries is waiting for a new dawn to start writing the first verses of his opera. A celebration of renewal and of his love for Beatrice. Black pepper, pink pepper, and cloves create a mysterious and intriguing atmosphere.

Between Us has a delightful heart of floral petals that brings delicate intrigue, this is soon followed by the mystery and sensuality of gourmand notes in the base with will seduce you in this outstanding fragrance.

name_perfume: What We Do In Paris Is Secret
description: This unique scent unveils what lies under the perfumer's virtuosic skill: the secret of a perfumer's soul.

Agonist Isis, a perfume dedicated to a vision: the flowers trapped in the ice during the winter and that the new season frees, exploding with energy; the new life of nature. There is a deep connection between winter and spring, and this transition, even though violent, is remarkably similar to the tension that exists in glass when it is being blown … a creative tension that then explodes into a new form.

A homage to a great classic scent, the new recipe will win over new admirers just as much as it appeals to established fans. A remix of sensual impressions, it reinvents the familiar while creating something and original.
The moment I perfume myself, I am me with myself, I am me for me. Instance Harmonia is the key to reconnect with yourself and live in harmony.

Effortlessly sensual and sophisticated, Fierce Perfume is an undeniable feminine take on our signature scent. Striking the balance of classic and contemporary, this perfume captures the essence of desire.

Baccarat Rouge 540. Powerful and distinguished, it's name evokes a metamorphosis of a clear crystal mingled with 24-carat gold powder and gradually brought to fusion at 540 degrees arousing a glowing scarlet appearance.
Be always in style. Polish your look with this captivating fragrance: Far Away.
The architecture of this perfume is based on two facets: a fresh green note, both timeless and comfortable, and a textured woody drydown to highlight its undeniably chic and sophisticated character.

Like a rallying cry, Givenchy today invites women to have the courage to step into that space beyond convention. To embrace the frisson of freedom and forbidden sensations. To transgress imaginary, real, invented limits and codes. Because sometimes the only limit is within. L'Interdit is a fragrance to remind us that sometimes audacity is the key to freedom. And that beyond what might hold one back, lie many of life's thrills.
Addictive and surprising. Created to challenge the world with your presence. Amsterdam, a night-time lover characterised by an aromatic accord.
Zeus pour Femme is an exquisite fragrance that was designed for the energetic and confident woman. This gorgeous scent is suitable to wear at night, at parties or any special occasion.
Wearing this fragrance is like entering a flowery forest, a virtual landscape, dreamy and iridescent, where you walk on a carpet of soft musks.

After the long winter months, you will want to put on your summer dress and dance with abandon across the nearest flower meadow. Feels Like Summer Women captures the sweet flair of the warm season that will envelope its wearer with the most beautiful essences of fresh flowers.
Let yourself be swept up in a whirlwind of combined universes. Be passionate. Feel alive. Fall in love.
Her sensual, tender sillage charms and captivates. She is mysterious and dreamy. She is every woman. She is THE woman.

Victory is a perfect match for powerful and confident men. As its name says, it is a perfume for men who like to win and are not afraid to take risks. Powerful and attention-grabbing wherever they go.
A soft, sensual, warm fragrance full of sweet, feminine elegance.

Embrace your inner nature and revitalise your mind and body with the power of the great outdoors whenever you breathe in Animale Seduction Homme. This rejuvenating men's cologne blends precious accords for a bright, invigorating scent that's sure to enhance your confidence with each application.
A fresh, masculine fragrance built around a refined woody accord, with lively citrus top notes.

When the hot desert wind arrives, it carries with it the fragrance of cypress hedges and a shower of rose petals in a sumptuous oriental palazzo. Sublime Rose opens the doors of perception to a modern fairy tale of A Thousand and One Nights.
Divine Decadence is a seductive statement of opulence and sophistication. The fragrance captures the iconic taste and style of the original Decadence, in a bright and sparkling version.
Bottega Veneta Pour Homme Parfum interprets and enhances the values as well as capturing the balance between tradition and contemporary sophistication of the Bottega man.

Inspired by the life, work and enthusiasms of the prominent French modernist designer Charlotte Perriand, and the Japanese rose that bears her name, it is an intense yet tender fragrance, nuanced and expansive, with remarkable longevity, intended to appeal to all genders.
In the great tradition of the fragrance classics, this luxurious fragrance is blended within a classical oriental architecture resulting in a sublime couture fragrance experience.
Timeless and avant-garde, Amabile is an exceptional fragrance that has inspired many but was never equaled.
This warm and invigorating cologne will leave a subtle layer of scent on the skin.

A young masculine, yet sophisticated scent. Like a camera, Argentic captures that moment in time. An instant that awakens strong emotions. Each souvenir can be brought to life forever thanks to the olfactive focus.

“Days in my grandfather’s garden were spent among his plants. Pots of patchouli lined the patio; the aroma from rub-bing their green leaves on my wrists. The scent of the stream drew me bare-foot into its water. I paddled under the watchful gaze of my father and grandfather, No. 02 is an invitation to walk among the flowers, shed your shoes at the river and recover that which has been lost.” Tonya Kidd-Beggs
Tehani means in Tahitian the caress of fragrant flowers. Isolated amidst the blue waters of the ocean, the island and the richness of the endemic flora transport us to paradise.

It’s never too late to stroll down la rue des Remparts in Bordeaux. While window-shopping you never know what to choose, what will please you, what will seduce you. Then suddenly there it is, just sitting there. Surrounded by chocolate croissants, a praline heart coated with a vanilla husk, sprinkled with orange zest. We're about to push the door then walk away. We must be strong! But the desire is still there; it’s stronger than ever and we can't resist any longer. But what fun it is to succumb to a whim.

She carries her memories like her scent. They surround her, they endure, and they speak her name. She is a collector and among her souvenirs can be found the beauty of beginnings, and the ache of endings. In the sacred of her heart lie the sacred and the profane they come together like the notes of her fragrance. She doesn't linger long at the altar of regret. She lights the candle and burns the incense at the shrine of remembrance and expectation, pleasure and pain, in anticipation of the glorious memories yet to come.
A robust yet fresh intensity with the power of the dark deep oud notes.
Orange a spicy contemporary men's fragrance.
Nativa SPA Verbena is a freshness that envelops and moisturises the skin. A unique perfume, both explosive and refreshing that will leave your skin scented and hydrated all day!

Elevate your daily routine with Azra, the perfect everyday fragrance. Its enchanting rose scent harmoniously blends with the sweet notes of nashi pear and raspberry, making each day a fragrant masterpiece.

It is hard for foreigners to imagine, but there is also a dry, arid Brazil, and that is what Terra is all about. That moment right after the sun sets, and the temperature drops – even if not dramatically. It appears here as a contrast to the Brazilian rainforest. It comes from the idea of the soil the warm earth and has the power of a blanket. It can make one think of cognac. Wearing Terra is like putting the heat back on.
Rocking my senses down the channel into the light, leaving behind a poem and a scent in a bottle.

Sunny and invigorating, Passiflora blends the flavour of a sun-soaked passion fruit with the smoothness of ylang-ylang flowers, in an aquatic freshness reminiscent of the crystalline waters of a lagoon.

name_perfume: Esprit Pure Summer Edition For Women
description: Enjoy the fragrance of the sunset in summer. An invigorating, floral, fruity, feminine fragrance!

The top notes include forget-me-not, wild lily of the valley, bergamot and yuzu. This combination is accented with mandarin and blackcurrant buds. The heart contains apricot, rose and jasmine while the soul of the fragrance is warmed by vanilla, rare wood, sycamore and cedar. A fresh, airy note, Hedione, holds the three parts of the composition together.

Indulge in the idyllic scent of a tropical sunrise over crystal clear waters and pure white sand. Azur Crystal offers a fresh, yet exotic, aroma and allows you to experience the crisp notes of coconut water and fresh florals, layered over a musky, citrus zest.

The relationship between women and jewellery has always been inexplicable. For this reason, Aurien Rubra looked for inspiration in high international jewellery and translates the femininity of pink gold, also known as Rubedo. A unique beauty that captures the nobility of gold, the lustre of silver and the warmth of copper in a simply stunning blend. The most feminine side of pink gold, fascinating and charming.

name_perfume: Fila For Man Eau De Toilette
description: Fila Man is a sporty and fresh, yet elegant and passionate fragrance. It is perfect for the vibrant, active man.
Floral, fruity, and tantalising.
The intoxicating scent of a field of tuberose at night.
Not a rose at all, but a white flower like jasmine or orange blossom, with creaminess and a carnal nature emphasised, putting the complete sexiness of this fragrance on full display.
Boulevard Haussmann is the icon of luxury and grandeur. Our fragrance is the history of a native Parisian, a culture imbued character, who exemplifies elegant maturity and heady passion.

An island arrival, as evening wanes. Stepping into humid darkness, the air is dense with a silent chorus of night-blooming flowers. Heat wave is the scent of complicity in paradise, steamy and decadent, a sophisticated contemporary bouquet.
In the shade of a linden tree, the sparkling notes of citron and violet leaves lend a welcome freshness, while the Provencal sun envelops us in its fragrant flower embrace.
A surprising twist on a classic French vanilla eau de parfum.
À la Rose is an ode to femininity, a declaration of love translated into a fragrance. Two hundred and fifty freshly bloomed roses from Grasse offer their unequalled richness to every bottle.

Cristal d'Or is a fragrance as luxurious and delicate as gold. With deep, sensual and intense facets, it is made for the exuberant and enigmatic woman, who lives in the moment and knows how to bend the rules without breaking them.
An invitation to surrender to your most secret desires. A provocative journey into a hidden world of sensuality and attraction. Are you ready to give in?

To open your arms so wide it's as if they were wings deployed to take flight. When you feel stifled, suffocated and crowded by constant pressure and the everyday grind, the call of the sea is all it takes to elicit fantasies of freedom. Called "L'Immensité", this fragrance carries the promise of a unique horizon, with which to invent a thrilling new life.

Spirited and free, frenetic, passionate. She moves to a new rhythm. Her bearing is unique. This ultra-modern woman cannot be reined in: an attitude cannot be tamed, it can only be admired, celebrated! Bold and cerebral, intensely feminine, she listens to the gallop of her heart. A woman in motion: the evident embodiment of Hermès.
A fragrance dedicated to Napoleon Bonaparte and Josephine, his beloved consort, more than two hundred years ago.
Bad Boys eau de toilette is composed of regressive Cologne notes that support the confident side of the Bad Boy with its woody notes. His character asserts itself and he assumes his attitude!

Combining easy to wear, fresh and sporty sexiness with the hidden depths of warm spice, precious woods and expensive leather. It is a thoroughly modern and distinctive interpretation of a favourite theme; a scent that will transport its wearer atop a luxury yacht on the open seas.
As sensuous and luminous as the Italian countryside. This fragrance perfectly captures the warm light and relaxed sensuality of a romantic hillside villa.
Hot and floral, this fragrance is eternally feminine.
Elite is reminiscent of a burst of sunshine streaming from the sky in all its majestic splendour. Revel in the divine sophistication of this fresh, bright perfume full of playfulness.
A hypnotic composition that mesmerises with an alluring heart and a mysterious base that evokes a powerful wild instinct.

The original classic fragrance housed in a new flacon. M7 is the 7th Men's fragrance by Yves Saint Laurent. Intensely masculine and elegant in a bottle made of dark amber glass, it expresses a new vision of male sensuality. A fresh, woody, sensual fragrance.

Its name recalls the legendary address of Guerlain, 68 Avenue des Champs-Élysées in Paris, and refers to its composition based on 68 raw materials. Fresh and spicy, it pulls you in with its contemporary facets, marked by the values of originality and quality so dear to the brand.
Revel in the opulence of Jovan's Silky Rose, a captivating floriental fruity fragrance.
The thrill on the skin, the rush of adrenaline, and the heart beating faster. A spray for amplified sensations. Succumb to the Black Opium addiction.

name_perfume: J'Adore Eau De Parfum Roller Pearl
description: J'adore, the spontaneous and joyful expression famously used by Monsieur Dior to guide him in his creative decision making. It's the expression that caught the fancy of the Christian Dior Parfums team and answers as if by magic Jean Cocteau's pronouncement about Christian Dior: "This subtle genius of our time holds the magic pun in his name with the words God and Gold."
Inspired by Jennifer Lopez's inner beauty, power, and glow on stage. Her presence, her energy, all eyes on her. She captivates her audience one more time with her unique glow.

The horse's gallop echoes in the early morning quiet. The sun starts to peek out over the rooftop of a nearby farmhouse. Its rays illuminate the vast runs through the green land like a sparkling dividing line, separating creation from what has been created.
A princess who looks like a lolita, but she is sexy and uninhibited. Arrogant yet true, young yet flamboyant. Sweet rebellion can allow you to meet your truest self.

With this creation, Guerlain captures the most affirming expression of femininity: an irrepressible love of life. Beaming happiness. The magnetic radiance of a woman who captures light and returns it to those around her.
It is an outcome of a wonderful collection of extracts that carry the secret of life.
Rive Gauche. A state of mind, a way of being, a lifestyle. A unique, avant-garde perfume for an independent and unpredictable woman.
Arabesque takes you on an olfactory journey through the enchanting and mystical Middle East, based on flowers, fruits and woods entwined together and found in Islamic art.
Like a powerful swell breaking against the shore, Blasted Heath evokes the moment where the Land meets the Sea and energy explodes.
Kirsch evokes the twisting tension of a first date. A traditional sake headspace.
Vicky Tiel's Pour L'Amour is an alluring and addictive perfume with a seductive edge.
After a very fresh and aromatic start, the heart reveals itself, fiery and flamboyant. The sweet woody base notes give the fragrance all its sensuality. Totally glamorous and addictive.

At the edge of a mysterious and fantastical universe, a woman connected to her deepest nature and guided by her instinct discovers a new horizon of light beckoning to her. Aura Eau De Toilette is an aromatic interpretation of colourful, glowing freshness.

A perfume that bears the name Piccadilly will mean different things to different people, but we can all be agreed that it should reflect an air of dynamism, decadence and grandeur, crowned by a homage to the statue of Eros, god of love, that stands in Piccadilly Circus.

Mystic like the incense that purifies the air of a gothic cathedral, suggestive and persistent as the humidity distilled by the secrets of a castle. Medieval images that focus on an alchemy of pungent and soft yet calm and fervent notes, ancestral but wholly new.
This energetic, sparkling and vibrant scent brings out the timeless refinement of this masculine scent, evocative of a black Fiat 500, a symbol of Italian elegance.
A fresh, delicate scent with a lingering bold and beautiful base.

007 for Women is a fragrance inspired by the iconic women found in Bond's seductive and daring world. The fragrance is 'dangerously seductive' itself, with a unique mix of ingredients that blend signature femininity with intangible mystery into a modern interpretation of an oriental fragrance.

In this Mad World, it’s ok not to be ok. Enter this zen-like grounding fragrance that feels like a little moment of calm amidst the madness. The setting? A peaceful inner oasis far from the chaos and demands of modern life, filled with the scent of osmanthus flowers. Take a step forward into a citrus green aura that wraps around you like a protective shroud. As you keep going, top notes of bergamot gently peel away to reveal a smoky ethereal lapsang souchong heart.

Sweet yet sour, its plucky pineapple charm reminds us that life too can be bittersweet and full of contrasts. But remember, for every tear shed, there’s a ray of sunshine waiting around the corner!
This scent is evocative, sensual and enveloping.
This Christmas, Tease gets the gift of glam. Inspired by the excitement of the holiday season, we created a new take on the trend for gourmand fragrance: Tease Glam, the gift that keeps on giving.

Hidden behind each Le Galion fragrance is a poet, a musician. A fragrance is more than the result of mixing flowers into a bouquet or adding spices and woods to a selection of flowers. It requires a touch of magic, something Paul Vacher used to add when creating his masterpieces, much like others compose poetry and music.

Fresh emanation inviting nudity, warmth, and sexuality. This source, a fragrance of well-being, relaxes tension and stimulates the body in letting go. Essential for a warm bath before surrendering to its enveloping fog. A perfume of abandonment.

Petitgrain Paraguay is a fragrance of classic elegance with a modern twist. The vibrant freshness of citrus fruits creates a joyful hint of sparkle and vitality enhanced by the vegetal note of petitgrain, giving a subtle earthy undertone to the composition.

As the undisputed queen of the flowers, there is no other symbol of romance and femininity quite as powerful as the rose. In the fragrance Betty Barclay pure pastel rose, this flower enchants us in a girlish interpretation. Youthfully fresh and creamy-soft.
Just like the Gentlewoman, this eau de cologne with its feminine edge is stamped with a specific genre. A masculine fragrance dedicated to women.

The Boss man is primed to succeed - competitive, driven and ambitious. His daily preparation rituals are integral to his personal quest for success and Boss Bottled has become an established part of his daily armour. Boss Bottled Night is destined to become the secret weapon in the Boss man's armoury of seduction, instilling him with the same compelling presence that underpins his success by the day.

31, rue Cambon: a legendary place, the epicenter of the world of Coco Chanel. Now, as in the past, the building is organised around four floors: the boutique, the haute couture salon, the apartment, the design studio, and the workshops.

An emotion of serenity and beauty emerges from Fontfroide Abbey, an exceptional place, surprising and mysterious at the same time. This Cistercian abbey invites us on a journey through time, along its stone walls and vaults. In this place full of character, the sacred perfume of hot balsams and resins resounds.
A distinctly aromatic masculine scent that you can take from the boardroom or an elegant night on the town to a thrilling and exciting day of adventures.
Odyssey Homme is a perfect modern fragrance that will give you an unmistakable charisma and allow you to achieve your goals easily.
L’Evidence, is a story of freedom, the idea of leaving a mark for a better world.
Voyage en Inde takes us on a fragrant journey through royal palaces of ancient India.
Intimate is an effortlessly sensual fragrance with an eclectic combination of refined ingredients.

name_perfume: Ange Ou Démon Le Parfum : Accord Illicite
description: Revive your instinct for seduction by spraying on the Ange ou Démon fragrance wherever you wish. Apply a drop depending on your mood and turn up the heat. Behind your ears, between your breasts, in the small of your back and behind your knees, even inside your wrists, add the finishing touch that will spark a new fantasy. The intense trail becomes dangerously addictive.

This work was inspired by the discovery of a Constellation, that of the Vela, visible from a faraway country on the other side of the Atlantic Ocean, in the southern hemisphere. It tells the tale of a land that appears, exotic and mysterious in the eyes of two children who, for the first time, are prepared to face a long adventurous journey.

Marquee is Xerjoff JTC's invitation to the theatre, to discover the lively perfume of backstage, a real show within a show. There is no fakery backstage, just spontaneous bustle and at the same time the tryouts for pre-show preparations. Marquee by Xerjoff JTC is pure, distilled theatricality in a perfume that is both sparkling and luxurious.
From slopeside to fireside, experience a winter chalet and take in the night with Nightsip.
Flamboyant, stylish, and spontaneous.
This is an elegant perfume with a rich dry down.

It’s impossible to do without this mineral freshness, as sharp as a flint, an ode to the voluptuous perfection of nature. A surprising fusion between stone and earth, this revitalizing perfume leaves a spirited wake that reconciles freshness and depth.

After Ballerina No.1 evoking the very young ballerina and Ballerina No.2 revealing a prima donna in her prime, Rosine presents Ballerina No.3. This charming and strangely evocative creation reveals the most secret and dark part of the ballerina.
This classy perfume presents an intense, mesmerising touch with an enchanting dry down.
Scent of Dubai is a bewitching fragrance that will cast a spell over those around you.
An olfactory creation like a new sensory journey to unknown territories. A royal and majestic fragrance.

Sunkissed and covered in sand, the Malibu Surf Girl is at home by the beach. She calmly breathes in the warm salty air as she waits for the perfect swell to cascade across the horizon. Early mornings give way to days filled with free-spirited adventure while the afternoons drift away to the soothing crash of waves.
Clive Christian's magnum opus. Rare and exotic flora are rendered timeless in this sparkling homage to the finest ingredients in perfumery. Truly worth of the name No1.
Maharjan Silver is like a flying carpet that takes you on a sensual journey from an Arabian fairy tale.
To complete our sun routine, let yourself be seduced by French Riviera. Just two sprays to leave your skin deliciously scented.

Let yourself be carried away by Red dress, an eau de parfum skilfully combining sensuality and fruity notes. In its greatest femininity, Red dress invites you into its secret universe. The scent of eternal love.

Coated with secret scents passed from princess to princess, Queen Malika tricked and captured her seamstress' beautiful younger brother. His body tries to escape. It failed. He just fell madly in love. An inescapable and hypnotic scent.

On a sun-drenched afternoon, intimate moments captured, forever. Two lovers hand out overlooking the sloping rooftops, gazing up at the Eiffel Tower, getting lost in the winding backstreets of Paris. Longing gazes and sweet scents, excited for what's next … my sweetheart, forever.

Master Perfumer Jordi Fernández, reinvents his iconic creation Gold Immortals through a quintessential essence. The extrait de parfum emphasises all the sensuality of the original scent through a brand new combination of scents.

The intensely herbal, lively and fresh opening evokes the passion within you. It rekindles an irresistibly captivating dazzle in your eyes, leading you on an opulent sweet-smelling adventure. With Opulent Sapphire, you are the fire.
Inspired by the floral green wave of the 70's, this feminine theme has been twisted with a woody overdose to make it more 'androgyne'.
Addictive Vibration. The Imperceptible forces of desire are awakening. Thrilling and striking, a perfume that signs an irreversible olfactory footprint.
Crabtree & Evelyn's Sienna captures old-world luxury in this masculine blend of leather, citrus and spice, with a just a hint of fire and herbs.
For the rebels. The thinkers. And the leaders. A powerful fragrance with its own electric current. A strikingly modern blend.

She's coy and clever with a wink. Her smile, her youthful spirit, light-hearted and charming. Oh, Lola! is vibrant and playful. Irresistibly sophisticated. A sparkling floral that is light, refreshing, easy to wear and leaves an elegant trail.

A fragrance for a girl who is friendly, outgoing and almost insolent because she proposes crazy ideas. Urban and full of life. A girl who gets the most out of every moment of life and loves doing things in the open air, but in her city.
A deliciously blended fragrance which gives the toddler sheer pleasure from a natural fragrance. Just simply pure joy and fun!

In a bright appearance of unique sensations, Carolina Herrera brings out another seasonal edition of CH L'Eau in time for the Summer season. The aroma is a summer expression of the original CH from Carolina Herrera.
Wearing Lucky Candy is like drawing a tarot card that continually unveils a delicious surprise. Say hello to your new lucky charm.

I am an escape in a forgotten garden, magic and mysterious place, where white flowers gently go along with subtle and sweet fruits. When the night falls, an olfactory waltz takes place in my heart, when the white and sensual flowers dance and confound themselves.
Rumba is the amazing elegance of Latin energy and the most sophisticated tendencies of Paris. Spellbinding harmony, all in motion. Bunch of passion and asserted sensuality.

For Bond No.9's high-spirited, holiday-time launch, the inspiration is Washington Square: that outspoken patch of greenery with built-in bocce courts, chess tables, Scrabble zone, and not to forget, its own triumphal arch. A spirit of rebelliousness has long pervaded Washington Square.
Created in homage to the ancient Indonesian dyeing technique of ikat, Ikat Bleu epitomises Giorgio Armani’s haute couture philosophy.

Full of contrast and duality, a composition of refreshing, oriental notes, Jicky Eau de Toilette plays on the ambiguous nature of the masculine-feminine olfactory repertoire. It was the first composition to be termed a "perfume", it was also the first unisex fragrance in the history of perfume-making and the oldest perfume created by the House of Guerlain.
This eau de parfum is mysterious and warm like the soft light of an arabesque lantern.

Amber Wood is a true masterpiece, imbued with the most exquisite redolence of Amber. Rich and deep, true to its main ingredient, every drop of this fragrance is captivating, sensual and powerful. Amber Wood possesses deep, intricate, multi-layered and interwoven notes to captivate the wearer.

The return of the pure, masculine fragrance. It is marked by the contrasts of the forest: warmth and freshness, softness and intensity, light and shade. With intense woody notes, it expresses an archaic decision, but remains pleasantly light. When is a man really a man? When he smells like one.
This unmatched fragrance creates a magical mesmerising effect, lifts your mood, and makes you stand out in the crowd.
Be ready to get a taste of summer with Nina Soleil!

Spicy is an elegant fragrance where fresh citrus notes are cleverly intertwined with warm woody accords, for an unforgettable experience. It is part of the Museum Collection, which uses classic raw materials and olfactory families from Europe and Asia, reminiscent of the fragrance library of an ancient perfumer.
The perfumer was inspired to capture the edgy feel of raw leather. She created a leather accord that would evoke an instinctual, yet modern masculine impression.

"Paris is a party, and the Parisian night is a dark velvet that wraps around the shoulders of the fashion capital when it surrenders to the will of the senses. Here joy is a flavour with a subtle touch of nonchalance. The city is a fantastic ride, a joyful illusion. This fragrance captures the spirit of Paris by night", Slava Zaitsev.

When we started our Shay perfume collection, we promised you a life of 'shay' moments, 'shay' fragrances and 'shay shay' emotions. Today we renew our vows with a Shaylusive perfume, Arqa Shay, for a brighter, shayer future together. Inspired by the shay moments we spend, love and enjoy together.

The first light of the day shines through the green branches of the trees swaying in the wind. The first run in the morning over the still damp forest floor fills the lungs with the fresh aroma of the forest. A breath of wind lets the leaves rustle in the tops of the tall birches. The refreshing run he takes every morning to start his day.
A scent that celebrates the pure beauty of light and shadow.
A bit of a rebel, Campus is enigmatic and full of freedom.

"I was incredibly inspired by my journey across Central Asia, and by the Silk Road cities of Uzbekistan in particular. A very special and memorable trip for me. Bukhara is the jewel in the crown, a magical place. A city of artisans, an architectural wonder, beautiful and ancient crossroads, a melting-pot," Nick Stewart, Founder.
Jubilation 25 will appeal to the elegant, enigmatic and sophisticated woman who lives her life as an art form, evoking the time, place and cultures she inhabits with mystical allure.

Ma Dame Eau de Parfum, a darker, more Rock 'n' Roll version! Like any Gaultier woman, Ma Dame does not impose any rose on herself. She is multi-faceted, lively. Her style? Her own, the one she invents depending on her desires, her whims.

Alongside a field of jasmine, some children have set up a stall selling lemonade. Their “Mandarino” is made from the juice of a handful of slightly bitter kumquats, and a few sweet mandarins, mixed with some cool orangeade. Their laughter is carried on a fresh and carefree summer breeze.

With Amande Persane, Roger and Gallet invite us to explore the Garden of Paradise of Ispahan, known in the Persian tradition as a place of hidden treasures. Among other charms, you'll find almond trees covered in fragrant blossoms, offering their cool shade to visitors strolling in the garden.
Chocolate Covered Cherries captures the smooth, silky sensuousness of this mouth-watering treat in all its glory.

Your senses sharpen, your skin awakens, your pulse races. Passion dominates each one of your steps. This is not the time to look for explanations, to reason, to ask yourself where the limit is. You are going to play, to test yourself. Exchanging glances. Getting closer. A light touch. It’s your moment, don’t deny yourself anything, don’t retreat. You long to feel the connection, to let yourself go and burst into a thousand different emotions at once. Something in you has ignited and has begun to burn: Her Secret Flame. A warm, sweet scent with a spicy touch, delving into the most primal and exciting feeling of seduction. The one that emerges from your depths when the attraction is irresistible and desire is activated, the spark that ignites and becomes a flame. Proceed with caution: don't get burned.

"An enchanting, luxurious, unexpected fragrance created to accentuate and exalt a woman's personality. A superb story of femininity and self-assurance, cloaking her in a fragrant aura of delicatesse," Honorine Blanc-Hattab, Perfumer.
Altruist: a scent for feminists, cyborgs and survivors.
The scent of Women S.Oliver has long been a classic for all those who value character, individuality and charisma.
Jonquille de Nuit taunts the delicate narcissus flower to shed its sweetness and spiral into the self-obsessive haze that its name connotes.
The green, relaxing scents of the Tuscan countryside blend with the liveliness of exotic spices.
Royal, regal, and fun-loving.
This unisex perfume celebrates the notes of Verbena and Citrus, highlighting the freshness and vivacity of its delicious scents.
This is an alluring, invigorating fragrance that reveals an interlude moment of tranquillity and serenity.
Shawq is inspired by desire. This is an intense fragrance that makes a powerful and alluring statement in the sun-kissed heat of a warm day. Find your heart's desire.

name_perfume: Pour Un Homme De Caron Parfum
description:
“With Pour Un Homme de Caron Parfum, I wanted to highlight the iconic signature of Pour Un Homme in a more concentrated version, to create a powerful and assertive lavender-vanilla duo,”

Jean Jacques, Caron's in-House Perfumer.
Nina Ricci feeds the flame of modern romance and writes a new declaration of love with Mademoiselle Ricci L'Eau. With L'Eau, Mademoiselle Ricci opens her heart and captures ours in the process.

name_perfume: Dkny Women Energizing Eau De Parfum
description: An explosive scent for the vibrant woman.
Inspired by the true spirit of competition and by the energy of soccer, Jean-Christophe Herault and Nicolas Beaulieu created this fragrance like a hymn to modern masculinity.

"In Dries world, antagonistic elements are combined to create surprise. This fragrance is like a light and dark olfactive pattern of fresh green leaves of clary sage aromatics rubbing against the woody leaves of patchouli,” Nicolas Bonneville, Perfumer.
A magical blend of blossoms that create an intense glow.

La Pausa is the house built for Coco Chanel above the village of Roquebrune, France. To evoke its luxury and simplicity, the perfumer Jacques Polge unravelled all the facets and contrasts of the fragrance, both earthy and powdery, radiant and secret.
Capturing the free-spirited allure of a sunset walk through a field of blooming flowers in a phenomenal landscape, Daisy Eau So Fresh Paradise is a harmonious blend of graceful and soft accords.
Betty Boop is one of the most famous female faces in entertainment history, is a sex symbol. The Queen of Cartoons continues to delight millions of fans of all ages around the world.

A limited edition celebrating the love story between Victoria and Albert. At their engagement, he commissioned an orange blossom brooch for his bride-to-be, a symbolic gift expressing true love in an era of arranged royal marriages. Victoria in turn, adorned herself in orange blossom at their marriage.
Betty Barclay Everlasting Love is a fragrance of great emotions that last a lifetime.
Mystic Nature is a mysterious, woody fragrance that opens with invigorating fruity notes before introducing an androgynous heart. While the base leaves a mesmerising trail.

Intoxicating, deeply sexy, and totally unexpected. A fragrance essence derived from the arresting purple of My Heroine and articulated throughout the composition by rich accents. A complex start to the composition illustrates and amplify the heart, while in the back assertive and luscious notes provide a seductive and sinister finish to this edgy fragrance.

To create Bowhanti, we wanted to evoke the scent of spicy woods found in the warm, humid, tropical atmosphere of the inaccessible Amazonian rainforest of French Guiana. It is a precious scent that few have encountered.

Jasmin Impératrice Eugénie was commissioned by a historic French Emperor for his wife, Empress Eugenie, who desired a fragrance of seductive, floral-oriental charm. A sensual fragrance full of warmth and strength, much like the woman for whom it was named. Jasmin Impératrice Eugénie has become a favorite among women who appreciate an opulent scent that takes center stage.

Rejoicing in its distinctive make-up as a true signature scent, Santal is a fragrance to excite the senses. Perfect for after-dark soirees, distinctive entrances and for crisp mornings. A fragrance that celebrates the confident, stylish and bold modern man.

An eau de parfum celebrating the centuries-old tradition of "Hanami" in Japan, when friends and family would picnic under sakura trees to relax and appreciate the beautiful view of the cherry blossom 'clouds', the delicate scent of which lingering in the breeze.

Pure and simple in structure but extreme in character, Ceramic explores the scent of natural white clay on the skin. Inspired by Icelandic geothermal areas overflowed with mineral silica, it's a scent almost transparent in nature, capturing the allure and intimacy of human touch. Ceramic is the scent of natural white clay.

Aura embodies a woman's instinct and reveals her life energy. Connected to her inner-nature and deepest senses, each woman discovers an unexpected force. Driven by her instinct, she metamorphoses and her Aura sparkles with strength. Aura is a fragrance that blends botanical freshness and feline sensuality.

Mysterious and seductive, Dunhill Desire Black is ruled by passion, arousing the senses and teasing the heart. Inspired by the magnetic charisma of the bold Dunhill gentleman, this masculine fragrance is a sensual blend of dark essences.
A fascinating scent inspired by the arts and exquisite aesthetics.

“The idea was that of an oxygenated wood. Steamy and refreshing at the same time, more complex than oxygen itself. I thought of liquid oxygen in which you put pressurised woods. Then everything is boiling, you put your nose on it, and there it is, a scent you cannot catch either capture, but that is the air. All around you.” Antoine Lei, Perfumer

Amber Rose Extract of Parfum is an intense delight for rose lovers. A decadent, elegantly romantic fragrance, marrying rare May Rose from Grasse with a voluptuous sweet milk note resting on a base of white amber to create a chic and modern scent.
Valoroso for Men is a refreshing and exotic fragrance made for a courageous man, who is a true goal-getter, a visionary.

Oasi Di Agrumi is an exclusive and timeless fragrance designed for true lovers of artistic perfumery. A creation of alchemy, unique in sensations, born out of an ancient perfume culture, which is centered on the excellence of raw materials.
Sweet Diamond Pink Pepper | 25 is an electric, floral, woody creation. Like a sudden impulse, this warm rosy elixir will spice up your mood or add a special twist to any fragrance combination.
The sexiest fragrance you'll ever wear! Provocative, smoldering, laced with sensual notes.
A sweet and refined composition of vivacious fruits and precious woods.
This scent is a snapshot of Italian Dolce Vita in the heart of Paris.

Time stands still at the gateway of Luxor, Humanity's oldest prayer site. On the banks of the Nile, the stifling heat makes me feel indolent. Crocodiles slide silently over the sand under the penetrating gaze of the Sphinx. Luxor oud, is an oasis of roses and fruit overflowing with freshness and sensuality in the country of greatness and majesty. The marriage of wood and rose under Pharaoh's whip and sceptre.
Azul Índigo takes us into its aromatic universe through citrus notes that reinforce the freshness of the fragrance. The sensual notes in the base prolong the seduction on the skin.
Radish and vetiver are both roots that were never meant to cross paths underground, however, the perfumer elevated them from their earthly homes in this woody, green confrontation.

brand: Au Pays De La Fleur D’Oranger
description: Gina, between modernity and memories. Half seductress, half goddess. A perfume of extreme femininity.

Shimmering and dreamy, provocative and dark, light and warm, Amouroud is a collection of olfactory memories, stories, real and imaginary. Transcribed with notes of flowers, woods, and herbs into perfumes that capture a primal place of serenity, joy, and passion.

Sensual and mysterious as well as toned and balanced. A strong, oriental composition with an intense oud note. A classic of the genre at its best. The inspiration for creating this fragrance was Dubai, a place of great appreciation for oud aroma.
New NB Unbranded VIII is a classy and sensuous fragrance. It is ideal for those special romantic evenings or parties where you wish to stand out with your striking personality.
A striking scent that's as cool as the night. A mystical combination of radical freshness and sensuous masculinity.
Disclosure is a strikingly masculine fragrance that will give you self-confidence.

name_perfume: Esencia Loewe Eau De Toilette Classic
description: Esencia Loewe offers a harmonious collision between the hedonism of the Mediterranean and the neo-renaissance trend of deep sensuality and almost-oriental refinement found in the spicy, aromatic and fruity notes.
La Fumée Alexandrie is the memory of a spectacular civilisation, powerful and mysterious, and this fragrance a tribute to the mythical shoreline of ancient Alexandria.

Intimacy Man Intense is the ideal companion for the confident man who experiences his own adventure intensely. He knows himself, always retaining a touch of mystery. He is determined to get what he wants in life!
Demeter's Iced Berries is a fascinating crisp and cool blend of raspberries, blueberries, and blackberries with a touch of spice.

The Nassak Diamond is the muse. Also known as the 'Eye of the Idol', this large (43.83 carats) vivid Blue Diamond was mined in India in the 15th century and was the original third eye of the deity at the Temple of Shiva in Nassak.
A carte blanche for the perfumer, with the brief being tea and the complexity of its accords as a guideline. If you like fresh and luminous perfumes, Le Thé is definitely made for you!

Néroli & Bergamote de Denim is a fragrance with a luminous top opening on zesty, sparkling and invigorating citrus and bergamot notes. The floral heart reveals a bouquet of mimosa and roses combined with an ambery base note which gives a modern and colourful cologne character.
A thrilling scent full of the energy of a bright sunset.
What you get from the Amber Oud Blue Edition is beyond a world-class perfume, it's a fresh start to life.

Rose Oud is a fresh fragrance with a touch of sensual notes. It is part of the Museum Collection, which uses classic raw materials and olfactory families from Europe and Asia, reminiscent of the fragrance library of an ancient perfumer.
An intricate and rather unusual fragrance. The inspiration behind Immortel Cedrat was the smell of the citrus trees in Sicily never so far from the beach and the sea.
An energising scent.
Tchelo is an enveloping fragrance with a precious, luxurious trail.
An intoxicating fragrance with the power to sweetly grip the senses, a scent that combines an aromatic bouquet of flowers that exude charm and float in the air like a forbidden perfume.
Love whispers the beauty of life and makes dormant dreams come true. We have bottled the power of this love in Elixir Intense.
Inspired by the Arabian Gardens of Paradise, Jasmin Moghol evokes a Jaipur love garden of captivating beauty; the narcotic floral and mystical garden of the Royal Palace in Jaipur.
For the visionary and innovative man who changes the rules and completely transforms the way of doing things. He sees opportunities where others don't and generates a positive change in the world.
The deep forests of the Nordic landscapes sunbeams reflected in the treetops, warm and cosy. The notes will seduce you into a calm state of mind, where every second last for a millennium.
Yardley's signature fragrance, chosen for its aromatic freshness and delicacy of scent. Lavender is a therapeutic plant that is effective in relaxing, calming and balancing mind, body and spirit.

Secret Fantasy Wonderland opens with a burst of luminous amazement with a luscious freshness, full of charm and playful femininity. The heart flutters alive with a youthful, but sophisticated bouquet balancing the scent. A signature creates a lightweight addiction with ethereal texture exuding a facet of soft sensuality leaving behind a glimmer of intrigue.

L'Eau d'Ambre is one of the earliest L'Artisan Parfumeur creations. It takes inspiration from Arabian Nights. The oriental flavour to this fragrance is a synergy of the most precious materials in perfume.
Baby Boti Nana Neném is a delicate and relaxing fragrance to finish the night care ritual of your baby's delicate skin.
A delicious and juicy fruit-forward fragrance to capture the vibrant harvest of Bali's tropical paradise.

Cascading white flowers bring back the scent of laughter, white flowers and green leaves, and the fragrance of jade cores. The flowers smile, they want to open and close, light and elegant. He lowered his eyebrows and smiled, raised his head to move, and the beauty smiled without saying a word. Flowers do not open their mouths, they tilt their heads shyly.
Feel the power of this engaging perfume which is perfectly refreshing and warm.

Designed to recreate the magical alchemy between the finest natural ingredients, this, combined with ethereal vibrations that are capable of bringing out precious exotic ingredients in warm and sensual tones along with strong and purposeful chords to create harmonious, elegant and highly refined blends to interpret and enhance the preciousness as part of the Colourfull Collection.
This is a rich, vibrant, elusive scent of mystery, for the man on the go, who always leaves his mark.

At first spritz, the Monsillage Eau Fraîche stands out by the sharp lemony top note given by the verbena and the aromatic notes of lavender, white thyme, and rosemary. The heart brings an aquatic lilac on which rest the beautifully natural top notes. The woody base notes, dominated by the vetiver Haiti, bring a special depth to the composition. The result is a modern, easy-to-wear fragrance, which exudes natural richness.
Derived from Latin, Irreverens, meaning rejecting conventions. Notes and accords that taunt and jostle one another with irreverence.
Illusion is created for the enigmatic woman who sashays by and your heart skips a beat. In totality, this is the perfume of the woman who is an exciting story wherein you savour each chapter.
Commes des Garçons 8 88, the scent of Gold, is the creation of a dream, the design of a sensory symphony to inspire and invigorate everyone who encounters it.
An exciting blast of spicy berries unveil a beautiful floral heart and fragrant leaves to create a rich sillage of luxurious oud, sensual woody notes and precious amber.

"I wanted to express that effervescent feeling of a time period (the 1920s), that was drawing to a close, but also the idea that there were hidden depths to all that glamour, a rhyme and reason for such luxurious pursuits, not just a decadence of society," Jan Ahlgren, Olfactive Director.

Designed for the urban and modern man who cares about nature and craftsmanship. According to old legend, Cumaru is the tree that realizes dreams and desires. For this strong symbolic tree, the perfumers were willing to use every part of this tree to infuse its creation with some mystical and holistic spirit that would invite men to reconnect with nature.
Radikal Tuberose is an ode to the sweet, sensual fragrance of Tuberose, a sulphurous flower if ever there was one.
A contrasting gourmand fragrance with oriental nuances
Floral notes combined with the gourmand accents on a warm background Code Orange has its unique exotic oriental character.
A delicate fragrance for the modern woman. Sparkling floral freshness on a sensual amber base.

Jardins D'Écrivains embodies the "Pléiade" with a triptych of poems whose olfactory adaptation expresses the intensity of cedar. Excellence inspires a precious sillage. Exile by Saint-John Perse. An emanation of deeply rooted elements. "I will inhabit my name",
A fragrant ode to the magnetic queen of gemstones, Sandal Ruby is a rich and elegant embodiment of the talismanic ruby. The bejewelled red fragrance captures the intense aura of true passion.
Oud Editiona timeless trail emerging from the hollow of the dunes for a sacred journey to the heart of the Orient.

Few world landmarks represent quite the smorgasboard of olfactory delights as the Grand Bazaar in Istanbul. With over 4,000 shops across more than 60 covered streets, it's a veritable cornucopia of fragrant treasures, from spice and tea markets to exotic fruits to exquisite leather and woodwork. Labyrinth Of Spices, as you might expect, is a sweeping journey through this iconic and bustling marketplace.
First Instinct Together For Her is a spontaneous, innovative fragrance for the exciting A&F woman.
I am Shamash, the Sun God celebrated by the Babylonians. High in the sky, I make myself a judge and observe humanity. Perfumer-creator, am I your interpretation of eternity? I am Oud Shamash.
Passenger Pour Homme, a luminous, concentrated energy. The perfect combination of traditional French luxury and modern travel codes.

Sitting on a terrace overlooking the Mediterranean Sea. Chilling out with a cocktail and watching the sun set. Electro Limonade is a fizzy, sparkling and aromatic electronic cologne that will accompany you until the early hours.
Club 6 Intenso exudes style and sophistication to enhance men's self-care routine and bring more intensity to their perfumery.
The energy of this fragrance is expressed in a delicate dance, wrapped in a warm melody of precious woody notes.

If it was a Metal, it would be precious gold. If it was a land, it would be the Middle East, mystical and intriguing. If it was a colour, it would be black, austere and resolute. If it was a Perfume, it would be L'Oud.
A fragrance that evokes the fresh and unusual scent of magnolia Grandiflora, native to Mexico, a primitive and at the same time, very modern scent.

Island Michael Kors. The ideal destination. Once you're there, it sets you free. It is the sense of being alive, feeling calm and cool all at once. More than just a beautiful place, Island is an attitude. Where you are surrounded by the warm laughter of friends against and endless backdrop of sea and sky.
An enveloping smell that causes immediate seduction.
The perfect scent for unforgettable evenings under the starry sky of Portofino.

name_perfume: La Vie Est Belle L'Eau De Parfum X Orlinski 2022
description: In 2022, for the holiday season, the iconic scent of La Vie Est Belle is adorned with a beautiful Lancôme x Orlinski rose.
A sweet and bold scent that celebrates the patience, loyalty, hard work and justice of Harry Potter's Hufflepuff House.

Imagine waking up one beautiful morning and finding a scented note on your pillow. You can smell notes of apple and blackcurrant as you read the following mischievous sentence: “Follow the clues …” The doorbell rings. It's a delivery of a gorgeous bouquet of flowers. Peony, lily of the valley and orange blossom are tied together with a colourful ribbon embroidered with a golden number. It’s time to head to the city centre of Bordeaux and locate the street number that will lead you to your mysterious heartthrob. In a vibrant atmosphere made of musk and vanilla, he is ready to dance, with a big smile on his face, holding a perfume in his hand. Love is definitely in the air.

Sitting at the window, the scent of citrus fruit and spices flow with delight into the room. Spreading out onto the balcony, they mingle with geraniums and blackcurrant buds and show a bucolic view of a magical landscape. In the distance, the calm and relaxing ocean offers a dazzling landscape. Marine and fruity notes are an invitation to relaxation voluptuously.
Activate joy of life and positive vibrations with Je Suis. Like an eternal spring, the green and delicate floral notes of lily of the valley illuminate and bring luck.
Crazy Fun Attitude blooms like a summer day, the air surrounding you alive and bursting with color.
Warm, bewitching, captivating, Souffle Ambré brings to life the magical world of the Thousand and One Nights.

As exceptional as the roses within it, as intimate as a garden, as captivating as a masterpiece. Like a shroud of silk, Izia is a fragrance for you and you alone. It is alive palpable, bursting with energy and enduring. It speaks to all generations of women. Sisley's Izia is modern and enchanting.
Make an impact that endures and emphasises your individuality with Areej Al Oud.

The sweetness of geranium and the spiciness of cardamom blatantly provoke your breath and quickly fall into the trap of love. The saffron with a slight medicinal taste makes people suffer from sweetness and bitterness.

Sensuality, romanticism, and seduction. Strength, sentiment, and ideals. Courage and danger. These are the many nuances of modern, contemporary, up to date femininity with no limits, no barriers, and no preconceptions. Dange-Rose embraces the challenge of the 21st-century woman.

"When we visited Charleston in the middle of the English countryside, I didn't know what to expect but I fell in love with it. When I was there, I made a storyline in my head from morning to afternoon to evening so the five fragrances have a natural evolution. What I particularly loved about the Bloomsbury Set was the juxtaposition of domesticity and simplicity with this hugely intellectual environment," Yann Vasnier, Perfumer.

Delighting in the pleasures of femininity, Lolita takes a bite of the apple, so delicious! Sweet is a delectable forbidden fruit, exquisitely transgressive and scandalously musky, taste the delicious pleasure of being a woman.
This captivating fragrance is sure to make an impression.

Inspired by the unique relationship of “Le Petit Prince” from Antoine de St. Exupéry and his beloved flower, this fragrance is dedicated to all men and women sharing this adoration. “Desert Rose” subtle balance between freshness and warmth makes this timeless love flower contemporary and “special” to everyone.

New York's most singular, most unique neighborhood finally gets its own long-lasting, stunning scent: Soho. A luxury shopping turf by day, and by evening, a quiet stroll-able neighborhood, separate even from the rest of hip-and-cool Downtown.

“This is a fragrance composed by Jean-Paul Guerlain, whose grandfather once dazzled the whole world with an overabundance of vanilla in his Shalimar. Nourished by rose, ylang-ylang and jasmine, it stands in ode to the Indian Ocean,” Thierry Wasser, Perfumer

Early morning, the day begins in the villa along the seaside with a shower of citrus freshness and dewy florals capturing the first rays of the sun. In the distance, the morning breeze brings the scent of the sea from the Mediterranean.
Mini Rino is perfect to brighten up the day with a fresh scent with a hint of energy and joy.
An irresistible take on the feel-good holiday scent, this captures the warm glow of summer.

Amber is believed to ward off negativity, in turn cleansing the mind to focus on positive matters. At the height of the warmest seasons, Benzoin tears from trees are preciously collected. Once distilled, the honey droplets transform into amber needles, weaving and warming the structure of the fragrance. This is when the sharp powers of the amber clear the mind and let positive thoughts take over.

A scent as resplendent as the glittering stars on a clear summer night in the Andalusian mountains. Silky magnolia softens the intensity, giving this stunningly elegant scented jewel its soft, feminine side.

Reminiscent of woodland after a rainstorm, Delicate radiates an aura of dewy delight, fresh and floral as the rain gives way to suffused beams of sunlight. Savour the feeling of grass beneath your feet and the gentle touch of resinous leaves as you dance deeper into the woods.

Tease is light-hearted, saucy and charming. Paris Hilton brings a fresh, youthful appeal to the image of a blonde icon of the silver screen. Tease is all about being sexy like a true Hollywood goddess.

name_perfume: Elie Saab Le Parfum In White
description: An artisan of the sublime, Elie Saab invented a world of absolute femininity, with a unique promise: to bring the exceptional into everyday life. He has created a white bouquet, as dazzling as those special moments for the big day, with a unique promise to bring the exceptional back into women's lives.

Yves Saint Laurent discovered the Marjorelle Gardens on his first trip to Marrakesh in 1966. During his stays in Morocco, he would walk there almost every day, and finally bought it in 1980. The Couturier was instantly charmed by its flowers, whose vibrant colours evoked the artists he admired.

A Kiss from Violet Oil is inspired by the art of alchemy and fragrance-making, formulated to be layered and blended together to create a unique, personalized fragrance combination. Built around a hero ingredient linked to the distinctive codes of the House, each scent can be magnified, muted or fused with other fragrances from the luxury collection to create a one-of-a-kind sillage
Paris Love is a perfume that will evoke all the sophistication related to the most romantic city in the world, Paris.

So…? In Love, is an ultra-hip feminine pick. It's the scent that pays homage to all the fabulous divas that have graced the runways.

AV Glamour opens with a soft sensuality kissed by a youthful sparkle. Followed by a playfully elegant heart that blooms through with intoxicating sweetness. A warm and comforting background wraps the fragrance in a creamy decadence.

A century of elegance and extravagance! La Coupole has covered times and fashions, while inside the emotion has remained the same. The wish to reinvent oneself. The pleasure of looking and discovering. The joy of possessing the object of desire. To honour the most beautiful dome of Paris, we created a unique fragrance, with notes inspired by these thrilling moments. Its name: 'Sous le Toit de Paris'.

L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme takes the art of balance to new heights with its combination of powerful aromas. Sometimes, it is an energising essence that preludes an active and successful day, At others, it excites the senses and heralds yet another conquest. In a bottle or a travel spray, it diffuses its scents like a time-enchanting machine.

Lying on the warm sand, the sun rays caress your skin. You dip your lips in your cocktail and discover an explosion of flavours. Vanille Coco is the scent of happiness.
Invoke is a long-lasting and sensuous fragrance designed to create an ideal scent for the modern, classy woman or man.
Glam Rose is aimed at the complex woman who dares to declare her uniqueness and difference with an intangible touch of boldness and ultra-femininity.
A floral masterpiece, blooming with rich textures and depth, that transports you to Monet's famous Giverny bridge.

description: I still remember that party when we met. I remember you blushing, your smile, your aura of mystery. Now we are here. The blue sky melts into the infinite ocean. While the silver waves break against your toes, I can see the origin of our story in your eyes. I draw you closer… I notice a different freshness on your skin, floral, slightly musky notes. Will this be the aroma that forever reminds me of our first trip together?

"I created Woman as a fragrance that celebrates the woman inside all of us. I want to empower women to feel powerful and sensual as this will inspire them to free their ultimate femininity." - Christina Aguilera
An innovative and bold olfactory composition. A breath of freedom to defy the unknown, for an electrifying sensation.

Flower power may be associated with the 1960s and 70s but let’s go back over a century before to 1840 when a young Queen Victoria floated down the aisle to wed her Prince Charming. A fragrance for a public that is young, urbanite, modern. Young people with concerns, regular users of social networks and the internet, that are looking to have fun and live in the moment…

An iconic scent that embodies all the pride, passion, and creativity poured into every Clive Christian perfume, now adorned with a platinum-coloured cap.
An elegant and long-lasting fragrance.
Luxurious, subtle and mysterious, like the peppercorns themselves.
For the elegant and super-chic woman… for a very important party!
Between essence and attitude. The feeling of being one of a kind. An attractive cocktail of traditional elegance and unpredictability.

Universally, red is the color of romance, love, passion and more. Red as a color is known to increase adrenaline flow and make your heart beat faster. Red communicates ambition, power, vitality and a desire to conquer. How the color red effects us mentally and physically: Increases enthusiasm, a sense of protection from fears and anxiety, encourages action and confidence, stimulates energy.

name_perfume: L'Envol De Cartier Eau De Toilette
description: To break away from any known sensations, that is the power of the masculine perfume L'Envol de Cartier Eau de Toilette. A magnetic fluid with a cloud of citrus, woody and honey notes, it is an active and addictive substance ready for take off.
This fragrance shares its name with the most prestigious street on the island. A memory, an emotion, a walk in the harmony of a ray of sunshine, through blue skies and freshly picked flowers.
Introducing our new scent for men. Core is simple, fresh, clean, and sexy--feels as natural to wear as your favorite jeans.

Burberry Brit Rhythm For Him Intense is inspired by the energy and anticipation of live music. Music sits at the heart of all Burberry activity globally, from shows, events and soundtracks to Burberry's music platform devoted to emerging talent, Burberry Acoustic.

“Inspired by an enjoyable memory, when the air begins to warm up and the first rose blossoms of the season begin to bloom, filling the air with a captivating aroma," Guillaume Flavigny and Rodrigo Flores-Roux, Perfumers.

"A rose is a rose is a rose" - but not all roses are created equal. Fit for a Queen, like Elizabeth's crown. Grab your hat Ladies, the definitive rose fragrance has come to town!

If there is such a thing as a sophisticated banana scent, this is it. Without trying to resolve the difference between bananas and plantains, we chose the less sweet and greener Plantain for our fragrance.
An olfactive immersion in the golden mythical era of psychedelia and hipness of the canyon of dreams in Hollywood, California.

An olfactory journey to discover the darker enigmatic side of oud. A mysterious composition that evokes the intimate and intense message of our soul.

Our most vibrant, sweet, playful Gingham yet.

The fragrance Kaiak Vital, as well as a reenergizing encounter with the sea, makes you feel full of life.

Elixir, by Shakira, inspired by her most sensual and exotic moves. A powerful blend of all her dreams that will take you on a journey into a hypnotic world wrapped in desire and Shakira's most powerful femininity.

A journey into the deep ambery core of the forest, expressing the essence of wood and amber with a darker shade. The scent of Nature.

Step into a tropical daydream with CH Men Birds of Paradise. Picture yourself on a lush island, where rain kisses the earth, releasing the invigorating scents of bergamot and violet leaves. A delicately fresh, and subtly verdant floral fragrance that evokes memories of sweet spring days.

A bold combination of aromatic and spicy notes for a sophisticated and contemporary fragrance.

An aromatic musky woody fragrance that is fresh and invigorating yet spicy and warm, evoking feelings of intimacy, sensuality and sophistication. An elegant, timeless scent with an audacious and unexpected twist. "Without elegance, playing and winning are not enough. Innovation means daring to take risks," Rene Lacoste.
An emotional scent that expresses all the facets of the rose.

Take the plunge into the freshness of the ocean with Scuba.

A sensual fragrance, a perfume with warm and delicious nuances, a sweetness that recalls the pleasures of life. An ode to Treviso, its culinary culture and the beauty of sweet Italy.

A spicy blend with subtle honeyed notes that takes you on a journey to the heart of Africa's untamed Maasaï Mara lands.

The sound of your voice, the scent of your fragrance, both a magnetic presence. Voce Viva Intensa celebrates every woman’s unique voice in one declaration: My Voice, My Strength.

A perfume that wakens with fresh notes. It mixes jasmine and hyacinth floral notes with aquatic scent. It reveals a woody base with seductive and powerful notes. A complex fragrance that is not easily tamed.
Interpreting sublime masculinity through sophisticated and revitalising notes, 19 Degree expresses an aura of intensity and vibrancy, all at the same time.
The gourmand note of milk and the sweetness of sugar candy and vanilla pod make this scent warm and sensual.

Reach new heights with this dynamic woody masculine fragrance that infuses you with enthusiasm, motivating you to strive for your goals.
