Enjoy a warm tea, light the fireplace, and make yourself comfortable on the couch: Feelings of comfort are made more special if we share them with others. Stay in the moment. Then it suddenly becomes clear: "Home" is not just a place, but a feeling, the real closeness to your loved one. Because it's about the time you give each other. S.Oliver Authentic Man represents these moments, for fellow-humanity, cosiness, and trust.
Metaphor is the change that humanity should have made long ago. Metaphor is the new age of acceptance, inclusion, and equality. Metaphor is unity.
A fresh and energising fragrance, with lively citrus and Mediterranean notes, and a green and aromatic touch.

A spiraling fusion of exuberant freshness, Perry Ellis 360º for Men is a sophisticated blend of unmatched freshness and warmth. The Eau de Toilette delivers a cool fragrance blend that captivates and intrigues.

A brand rooted in tradition with an emphasis on comfort, quality and optimism, Perry Ellis describes this men's fragrance as refreshing, refined, and confidently cool. Classified as vibrant, fresh fougère.

There are as many types of kisses as there are reasons to kiss. Love kisses. Friendship kisses. Kisses for coming and kisses for going. Consolation kisses and kisses with passion. Requited kisses and kisses for no reason. Kisses behind a screen or in real life. But the important thing, usually, is not the kiss but who you give it to. After the great success of 2017, Shakira is relaunching her S Kiss perfume in a unique limited edition. Iconic and irresistible, it is ready to devastate. Like that first love that you'll never forget. A young fragrance, with the innocence of the first kiss at the school gate. A seductive and feminine aroma. Fruity and passionate. Like secret kisses at work. A heartfelt and true perfume. Like a kiss you've missed.

ERL Sunscreen perfectly evokes the fleeting memory of a nostalgic summer. Feelings of the warm West Coast sun against salty skin transform into cool splashes of ocean water and chlorine suspended in the air. The scent of Venice Beach, California.
H.I.M. Reserve is a sensual fragrance that offers the perfect blend of sophistication and playfulness.
This special scent was inspired by and dedicated to the "intellectual Mafia" game. Don is a perfect incarnation of all aspects of the criminal world, with a touch of gunpowder and hot lead.
A fragrance that brings to mind the magnetic energy of the northern lights alongside the protective warmth of a cos wooden house.
Live life in the fast lane with 300 km/h Nitro, for the Avon man who dares to take risks,
Crystal Bloom Promised Love is a sweet and gentle fragrance to express true love with a deep trust, like falling into passionate love.
Sun is a dazzling and sunny fragrance for the alluring and self-confident woman who lives life to the fullest!

The slightly spicy-sweet scent of myrrh has a special balsamic subtlety and supports the mental relaxation. The tart-sweet aroma of the Kumquat revives the spirit at the same time and thus provides an exciting combination. This balsamic composition harmonizes the spirit and gives peace and serenity.
The fragrance will last longer than the night. Dark and mysterious.

A contrasting fragrance to bring out the charisma of every woman.
A bold scent for the rebellious minds.
All the colours of the light spectrum crystallised in these precious stones that exchange their energy with an explosive perfume with fruity, floral, and woody notes. Just imagine what might happen.

Like flowers blooming beneath glittering tree tops. The gentlest and most colourful fragrance in the world.
Moonlight Patchouli le Parfum is a bewitching and magnetic composition that seems to have captured the intensity of the night.
With Magic Life, Yves de Sistelle has created an unforgettable fragrance for women who play by their own rules.

Armand Basi in Red addresses the woman of today. Self-confident, she affirms her own personality and is capable of expressing her feelings and emotions. A woman who is tender and spontaneous full of passion and strength.
A phenomenon awaits. Become a legend. Claim your destiny. For the man who's born to lead. Rise above the rest and discover the essence of a man. Ascendant, the shape of perfection.

Nobile PonteVecchio Exceptional Edition is a contemporary interpretation of classic grandeur. An elegant creation that is treasured by both men and women alike.

Eau de Givenchy embodies a woman full of joie de vivre, spontaneity and gaiety. She has a natural charm and she seduces with a cheerfully carefree air. This fragrance addresses the elegance of a dynamic, joyful and relaxed woman in a dazzling freshness. Eau de Givenchy is still considered to be one of the finest "Eaux", and strongly epitomises the brand Givenchy.

"I remember the smell of the fig tree in the garden of my grandmother where I was having breakfast in the morning, the scent of jasmine released from the arbor leading to the sea, and the smell of the clothes my mother scented with incense returning from church," Meo Fusciuni.
A captivating scent with sensual, precious accords.

Charged with nature awakening from its torpor, quivering with energy, revitalised by a life-giving stream, Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée is a reminder that freshness can be synonymous with intensity and surprise. A vital force, far removed from timid minimalism.
Graphite is a bold and invigorating scent blending the finest ingredients for a long-lasting fragrance experience in this concentrated cologne for men.
Inspired by Ancient Rome, this scent evokes the essences of those times: essential oils, natural resins and spices.

Viva La Juicy Gold Couture. Living life luxuriously the Viva la Juicy way! Inspired by the life of the Viva muse is a life well-lived and full of stylish treasures. Over-the-top decadence characterises her every day, where soirées at the of-the-moment hot-spots are just part of the job. Her lavish lifestyle travels everywhere she goes.
"Aqua Paradisi is full of tenderness and as delicate as the first roses picked at dawn." Jean-Claude Ellena, Olfactive Director

Style is paramount to Guerlain's La Petite Robe Noire. A scent that dares to combine all the genres of refinement. Accessorised with high heels, the legendary Little Black Dress dominates the rest of the wardrobe!
Discover the timeless allure of breath-taking Provence with this intimate floral bouquet. Romance de Provence opens with fruity nuances followed by a floral heart, on a sweet, smooth gourmand base.
Séxûal Fresh Pour Homme is a crisp men's fragrance that is undeniably clean, masculine and sexy, making it completely irresistible.
Safran Troublant is an oriental spicy fragrance, with a blend of saffron, rose and vanilla.
A refined, passionate scent that spotlights one of perfumery's most-loved ingredients.

Shine all season long in Love Star, a limited-edition sister to our original Love fragrance. The after after party. Bad behavior and good champagne. Temptation in the air. Dancing all night long. That's the backdrop for Love Star.
Reflecting the ambiguity of Noho, a serene historic district with raw edges and ultra-modern spareness, is a fragrance created for a dreamy, elusive yet warm seductress.

Not Telling is inspired by the Année 80 Exhibition at the Musée des Arts Décoratifs at Paris that both the perfumer Sophie Labbé and Artistic Director Christopher Chong attended together. For Labbé, “It was a moment of total immersion in the aesthetics of the 1980s, with its flashy colours and warrior women in epaulette jackets. I was struck by the notion of their power, which I translated into this sophisticated alchemy of seduction.”
For the jeans and t-shirt guy on the weekends.

Majestic Amber pays homage to these creations with the radiance of a yellow rose. Its petals, like yellow fruits caressed by the sun, give this perfume its beautiful golden amber colour, like the flamboyant decor or yesteryear.
A fragrance as stimulating and fulfilling as a long, sunny beach day with a refreshing sea breeze and fruity vitamin C-packed cocktail.
A fragrance for those who won’t be tamed, Rebellious is as feisty and forthright as its name suggests, playful at the outset yet complex to the core.
Intoxicating and haunting, Guipure & Silk belongs to the world of seduction. Enchanting and sweet, this fragrance is dedicated to mysterious women who live their lives passionately.
The scent of free spirits! A daring sensory adventure with vibrant lively top notes and a smooth woody base. Authentically modern and fresh.

What good luck! Wherever you are, this lucky cat will bring you good fortune! Tip-toeing on velvet paws, it blends the direct simplicity with opulence. Loubidoo is a fragrance that's high on mischief.
Adventurous and energetic – for the man who's not afraid of life in the fast lane; who sets high standards and delights in the thrill of the chase.
Mild, sweet and adorable: Happy Juice from the Douglas Privée Collection is the perfect scent to feel just as good and vibrant.

Nautic Spirit provides a fresh interpretation of the "enjoyment of precious time". It is a journey that symbolises a time-out from stressful everyday life, a tonic for the soul, characterised by harmonious contrasts.
Florissa Encore is a modern interpretation of the original scent from 1978.
Mignon Red is an exotic blend of delicious fruits and exquisite flowers.

Oriental Leather is a rich and intoxicating fragrance that evokes the dazzling wonders of the Sultanate of Oman. Illuminated by the velvety veil in the heart, such as the golden heat are the Wahabi Sands desert and the bright sun on the peaks of the Hajar mountains.
An energising, sunny fragrance that makes you want to move.
Evoke Silver Edition is designed for the glamorous young woman who is vivacious and dramatic.
An addictive, sensual, and aphrodisiac blend, taking us back to our origins. Seduced by voluptuous notes.
"Explicitly sweet and dangerously voluptuous, Bitter Peach surges with dark, skin-gripping sensuality. Like the full-flavoured fruit at its most ripe, the scent is erotic by nature," Tom Ford.
This fragrance gives a perfect vibe of morning freshness, with a luxurious and long lasting dry down.

Down with the shackles of the female object! Make way for the woman 2.0. Less dressed up but still as beautiful, she advocates naturalness and swaps her model-like appearance for that of a warrior, a fighter and a liberated woman. No more glamorous, evocative and frozen poses on glossy paper, no more blissful and passionate lovers!
Inspired by the Sussex countryside and its fields of clary sage. The heady scent of an aromatic plant set amongst a vast, pastoral landscape.

"I was inspired by the unique scenery of the Yangtze River, formerly known as the Blue River. On its banks there is the delicate flower of Osmanthus, symbol of wisdom, calm and balance." Sebastian Martin, Perfumer

name_perfume: Police Contemporary Amber Gold For Man
description: Amber Gold for Man is the celebration of the contemporary Police man, elegant and extremely strong. You can feel his charisma wherever he goes. He polarises attention and attracts glances.

In Grasse, the colour of winter is gold. We all have memories of nature. We can all remember a garden we once knew. You only have to look at a mimosa tree in blossom and the feeling of celebrating Christmas in Grasse comes flooding back. Fleur d'Or & Acacia, for women aims to capture this sensation.
The scent of sweet rose petals dipped into an intense base.
Peaceful, soft, and mystical.

Rays of sun enlightened the waves, creating millions of golden sparkles. They flutter the skin, drying out droplets of ocean, leaving a seductive salted sensation of her warm skin. Sensual Essence is an inspiration from the ocean like a siren song.

name_perfume: You'Re The One Eau De Parfum
description: A luxurious blend of soft rose, winter woods and a drop of strawberry nectar.
Make every day feel like a holiday with a burst of the fruity and floral scent of Pur Blanca Golden Rush.
Escape from your everyday. Indulge yourself in Daisy Love Daze. A warm glow takes over, spreading positivity, optimism and good vibes!

Queen of Silk embodies the richness and allure of silk, a symbol of luxury both then and now. Coveted since time immemorial, silk's rich colors and ethereal lightness cast a spell on all those who encounter it, leaving a trail of sensual allure that captivates the senses.
A sensual rush of iconic oud. Powerfully enigmatic. A dark jewel encircled by shadowy woods and glowing amber.
A refreshing scent that smells like a peaceful getaway.
The inspiration behind Pavilion was Geopark Villa, Andrea Maack's studio headquarters in Iceland. The scent expresses soft facets layered with warming notes that make your heart skip a beat.

Oud Zanzibar translates the embrace between the ocean and the horizon: the union of the two worlds through the eyes and spirit of a young Masai who, while offshore, looks at the water touching the sky. The fragrance is a hymn to the scents and colours of the island of Zanzibar: that of the sea, crystalline and pure, and that of the celestial vault, infinite and immutable.
The power of the wind and the waves give us half a second to change the ship's direction. But when symbiosis between men's creation and the elements is achieved, then it is sheer grace.
Mini Baby QuéQué has a soft baby smell, which brings a feeling of harmony and happiness. It will be the companion of your baby's first stories with an enchanting fragrance.

name_perfume: Mirto Di Panarea Lunar New Year 2021
description: Panarea, an island suspended in time. Mirto di Panarea by Acqua di Parma evokes the character of the smallest and oldest of the Aeolian islands. Celebrate Chinese New Year with this limited edition.
Batman has been specially designed for little superheroes and will instantly immerse them in the universe of the great Batman.

Inspired by the vibrant midnight sun that never sets during summer in the north. Fresh, warm, and with a spherical roundness in the transitions of the notes, makes this fragrance as magical as the never-ending sunsets.
The significance of Arabic name “Insherah” is Joy. Fill your life with as many moments and experiences of joy and passion as you humanly can.
Mist Element returns you to your origins, the beginnings, portraying strength, mystery, seduction, and masculinity in its essence. A warm, rich, and mysterious scent.

A woman with power, with the power to do what she wants, with the power in her eyes. Exuberant and provocative, Anitta invites you to surrender to your most intense desires through her fragrance, Anitta Tentação that keeps your most valuable secret, your seduction.

Gant Silver Intense is for the adventurous, modern man, he's audacious, on the hunt for those elements of nature, the outdoors rugged and unpredictable at the same time with a passionate character, always seeking an edge, a discovery unknown. He is intriguing in his nature, yet has a graceful elegant personality.
The essence of a journey inside a bottle, with the same turquoise colours as a beach on the other side of the world. A fragrance as sweet as desire itself.
Suddenly, Italian has two new words that mean "romance", Dolce Aura. A classic scent that combines citrus, flowers and sensual woods.

Eternity Now captures the thrill and raw emotion of new love, when two people realise that it is the beginning forever. They come together in a moment of profound clarity where emotion transcends the physical and the sheer power of the connection is unexpected and undeniable.

As a child, Yves Coueslant, one of Diptyque’s founders, spent his summers in Do Son, in Along Bay. The sea breeze carried the heady and spicy scent of tuberoses. Do Son has the delicateness and persistence of a memory from a childhood in Indochina: the memory of a flower, between lightness and delight.

A rose as you have never known it. Clinique Beyond Rose, an exclusive blend of the most precious balms and resins handcrafted around a unique Wild Rose Accord. A modern, clean and sophisticated scent. This is the fragrance of today and tomorrow!

White Diamonds Legacy celebrates the 30th anniversary of the original White Diamonds perfume. Inspired by Elizabeth Taylor's love of elegant jewels, this limited-edition scent is for the confident and sophisticated woman who makes a statement when she enters a room.

description: An aromatic scent for the elegant, authentic man.

Aurien Platiné is the olfactory interpretation of the metals and stones most desired by women all over the world, carefully cut in a collection of fragrances that reflects different, exuberant and illuminated personalities.
Blue nature, the scent of fresh men of body and mind. Discover the freshness and energy of the new fragrance Daniel Hechter.

Yong Rose was born in the process of discussing Taiwan's restrictions. Listening to some heartbreaking stories about Taiwan, or the brilliant people, things, and things, resonated with Linda Pilkington, Ormonde Jayne's founder, and she hoped to create something like Yong Rose. Discover the alluring excitement of a romantic encounter with this fragrance. Tempting tender notes open following with a captivating heart of royal flowers and passionate, addictive trail of sweet gourmand notes will sweep you off your feet and leave you wanting more.

This fragrance transports you back to 1886 to the decadent streets of Kensington where William Sparks Thomson lived. He would awake every morning to the delightfully fragrant crab apple tree just outside his house. Its delectable fragrance would fill the room with its warm comforting aromas.
Men Galbe is a refreshing fragrance with green and citrus notes for men who believe there is always time to reinvent themselves.

An elegant scent with a classical and authentic style.

The freshness of a rare magnetic night. A refreshing interpretation of Nuit d'Issey emphasizing the contrasts of its moonlight landscape under the glow of southern lights on an overdose of ambery woods and vetiver.
Magic, illusion, pixie dust. Curiosity, surprise. Unexpected notes.
A sensual fragrance with touches of luminous accords that evoke sensuality and femininity.

Optimistically outspoken. Playful yet cool. Introducing Thank U, Next. The ultimate fragrance for moving on and looking up. Thank U, Next bursts opens with juicy notes of sparkling fruits that soften with a creamy heart. Divine velvety notes infuse with the base to add a playful femininity. Full of attitude, full of sweetness.

The essence of the House of Prada embodied by La Femme Prada. A grand floral that restlessly shakes off the clichés of femininity. The result is innocence undercut with carnality. Launched with L'Homme Prada, together they depict an olfactory pas de deux, a pairing of equals, regarding each other with studied admiration.
Fancy Lady promises a mysterious yet familiar scent that exudes the very essence of femininity, for those with a discerning taste for the magical and marvelous.
Intimate and narcotic. Dark Vanilla will warm your heart thanks to its sensual notes that evoke an intense sillage. A delightful fragrance for winter that you will not get enough of.
1 Million Intense gathers all the attributes of attraction in order to write the scenario of a love game where boldness and diversion share roles with elegance.

Juicy girls don't have to do what they're told! Couture Couture is busting out with a decadent scent. Let this 'it girl' fragrance inspire you to show off, be loud, talk to strangers, make a scene and love life!

A sublime whisper of cashmere against bare skin. Cashmere Mist Eau de Toilette is a sheer floral fragrance. A lighter, fresher interpretation of the eau de parfum with a subtler concentration of essences.
For people who are authentic and remain faithful to who they are, what they think, and how they feel.
A subtle balance of boldness and sweetness, Gentle Night dramatically captures the duality that lies within us all.
UDV Pour Elle. A glamour and definitely feminine bottle. For Her alone, a new alliance between the freshness floral notes.
Like the street itself, Rue St Honoré is the epitome of elegance, class and mystery.

Cuba Jungle Tiger evokes images of exotic gardens filled with wildflowers. Whether you are the classic girl next door or the daring and adventurous type, this alluring scent’s ability to embody traditional femininity while still hinting at hidden depths keeps everyone around you intrigued.
The majestic rose is reinvented here in an oriental palace. A rose with the allure of a Queen of Sheba, voluptuous and sensual.

Are you the kind of guy that would describe yourself as contemporary, while also valuing heritage and tradition? If so you will enjoy Riflesso, a subtle scent with a continental kick…making it the perfect match for such a creature of contradictions!
A harmony of powdery white musks and jasmine. An elegant and soft scent, comforting like a cotton bud.

name_perfume: Baiser Volé Eau De Parfum Fraîche
description: Cartier Baiser Volé Eau de Parfum Fraîche leaves an astounding trail. Every aspect of the lily, a flower of intriguing femininity, is explored for the first time. A flower of innocence for highly charged emotions. A fresh variation of the eau de parfum, Baiser Volé Eau de Parfum Fraîche is like a whisper of light and airy lily on the skin.

A walk through an English woodland at bluebell time is celebrated in Jo Malones' Wild Bluebell. That magical moment of discovery, when shafts of sunlight pierce the shadow of trees, bathing the carpet of blue beneath with a breathtaking intensity. When the morning air is suddenly suffused with the shimmering sweetness of the delicate, nodding blooms.
Childhood memories of blackberry picking stained lips, sticky palms. A burst of deep, tart blackberry juice, blending with the freshness of just-gathered bay and brambly woods. Vibrant and verdant.

The elusive scent of Lionora celebrates the seductive allure of grace, beauty, and wisdom. Powerful in its delicacy, and completely enchanting, the scent captures the passion and romance of new love, and the strength and sweetness of true love.
18-12, for 18 December, is a luminous, vibrant composition. A fragrance inspired by laughter, joy and carefree youth.

name_perfume: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Coral Fantasy
description: The golden hour is the olfactory inspiration for this fragrance, when the city of Rome vibrates with the force of renewed energy. This golden hour invites everyone to reinvent themselves, express their personality and give free rein to their dreams, desires and fantasies. A world of fantasy awaits you at Roma Coral Fantasy.
An enchanting white floral with an underlying cool aspect. The beauty of this composition echoes the air of mystery and sophistication created by a veil.

Ibiza, a Mediterranean island, a paradise come true. From its crystalline waters to its hippie lifestyle and free spirit. Endless nights of music, parties of lights and colours and fun without limits.
Perry Ellis 360 Collection Rosé is a fragrance for the woman immersed with style, playfulness, and romance. The scent stimulates an endless trail of sexiness, warmth, and intrigue.
A breeze of lively and minty freshness.

A true nod to the beginnings of the adventures of Maison Les Néréides, the fragrance Rue Paradis is a reference to the old jewellery shop in Nice. This fragrance was born of a true olfactory encounter, the woody notes of sandalwood blend beautifully with the mimosa, so characteristic of the South of France.
A milky bath in which we would curl up before finding the one that we love. A manifesto of femininity.

An incredibly chic fragrance, Fleur de Soie opens with a combination of delicate flowers and sparkling citrus. The voluptuous heart reveals more femininity and sensuality. A subtle musky base, enhanced by warm and elegant woody notes rounds off this delicious scent.
Open a door, follow the light and let yourself be guided through the night. An invitation to sensual, reassuring skin-to-skin contact.
Experience Mystique's long-lasting allure, enhancing your mood, boosting confidence, and exuding irresistible attractiveness. Embrace the Mystique that sets you apart.

Osmanthus, but not entirely as you know it. It's a new discovery, catapulting you into a sunny field of flowers embellished with intense citrus notes, crisp and mesmerising as illustrious as the original but more achingly profound.
A totally narcotic blend that creates its own overwhelming magnetism while pulling you in with addictive passion.

Toni Gard Woman is a flowing, floral and oriental scent that emanates discreet luxury. It enrobes the woman who wears it in a veil of feather-light cashmere and reveals her natural sensuality. The finesse of the scent is manifested in the selection of ingredients that are masterfully woven together.
A fresh, invigorating take on a classic cologne, teamed with spicy warmth and creamy woods to create a refined yet masculine fragrance.
Imagine sitting on the terrace of an ice-cream seller on a hot summer's afternoon, a refreshing and aromatic scent recalls the icy sensation of that first spoonful of verbena sorbet.

"I'm asked so often about which fragrance I'm wearing, or if I have a signature scent. I do have favorites, but I really want to create something that encompasses everything I love which is why I am so excited to create my personal fragrance I can call my own," Ariana Grande

The Man of Luxury is smart, cool, yet warm and striking sensual. His job is important to him, he is calm, smart and achieves what he's after. A fragrance for the determined man who uses his know-how skillfully. It is made for you!
Incredibly potent and sexy, this fragrance is warm and mesmerising.
The fragrance's name was inspired by something Yves Saint Laurent (1936 – 2008) once said: ‘I address myself to free men.'
Allow the enthralling notes of Imperial Blue to touch your soul with a glimpse of everlasting love.

In the cool morning air, dew alights on petals. Still-dozing nature slowly awakens with the sunrise. An impatient flower opens gently, revealing itself, radiant, generous, bright. Time passes, unchanging. This is Première Fleur.

name_perfume: Message In A Perfume (Message In A Bottle)
description: "Message in a Bottle" is the recreation of a beautiful experience I had more than 20 years ago, but which has never left me. I went on holiday to the Maldives. I was staying on one of the tiny islands that make up the chain, where only a handful of people were allowed to go…. I really felt like Robinson Crusoe… but a lucky Robinson Crusoe, because I didn't want to be rescued…. I wanted my holiday and the memory of it to last forever".
Figue Du Forêt lets you opt for something fresh, feminine, or sweet, all depending on your mood.

Eternally seductive, Eau de Iceberg Pour Homme is built around an iconic, timeless and devastatingly sexy ingredient: vetiver bourbon. For the refined man of true character, strong personality and intense powers of attraction.
A luxurious floral heart is supported by the sensuality of the base notes.
An olfactory interpretation of the "philosopher's stone" legend, this fragrance answers human's main desire, the quest for eternal life.
Creative energy abounds in this sophisticated spicy scent. An olfactory conjuring of a Balinese temple at dawn.

Miracle Blossom is a fragrance created to capture the miracle of become a young woman. a gradual sense of blooming with its abundance of desires and emotions evoking the magic within a drop of fragrance.

The essence of the romantic woman reveals her ethereal and natural beauty. She is sophisticated and gracious, her style delicate and sensual. This fragrance is inspired by trends that highlight her beauty, her essence and her uniquely romantic sense of style.
Endowed with an unparalleled power of attraction, Pur Ambre captures the utmost mystery of ambergris, captivatingly exuding seduction in successive waves.
Jil Sander Style, a new fragrance that is designed for the self assured woman who does not need to exaggerate her seduction. Style is both feminine and sensual.

This fragrance is so sophisticated, so vibrant, it plays with the magnetic contrast of energizing notes built around the distinct sea stone effect. Alluring and refreshing, the marine saltiness is blended into an invigorating, translucent, and sensual trail of amber fused with elegant woods.
Dry Wood Vanilla is the fragrance for mysterious personalities who love the combination of sweet and woody notes.

Sir Santal is a refined and very elegant fragrance, created from the most precious treasures found in nature. Noble, confident, charming, this aristocratic creation, with sandalwood is at the center of the action like an English sir, on the centre stage.

Love Chopard starts off flamboyant and glossy, a cheerful smile to immediately capture your heart. Blossoming, it grows into a rich and pulsating floral elixir, while the signature is a sweet and lavish slide into a radiant and seductive red carpet trail.
Bring tranquility and leisure under the blossoming trees in the afternoon.
Red Rose is an irresistible fragrance with a unique scent to accompany you all day long.

If freshness were a woman, it would be both naughty and elegant. The sensual softness of flower petals combines with the sparkling freshness of citrus to give this EdC a mischievous, almost seductive air.

Inspired by the freshness of the Mediterranean, and the feeling of Spring air, takes you to the beginning of summer: the sea breeze, with the characteristic landscape of the coasts of Spain, Italy, Croatia, and Greece.

A rich, warm and mysterious scent, Bois du Portugal is bursting with personality and power. Its intoxicating aroma charms you at once, then slowly invites you in to explore its hidden depths. Complex, alluring, soothing. Although it is beloved by men, it is also appealing to women who appreciate a rich and warm fragrance.
Pasha de Cartier Parfum is a fragrance suffused with elegance, an opus with an intense and deep signature carried by the warmth of sandalwood.
What do young women dream of? Free, bold, mischievous and impulsive, they turn expectation on its head, swim against the tide, impose their own rhythm, and invent a brand new tempo.

Mademoiselle Margot is an ode to life and enjoying simple things. Imagine an early morning walk in the garden. Take the time to smell the lemon trees and taste the tangy blackcurrants. Walk through the alley of jasmine plants and admire the poppy field, as beautiful as a painting. Feel the sun caressing your skin. It smells like hot bread. Sit under the big trees and enjoy a vanilla coffee while listening to the birds chirping.
"Since I started working with fragrances, I have been obsessed with the idea of creating exactly an aroma that moved me at a certain time." Angel Schlesser

Dashing down the world's most famous avenue, your infatuation with New York City grows. It taps into your deepest passions and reminds you that there is not anywhere else you want to be. Brilliant and illuminating, the city will always be your ultimate true love.
Far Away Beyond Intense is an enticing scent with emboldening and sophisticated notes.
Accord Boise a decidedly masculine fragrance targeting him who appreciates the finer things in life and whose self-confidence and masculinity are overwhelmingly obvious.

name_perfume: L'Homme Yves Saint Laurent Parfum Intense
description: L'Homme positively dazzles with character and refinement. L'Homme Parfum Intense expresses a more powerful and sophisticated olfactory interpretation, the promise of charisma at its summit. The revelation of a dandy with an incredible power of attraction.

When the sun reappears, the coffee lovers favor freshness by choosing iced coffee. Café-Café Puro Iced; a light and sparkling fragrance specially created to satisfy their desire of coolness and sensuality.

The scent is a play on the original juice. Top notes are of cypress, sweet orange, Italian bergamot, Sicilian mandarin and blue topaz accord; its middle notes are of Bulgarian rose, geranium, Moroccan tuberose, ylang-ylang, marigold, jasmine and muguet, and its bottom notes are of Virginia cedar, sandalwood, Baltic amber and sheer musk.

“I wanted to condense the mystery and strength of the precious blue adventurine stone into the most sophisticated fragrance. I selected natural saffron, the most precious spice in the world, which is very rarely used as an essence. The result is a scent with unparalleled intensity,” Alberto Morillas, Perfumer.
A combination of ingredients that awaken and provoke all your senses.
Santal Austra is a sensual white wood.

Spring-kissed and bright Cherry Moon is the kind of perfume that will make your mouth water. Inspired by the Pink Full Moon, known for love and new beginnings, Cherry Moon is a sultry blend designed to call in love and propel you forward during this new moon cycle.

Tar evokes the smells of the hot asphalt road that excites passionate drivers, the smell of exhaust pipes, melted bitumen and cigarette smoke. Through all this chaos, and pollution, you will find a whiff of wet soil after the rain.

Just when you thought it couldn't get any sexier. Very Sexy For Him 2 Cologne Spray. The second men's fragrance from Victoria's Secret, features crisp, confident and inviting notes of berries, herbs and spices.
Force Majeure, meaning "force of God" describes this incredible men's scent - be prepared for this strong, elegant, masculine fragrance.
Immerse yourself in the warm ambery woody accord that is overtaken by a breeze of star anise and violet.

A crisp breeze that ruffles your hair. The thrill of something new, of an unexpected adventure. The sweetness of the fig marries with the fresh notes of grapefruit and lemon in an unforgettable hymn to life and youth.
A zesty blend of citrusy freshness and fruity juiciness intertwine in the impeccable luxury of Sakeena.

Superdry Hero premium men's fragrance. Bold, fresh and magnetic. Hero possesses crisp fruity notes, softened by gourmand hints. Superdry Hero creates a dominant first impression. Bottled in the brand's signature vivid orange colour, this fragrance epitomises everything core to the Superdry philosophy – contemporary classic with a modern edge.
Eager awakening. Innocent talisman. Sudden, informal and shameless as a compliment, from the centre of the heart of a cherry in a bed of white flowers, resting on the aphrodisiac paradise of musks.

Imagine you’re alongside the artist in the studio. What is inspiring him to create? He recalls this volcanic island, somewhere in the Mediterranean. He recalls the coloors and smells of Tangier where pistachio mixes with saffron. He recalls all his past or imaginary trips that still awaken his senses. Inspiration is a fantastic journey between memories and desires in the present.

Inspired by the wind rushing against the skin at full speed and all the exhilarating adventures and experiences along the way, Master Perfumer Jacques Cavallier-Belletrud composed a grounded fragrance to wear for any occasion. A fragrance that resonates like the heartbeat of a traveller in quest of his true self.
A floral and musky Eau de Toilette that enhances the elegance of cherry blossom.

name_perfume: Les Fleurs De Lanvin Sweet Jasmine
description: Sweet Jasmine pays tribute to the delicacy of fragrant jasmine petals dripping in morning dew, carried through the air by a gentle breeze. This light dawn, warmed by the first rays of sunlight awakens the senses and invigorates the mind and body.
Both fresh and woody, Avengers Eau de Toilette is like its heroes: full of energy!
Azzaro Sea exhilarates. Like that first dip in the ocean on your getaway with friends, this vibrant fragrance is bracing then reviving.
A sunny scent with a deep, seductive trail.

Unapologetically masculine with a touch of luxury. Powerfully opulent, symbolic and authoritative. Boss Bottled Oud is an exciting male fragrance that is distinctive and commanding and the epitome of modern masculinity.
Aromatic Essence for Men pays homage to the iconic Eternity fragrance pillar with a bold olfactive experience.

Do you promise everlasting loyalty to 'FC Barcelona'? Then you know, just like Neymar Junior, that the slogan 'Més que un club' is not out of the blue. It is incredible with what power this fresh men's fragrance evokes your favorite goal.
Fancy Forever Jessica Simpson is an addictive and alluring scent that lasts like everlasting love.

The sun of an ancient city, rises slowly over the citadel, like liquid gold that fills the sky. Now, the early morning murmur of life is about to burst through, much the same as Spring. And in harmony with the masterly shapes that rise upwards from the earth, soft female forms command the sky. The Mediterranean melting-pot is home to a thousand minarets and a thousand fragrant gems.

Illuminating the freshness of wild flora found along the dramatic British coast, Blasted Bloom captures a free-spirited landscape where the energy and majesty of the Sea meets the natural richness of the Land.
Deep amber. Sugar kisses. Chasing sunsets.
