description: This fragrance is the floral expression for summer of the best loved Montabaco fragrance.
A warm and comforting fragrance, with captivating characteristics you'll never forget.
A vibrant creation for the modern man with an electrifying effect that will make you pause in amazement.
Live the limitless life most men dream of! For an urban globetrotter in search of total perfection and a unique luxurious lifestyle.

A floral infusion, both fruity and exquisite; a striking freshness that evokes an afternoon in summer, full of sun. Beneath a black mulberry, in the shade, it's easy to let go and daydream,” Annick Menardo, Perfumer.
A reinterpretation of Prodigieux le Parfum that is even more intense and sensual.

fragrances: Floral Fresher Lily of the Valley
description: The Lily of the Valley flower is native to Europe where it grows wild in the woods of the Alps. Because of its sweet scent and beautiful, fragile appearance, the Lily of the Valley signifies innocence and happiness that has returned.
An ode to the pure, deep blue freshness of the sea. Powerful marine notes crash against invigorating lime heart, anchored by musk and Mediterranean cypress.

Amyris instantly kindles a flame, a flame that never dies. Its center revolves around two planets that galvanize each other: Amyris and Iris. Together the tree born under the Jamaican sun and the subtlest of Florentine flowers create its glowing warmth.

Refreshing Lagoons of Laos is a fragrant ode that transports you to the land also known as the forgotten jewel on the banks of the Mekong. The aquatic tropical notes recall worlds of incredible originality and naturalness: the incomparable moment of discovery of a mysterious lagoon in the rainforest. An aquatic green creation in harmony with transparent floral aromas!

Get used to it! That’s right, Jean Paul Gaultier is once again proud to show his support with this brand new limited edition PRIDE fragrance. A rainbow-coloured perfume that proudly celebrates our love for ourself and our differences.

The proud bottle marching at the front of the parade, Le Male flaunts his chrome torso in a t-shirt tagged with the 1994 Spring-Summer Street Art print matching that of his beloved partner. In his wake, freshness on the skin and love in spades, an eau de toilette for everyone that brings joy to the senses. A whole community in celebration.
This scent is evocative, sensual and enveloping.

''Secreted behind the screens of the Topkapi harem, Murad IV's favorites and courtesans smoke long sculpted pipes, blowing smoke curls to pass the time; a contest of patience to create the most evocative curls which may hint at their destiny. Soft tobacco combines with the delicious scent of opiates, inviting you into the harem of the Great Lord of Istanbul.'' Serge Lutens.

The name Apsu in mythology translates to ‘fresh water', a nod to the watery notes found in its composition. The fragrance was developed with the concept of uniting minimalism with freshness. Apsu grabs your attention instantly with its bright blend of lush green notes drenched in clear water.
Kokeshis are Japanese dolls symbol of mood and personality. Our fragrance Lotus is a symbol of beauty. A bouquet of white flowers and water, it is filled with tenderness and smiles.
"I admire women who can be just as attractive wearing trousers, a plain shirt and short hair as they are in a dress." - Hubert de Givenchy
Born from creative experimentation. Can we imagine a perfume that is as hot and sensual as the voice of Marving Gaye? Yes, we can.
A floral that prides itself on green.

Loewe Water 44.2 represents everything natural, transparent, and pure, taking the first step towards clean waters of the world, an objective to support the preservation of water, taking care of our oceans and seas.

ingredients: ['Rose (Taif)', 'Citruses', 'Iris / Orris', 'Benzoin', 'Ciste Labdanum', 'Incense / Olibanum', 'Vanilla', 'Lily Of The Valley', 'Magnolia', 'Peach', 'Rose (Grasse)', 'Oud / Agarwood', 'Aldehyde', 'Ambergris', 'Cashmeran (Woody musky)', 'Cypriol / Nagarmota', 'Musk', 'Pink Pepper', 'Sandalwood']
description: Lakmé is like a fragrant opera paying homage to the exquisite ‘Bell Aria’. Created exclusively for the Royal Opera House Muscat.

Unique Wood is inspired by the absorbing novel “The Boy in the Bush” by D.H. Lawrence. It explores themes of pioneering the wilderness of the raw bushlands of Western Australia, physical and mental assertiveness, virility, independence and transition to adulthood and responsibility.

It's the story of two lovers who met in secret in Paris. Passionate, exploring the town in search of treasures. Each one has their own trials and tribulations. They walk along the passages and galleries, the stairs of Montmartre. They eat macarons from Pierre Hermé pastry boutique and walk past magazines from the bookstalls. The high point of their peregrination is a hidden garden, where, seated on the same bench, they rediscover themselves, wrapped with the same love of their secret Paris.
100% sensations. 100% adrenaline. 100% vitality. 100% fun. 100% colours. 100% positive. A fragrance for men in motion, dynamic and in the full expression of a spontaneous vitality.

name_perfume: Flacon Aux Abeilles Edition Maison Matisse 2023
description: Celebrating the 170th anniversary of the iconic Bee Bottle, a spectacular Pièce d'Exception features an exclusive design inspired by “La Musique” (1939), one of Matisse’s most recognised paintings. Fourteen unique pieces are adorned with vibrantly coloured motifs created by Astrid de Chaillé, an art craftswoman. For the occasion, Guerlain Perfumers have composed Couleur Bonheur, a modern fruity chypre fragrance filled with olfactory colours as sunny and bright as the artist’s palette. This precious perfume extract is exclusive to the Bee Bottle Maison Matisse Edition.
Deeply voluptuous and at the same time masculine and feminine, this fragrance is inspired by both a gentlemen's club and an Austrian tea room.
Woody notes and incense mingle with freshly picked citrus fruits to create a powerful sensuality.
Playing on the flames of love, Mood For A Dream Man sets hearts alight with a flame that will never die.

"My Dear Friend, In the sky the stars have no names. Children stare at them, looking for a face. I am not attached to answers but find myself more interested in the questions. True creations are unplanned and recipes only contrive it. Perfume is an audacious sleep, an olfactory subversion, and an intoxicating consensus. As I write this letter, Paris is overtaken by a luxury craze. Lyon is not alone anymore: Java, Borneo, Sumatra are smothering Paris under a flow of silk," Serge Lutens.
Remarkable and engaging, Ella is a lasting, vibrant and stylish fragrance .

A lively departure prompts barefoot walks on the cool sand under the pier at Beso Beach. A meeting of sun and gourmand notes spread across the tables, while music floods the space and provides harmony in a moment that you never want to end.
Also known as Red Gold, Saffron's distinct scent meets Orris; it's woody yet oddly sweet aroma with an elegant hint of powder, intensifies with time, taking over three years to reach its peak.

name_perfume: L'Air Du Temps X Antoinette Poisson 2022
description: For this limited-edition version, Nina Ricci’s most iconic bottle has donned a veil of immaculate white, evocative of porcelain. A dazzling hue, on which several graceful doves have settled, delicately etched out in blue ink. This is the second time Antoinette Poisson has been invited to reinterpret the L’Air du Temps bottle. The scent formulated for this fleeting edition is a gourmand floral fragrance infused with the same sense of liberty, playfulness, and joie de vivre as the original L’Air du Temps.

If nature itself composed a symphony, it would be heard in Massimo’s theatre. This libretto of fiery ginger and pimento embodies the poetry of spices, firing up a torrid leather. The maestro sets the tempo before nuances of woods, incense and amber bring out the essence of emotion.
The feeling of warmth and affection is felt with Mini Baby Beé . It has a delicious smell, which brings calm and a cosy feeling.
Lôence [loense] is the result of the gathering work of the royal entourage, and it offers us a mysterious and captivating fragrance with a touch of the juniper berries freshness.

name_perfume: Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Eau De Toilette
description: A salt-sprayed collision of the ocean swell against rugged outcrops. Waves lapping in uncharted caverns. A peninsula awaiting great exploration. Awash your senses with sea-soaked adventure.

name_perfume: The Italian Artists Of Via Solferino
description: This unique scent recreates the fragrant sensations of a Sunday morning when the first rays of the sun peek through the buildings on Via Solferino with the fragrant lightness of a spring breeze.
If you are looking for a fragrance that is certain to dazzle everyone you come into contact with, then you need to get Cuba Jungle Zebra
Splendor evokes an exotic bouquet for the woman who wants to turn heads wherever she goes.
Sporty, energetic and modern, CR7 is a fragrance for the spontaneous and on-the-go young man who aspires to live life like their idol.

Before the elements that form the foundations of the Universe, there were the Titans and Titanides. It was they who commanded the forces of nature. From the power of the waters and the sea came Oceania, the ancient divinity who ruled the oceans and all waters. This creation has the power to regenerate your inner strength and give you new vitality whenever you feel the need for the sparkling sensation of fresh, cool waters.

Imagine you are wandering in the gardens of Porta Venezia, the first public park in Milan, under the effect of the so-called Fée Verte, the green fairy: absinthe. In this scent, the herbal liqueur becomes the key for exploring all the secrets of nature, both its dark side and its luminous aspects. The result is a fragrance that is exhilarating yet dangerous: two forbidden drops hidden amongst woods and flowers.
"I combined soft florals and ripe, rich fruits to capture the sophistication of a woman who owns her sensuality." Harry Frémont, Perfumer.

Coming from the street with all the vitality of its red heart this Latin dance call the Rumba develops the intensity of most cheerful, sensual and dancing suggestions. Rumba is the amazing elegance of Latin energy.
Brew a concoction of passion in your life with U.R. Lovely.
Guerrilla 2. A fragrance for men and women that might be perceived as a pure provocation.
Inspired by a stroll in a peaceful Japanese tea garden, Chakai pays homage to the meditative power of diffused sunlight touching the green moss creeping along the pond's edge.
Cassandra Rose Intense is a fragrance that is both dynamic and mysterious, enveloping you in an exceptionally attractive aura.
An exquisite scent that expresses the essence of Vivinevo's sensual power.
Wafaa is a priceless emotion, captured and treasured in a precious filigree cage. It's a scent that creates memories and lifelong bonds of loyalty.
Aspire Man, a distinctive scent, with seductive woody and alluring spicy notes.
The power of Juliana Paes is found in strong and determined women, who know exactly where they want to go. Nothing can get in their way. The scent of success!
Hemlock's powdery petals, brightened with bergamot. A deadly, yet unexpectedly delicate flower. Luminous, yet crisp and modern.
Fleurs des Sentiers evokes the immensity of the Breton fields in an olfactory bouquet. A refreshing and luminous fragrance, ideal for the arrival of sunny days.
This fragrance exudes an understated sensuality and elegance.

The golden hue and warmth of luxury. Imagine this deep-rooted in the traditions of the Orient. Amber is entrenched as one of the traditional flavors of the East. Each drop is deep, woody, rich, and sensorial.

A cascade of gourmand notes stands out in a crisp scent of roasted Almonds. Pink and white flowers soften the food of the gods with delicate floral notes. A powdery, thick and opulent embrace from which emanate prolonged floral sighs. A delicious nectar of diluted romanticism that delights the senses, which surrender to a hypnotic and provocative juice.

The opening freshness of Musk Vulcain entices the vibrancy and effervescence of this scent, while the heart conveys reassuring masculinity, highlighting a refined signature with virility and elegance.
A fresh, woody fragrance for the strong, unmistakably masculine man with uncompromising taste.

name_perfume: Bruno Banani Woman Eau De Toilette 2023
description: A refreshing and sweet scent for the elegant woman.

The Givenchy man is one who defines himself by both total immersion in his era and absolute loyalty to his roots. Givenchy Pour Homme is the choice of a man for whom a fragrance is a natural pleasure to be indulged in every day, a courtesy that one owes to oneself, as much as to others.

Launched in the late 19th century, when silk was very much in fashion at the court of Queen Victoria. At this time, Asian silk cloth arrived by boat in London and packed in patchouli leaves to protect them from insects.

Created by Pascal Gaurin, Daringly Different is a tribute to Mrs. Vreeland's passion for the Middle East and its light, colours, and scents. Having vacationed frequently in Tunisia and Morocco, she brought the kaftan to the west and launched it to an international crowd through the pages of Vogue. This unique composition balances luxurious floral elegance for a new take on a classic.

Chinotto is one of the rarest and most precious citrus you can find in nature. It's a little tree with small leaves, releasing a beautiful perfume when blooming, that carries bunches of small citrus renowned for their very bitter taste.
Mugler Secret an irresistible fruity floral fragrance, a magical scent both luminous and mysterious… A secret you won't be willing to share. Yield to the temptation and let the charm act!
An Eau de Cartier infused with the raw, elegant energy of vetiver, which crystallizes its power into a fragrance that is manifestly intense. A rush of lighting, or more like a caress?

ingredients: ['Leather', 'Iris / Orris', 'Pink Pepper', 'Birch', 'Fresh Cut Grass', 'Ginger', 'Amber', 'Juniper Berries', 'Mate', 'Clary Sage', 'Tonka Bean']
description: Like a soft and well-worn leather jacket, Leather Anfas is a soft and enveloping scent for the sensual man or woman.
Magnificent Blu whisks you away to a magical world of complete serenity. An enthralling fragrance that uplifts the spirit with a harmony that’s as beautiful as it is simple.
Trompette 8 aims to describe with incense the many sounds of the registers of the Great Organ of Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris.

Pierre Guillaume explored the theme of chypre tea for the first time in 2005, with Hyperessence Matale 12, texturing it with citrus and leather accents. Twelve years later, he reworked this theme with the Rework Un Crime Exotique where the chypre structure is adorned with spicy and gourmet notes. The sin of gluttony in the land of the rising sun …

All of Aqua Allegoria's charm lies in their poetic way of reinventing naturally compatible accords with an irresistible spontaneity. For Pera Granita, the perfumer has transformed granita, the most thirst-quenching of summer desserts into a sweet and cheerful fragrance.

The downy feel of peach brings to mind the delicate sensation of velvet. A fragrance created to be the essential piece in an olfactory wardrobe. The quintessence of style, where fragrance is the fabric.

The scent of the Mediterranean summer. Aromatic and understated with a sense of refined elegance. “Vetiver: a tantalizing scent replete with elegance and classic perfection. I wore it as a boy to feel like an adult,” Domenico Dolce.
Put on this fragrance and bask in electric top tones, sharp and balanced heart notes and sensual base notes, it is for one who knows her mind.
Fresh aromatic. Be drawn to his energy. Unravel in his warmth. This optimistic and inviting masculine creation embodies a true zest for life.
The warm, lush scent of fougère is intensified with sensual, woody notes. A unique and magical experience.
Stand out with Sweet Black Exclusive thanks to its addictive and sophisticated notes.

A limited edition with 100 per cent good vibes, guaranteed. A unique experience, concentrated in pure joy, for a sisterhood that cultivates happiness every day and does what it takes to see the world in a better light. Answer the call of springtime and celebrate your deepest nature: joyful, luminous, harmonious!

Betty Barclay Precious Moments lets a woman shine brilliantly like a gleaming, multi-facetted diamond. The fragrance inspires its wearer to dream of the moments that will shine eternally in the memory like bright diamonds: exceptional encounters and unique experiences…

Heady, floral juice. The 'head' begins with dew coral flower, angel's trumpet flower, luscious lychee water and pink peppercorn. The 'heart' note blends heirloom tiare flower, blush orchid, frangipani bloom and warm sand accord. The 'soul' accords include queen of the night jasmine, moonlit woods, tropical mango musk and glowing amber.

ingredients: ['Sandalwood (New Caledonia)', 'Iris / Orris', 'Jasmine (Sambac)', 'Cedarwood (Atlas)', 'Orange Blossom', 'Tuberose', 'Ylang-ylang', 'Amber', 'Bergamot', 'Incense / Olibanum', 'Mandarin', 'Myrrh', 'Tobacco Leaf', 'Tonka Bean']
description: "Female confidence comes in so many incredible forms. We created Super Gorgeous! to celebrate the strong, fearless women that inspire me every day," Michael Kors.
A natural fragrance that embodies vibrancy and masculinity!
This warm, soothing fragrance is an ode to the man who is master of his craft.

name_perfume: Tous Eau De Toilette La Cologne Concentrée
description: She masterfully manages her relationships with her friends and her professional team, family and looks after the house pets. She is a fascinating woman who knows how to make you feel like the most important thing in her life in spite of so much activity.
The unique vibration of patchouli blends with the timeless sophistication of rose. The result is a composition as carnal as it is elegant.
A deliciously enchanting fragrance that is as timeless as art. Nancy invites you into a mysterious realm of temptation and intrigue.

Platinum; the universal symbol of true love, rarity and strength. When the journey to forever, becomes the promise of a lifetime of adventure. The thrill of the spotlight, all eyes on us, but I'm the only one you see. Each day is a new beginning, better than the one before. Sharing a love so strong, it's Platinum.

An ode to exotic travel casts its spell, enveloping us in the magic of Africa and Brazil, the birthplace of the most beautiful black diamonds in the world. Korloff Pour Homme lets you break the rules, making its presence felt with its subtle, elegant and lively notes.
This scent is a beautiful ode to travel. Close your eyes and find yourself in the Yunnan region.

What would life be without a touch of passion? For Carolina Herrera, it's impossible to conceive. Since the creation of her fashion house in 1981, the New York designer has created a universe of fashion, fragrance and beauty that rejects boredom and celebrates joy, enthusiasm and spontaneity as vital attributes. Her fragrances for women and men, CH Passion, pay homage to that philosophy with a clear objective: to celebrate the Joy of Life that empowers us all to overcome any circumstance. "CH Pasión fragrances are a shot of creative energy for women and men, a love letter to the colours that define our House and an exercise in optimism that invites us to be intrepid. Herrera, Creative Director.

Perfect for the bold, strong spirited and prepared individual ready to build their life's masterpiece. This fine and delicate perfume makes reference to the new contemporary royalties known for their good luck and impressive ways of having opportunities almost fall in their laps. The world traveller is famous for their savvy skills, luminous elegance and impressive aura.

This creation was inspired by the memory of a trip to one of the most romantic cities in Italy, Sanremo, a place famous for its spectacular flowers, its wonderful climate and the gentle sea breezes blowing in from the Tigullio Gulf, where it is a joy to abandon oneself against the infinite blue of the sky. Borea is an endless journey into an enchanted labyrinth that will leave no possibility of escape for those who experience it.

name_perfume: Irresistible Eau De Parfum Rose Velvet
description: With Rose Velvet, a unique wave of tenderness and sensuality unfolds. The eau de parfum reveals its most enchanting and carnal side. Hearts now beat to the rhythm of an enveloping fragrance that exudes a true skin-to-skin attraction. Tenderness is the new audacity.

Club 6 Voyage takes you to the Caribbean without leaving your home! Made for elegant, powerful men who like to be present, Club 6 Voyage brings an unforgettable sensory experience: wherever you go, your presence is noticed!

Hugh Parsons perfumes are for an elegant and charming man with a decisive, modest, strong and tactful character at the same time. Heir of an elegance passing through the times, Hugh Parsons man can get comfort in fabrics and aromas found in far away oceans but manufactured according to the English style and taste.
Liberated with flamboyant olfactory ingredients, the 500 Years eau de parfum blends top notes of rose, the power of spices, and the sense of something precious, in a precious creation.
With Dark Amber, we sail across the Seven Seas. In the stillness of the ocean, we listen to the stories of ancient seafarers.

name_perfume: L'Amour À Paris Eau De Toilette
description: Delicate romantic glamour, which associates the freshness of a bouquet of flowers, with soft, musky and sweet, woody notes. Agatha's Agatha Street, evokes true glamour, so that every woman can have a scent that suits her best!
Inspired by the refreshing scents of an afternoon at the beach, Vibrant Summer brings a pure, positive and natural energy evoking memories of a perfect summer day.
An evocative and warm scent for the sensual woman.
Nature reflected in a shape of a shaker. Feels like summer, smells like summer.

No gemstone is more creatively colored and striped by nature than the Agate (Agathe in French). The scent is as surprising and gratifying as the stone itself. An encounter as feminine as the trail of an evening gown.

"For the creation of Guess Double Dare, I was inspired by the icon and ultimate representation of American glamour and sexiness, Marilyn Monroe. She captured everyone's imagination with her beauty, style, playful free-spiritedness and her bold daring attitude." - Marypierre Julien, Perfumer
Acqua Lotus takes you far away and evokes freedom, space and infinity. With sparkling grace, it switches between tenderness and impetuosity in its own, singular way.

“Passionate about travel, my experiences inspire my creations and allow me to explore extraordinary scented combinations. Pretty Bliss is inspired by my childhood, immersed in the most enigmatic natural raw materials of perfumery. This contrasting scent, sparkling at the head, wild at heart, will give way to an amber woody background. A carnal and feminine fragrance," Amandine Galliano, perfumer.
The essence of minimalism in a light, fresh scent for both men and women.
Party Girl is a unique and pleasant fragrance that is incredibly attractive.
Floratta Flor de Lavanda : a sophisticated and fascinating fragrance, perfect for spontaneous women.
The inspiration to Hollister Festival Vibes For Him comes from all the adventures and experiences that is summer, with a feeling of freedom, joy, and friendship.

Eccentric and unreasonable, Fantasque twirls under the bright lights of the ballroom with its sumptuous decor. Be ready to be surprised: Fantasque avoids banality. This singular spirit lives intensely, in complete freedom.
This fragrance is a tribute to Corsica. Its spices and woody facets makes it surprising and strong, symbolizing the aridity and humidity of the Corsican land.

The first spring sun that makes you happy. The bright aura of May's white flower blossoms in a surge of spring renewal of a soft, innocent, and sparkling green. For a fragrance that speaks of happiness.
Spicy and fruity nuances provide a distinctive top note whilst the floral heart blends with woods, amber and musks to offer an unmistakably evocative effect.

214 Black Vanilla Eau de Parfum is an exceptional combination of Vanilla combined with enchanting notes to promote the refined gourmand encounter of perfumery revealing an intoxicating and unforgettable fragrance.
Eau De Balenciaga Lavande is a traditional and classic fragrance perfect for gentlemen.
A scent inspired by the hundred years old trees in Pucheng, China.

Because women are multi-faceted, emotional, instinctive and cerebral, Eve Elegance is a Haute Couture scent dressed up with fizzy fruits and radiant woods. A delectable smooth perfume that pulls all the ingredients together and enhances the creation with depth for an ultimately feminine and elegant finish.

Devil Tender is the incarnation of free and dangerously bewitching femininity. Virginal but scandalous, under her sweet and cheeky appearance, she aims straight for the heart to ensure the pleasure lasts until the ecstatic end.
This scent was inspired by a blossoming Japanese garden, where a romantic and exciting atmosphere is combined. It expresses feminine tenderness, dreams and loving moments.

name_perfume: Cheap And Chic I Love Love
description: Sparkling, fresh and fun. A fragrance that is as spontaneously fresh as the feeling inspiring it and the notes that exhale since the very first hints. It is inviting like a smile you cannot resist.

“See a shoe and pick it up, and all day long you'll have good luck.” So said Andy Warhol half a century ago, when he first got noticed… The name recalls the artist's formative pre-pop years in 1950s New York when he lived in the first of several apartments on Lexington Avenue, and plied his trade as a prolific illustrator - mainly of imaginative shoes.

name_perfume: Sì Eau De Parfum Edition Limitée 2020
description: In 2020, to celebrate Christmas, Giorgio Armani is thinking big and is offering a limited and colourful edition of his iconic product: SÌ Eau de Parfum. Sì is a tribute to modern femininity, an irresistible blend of grace, strength and a spirit of independence. This fragrance is a modern chypre, which is chic and voluptuous.
Inspired by an ethereal spirit, Cosmic Sky celebrates the magic inside everyone and the power to confidently dream until it becomes reality.

Shakira presents Golden Dream, the emblem for achievement, dedication and courage in its most golden elegant version. Shakira has made it to the top. She has fulfilled her dream to be an internationally recognised artist. It's time for her to share the secret of her success with all her fans. The dream continues with you.
Elegant, mysterious and unique - that's Nero Donna.
She swipes for the thrill of intense moments, hunting for the intense excitement. Untamed and always in the public eye, she lives for the moment of passion, without thinking about tomorrow.
The thrill of discovery, the adrenaline of a first-time encounter, the feeling of being ready to jump into the unknown or dive into a new mystery.
A daring contrast between light and dark, Tuberose Overdose attempts to blur the lines of feminine and masculine. Provocative and simply irresistible.

Benjoin 19 is about a moment. A moment depicted in Tolstoy's eternal novel Anna Karenina, when Anna meets Count Vronsky in a Moscow train station. Benjoin 19 is that moment. the moment when everything changes, when nothing will ever be the same. A universal tribute to passionate spirits.

Patricia Abravanel radiates light wherever she goes. Cheerful and spontaneous, she is an inspiration on and off screen. Her own shine and a genuine smile are her trademark. Her fragrance reveals her authentic and irreverent personality through floral notes combined with woody notes and a touch of vanilla.

“My Oud belongs to a marble palace engraved with gold, set under a dark-blue star-studded night. It's the fine sand of the capricious dune, a fragrant harmattan in the silence of the desert; the sensual atmosphere in perfumery à la française. In short, I considered it as a charismatic player in my palette.” Francis Kurkdjian, Perfumer
This unique scent evokes the lively spirit of a Mediterranean tennis club. Fresh, elegant, invigorating.
Aromatic, warm and green at the same time.
Get cosy with this playful mashup of apricot and vanilla. Perfect for pillow fights and love bites.
In Demeter's Grass pick-me-up cologne, we have captured the freshness and sweetness of a lush green grass pasture.

Sublime materials and assumed opulence, unlimited sensuality: Absolute Scandal. But what is this intense scent of Scandal that sets Jean Paul Gaultier nights ablaze? According to the latest rumors, the Scandal in question is outrageously free, mysteriously charismatic, and very undisciplined. It is even said that his Boisé is absolutely sensual and that with it you will no longer sleep.

This summer, let's celebrate the unforgettable moments that make life special with Mexx - it's time to break and see more sunsets and collect more memories than likes. Let the special summer feelings wear and live just in the moment.

Aflorá was inspired by flowers that, as women, impress by bringing together delicacy and strength. Soft touches and a striking fragrance that envelops your entire body, with a perfect combination for you to achieve more, every day. Your power to always impress!
Our girl has always been confident. She wanted her own perfume and she's getting it… she's not like a submissive woman… she's a strong and confident woman, and knows her own mind.
A refreshing yet sensual scent for the confident man or woman.

The life of Marlene Dietrich was full of passion, whatever she launched, it was with a lot of dedication. My Passion is a deliberately sensuous perfume that brings out the vamp in a woman, passionate, surprising, and very appealing.

Betty Boop became the first reference of the “pin-up” aesthetic with her dresses above the knees, neckline, garter belt, red lipstick, short hair, and lots of charm. All this, now transformed into a multi-faceted, charming, and passionate fragrance that reflects the moods, thoughts and attitudes of a woman.
Intimacy Sport radiates strength and determination. Think of a man who wants to recharge his batteries in a vast desert plain and find a new balance here. A fresh scent to give you energy.
A few years ago, we used to dream of unicorns … now they are unique, strong, and original trendsetters, this is how the glitter craze in festival fashion has emerged!

Madame enjoys going to that cabaret place de la Concorde. In the dark, she notices the silhouette of a man. Always the same man. They often meet but never speak to each other. Around 2 am, when the confident and mysterious dandy invites her to dance, she whispers a few words in his ears: "not tonight."
S.Oliver for Him is an ode to elegance in everyday life, to the great and outstanding moments of happiness. S.Oliver invites you to pause for a minute and enjoy the moment.

Osmanthus is a sun-filled interpretation of the flower's deep and sensual notes. An artistic combination that takes you to the rock forests of South East Asia where the elusive flower blooms with a rich and powerful fragrance.
Rare, narcotic notes worn by Anna Vladoska at her legendary balls.
Don't leave home without AllSaints fragrance. Designed for women and men, they're unisex. Made to evoke the senses with contradicting scents. It's time to find the new you.

The tradition has been immortalised through the generations, handing down the address of this Brooklyn jazz club. An anthology of classic notes and coppery tones, between deep armchairs and a handful of bar stools, with subdued lighting, reflected on the piano where some cocktails linger, wafting their liquory notes.
The freshness of tea rose is enhanced with resins and creamy woods. A refined Arabian Oud accompanies the composition, to create a graceful and sparkling dry down.

Majestic and exquisite, the smooth white bark of the lithe birch stands out against the crystalline drifts of snow covering the forests' silent floor. The sky, covered by impending snow clouds, casts a velvet-like dusky blue backdrop that reveals the stark array of trunks standing silently with frost-decorated branches.
The uplifting fragrance of lavender calls to mind gentle breezes rolling over lush fields on an idyllic summer day.

A memory of India, steeped in the rich and airy fragrance of jasmine Sambac and the creamier scent of sandalwood, is what guided the composition of Madurai. A fragrance that stirs the senses with vibrant notes of citrus and turmeric, like a colourful market stall.

Dear rose, do you remember our marvellous journey to the East? Do you remember all those mythical fragrances surrounding us with their vibrant power? I can smell the perfume of oud wood gain, as lively as a beating heart. Oud enchants me, with its mystery, its warmth, its vibrations, the quintessence of an unforgettable, scent-laden journey!
Fougair is as clear as a bright morning and at the same time wraps you in a cocoon of lasting elegance. For urban free spirits.
A bright and refreshing scent with an intense trail.
An intense, sensual and carnal fragrance that dresses the skin. A deep velvet with enveloping softness that drapes the skin.
For lovers of the night, this fragrance has a dark, classic yet sensual feel to it evoking feelings of long dark capes and nights at the opera surrounded by sophistication and glamour.

Cuir 28, our Dubai exclusive, is Easy Rider without the sweat and gasoline, blending powerful, dark and mysterious notes to create a potent personality. Sweet, spicy and smoothly animalic notes give Cuir 28 its oriental and addictive finale.

Once Upon a Garden transports you to that idyllic summer, full of youthful exuberance and anticipation for the adventures ahead. You are drawn to the warmth of the summer night, with the feel of a cool breeze against your skin. The recollection of the fragrant sweet pea in bloom holds your secret, an innocent first kiss. Is it a memory or a dream?

When the hour begins that changes desires, sailors' hearts melt and an authentic uproar of conflicting emotions begin in the left hemisphere of the brain. The doors of vibrant, vitamin infused energy are opened to the vibrant depth of a memory. At this point, the perfumer Nathalie Lorson masterfully plays with the unfathomable paths that men's thoughts sometimes take. Therefore, heart notes pass from spicy tones to floral accords. The fragrance concludes with a woody blend of base notes.

That moment when when Autumn is captured going into winter. The freedom of cycling past the former spice warehouses of the Warmoesstraat to a canal-side apartment on Prinsengracht on the elegant south side of the city. Wind in your hair. Now you're inside. Cosy and warm. Dark wooden furniture, flowers in the window.
Cactus Garden contains an extraordinary garden. On an exotic patio that offers shelter from the heat, astonishing scents blossom.
Extraordinary is an edgy seductive unisex scent. It is designed for people with a strong and charismatic personality, who are always a step ahead of the trends and make their own rules.

Classique X is getting more suggestive than ever. Genuine jewels, necklaces, or bracelets, accentuate the bottle's voluptuous curves to the point of excess. You'll love undressing the bottle and wearing these Jean Paul Gaultier accessories for a sexy touch of chic!
Summery, bright, radiant and fresh: Sunny Fruit from the Douglas Collection Privée is the perfect scent for a dazzling mood and thriving life - just made for the cheerful, fun-loving woman.

name_perfume: United Colors Of Sisterland Yellow Peony 2023
description: Yellow Peony is the most romantic of all sisters. Free-spirited and dreamy, she shares the same values as the other sisters and believes in a community where they accept you as you are, without judging you, embracing and celebrating difference. Because that’s what Sisterland friendship is about. Yellow is her favorite colour and she always keeps yellow flowers at home. Her pink hair is a burst of optimism and inspiration. Her chic Italian style triumphs wherever she goes. She loves flowers, natural fabrics and organic food. She is dreamy, genuine and tender. Who wouldn’t want to be her friend?
Inspired by David’s authentic journey, lifestyle, and values, this scent is classic with an edge, for an everyday touch of effortless elegance perfect for any occasion.

Soothe your heart and soul with the warm, fragrant scent of Demeter's Nutmeg Ice Cream. Enveloped in fresh cream and garnished with a touch of sugar, that's just enough to remove any bitterness, but not enough to make the fragrance sweet. Fragrant Nutmeg is the star here, but balanced to be wearable.

Like a model on a fashion show catwalk, Sensual Orchid captives your senses with its incredible aromas. This fragrance will take you to the front of the stage. The carnal pleasures evoked by this sumptuous arrangement of natural sophisticated fragrances awake all the sensuality surrounding.
"I have chosen your name for this perfume because none is more beautiful. Because I love you. My Paris." Yves Saint Laurent.
Inspired by the intoxicating scent of the Western Australian outback in the intense heat of summer. The dry air tingles as wild fires threaten.
A mysterious scent with a vibrant, powerful trail.

Strong, but sensitive, heroic, yet vulnerable, the Bad Boy is confident in who he is, embracing all sides of his contrasting personalities. Bad Boy captures the multiple facets of contemporary manhood in an explosive yet sophisticated modern scent.

name_perfume: Rewind & Play Again The Feeling Of The Night
description: A modern fragrance by Andrés, Luis and Nacho from the DVICIO music group. An intense, seductive and masculine perfume to enjoy every day.
Malik al Oud is the essence of paradise.

Ardenbeauty is a fresh crystalline floral fragrance with an inviting presence that is as multi-faceted as the woman who wears it. It evolves into an array of rich florals. The background is warm and enticing, defined by amber, woods and musk.
The Cool Water woman is a night enchantress, bewitching and instinctive. She emerges from the dark water, seducing and appealing, and attracts her man.

name_perfume: Flora By Gucci Garden : Glamorous Magnolia
description: A soft sassy floral, Glamorous Magnolia is a recreation of this most lustrous bloom. The Flora Garden woman is youthful, enigmatic, beguiling, and contemporary, but with a sensitive appreciation of the past. There is more to her than meets the eye, not least, a fusion of strength with grace.
Egeo Red is the essential signature for the feminine, striking, and decided woman who is having fun, enjoying all the possibilities as if there were no tomorrow!

Named for 1971, the year that the United Arab Emirates declared their independence and sovereignty, Limited 71 Intense is a lavishly celebratory limited edition from the house of Widian. It combines the best quality ingredients in one bottle and packaging at once. Only 900 pieces will be available worldwide, and each piece will be numbered with a special certificate included.
Primordial fumes of deep spice, wood and fossilized Baltic resin. Otherworldly.

Agua Fresca Verbena Mujer is a celebration of summer, of a simple life, of people, the land and the sea. It's a return to our origins. A limited edition fragrance created with natural, vegan ingredients, gentle and respectful of your skin. Wild, bright, amazing. As simple as that.
The light, the flesh, the air of flowers. An ethereal, vaporous, atmospheric fragrance. Flowers in weightlessness.

Today is the first chapter in a trilogy of love. Like a butterfly emerging from its cocoon, Today is a beautifully feminine, metamorphic fragrance that embodies the love of yourself, your life, and who you are today.

Fall under the spell of a rare and precious revival of Loubidoo with Loubidoo Rose. Faceted by master perfumer Daphné Bugey, this scent was inspired by a three-dimensional expression of a rose, then brought to life via the expert extractions of a centifolia rose absolute, a centifolia rose infusion sourced from the region of Grasse and an otto rose essence.This intoxicating trio bursts forth from the fragrance’s rose heart accompanied by head notes of cedar and base notes of musk that draw out the flower’s true character and reveal all the sensual secrets between its petals.
Allow yourself to be seduced by the magic and colours of this unique fragrance. Wynwood will reveal your inner beauty to the world.
The essence of strength and perseverance. Life can challenge us all, this scent provides us with the strength to fulfil our hopes and dreams.
Starlight Shimmer reflects the mesmerising glamour of late nights and infinite lights.

The freedom of a new day. The sunrise in the Araucaria forest, The morning breeze is still full with the frost of the night, spreads through the fields while the Araucaria awakens. L'Occitane au Brésil was inspired by the liveliness of Araucaria at dawn. A fragrance for men who seek their moment of freedom.

Like the woman embodying the campaign. A futuristic amazon, dancing with the devil, under a vanilla sky in the Californian desert. Possessed by the electro beats, she offers up her silver covered body by the gods of blissfulness.

A room with a view: on her bare skin, the reminiscence of ecstasy, and in the air, a slender trail of cigarette smoke. The indelible mark of love, the burning memory of lustful passion. Tubereuse is a narcotic perfume, the thrill of the forbidden, a return to perfume’s natural instincts.

Experience the power that comes with the sensation of freshness that takes over with Eudora H Acqua. Give your body the maximum refreshment it asks for. Energize yourself its intensity. Finding the balance of spirit has never been so refreshing!

The very definition of elegance according to Mademoiselle Chanel. Charismatic and natural. A floral-fresh-oriental fragrance in six facets that finds an expression unique to each woman. Because every woman has her own special allure.

Born of the seas and magically built on stilts, Venice was for centuries the gateway to the Orient and prospered under the rule of its elected leader, the Doge. Under his reign, a world of spices and resins came to Venice, flanking and often mingling with local products. Thus was born an extraordinary world of perfumed ointments, and Baume du Doge: a warm, exciting and rich fragrance.
Celebrate your individuality with a fragrance as unique as the dresses that inspire them. The simple elegance of the haute couture dress in velvety sandalwood fragrance notes.
A desire for freedom, space, and strong emotions rings out in Kenzo Jungle pour Homme.

This scent was an echo of Brazilian architecture – strong and modern, always responding to nature. The aim was to bring coolness and warmth at the same time. It’s a woody fragrance, sometimes bracing, sometimes cozy.
Volcanic Flowers combine notes of white flowers with a gourmand accord to create a delectable depth and leave a vibrant and woody signature on the skin.

The pure, magnetic raw materials that make up this floral gourmand, resonate with feminine mystery. A perfume that is milky, tender and "round", yet addictive, it will appeal to women who are gentle, intuitive, gracious, welcoming, magnetic and mysterious. A sensual perfume, infinitely tender, full of candor…

Inspired by the famed feline, Leopard of Arabia is a perfume of predatory intent. This sensual and scintillating scent will leave you ready to pounce, as it bursts with animalistic character, sure to set everyone's pulse racing!

brand: Au Pays De La Fleur D’Oranger
description: The luscious figs with it's milky sap and green notes create a fruity fresh fragrance. An opening note of this sensual fruit together with citrus notes announce a heart of green and woody notes. A musky trail is draped in an sensual and candied notes for a long lasting signature.
Yardley Gentleman Elite perfume with vibrant top notes, and a masculine heart that settles to signature accord of warm woody notes in the base.
Iceberg Homme – A fresh, luminous men's fragrance that's also warm and sensual.

A fruit basket garnished with violets leaves a gourmet trail, just like this fragrance. Delivering a blast of fruity sensations, this fragrance is deliciously fresh and delightfully enticing, creating an uplifting invigorating elixir.

Designed for the romantic dreamer – a fun-loving and compassionate woman, who knows what she wants and how to get it. Warmth, sensuality, strength, these are the key elements that underline the characteristics of Zenya. A fragrance with vitality and sensual authority. In one word. Inspiring.
Black Opium Neon Edition is a vibrant and indulgent perfume that's a perfect combination of seductive and sweet.

This is an intensely scented love potion to delight all the senses. It whisks you away to the land of the Thousand and One Nights, a luxuriant and opulent invitation to foreign climes, steeped in luxury and voluptuousness.
Nature's aphrodisiacs presented in a perfumed kiss create a signature seductive perfume.

A bold fragrance, reflecting the urban, contemporary, active life of the Lalique woman. A dream-like fragrance, sculpted from materials as luminous as crystal. A soaring fragrance, inspired by the elegant swallow Lalique has chosen as its emblem.

Masculine and sophisticated. Sexy and stylish. The Stetson Black fragrance blends warm, masculine notes of sandalwood and spice with notes of fresh woods and liquid suede to create a sensuous yet clean fragrance for the man with a magnetic and mysterious persona. His charm, confidence and scent are irresistible.
"The lavender's camphor notes, softened by the burst of bergamot, make this cologne highly addictive," Sophie Berdoues, Perfumer.
An invitation to dress your body with a light scent. Sensations of freshness and lightness.
Indulge yourself – and all your senses – with this eau de parfum that tantalises and seduces as it reveals its secrets.
This wild, fresh fragrance opens with fruity notes playing off crisp oceanic notes. The core refreshes with a bouquet of flowers. Woody notes blend with musky notes for a strong close.
Immerse yourself in summer with Coco Lada, a devilishly sensual, exotic and sunny fragrance. Inspired by your favourite cocktail, it promises to intoxicate you!
Explore uncharted excitement with 2 Bijou a sexy contrasting scent.
Bring light and the bohemian spirit into your days with Ibiza Bohemia. In just a few breaths, you will travel to the most elegant of islands.

An essence for women that captures all eyes and stands out for its intelligence. Her captivating gaze and charming smile attract more than one. It is your perfume if you are strong, sensual, and sure of yourself. Someone who is different from the others and is looking for the perfect scent to feel irresistible.
Ambivalent powers, supernatural vibrations. Ginger electrifies while incense hypnotises. A fragrance to feed fantasies, assault dreams. Bewildering provocation, it intoxicates the senses.

White Suede captures the whisper of whiteness, the subtlety of shadow. Luxurious, expensive, textural elements wrap you in a feeling of warmth and intimacy, exploring the primal tension between smooth, typically masculine leathery-suede and feminine musky florals; White Suede has a cocooning emotional impact hypnotically drawing you into its soft sensuality.
A fragrance inspired by the unique power of women and the strength of their self-love. A multifaceted aroma, full of emotions that moves between softness, energy, and intensity.

Narciso Eau de Parfum Poudrée is a delicately seductive fragrance for women in the iconic Narciso collection. This powdery floral fragrance envelops the senses, cocooning the skin in a diaphanous veil of scent.
An irresistible fragrance that encourages you to say yes to the simplest and most unexpected moments of love.

The Idole Eau de Toilette woman glows with a magnetic sensuality and a natural grace. She is exquisite, captivating. Sexy and sensual, she is expressive but reveals her strength of character. Free to be herself. The elegance of her inner soul makes her simply sublime.
A fragrance light enough to wear all over your body all year round. It seduces the senses, skin and spirit. When in doubt, wear red.
This glorious fragrance awakens memories of heady smoke trails steeped with traditional aromatic incense, and combined with precious notes to create a warm and cocooning feel.

The Almaz evokes a beauty so enchanting that it has captivated people for centuries. A clarity so pure that one glance is enough to mesmerise. A love so powerful that its eternal radiance will shine forever.

The scent of Oud resin exerts its attraction to the full, matched only by the seductive force of the Rose. Together they combine the exceptional and the absolute in a harmony that rejoins the hallowed tradition of the fragrances of the Orient.
Urban Spirit is a young, modern and elegant fragrance.

I was inspired by the Ed Hardy clothing line more specifically by its vibrant colours! The Perfumer. A tantalizing abstract floral cocktail, this fragrance reflects the same colorful vibrancy, optimistic energy, and open-minded movement of Ed Hardy.

4 Agua Clementina evokes citrus groves and winter fruit by the River Douro. The Douro is best known for its vineyards that rise steeply from the banks. Lyn was particularly struck by the citrus trees gracing wine estate gardens.
A fragrance suggesting the delicate rustle of a draped fabric in motion. The mysterious pleating of a tulle gown, the oxygen of a bubble skirt, the signature of Lanvin ribbon.
A fruity, floral, festive fragrance. An explosion of citrus fruits and berries open this perfume on a flowery garden of majestic flowers while a musky veil rests gently on the skin.

Opening with Guatemalan cardamom and Moroccan artemisia, this fragrance reveals the perfect balance between the woody, sensual richness of oud and the smoky scent of Bulgarian tobacco absolute. It is the luminous trail of an impertinent fragrance with intense contrast.

Bold and bright melancholy thistles guard a long-abandoned castle in the Scottish Highlands. Entwined with a green freshness, this woody aromatic scent is underpinned by coolwood to summon the ivy-covered stone walls inside a majestic relic.
An award-winning fragrance, Bijan was created for the woman with an inborn taste for perfection. Capturing the essence of elegance and style,

Sandalwood Sacré is an airy and spiritual Eau de Parfum. Milky sandalwood and patchouli will transport you to the heart of Indian rituals, where incense sticks burn precious woods. This fragrance will take you to meet Yuri Gutsatz, founder of Jardin Retrouvé, who has worked intensively in India to discover the aromatic plants of this country rich in aromas. Sandalwood Sacré, created in 1981 by Yuri Gutsatz, was then called Eau de Sandalwood.
This scent is an exploration into the sour edge of one’s mind.

An infusion of leather, an invitation to explore the senses. Travelling often has the power to embolden desire. Dans La Peau imprints on the skin like indelible ink. A scent that doesn't feign desire. It lays it bare.

A tribute to the gravel from the Hudson River that makes each bottle unique. The name of the cologne was born during the perfumer's walk along the Hudson River when he first took pebbles from the Hudson and added them to a perfume.
"The rose is the queen of all flowers. In Donna, I mixed Bulgarian roses and Rose de Mai with other precious and noble flowers to obtain the quintessence of femininity," Lorenzo Villoresi, Perfumer.
Inspired by Valentina, her world and her lifestyle, Acqua Floreale is like a leisurely stroll in the midst of nature, immersed in the sensual and exciting fragrances of a summer garden.
Voluptuous and adult vanilla, vanilla that has been around the block, vanilla that has nothing to do with cupcakes. Enveloping, warm and slightly dangerous.

Acqua di Giò Parfum is an olfactory escape into exhilarating sensations and experiences, exploring man’s intertwined relationship with nature. A charismatic, vibrant fragrance with an aura of mystery, emblematic of a rugged landscape meeting the ocean’s strength and immensity.

The romantic and enchanting fragrance of Rosa centifolia, the hundred-petal rose, has inspired perfumers throughout the centuries. Our eau de toilette pays homage to this captivating ingredient with an enticing blend.
All the refinement of the Arabian Oud associated with Damascus roses. Enhanced by pearls and sparkling resins.
Midnight Muse was inspired by Shakira's iconic dance moves. An intimate, brilliant and inspiring version that represents a confident, strong woman.
Opoponax is a fragrance with an elixir of character. A majestic and sensual blend.
Jolie Rose is a true girly-girl fragrance that brightens your day and enhances your mood!
Embrace your bold self with Colour Me Black, an invigorating fragrance designed for men.
A fragrant break in the incredible universe of the Mexican Day of the Dead filled with colours, music and joy!
Instantly vibrant, sparkling and effervescent as a modern interpretation of the classic Cologne, this dazzling and immense freshness brings light to this wonderfully radiant perfume.
Beautiful beaches. Vibrant sunrises. Far Away Bali captures an exotic island vibe with alluring, sparkling notes.

FIORE DI PORTOFINO is a unique bouquet inspired by Portofino, the Italian enchanting location considered one of the eight wonders of the world. It is a lively and bright fragrance filled with the bay's transcendent magic: the chromatic spell of its waters, the glistening horizon, the glamorous personalities and VIPs that have contributed to its history and fame, the olfactory story of its nature that blooms with rare beauty.
So Sweet is for audacious, fearless and charming women as it represents an invitation for an "overdose of fun.”

The fireplace dances to a marvellous tune played by the evening owl, the restless deer rustling through the woods, and the turtles splashing their way into oblivion. The smell of the tall trees engulfs your senses, the warmth from the fire lights the night of tranquillity. Cabin Retreat takes your senses away with precious woody notes.
A refreshing scent for the sporty gentleman.
M4M conveys energetic and mysterious masculinity from the very first glance. A fresh, aquatic perfume with intensive woody notes/
Curve for Women is a sparkling, sheer, feminine watery-fresh floral which will be unforgettable.

It is a spicy composition with a dry scent and strong hints of mace. The perfume was created by a French noblewoman, the Countess d'Aumont, wife of a Marshal of France, who used it to perfume her gloves. It is said that because of her interest in alchemy, she was accused of witchcraft and burned at the stake.
Casamance. Peaceful, Savannah. Beginning of ceremony lulled by the magical harmony of a Kora. A mirage leather, wild, woody and spicy.

Here at Strangelove, we are celebrating 50 years since we landed on the moon. After months of sourcing some of the world’s most beautiful and precious ingredients, and testing each version, we are thrilled to be introducing the fifth scent in our collection of oud-based perfumes.
A distinguished eau de toilette with strong character, Rejuvenating Vetiver is the very essence of charm.

Aromatic and fresh notes, enriched with spicy touches, open this composition with a strong woody personality. The rich floral bouquet is enhanced by powdery nuances, which give the blend a timeless elegance. The accord finds its harmony in the multifaceted smoky shades and sophisticated touches in the base.
A fragrance that will appeal to even the most demanding and sophisticated man. Embodying a new expression of contemporary masculinity, artfully fusing fresh and captivating essences.
An energised and fatal fragrance.

Earthen notes of cistus flourish in dry heat. In homage to the traditions of Día de los Muertos and All Saints’ Day, De Los Santos captures the transcendent power of coming together in collective ceremonies, translating scent into a new ritual of remembrance.
Mystical and fluid, with tones of Chinese ink and bewitching essences of hard wood, this anthracite fragrance is liquid incense with notable prestige and elegance.

The sea has fashioned a legend that electrifies the enamoured heart: whoever swims through a rocky passage will know a lasting love. The Canal d'Amour, such is its name. The Greek island has many other secrets to share. Landscapes of wild, mountainous and wooded beauty lead to visions of Italian, French and British architecture, Byzantine churches and Roman remains. Epochs, cultures, languages, traditions, scents, can all be found in Corfu. The island of all encounters.

Enjoy the beauty of Valor for her, this magical and charming aroma comforts your senses and cloaks you in a delicate touch of flowers, sparkling fruits and sensual woods. The foundation is soft and creamy delivering a memorable and long lasting sensation.
When the Empire State mingles with the premier Gulf State, the alluring result is Bond No. 9's Dubai, a new collection of modernistic New York-inspired Arabian perfumes.

name_perfume: Be Delicious Pool Party Mai Tai 2019
description: Dive into this playfully addictive fragrance - DKNY Be Delicious Pool Party Mai Tai makes a splash this summer with this limited-edition Pool Party scent, Inspired by trendy summer cocktails that are staples at every pool party, one spray will make you feel as if you're lounging next to the water.
"Today I cannot remember anything. We had grapes last midnight. I think we touched, our foundations mixing. I feel young again," David-Lev Jipa-Slivinschi, Founder-Perfumer.
Oud Musk is a perfect fragrance for summer nights.

A harmonious fragrance, as fresh and delicate as a caress at the start, followed by an almost cheeky side. D Homme will captivate you from the beginning, like an intriguing kiss leading to sensual abandon.

Vivir is a women's perfume that reflects the balance between opulence and femininity. It has addictive notes of cocoa that blend with the radiant Jasmine of Sambac for the woman who celebrates life, chooses to be happy and enjoys every moment. Live with that smile that changes everything!
Mezcal Blanca is a sheer citrus with solar resins.
Zaad Santal brings the warmth and sophistication of sandalwood to enrich the routine of the man who enjoys intense and elegant perfumes.
Infusion de Figue encapsulates the vibrant personality of the fig in a woody green fragrance.

"There is no other straightforward way to say that you have reached an unlimited world when you get a 1 trillion credit card. Nothing you can dream of is out of reach. A very simple and powerful message. No Limit$ is the passkey to fulfill more than you can ever desire. It is all about fun, excitement, money, and sex. With No Limit$, your life has no limits, so get in, your access has just been granted!" - Philipp Plein, Founder

The trench coat possesses the all-military demeanor of a uniform. Designed for British army officers, the symbolism of this utilitarian garment has all to do with in-field realities: a collar and waterproof canvas fabric shield from the rain while a double-breasted crossed closure and buckled belt ensure total freedom of movement. Pink Pepper & Grapefruit is a mood-enhancing composition comparable to a tropical expedition through the jungle of Brazil. A surprising scent experience that infuses with new energy and vibrancy.
Atelier Des Ors poetically magnifies each of its creations in a glittering ballet of stardust. An intensely distinguished emotion.
Rose Pétale, with its fruity floral notes, full of freshness, evokes the queen of flowers, the rose centifolia in its most beautiful finery.

“This perfume creates a sense of confidence and spirited energy, which becomes an attractant to those around you. This is the effect of this particular molecular formulation,” Azzi Glasser, Olfactive Director, and Perfumer.
Get caught up in the game with this sensual, woody-oriental Eau de Toilette. Created for passionate and assertive men who dare to seduce.
Immerse yourself in the wonderful world of Wonderful Intense, the glittering eau de parfum with enchanting notes. Solar, floral, intense, it envelops your days with delicious and joyful notes.

Pear Inc. is a «serious» fragrance name that hides its true nature: an improvised lunch underneath the pergola, the sound of laughter, a water bomb playfully exploding, a finger dipping into a jar of jam. Pear Inc. is that mischievous perfume that instantly makes you smile.
The butterfly's wings. Silver clouds blowing. The wind in my hand
This is what a date with your favourite fragrance should be like. This fragrance is super fun and makes you feel like you're in love, like hugs & kisses.
Intense, organic, and seductive.
Inspired by confident, joyful and powerful women, this scent is an invitation to self-love and discovering inner beauty and feminine sensuality.

Celebration is in the air. At the stroke of midnight, a toast, and an unexpected scent of emotion is born: fresh and sparkling bubbles of champagne burst on the hot perfume of candles, lost in the heady notes of pepper and frankincense.

Electric, sparkling and exciting. A sense-awakening fragrance. Fresh vibrant citrus notes blend with fruits and greens followed by a heart of lively floral notes accented by unusual fruity stalks. Finally, woods, resins and musk give the scent its bright diffusion and intensity.
Wild, woody, lushly green and resinous. We’ve created a fragrance that fully evokes the feral aspects of the forest.
She takes the burden, yes. She acts and she doesn't care what they say. She wants it, she does it, she gets it. She brings joy, she's sassy, oops! She's happy like that.

The fragrance opens on fusing silver tones, the composition is intensified by hot and cold spices. Finally, the trail reveals itself in a bewitching combination of ancient scents sustained by the elegance of woody notes.
A sensual and mysterious scent with an intense trail.
Style as a necessity and elegance expressed through a constant search for beauty, virtue and truth: this is the magic of Trussardi Uomo Levriero.

The Acqua Originale Collection is Master Perfumer Olivier Creed's living fragrance journal of countless globetrotting journeys with the fine art of perfumery as the narrative. Born from Olivier's appreciation of Japanese art and culture of the Far East, Asian Green Tea evokes the landscape of Malaysia, another of his favorite Eastern destinations.
Pretty & Sexy is an irresistible and naturally sexy fragrance.
| Man |² is an expression of intrinsic, masculine values. He leaves no one indifferent to their surroundings. He interprets the new masculinity in the purest form and gives it a clear profile.

There is a place where body, mind and soul find harmony again. On tropical shores, in the shade of coconut palms caressed by sea breezes. Here, lying down with eyes half-closed, you may see Creole women, with pale and amber skin, pass by. One of them slows down, her eyes full of strange spells, thoughts wander lightly and impertinently. Lost in a delicious dream of tactile and creamy treasures.

Like the fuel that adds fire to make a hot air balloon soar powerfully into the stratosphere, this limited edition fragrance ignites the will to undertake a risky yet exciting exploration, like scientist James Glaisher in the epic adventure film The Aeronauts, who embraces challenges and ventures on a vaporous voyage escalating to infinite heights.

Rouge Seduction was born from an idea to represent a woman with character who knows what she wants, with a magnetism that is impossible to ignore. Dare to follow your instinct, the ultimate seduction!
This scent is like a dream come true: brilliant, unforgettable and bold.
A romantic and dreamy fragrance for women featuring a bouquet of flowers with a fresh, green and floral scent. Dedicated to calm, charming women, who with their imagination find true paradise.

Outrageously Vibrant is an "amped up" version of the original Outrageously Vibrant perfume. "It is far more luxurious, far more soulful and speaks to a more sophisticated fragrance customer who likes a more powerful fragrance experience,” Alexander Vreeland.

"I have a beautiful childhood souvenir: the smell of the leather handbag of my mother. I wanted to create that specific moment in adding a luxurious and feminine touch of the majestic flower, the Iris." -Mathieu Nardin, Perfumer

Like for her was designed to create happy moments during the day to maintain positive emotions and good mood. The composition is designed for those who appreciate naturalness and sincerity, who is confident in their dream and doing what you like. Scents remind us that the best is yet to come.

La Fille de l'Air is the feminine icon of Courrèges and expresses the freedom of expression, movement and life that Courrèges offers to their creations. A surge of lightness, a wake of light, "the girl in the air" inspires as much as she fascinates. The scent, in its original version, unchanged, illuminates with its musky orange blossom.

ingredients: ['Freesia', 'Lily Of The Valley', 'Cashmeran (Woody musky)', 'Jasmine', 'Peony', 'Rose', 'Bergamot', 'Pink Pepper', 'Black Pepper', 'Cedarwood', 'Musk']
description: Step into sophistication. A relaxed sense of sophistication, combined with a luxurious touch of bohemian style, she fits in seamlessly and stands out effortlessly from the crowd. Breaking all the clichés of what is traditionally chic, she is the beautiful, free-spirited woman in each of us.

Created in ancient Egypt, 4000 BC, Le Dieu Bleu exhales its divine and mysterious perfume to inspire beneficial mediation with the powers beyond. Now beautifully reconstituted by perfumer Dominique Ropion, its marvellous, intoxicating and solar essences evoke the colourful splendour of the temples and frescoes of ancient Egypt.

"A rose-forward floral, laced with an unbelievable, edible, ambrosial note transporting the wearer straight to the rose fields found on the border of the Black Sea … Legend tells that a single Turkish rose was used by the Sultan to designate his favorite among the harem. To this day, if Jasmine is The King of Perfumery, to me rose is the unmistakable Queen of it all." - Rodrigo Flores-Roux, perfumer.

An intimate and deep perfume, Autoportrait is an intimate and deep perfume that you wear for yourself, resonating with your own personal harmony. A companion, a reflection of yourself, familiar and warm, in which you rediscover your own spirit and inner serenity.
Celebration Woman will remind you of a gentle breeze on a sunny day.

Let a Gold Seed extracted from an ancient Roman site in former Hispania fill your senses with the intensity of true luxury. Combined with the marvels of Diamond Quartz, this deep fragrance will take you to the strength and power of history through its combination of Mediterranean notes of everlasting and labdanum with an oriental chord.

All the wonderful stories from Dolly’s front porch, straight from the Smoky Mountains to our hearts. Dolly’s joy and positivity inspires us to chase a firefly, dance in the mountain mist and enjoy every sunset. Share your dreams, have some fun, create your stories with this bright, powerful scent!

Hawaiian heat, sweet rains and mild breezes transform Hawaiian vanilla blossoms into the richest, most aromatic vanilla beans in the world. Demeter's Hawaiian Vanilla is a warm and wonderful scent. Without it, life would just be "plain vanilla".
A wave of freshness by the beach! The salty ocean air heats up step by step and diffuses aromatic marine notes, making for a spontaneous and passionate scent.
Cassis Frénésie, has an appetite for living, loving, tasting pleasures, without moderation, in an utmost exaltation.
Rife with flowers and spices, Serenade is a romantic fragrance exuding an aura of harmony and assent. A most harmonious of fragrances, an overture to love and devotion.

name_perfume: Ginza Stefany Wish You Were Here
description: Long ago, a traveller from afar fell in love with an elegant beauty in the bustling Ginza district of Tokyo. Wish You Were Here transports you back in time to a quiet, dewy meadow at dawn where Steve and Stefany declared their love.
A vegetal freshness and floral sweetness, subtly enhanced by cereal and milky notes.
Take a moment to engage in a truly stunning sensory experience with VIP Oud.
An expressive, fruity perfume with a tropical vibe and great sillage that can be worn well on any occasion.
Sun Java Rose Oud, is a sensual and feminine jewel. Its notes will caress and envelope your skin like a ray morning of sun.

name_perfume: Jasmine & Sun Rose Eau De Parfum
description: A flickering lantern warms an ornate lattice doorway. Story-telling shadows dance across a lustrous pillow, as soft as the rippling sands that dissolve into the distance. The gentle whisper of a hand-woven canopy welcomes in a light twilight breeze. A Deltaic garden, bathed in moonlight, is heady with night jasmine, elegant rose and davana. Succumb to the allure of a dark floralscape.

Enjoy Solinotes's interpretation of white tea, delicately scented with bergamot to gently awaken your senses. The purity and the freshness of its notes, widely used in perfumery, reveal a timeless and floral fragrance.
My Looks Man Color is a dynamic fragrance full of verve, with notes that oscillate between revitalising and encompassing.

The brilliant freshness of the opening is emphasised by the passionate dedication to beauty in the heart. The sensual warm shades in the base enhance the depth of the fragrance, giving it a voluptuous old fashioned glam.
"An exclusive creation based on an innovative black leather accord, intensely masculine and modern." - Honorine Blanc, Perfumer

"Bright, delicious and elegant, with enchanting opulence, with volume. When I smell it worn, it feels like a cloud that overwhelms me, catches hold of me. It's a delight, a truly ultra-feminine and addictive fragrance." - Quentin Bisch, Perfumer
This fragrance celebrates courage as you embark on a journey to the dark side, where you dive into your deepest, darkest fears, and emerge victorious.

description: A flowering mirage shimmers among dusty pink sand dunes at sunset. Shimmering mists of golden saffron, tinged with rich cassis. The floral swirl of velvety rose and geranium, wrapped in earthy Sulawesi patchouli: hushed and sumptuous. Fall under its spell; lose yourself in the mystical beauty of the desert.

This fragrance elegantly expresses the time-honoured bond between Venice and the East, expressing the splendour, the opulence and the fascinating alchemy for which that ancient world of spices is justifiably renowned.

A symbol of royalty, the oak tree was very important in France's history. They were all felled during the French Revolution but Serge Lutens has used rum absolute to recreate this exceptional, iconic woody note to add a comforting and elegant masculine element.

Authentic and unexpected, the Rochas Man Intense trusts his instincts and lives by his own rules. With this intense version, he is writing a new chapter in modern masculinity and revealing his many facets: charming, charismatic, seductive. A captivating character with a magnetic energy that fascinates and enthrals everyone who meets him.
A timeless and refined scent, not unlike the woman who wears it.
Alliance born from the inspiration of Carlos Benaim, one of the great perfumers of the world.
Relax on the shore, let your mind drift away. The rhythm of the water creates ripples in the sand, and the azure sea flows into an infinite blue sky.

For a collection exclusive to Harrods, Alexandre.J flexes its olfactive prowess to create scents that are truly and exceptionally unique. Inspired by Art Nouveau’s recurring theme of nature, Ode to Rose explores the beauty of nature in all its forms.

Live an adventure at sea from the refreshing top notes of rosemary and elegant pepper to the vibrant heart of sage and lavender. In the background, fir balsam joins vetiver to enhance the hypnotic personality of the composition. A perfume that concentrates the vibrant sensation of a marine odyssey.

Rosa Turchia captures the essence of a rose freshly harvested from a blooming garden in May. Delicate and innocent, yet opulent and bewitching. One sniff is all you need to instantly reconnect with the beauty of nature.

Cool Water Game, “good vibrations”, good times. A beach-bikini weekend blazing in the sunshine:a tangy, ocean-spray “sea breeze” with a frosty heart of frozen cocktail of luscious exotic fruits, softened by a floral bouquet of aqueous, translucent water lily and delicate freesia. A seductive swing of woods and musks are irresistible, making the scent radiant and bewitching that fits like a drenched wetsuit.
Burberry Brit Rhythm For Him is inspired by the exhilaration and adrenaline of live music and the electric energy of the crowd.

name_perfume: La Petite Robe Noire Eau De Parfum Velours
description: Under the spotlights of a Parisian catwalk, it puts on a show. It glides boldly and smoothly with an undeniable modern and Parisian allure. Terribly on-trend, its radiance wavers between shadow and light and the depth of velvet takes a stand: sensual, enveloping and definitively enticing. It is La Petite Robe Noire Velours.
Ruby Red is an exuberant fragrance, enhanced by the perfect synergy between the spiciness of ginger and the delicacy of flowers.
Gourmand, rich and sensual, this fragrance with additives fruity accords, warm in heart a sublime patchouli with a bewitching base made of litchi elixir.
Basat Al Reeh is like an essence of dreams. Its fruity and earthy scents will bewitch your senses and make you desire more.
Diffusive spicy notes in the top provide an initial impact whilst a white floral accord in the heart adds richness to this unique and precious scent.
In autumn, if you hold the highland barley in your hand, you will smell its fragrance, feel the shadowless wind, the fresh rain, in the distant sky, and under the fiery light.

Every man is an adventurer, and he wants to find a fragrance befitting his level of machismo. Embrace a perfume that was made keeping you in mind. Your hard work, your pain, your dedication and attitude are all encompassed beautifully in the rugged fragrance of L'Aventure. Dependable, long-lasting and full of masculinity, L'Aventure smells just like you!

name_perfume: La Rosée Des Jardins D'Ispahan : Sublime
description: Chaugan's noble heritage takes us back to a time to a past that is the stuff of legends, a sophisticated Orient where princes set the tone for refined living. The palaces, the architecture, as finely wrought as jewels, are fragrant with delicate perfumes; the draperies swing in the breeze in the warm breeze caressing figures reclined on plush silk carpets… in an atmosphere perfumed with veils of incense.
A masterpiece in contrast and elegance…

The inspiration for this exciting blend was derived from an original formulation dating back to late 1850s, when Truefitts offered a service of making up exclusive fragrances for various Regiments, prominent institutions as other as well as other persons of eminent status. 1805 was launched in 1999, a fragrance to commemorate the year in which William Francis Truefitt opened his salon doors for the first time and thus establish a business that would successfully carry on for the next two centuries.

“Whenever I think of Harrods what do I think of? It is the ultimate. It is where you find the finest example of everything on earth, all in one place. It is a temple of luxury unlike anywhere else in the world. This scent represents the absolute embodiment of luxury, bursting with the world's rarest and most costly ingredients,” Roja Dove.
The coolest waves are dressed up in summer colous. Let the summer radiance invade you with this refined and exciting summer scent!
Go on a spicy Ayurvedic journey with this scent, and awaken all your senses.
