description: This sensual, powerful, and refreshing fragrance is an intense formulation with the most amazing aromatic nuances for your ready-to-go mood.
The fragrance aims to attract men who have strong, bold personalities who can stand firm no matter what the situation. They are acclimatised to new scents and appreciate bohemian fragrances.
Inspired by Giuseppe Verdi's opera, Rigoletto reflects the hustle and bustle of the performers backstage, the warm atmosphere just before the curtain opens.

“Black hemlock had never been used in the perfume industry before Ormonde Woman. From the moment we met, it became not only the inspiration for this scent, but also the start to my philosophy of fining rare and exquisite oils. The dignity and bravery that Socrates showed during his slow death after choosing hemlock as his position adds another dimension to the femme fatale element that make this scent so appealing."
Blanc de Sienne is a luminous fragrance, as luminous as Italy.

The essence of French women's assertive femininity. Worn to seduce, captivate and leave a unique, unforgettable sillage. A fragrance with a big personality for the initiated, flaunting intriguing and elegant accords, enhanced by contrasting ingredients.

The she-wolf, the imagination runs wild. What creature lies behind this name? Where would a wolf live? This she-wolf is heraldic. She lives on top of a mountain in a castle of snow. A tale from the dawn of time, and a perfume.

"Composing Holy Peony was like painting a portrait of a visibly charming woman. This peony was created in a floral and fruity trompe l'oeil style, with the inviting sparkle of red fruit. Holy Peony is a luminous scent, like a rose without thorns, soft, yet confident," François Demachy, Perfumer-Creator.
This fine ambery fragrance has head notes of citrus and spice. Its heart notes of soft gourmand notes and fruity, florals rest on base notes of powdery and green woods.

Gathering reflections from a past journey, Marie has infused the olfactory pyramid with some Mexican sun, wafts of aromatic herbs mixed with the intimate smell of men's skin and the wild smells of a distant island.

name_perfume: Amazing Grace Magnolia Eau De Toilette
description: Heartbreakingly fragile, a wind whispered melody so familiar that it's part of you. But you still catch your breath every time the sound blooms around you.
Messy hair, white shirt, faded jeans, sports shoes. Her look is sublime, he is an angel. A breath of liberty and modernity, no strings attached.

“This creation is my homage to everything feminine: a lingerie drawer, make-up, and a knowing look. It is like the caress of cashmere against the skin or a woman's tender kiss which stays with you for a lifetime,” Roja Dove.

As revered by the Iceni as she was feared by the Romans, Queen Boadicea merits a special place in our valiant history. Daring and driven, her spirit has been captured in Adoration. It mixes light and shade in playful profusion. Adoration is both a glorious tribute to the past and a thrilling step into the future.
Smells so good, you can almost taste it.

Toy Boy speaks to a unique, dynamic, enthusiastic and passionate man, but one who is not afraid to reveal his more tender and playful side. Toy Boy is an exciting play of endless codes seeking out re-evaluation and liberation.
A barnyard oud, deep, dark, and sensuous. Extreme velvety potency. Generous like the nature of the oasis of Ulya.
Intrigue your senses with this royal blend of citrus accords intertwining with a robust floral bouquet in the heart and luxurious notes in the base.

ingredients: ['Palisander Rosewood', 'Iris / Orris', 'Lily Of The Valley', 'Coumarin (Tonka Bean note)', 'Rose', 'Ylang-ylang', 'Vanilla', 'Musk', 'Peach', 'Sandalwood']
description: A simple, subtle and timeless scent that smoothly passes through ages. A fragrance to make you forget all others!
Created for the dreamer in all of us.
A tribute to the successful Boss Woman: Expect everything.

name_perfume: Flora By Gucci Garden : Glorious Mandarin
description: The Flora Garden woman is youthful, enigmatic, beguiling, contemporary, but with a sensitive appreciation of the past. There is more, much more, to her than meets the eye, not least, a fusion of strength with grace.

The Guess Man is a force of attraction, one with style and intrigue. His fragrance is a powerful mix of excitement, allure, and sensuality. It awakens the senses with a burst of zesty citrus. The heart notes reinforce the fragrance's freshness and create a bridge to the sensual and provocative base. The overall effect, a bold and uncompromising fragrance that captures the essence of Guess.
Like the Jardin du Palais-Royal, a favorite strolling destination for Paris lovers, this sophisticated fragrance, both complex and harmonious, is resolutely iconic, just like its inspiration.

"Here, captured in a bottle, we have a picture that sweeps you away to a far-off beach in the Indian Ocean. With this one-way trip, you find yourself lying on white sand surrounded by coconut trees with a view of a turquoise sea," Thierry Wasser, Perfumer.

“Flowerbomb Extrait is a bewitching elixir of which every precious drop exhales all the density and intensity brought by ingredients, carefully selected for the particularity of their olfactive qualities.” – O.P., Perfumer
Nina Nature is a clean and vegan scent that immerses you in nature. Enjoy a green new world.

JV XX is a fragrance inspired by the sensual warmth and addictiveness that has allowed John Varvatos's heritage to stand the test of time. The cologne was inspired by the celebration of style and music, the heart and soul of the brand.

Yes Please! is a homage to Manchester in the ´80s, railway tracks, old warehouses and an energy like no other, legendary bands that went on to break world records playing in crammed clubs where everyone and everything came together as one. A time of unforgettable nights of dancing, music and late-night shenanigans that seemed to be all that mattered.

You have no need to hide. You stand up for what you believe in, even when it is uncomfortable. Everyone's against you? No problem. You're your own man. The new scent OTTO KERN NEVER HIDE is for brave opinion-makers who don't mince their words!

Faithful to her philosophy and her deep attachment to Art, Nina Ricci invites the painter and illustrator Martyna Zoltaszek to draw Nina Ricci's Paradise. She animates Le Paradis de Nina Ricci. Lush vegetation, exotic fruits, wonderful creatures. The artist signs a poetic fresco that comes to dress the cases of these limited editions. A window opens on the wonderful.
Bubble Gum. As the relationship between scent and memory is one of the cornerstones of the Demeter Fragrance Library, this fragrance is a flashback to childhood with this new fresh scent!
A refreshing yet sweet scent with a moreish trail.
La Lune is a perfect enigma. Fresh yet sensual, dazzling yet forever retaining her secrets. She enthralls everyone she encounters with her radiant and ethereal beauty.
Prove yourself and the people around you that your energy is boundless. Never stop. Surpass your limits, and tackle every challenge. Opus Men will keep pace with you wherever you go.
Allow the spotlight to fall on you because the scent of Doux Amour will draw everyone's attention to you.
Revlon's Fire & Ice Inferno, is a charming and intoxicating scent for the charismatic and passionate gentleman.
Infini is an ode to modernity, a fragrance of absolutes.
A thrilling fragrance for the sensual man.

After exploring the far end of the Arabic Peninsula, the nomadic couple continues its path towards the Mediterranean sea. They are surrounded by the desert peaceful scenery and discovering luxurious palaces en route. For this new journey, the couple feels like the great adventurers in the history. Eutopie No. 3 captures the essence of the most precious ingredients, elegant woods and refined spices, as always interpreted with a French touch and sophistication.
An authentic, feminine and curious woman, she wants to broaden her horizons. She knows what she wants and how to get it. She lives intensely and is fearless.
As a breeze going through gardens and hills, it comes to you with flowers and fruits. A perfume with a marine note is a harmony of flowers on a background of musk and amber.

Inspired by Greek mythology, from the creative vision of Paolo and Tiziana Terenzi, always able to combine tradition and innovative research, comes a new creation, Themis. Titaness of justice and balance, she was the emblem of unshakable solidity, just like the extraordinary persistence of this fragrance.

name_perfume: La Vie Est Belle L'Éclat Eau De Toilette
description: La Vie est Belle L'Éclat Eau De Toilette highlights a modern, bright and dazzling freshness, embellishing the orange blossom and iris which were the core of La Vie est Belle L'Éclat.
S.Oliver for Her is an ode to elegance in everyday life, to the great and outstanding moments of happiness. S.Oliver invites you to pause for a minute and enjoy the moment.
Energising, inspiring and, uplifting. It's time to play.
Seductive, intimate and sophisticated, Esencia in Black is directed to a passionate man struggling to get what he wants out of life.

An assertive woman, the Mexican artist Magda is the muse of young poets. On Tuesday evenings, she sometimes sits around Mallarmé’s small round table. Craving perfection, uncompromising and curious, she fills the small living room with her exotic presence. Yet soon, Magda will leave to return to her land brimming with flowers and fruit.
A cool blend of fresh fougère notes and subtle spicy elements, evoking the romance and promise of a balmy summer evening.

Inspired by the brilliance and charisma of show business as it soared to mesmerise a global audience. The Greatest Showman for Her is a beautifully original perfume that celebrates the wonder felt when dreams come to life.
Light and breezy with plentiful character, Aqua from the Love and Joy collection is a fresh blend of floral and woody notes, with an unmistakable scent of the sea.
This is a premium perfume with fresh notes on an elegant heart, with a warm base that celebrates femininity.

A new kind of seduction is emerging from the shadow. Come closer and discover Whisky Black Op, the fragrance of an untamable and fearless man. The stylish and modern camouflage design of the bottle hides a mysterious and powerful scent that will make you stronger than ever.

Sands are a perfect allegory for the Off-White brand. They are also symbols of cultures and coasts around the world as they travel around the planet thanks to the wind and the seas. Solution No. 1 is an interpretation of the smell of sand in all its transparent and airy facets.

Spontaneous, diffusive and impossible to ignore, Giordani Man Notte captures the iconic appeal of the stylish Italian man who celebrates life to the fullest. A charismatic fragrance that conveys Italian masculine style to perfection.
Avon Stamina is designed for everyone who likes to discover new opportunities and longs to experience unforgettable moments full of excitement.
A sophisticated blend of sun-drenched citruses and sensual woods.
Do dreamy femininity our way, with babe dreams fragrance.
Mexx Man – Powerfully aromatic, wonderfully spontaneous. Mexx Man. Inspired by life.

Flamboyance and colour - two key carnival concepts that inspired the artist's work. The cap is a spectacular mask that disguises and embellishes. The bottle mirrors the curves of a woman's body. Within the bottle and effervescent and passionate fragrance.

description: Provocative. Luxurious. The ultimate expression of sexy. Give in to Victoria's Secret Seduction. Designed to seduce the senses, Dark Orchid is a signature blend of midnight orchid.
Leather Patchouli invites us onto the shores of a lake in India where we surprise the reflection of the first rays of the sun on the calm water. A spiritual journey where time seems to stand still.

name_perfume: Pepe Jeans London Calling For Her
description: An original fragrance inspired by the famous Pimm’s, a traditional British cocktail, that smells like sunny days in London, summer parties and Wimbledon.
Miss Giordani Intense is a sophisticated, exuberant fragrance that lifts your spirits and helps you celebrate your passion for life.

The sun ignites everything in its path. Vibrant shades of blue reflected from the seaside pool, capturing the warmth of a summer day. A moment suspended in time. Enjoy this limited release of cK One Summer, a creative collaboration with artist Joe Cruz.

Decadent evening, wrapped up in the sensuality of amber. A heady pairing of a legendary ingredient with deep, characterful patchouli. The tempting smokiness of guaiac wood. A supple, suede-like finish. Seductive.
Cardamon & Mimosa is a very sensual and addictive scent which both you and those around you will fall in love with!

On Men Red invites you to enjoy the provocative nights, the seductive looks and the intense passions as if there was no tomorrow, after all you only live once! The exclusive Secret of Eudora brings sensuality and ensures that the meetings are even more irresistible. On Men Red. Live your most intense days!

L'Eau Kenzo Aquadisiac ventures into the depths of the ocean … resolutely fresh and surprisingly sensual, it embraces a new captivating dimension, like an invitation to let the exciting thrill of the deep sea snap you up.

name_perfume: Spf Like Marine Waves For Him 2018
description: A wave of watery freshness combined with sensual notes of ginger, provides the sensual masculinity of the scent.
At the bottom of the sea, Christian Louboutin anchors his famous stilettos in the urchin of a hood bristling with spikes.
A fragrance inspired by Butterfly Flower, a flower known in the Caribbean for carrying messages from women who were not afraid to take a chance on love.

"Beauty and femininity are ageless. Bella empowers women to embrace their individuality and inherent beauty. We believe this sensual scent will resonate with the Vince Camuto woman, offering her another fragrance option for the many facets of her life," Vince Camuto.

The top ace walks around in the aisles of a casino, drawing all the attention towards him. You can see him in an outstandingly charismatic tuxedo, dressed to kill, sharp as the ace of spades. Leaning on the counter, he orders a bitter Lady Grey and tastes its citrus notes, with sour bergamot on top of that. Now’s the time to play his cards right. So much for making heads spin, here comes the roulette. His cunning ways set the tone: hitting jackpot is guaranteed, a true lady-killer!
Transparent as the spring’s air, imbued with a delicate spirituality, Milize, spread touching hearts as an unstable love. Light and precious as silk in the air.
Dry by Superdry. A rich, aromatic, woody fragrance that combines a vibrant top note of citrus notes with subtle spices to provide a balanced scent.
Indigo Tanzanite evokes the mysterious aura of the Tanzanian plains, and the country’s sumptuous skies at night, which are reminiscent of tanzanite’s intense purple-blue color.

Fico Fiorentino is an exclusive and timeless fragrance designed for true lovers of artistic perfumery. A creation of alchemy, unique in sensations, born out of an ancient perfume culture, which is centered on the excellence of raw materials.

A highly aromatic citrus scent of Sicilian orange groves.
Assemblage of sandalwood in two different extractions, brightened by a radiant and spicy green cardamom signature.

Imperial Ruby, a unique gem that provides an unforgettable trail for ultra-sophisticated women. A fragrance for lavish evenings. Dazzling with radiance and seduction, opulent in her refined elegance, luxurious with the precious jewels she wears; she walks proudly and confidently, as if on the red carpet.
A wonderful scent full of joy and life for the sensual woman.
Inspired by the acacia vitality and the freshness of its palms.
A sweet fragrance for the romantic woman.
Inspired by the exotic essences of a tropical rainforest, lush with its warm sweet perfumes of fruits and flowers unknown.
Sensual & elegant.

Obvious, extra fresh, free. An Eau with unique freshness and simplicity. An explosion of citrus with insolent modernity.

Awaken your sweet side with Ornament Purple Allure, motivated by candied notes in a musk environment.

njoy your own personal getaway with the perfect summer escape! Whether you lavishly splash or lightly spritz, you'll fall in love at first mist with this sugary scoop of summer berries and sweet accords.

An innovative and distinctive fragrance, dedicated to those who wish to distinguish themselves by their extremely subtle elegance, with a touch of incomparable class and style; for those who do not need to show off to be noticed, because the trail of their unique and inimitable perfume is enough.

Fruits and flowers bring their perfume, their color, their freshness in a collection of light waters inspiring those who wear them the same sensation of radiance as with the care. These are the Radiant Waters, they make life lighter and more joyful.
A rare and precious perfume of elegance and sensuality. Armateur Gold Limited Edition finds itself as a rare fragrance hidden within a black and gold bottle
A mesmerising sillage that spreads through Dubai at night, until dawn.

Achievement in seduction: the silver and seductive power of a man's inner strength.

This masterful blend of herbs, berries, resins and flowers is harvested in the Florentine hills and sealed for three months in special Tuscan terracotta urns, where it undergoes a special fermentation process that produces this special fragrance that has become a worldwide success.
Intended to refresh the legacy of the original Z- 14, Halston Z is a fresh effervescent scent designed for the active man who is unencumbered by pretense. Contemporary, clean, and spirited.
Boca Raton is a true floral poem. Allow yourself to be seduced by this exceptional creation.

The scarlet fuchsia sunset was her only hint to their destination. He had spent months organizing this event in the greatest secrecy. Surrounded by everyone they loved, they savored the moment with joy and excitement. When the doors opened, she recognized the beach of her childhood. Everyone was dazzled by the vibrant colors, the exotic perfumes, and the exhilarating tropical heat. The party could finally begin.

Its mesmerizing essence offers an irresistible pull only she can control: her femininity.
All eyes want me when I walk in a room. Intensely sexy, and in control, I command attention. The adoration drives me - never satisfied, I ache for more.
A fresh citrus fragrance with a velvety floral body. A light way of living.

A “captive body”, the reconstitution of a very dry wood, ebony, oak and guaïac wood for a woody scent that is almost abstract. These extremes blend together releasing the Ether Angel as if it were a perfume… An imperceptible emotion, which – if evoked – could be that of a perceived reflection shimmering on the wing of a dragonfly.
This enchanting scent perfectly embodies the unexpected and captivating beauty of a warm coastal getaway. Immerse yourself in a captivating and refreshing escape moment.

Radiant caress. Idyll between drops of dew and velvet textures of the petals of aromatic roses. A captivating aria that finishes with the adagio of musky notes nestled between the leaves of grassy notes.

The first Jo Malone fragrance was created as a gift for the original 20 facial clients. The warm, woody scents are seasoned with nutmeg and vibrant spices in this unexpected combination of ingredients.

A beautiful everlasting scent that leaves a delicate veil on the skin.

This men's scent is fully loaded with adrenaline to reach supreme freedom.
A carnal and sweet scent, with an unmistakable oriental tone.

I finally have the sand beneath my feet and I can gaze on the endless expanse of the ocean! Warm sunrays on my face, salt on my skin, and the freshness of the water at my feet – this is where I belong.
The perfect balance of grape jam and peanut butter, which took years to achieve and more tries than we can count. American comfort food at its most fundamental.
Joélle captures the perfect feeling of joy with the fragrant nuances of light. Designed for a modern, confident woman.

Sisley makes its Soir d’Orient scent more covetable than ever before in this limited edition, which encases the bottle in a gold-tone crocodile pattern and spritzes with a vintage-inspired pump. Charged with mystery and femininity, its iconic fragrance has endless facets thanks to a dynamic concoction of fruits, spices, and florals.

A floral fruity scent that is seducing from the beginning, dragging you deep into her secret, surprising, and incredibly colourful world. Lovely•U is a magic secret code to get to her universe.
This fragrance is like salty notes on a fruity breeze.

Created especially for urban fashionistas.

Rocked by the waves and in the shade of our sail, we wander through this bustling village where men and women shake hands, embrace and kiss. Deep layers of colour intermingle on the facades forming a patchwork dedicated to the sun, to Helios, to the sun. Floating in the air, just above the water, is the perfumed trail of the Dolce Vita.

A perfume that transforms the perception of remaining motionless, becoming "a new form of resistance, in a world where everything is too fast. And where the greatest power is to decide what to do with one's time", as Sepùlveda says.

Sophie Like is awesome! Beautiful, cool and fragrant, perfect to go to your friends' house, they'll want to use too!

Only those who are not afraid to love being able to fly high, those who are always themselves, who believe in friendship and protect nature. Those who are like you, man or woman.

description: Eau de Virginie is powerful right down to its base. Luminous flowers in the heart to create a balanced scent. Virginie's aim is to offer a floral and sensual bouquet that does not betray its direct freshness with spicy notes.

Beach samba nights. Dancing on the beach, bursts of orange and blue in low light, crashing waves and the ecstatic laughs of the young and sexy. A cocktail of clean sex appeal.

The scent unfolds into oriental notes of coconut water blended with the sensuality of amber accord. Your ultimate call of freshness, hedonism and seduction.
The lightness of vetiver wood is cut with a soft musk to create a perfectly balanced freshness.
Modern adjustments bring a contemporary twist to this timeless classic, creating a new legacy of elegance.

A bright, sparkling scent with enveloping accords.
Void is nothing but the purest scent of tea, which is the long-lasting tranquility that every tea drinker feels after tending to a tea party.
A traditional French expression of freshness.
A bold freedom! Courrèges liberates women and offers them a new shape with the miniskirt. A free spirit in a free body.
Nude is a fragrance that compliments a woman who is elegant yet sensuous, and is reminiscent of summer romance.
Pure charm and purity that only a white rose can evoke. When you want to challenge new things, when you want to change your mood, you will want Flora Notis White Rose Scent.

How far would you go to experience pure beauty? Escape your everyday life and travel to the beauty and wonder of the Aurora Borealis with Far Away Aurora. A unique fragrance that captures the unique moment when warm sunlight awakens the untouched nature of a sleeping, frozen world.
A sparkling scent with elegant, sensual accords.

Mirabeau, what a pretty word, peculiarly Parisian, suspended above the Seine. It composes a memory, joins another bank, and returns by following its trail of sandalwood, pink bay and cedar. In the heart of the City of Light, on the way to the twilight of the day, there is a bridge, a poem and a perfume.
Warm musk is combined with a touch of freshness to play, explore the world and discover new sensations!

name_perfume: This Is Her! Vibes Of Freedom
description: Vibes of Freedom is an invitation to get away. To cast off. A breath of fresh air that fills you with energy and lets your mind sail free. The essential step before you make a move. Press pause. City vibrations give way to those of nature. Because the Zadig & Voltaire woman can do without the city, but she can’t give up her vibe.

"I was really inspired by the unique energy that NYC emanates. A downtown attitude in a cool, luxurious way. It's so New York! That's why I chose to create a fragrance that evokes this duality of a spontaneous and absolutely chic urban lifestyle." - Juliette Karagueuzoglou, Perfumer
“For me, the perfume doesn't have sex, if you enjoy the smell you love, you can wear it. We wanted to create something that would resonate with everybody,” Alberto Morillas, perfumer.
Loved by our founders for its crisp, modern essence, Silver Pearl captures the brand's love of fashion. Where classic elegance meets the avant-garde.
Committed to using the finest and rarest materials, Italian luxury perfume house Xerjoff artfully combines traditional craftsmanship with contemporary creativity.

name_perfume: Boss Alive Eau De Parfum Intense
description: Boss Alive Intense is a captivating Eau de Parfum that celebrates the lust for life and the boldness of women everywhere. Created for individuals who dare to embrace the unexpected and explore new opportunities, this powerful scent acts as an inspiration to live life to the fullest, every day.

Fleur Narcotique is Ex Nihilo's interpretation of the new Rive Droite's woman, sophisticated and seductive. The musk coats an overdose of substantive ingredients revealing new softened and voluptuous nuances on the skin. Its sillage becomes deliciously intoxicating.
Alluring, radiant and zesty.
Make a lasting impression with Madame kiss, your fragrance as sensual as a kiss!
Perfuming and hydrating water for the body. Eau de Varens Nº 3 is a sweeping fragrance for him and her, in line with the vibrant rhythm of the ocean.

From the end of their surfboards, we experience the desire to push time zones further away so the summer never ends. 'Bohemian Soul' reflects this journey with elegance and modernity: an immediate freshness, like a gentle wind rising up over the ocean.
Enriched with organic verbena from Provence and citrus accords, this eau de toilette tones and leaves a sparkling, fruity scent on the skin.
Lale is the original name of a tulip in Turkish. It evokes a refreshing yet understated sweetness.
A distinctive and compelling woody spicy perfume composed using nature's finest aphrodisiacs, leaving a perfumed kiss in the wearer's wake.
Vanille Absolu reveals it's true nature with a dry scent that is authentic, deep and warm. Pure sensuality.

Bohemian Infusion was inspired by the stories of the Piazza at Covent Garden in the 19th and early 20th centuries, when it was a playground for sinful and decadent pleasures. Elegant and romantic, yet exuberant and libertine, this bold scent seduces you without you even noticing.
Delicate essence, the symbol of purity.
Sajwaa reflects the beauty and glamour of women in Arabia. It emphasises the individuality of its owner.
It smells like danger yet it's crisp, fresh, and warm at the same time.

Treat yourself to something delicious. A playful side of Pleasures that's simply irresistible.
Magnetic, confident and sensual. She has style and heart. She is always a trailblazer, paving the way towards her destiny, letting nothing stand in her way!
A celebration of Tommy Hilfiger's love for music and his passion for emerging musical talent - a vibrant, modern composition with real soul and rock 'n roll roots.

name_perfume: La Vie Est Belle L'Eau De Parfum Rollerball
description: La Vie Est Belle is the fragrance of joyful femininity that makes life more beautiful. It is for the woman who lives in the present, who is filled with honesty, truth, and gratitude, and who is free of social constraint, to blaze her own unique path.
Cheers! Let's hear it for the sparkling perfection of spring. Whether you splash copiously or sprinkle lightly, you'll fall in love with Champagne Toast at first sight.
Anaïs Anaïs Premier Délice L'Eau embodies the memory of the transition from adolescence to adulthood, a true legend, revisited to the delight of young girls today.
Mini Cici Mel was created especially for tween girls who love to be always perfumed, connected and ready to play. Your new fragrance to collect moments and have fun!
This voluptuous evening interpretation of the rose is instantly warm and enveloping. An elegant evocation of an elegant dinner surrounded by roses, crystal glasses and cutlery.
Roma fragrance was born in 1988, better known as the sentimental voyage in my town past, which have left intact my search spirit and love for the eternity city.
Volatile and mysterious, this fascinating scent comes and goes freely, constantly fluctuating. Its magnetic trail generates a seductive echo. The essence of the Cavalli Man: leave your imprint.
Sueño Mujer by La Martina is an extremely sensual fragrance. It highlights both the charm and the elegance of the woman wearing it.

This fragrance plays on the luminescence and generosity of oriental notes. Its opulence flows like a promise, thrust into the counter-current, wild nature exposing itself with sophistication and grace, all while seducing you.

Love Shot, the assertion of a sophisticated and uninhibited Parisian femininity. The memory of the carnal opulence of the seventy's most iconic creations, the olfactory trail of a Palace, a "Coup de Foudre" in the twilight. The elegance of a great Chypre with a contemporary signature, twisted by the fantasy of fresh raspberry and a bewitching leathery musky accord.
The perfect accessory to any wardrobe, eau de toilette is the finishing touch. With rustic and aromatic notes of marjoram, white alpine lavender, this Eau de Toilette is long-lasting.

At once familiar and yet utterly ambiguous, the inability to put your finger on who that woman is, is the enigma itself,” Roja Dove.

This fragrance is a cocktail of rich, exotic, very powerful and persistent flowers to make a clearly floral perfume, a true statement of intentions.
Shadow II for Him is a fragrance designed for confident and grounded males.

From the start, Samsara envelops us with the predominance of the jasmine flower. The solar flower of ylang-ylang sublimates it to better match the radiant and generous heat of sandalwood. Finally, iris, tonka bean and vanilla enhance and harmonise this union with a remarkable trail.
Cygnus pour Homme is a refreshing scent with calming accords to stay cool all day long.

Not totally convinced that such a thing actually exists in nature? What's ore, not sure that anyone in their right mind could handle such perfection? Well you're right, like the ideal man, the ideal husband is just a myth. But this fragrance, is now a reality!
Designed to evoke happy memories, HoneyDaze tickles the senses with a joyful blend that captures the radiant essence of sun-filled days.
Crystalline notes of crisp green geranium and pink peppercorn blend seamlessly into delicately sweet honeyed rose petals and crushed berries enveloped in a translucent, airy musk.

A fragrance that brings out the best of Vegas nights: Vibrant green outgoing notes blended with sophisticated cedar notes in the background form the perfect combination to take full advantage of every second. Make this an unforgettable moment. The world awaits you!
Elvis had an incredible ability to move and captivate audiences, just as Forever for Him will move and captivate those around him.
As faceted as an Art Deco crystal column, this woody scent plays on masculine codes and subtlety and elegance.
An aphrodisiac scent dedicated to the iconic era of the '70s.
A creamy and luxuriant bouquet of white flowers, wrapped in a lacework of delicate white musks.
Canabis Rose is an ultra-sensual and completely seductive scent. Enjoy this intoxicating aroma.

The scent is instantly recognizable and intimate, like a strong childhood memory of apples and cinnamon. At the end it warms up thanks to vanilla and its creamy and comforting character.
In Greek mythology, Kore, or as she is more commonly called, Persephone, is a goddess associated with spring and fertility. She is the perfect inspiration for this kinetic, blooming scent.

A mother gazes at her daughter, pondering all that she desires to pass on to her. Petite Chérie is a fragrance of infinite love between a mother and daughter. Camille was 23 when Annick Goutal created it for her. Now one of the House’s signature scents, Petite Chérie is the fragrance we offer to those we love.

Uninhibited. Feminine. Light. Outspoken Fresh is for the woman who needs no introduction. With her fearless confidence, she lets her true personality shine through. True to herself and her beliefs…she is Outspoken. Sexy. Fearless. Unexpected.

name_perfume: L'Eau D'Issey Pure Pétale De Nectar
description: At the source of L'Eau d'Issey, there is a drop. Just a drop. Rare, precious. Water, symbolised by its purest form.
Indigo Dreams smells like a bright and welcoming utopia.

It comes out at night: a fragrance for men, the apex of elegance brimming with fatal tension. Therein lies its appeal. This fragrance steps out after dark, impeccably dressed in a bespoke black tie design that Cartier perfumer Mathilde Laurent has tastefully punctuated with a pinch of mild chilli.
The scent of the modern adventurer.

Solar flowers and warm sand, Left Bank-style. In this white floral, blending exoticism with the allure and distinction of the Saint-Germaine-de-Prés, the perfumer bridges two olfactory universes, returning to the Left Bank holiday by the Indian Ocean, a Parisienne carrying back the essence of the tropical beach on her skin. A delicate composition, conjuring warm, salty skin under a classic cashmere sweater.

No Ordinary Man is a unique signature, celebrating the spirit and daring of a man at his most insolent and provocative, capable of overcoming every prejudice, every obstacle. A perfume that recounts a voyage, full of strength and inspiration.
Rose is one of the finest raw materials used in perfumery for over 3,000 years. Every drop of Nejma's oil elixir is a balance between two species of the rarest and precious varieties.
A mystical scent wrapped in soft and velvety accords.
The beautiful journey gives you wings and carries you in its delicate and enveloping wake. A generous floral bouquet.
"I have passing loves, as well as solid, perennial loves, among which there is my love for bergamot. It was time for me to make that official," Jean-Claude Ellena, Perfumer.

Nadir encapsulates the essence of elegance and sophistication
Just Jack Patchouli pays homage to natural beauty, femininity and elegance. It perfectly accentuates your natural charm and relaxed sophistication.
A bright scent with joyful accords.

A modern scent inspired by the everyday guy, who knows who he is and how to work it.

A flowering plant often found in Venetian gardens, the Calycanthus blooms uniquely in the heart of winter. As the flowers bloom, their wonderful fragrance fills the air, hinting of spring's arrival. According to Venetian tradition, to receive a few sprigs of Calycanthus is to receive a gift of loving care.

Life is a piece of aft. Convey to the maximum the expression of your own personality. Monteil Le Nouveau Parfum unifies the essence of a woman who is both strong and sensitive, extravagant and powerful while at the same time sensuous and gentle, characteristics that represent the ideal in a harmonious give and take. Monteil Le Nouveau Parfum transports the charm, pride, and elegance of a self-determined, free woman.

Escape to an island paradise with Tommy Bahama Set Sail St Barts Perfume! This sophisticated and sparkling fragrance will take you to where island petals perfume the air; palm trees sway gently in the breeze and where frosty cocktails have a splash of tequila and a twist of lime!
Mon Parnasse: a sensual and captivating fragrance with an audacious power of attraction.
Divine Bergamote is a lasting pleasure, made with a material often used in lighter fragrances. Its creator, Jean-Claude Ellena, has composed a unique, timeless perfume.

Embracing warmth is a comfort zone. Let it be! Nothing can feel so luxurious, soft and perfect as cashmere. It wraps you in comfort; it goes with everything; it ages gracefully and slowly. Classy, elegant, unique. Nothing can resemble and celebrate its sensuousness better.
Style à la Française Chic is an iconic and elegant fragrance for committed men.

"The goal of this fragrance creation was to work around patchouli oil. The fragrance is precious, elegant, enchanting with noble raw materials. It exudes curiosity, depth and warmth, just like the themes of the novel "The Citadelle, Wisdom of the Sands” by Antoine de Saint-Exupéry," Marc Zini, Perfumer.

An overload of sensation. The discovery of multiple cultures through convergence. Slow-motion in the tangible atmosphere and lightly suffused through shimmering heat. Soleil au Zenith combines innocently sweet fruity notes, traversed with sophisticated essences of woody notes built on a deep, dark base of gourmand and rich spices.
Cuir Nilam is a patchouli dressed in a leather perfecto with typically Parisian elegance.
In an effort to understand the rules governing nature, Vidi resonates somewhere between reason and passion with the intensity of embracing and enchanting the spirit.
A powerful fragrance with irresistible juicy notes, luminous florals and an intensely woody depth, to embody the goddess within.

"It is impossible to talk about my perfumes without looking back at my childhood. I was obsessed with the Mediterranean. All my senses were saturated by the sun, sand and blue sky. I always tried to fill my perfumes with scents, flavors and colors from my Mediterranean." - Loris Azzaro

"Terra Rossa pays tribute to the unique energy of Siena's sun-burnt earth, where one of the most important pigments used by artists since the Renaissance comes from. A truly Tuscan treasure that made me choose the precious ingredient for this fragrance: My idea of Italian heritage that has turned into a legend." Domitille Michalon-Bertier, Perfumer.

name_perfume: United Dreams : Dream Big For Men
description: You are the limit! Choose your path, without setting limits. Hold fast to your dreams and aim high with United Dreams Dream Big for Men.

This playful, seductive fragrance opens with a sparkling citrus bouquet, while the heart of this creation reveals captivating floral nuances of stunning florals, releasing an explosive wave of sensuality. The background boasts decadent gourmand accords and creamy base notes to create an alluring and addictive trail.
Soft, pure, authentic. So Pure Woman is a scent for which evokes the Scandinavian lifestyle. This pleasant and enchanting fragrance, is the perfect companion to everyday life.

Vici Leather is inspired by the victory cry of Julius Caesar. This refined and addictive perfume captures the soft smokiness of a warm leather armchair in a library of leather bound books, a nightcap in a heavy crystal tumbler and a face lit by the soft glow of a fire, surrounded by dancing shadows. The scent of success.
From the blossom of the bitter orange tree citrus Aurantium Amara. Refreshing and distinctive, a spicy aroma with sweet and flowery notes.

name_perfume: Police To Be Born To Shine For Him
description: This fragrance dares to push the boundaries and plays with the senses, for a guy that exudes power and energy.
When night comes, the magic world of Forever Night turns into a universe of dreams, sensuality and mysteries.

“Amber Aoud Absolue Précieux is the contemporary interpretation of Pure Amber Aoud. This rare and exotic material has been used for centuries in its pure form.- The Absolue Précieux has all the depth, body, and lasting quality of pure amber around, and is a luxurious extension of the Aoud Collection, created for those who want the ultimate 'Aoud Tollah or Attar' It is a richer, and even more luxurious interpretation of the iconic Roja Parfums Amber Aoud,” Roja Dove.
Patchouli in Love is the free spirit that ruffles the hair, a perfume that comes from distant lands, breaks the mold, contrasts with art.

Sable Blanc invites you to let yourself be enveloped, cajoled by its spicy wake, warm and reassuring. It is the olfactory embrace of the friend or confidant between the arms of which one finds the softness and the appeasement.
Tenebrae immerses us in a mystical wood; a shamanic forest where vapours of incense infuse supplies of concentrated sap.

The gaze of dusk and the charm of one night, reminding of two lovers' taste, hidden by hot reflexes of love and by irreverent provocations. An abstract conscience, enthralled by essences and odours of a beauty that leads me to lose reason, step by step, up to the door of my suite. Since that night, still persists over my skin a perfume I live and I listen to; it speaks of seduction, while, from my room's glass I am admiring nocturnal Singapore.
A bright, joyful scent for the optimistic woman.
Awake captures the evocative smell of a warm coffee shop on a cold day. the freshly ground beans, the steam, the heat, and the bitter luxury. A scent to energise you at any time of the day.
Dare to try the sweet and savoury femininity on your skin. Dare to try Womanity.
A sophisticated fragrance for those that love fresh and green scents unembellished and simple.

description: A herbal woody perfume inspired by nature. Perfumer Mark Buxton used ingredients that inspire the people from all the world to reconnect with themselves or with nature.

Does the Ideal Man need any introduction? Impeccable, irresistible in every way. L'Homme Idéal Cool: he knows how to stay cool under the circumstances, with that skilful blend of humour, ease and charm, that is his alone.

R.Faro is a spectacular fragrance combining spices with an aromatic accord for a touch of unusual freshness. It also has enveloping amber and woody notes, which reflect the seductive side of the TV presenter and artist Rodrigo Faro.
Mystic Oud is the essence of mystery and pure, divine, timeless elegance.
PureDKNY A Drop of Rose is the scent of pure Turkish Rose.

description: Feel the power of this electrifying and energizing fragrance, awakening the soul with courage and wisdom.

An exquisite floral scent that is full and airy. The soft scent of powdery petals is combined with delicate, subtly spicy gourmand notes. Bergamot adds a sparkling freshness with the scent of flowers and herbs, light, soft and original.

Paris 1978 and another endless night in one of the wildest nightclubs in the world. Downstairs, a Negroni Yuzu for her and a Whisky Sage for me. Ribbons of tobacco smoke weave their magic. Leaning against the cedar wood bar, I watch her move on the dance floor. Even if I close my eyes for a second, the Bains Douches never sleeps.

“The realisation of a childhood dream: to create a new vegetable facet. Working with vegetables means returning to the source of perfumery and indeed of oneself. in Cédrat Céruse, I love the lively, aniseed-flavoured freshness of fennel," Quentin Bisch, Perfumer.
Haneen is the scent of arid lands, nourished by citrus accords and balanced with fine touches of precious notes.

Polo Supreme Oud introduces a powerful olfactive chapter: the first Oud signature in the world of Ralph Lauren. The most supreme ingredients have been selected to create this bold and luxurious scent.

Reflection Woman opens with a lush green freshness reminiscent of morning dew in the springtime. A sophisticated bouquet of white flowers crowns the fragrance with richness and depth while embracing deep base notes wrapped with warmth conferring a magical aura to the skin.

Intense, smoky, exuberant and candid may just be a few words to describe this new fragrance from Al Haramain. Spray on the maverick fragrance of ‘Night Dreams' and let it take control of proceedings. Provocative like a knowing wink, this racy perfume sets their hearts and minds aflutter. Just walk past and catch them sniffing the air. Meet the glance, seize the night and make dreams come true…theirs more than your own!

A hypnotic and mystical fragrance. The intense and enveloping notes of incense are immediately revealed, made more vibrant by the hints of spice. The heart releases its latent magnetism with the help of enveloping notes magnificently enriched by the depth of the intense dry down.

In Bois d'Iris, precious exotic woods are accented with a vibrant salty note, recalling ocean sprays that splash over driftwood warming in the sun. A soft and elegant note of lightness manifests itself through beautifully powdered florals, bringing to mind the lands of Tuscany.
A perfumed bouquet, a magical and unusual creation. The scent of the Orient and a sophisticated citrus burst. A modern fragrance in the secret garden of desire.

The mythical song, "Pale Blue Eyes" by Lou Reed, leader of the band, The Velvet Underground, that Alexandra listened to since she was a teen and a desire to create a perfume that we couldn't exactly describe, a scent both carnal and evanescent, mysterious and clear, like pale blue eyes the keep secrets. And as it happens, both Chantal and Alexandra have pale eyes, one green, one blue.

Shunkoin by Xerjoff JTC is the mystical place of rare intensity that naturally brings inner peace, with oases of fountains and polished pebbles, statues of antique divinity in their millennial wisdom that seem to watch benevolently over the visitors. Immersed in a solemn atmosphere, time dissolves into a faraway dimension where rhythms are slowed to the beat of the serene rustling of the vegetation.

Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa is draped in red for the Chinese New Year. A festive design in a limited edition. The unexpected meeting between a delicate rose and fresh fruit. A cheerful cocktail to savour in a rose garden whilst surrounded with juicy berries and succulent fruits, after a bicycle ride wherever the mood takes you.

Interlude Man, the underpainting, gives a context in which the paint-strokes of orris and other ingredients become more resonant and powerful. The creative intention was to reveal different facets of Interlude Man.

Staying rather clear of Coke bottles, the reintroduction of this blend comes in six unique matte silver industrial bottles, each featuring a different whimsical quote by Andy Warhol.

Poised, she waits for the signal of the orchestra to make her entrance. Something indescribable fills her body and she takes flight. Under the moon, satin and tulle merge with her skin, and the ethereal White Swan dances on the shore of the lake. Pure seduction, the Ballerina soars lightly off the stage of The Bolshoi.
With X 1986, you can support the mission of the Piedmontese Foundation for Cancer Research, established in 1986, to make a significant contribution to the defeat of this disease.

Clinique Happy To Be. Dewy, shimmering, spontaneous. A different kind of floral. Notes of watery citrus, crisp pear, elements of hibiscus and syringa flower. Whimsy comfort. Liking who you are, where you are…happy to be.
Feel invigorated with this fresh zesty blend of citruses and spices layered on a radiant floral heart and a suave base.
Lavande, typical flower of Provence, which inspired the greatest painters.

The 90% natural Vanilla & Amber eau de parfum will make you discover the warm and refined lands of Madagascar. Its irresistible and ambery notes of Bitter Orange, Tonka and Red Sugar blended with the sweetness of Vanilla and Musks will bring you sweetness and indulgence.
Warm from the dryer, fluffy towel fresh and clean. As familiar as your favorite just washed t-shirt. An irresistible just laundered new scent from Clean.

Memories of a journey to India, to Pondicherry, a cosmopolitan and fascinating city with a double soul. A holiday spot on the Gulf of Bengal, bohemian and jet-set, it is also a centre of great spirituality.
Deeply exotic and sensual, Vanilla Shot takes a very unusual route towards the dark vanilla bean in the base. The vanilla purrs like a Persian kitten.

A unique seductress arrives - Escada Desire Me. The fragrance aims at a modern young woman who enjoys being the centre of attention, is aware of her qualities and knows she is the object of many men's affection. Her charisma, charm and scent leave an unforgettable impression.

Clori, nymph from Greek mythology, kidnapped by Zefiro. Then turns into Flora, the goddess of flowers. An elegant jubilation of white flowers covers the delicate note of heliotrope and the water lily.
It invites you into the world of mystery with the sensual warmth of earthy woods.

The sublime femininity of the Bulgarian rose, gathered by hand in the sunrises, enhances an exquisite chord of white flowers. An elegant chord that contrasts with ambrated and sensual notes of the patchouli of Singapore distilled by hand.
She is natural, romantic, and savage. Her world is a dune in the north, a love walk on a summer afternoon by the Veneto lagoon.
Love me, the cry of a woman in love. A message in a bottle, a nod to the iconic N’Aimez que Moi.
One8 Pure is a seamless fusion of woods, fruits, and spices in a scent that is pure at heart. The fragrance is meant to evoke a serene ambiance that becomes a synonym for purity.
Smoke is inspired by the pleasure of the first drag of a cigarette, which is consumed as quickly as it is born.

The name is not just a play on the French 'encens' ( French for 'incense', and 'insensé', French for 'crazy'.) Encenser means both to scent with incense and to praise to the skies. Musc Encensé does exactly what it says on the bottle.

name_perfume: Black Suede And Fougere Eau De Parfum
description: Make everyday effortless with Bespoke London’s Black Suede and Fougere.
Crisp and fresh as a new Spring day, our Clean Windows is bright, refreshing, and squeaky clean.

An addictive, intensely heartfelt, yet refined fragrance, Musc Immortel will hold you tightly in its embrace. Elegance. A rare nuanced form of beauty endures through time just as gold shines eternally.

description: Tiger's eyes, female claws, feline instinct, the call of the wild. At the Equator, where the heart is, the beat becomes the crossroads of dreams. From the cargo ships, in the harbour, barrels are unloaded in a balanced blend of scents that sets aglow all the garments of the sultanate.
Attitude is a daring and powerful fragrance for men. Created for men with attitude, who don't compromise, aim for perfection, and enjoy life to the fullest.
Tonic 69 is a mysterious and enigmatic scent suitable for adventurous men with a dynamic personality.
An enveloping and reassuring scent with a soft and cocooning trail.
A delicious harmony of ingredients will transport you to the tropical delights of an exotic island holiday.
Aquavibe Ama starts with the freshness and sophistication of crispy fruit. The heart brings a delicacy to the scent, while sheer resins in the base add a surprising romantic elegance.

William Burroughs was the Beat Generation's boldest writer. His work depicts the harsh realities of addiction and extreme experiences. Jardins d'Écrivains interprets Junky in the spirit of a unique and enigmatic fragrance.

Lolita Lempicka offers women an encounter with a story of love and enchantment more – more romantic than ever. With Lolita Lemipca L'eau En Blanc, brings all women in love an Ode to Love, a new story that every girl dreams of being the heroine of one day…
Fenicia is a mysterious fragrance. This fragrance mirrors the allure of the modern East.

Discover Light di Gioia, a transparent, luminous, and effortlessly feminine fragrance from Giorgio Armani. This fragrance captures the plenitude of the golden hour when the sun is still radiant, warm, and caressing.

Misia Sert was the muse of many artists and a friend to Coco Chanel. Enigmatic and radiant, she lived and breathed art and beauty, fascinating all those around her. Known as the "Queen of Paris", she is incarnated by a fragrance that recalls the excitement of opera dressing rooms with bouquets of flowers and the powdery scent of makeup and lipstick.
Mimosa by Charrier Parfums is a luminous scent that perfumes the forests with its shining golden colours.
Una Artisan is a precious, floral, and intense fragrance, perfect for special occasions.

A wicked lady, a seductive fragrance, sensual and refined, Seductrice de Paris is a symbol of elegance, modernity and femininity. With sparkling florals, marrying captivating and velvety fruits, the subtle and bewitching floral bouquet in the heart is sublimated by the magnificence of a voluptuous base that creates an unforgettable trail.

Energise yourself for whatever your day holds with 24 Platinum Oud Edition. This captivating men's fragrance was created from an unforgettable combination of special ingredients. It is ideal for daily wear, and to add an extra touch to charm a special someone in the evening.

This Spring, cool mint tones meet pastel lemon, leading to some unusual new combinations in the fashion world. When put together with pinks and reds, these contrasts create even more summery freshness. The diversity of pastel prints with floral and graphic elements heralds the warmer months.
The fragrance is inspired by a man's behaviour, marked by his power. This man also brings an air of mystery and seduction and his presence is a weapon of conquest.

Celebrate NYC’s annual spring spectacle of blooms, when flowers take center stage. New York Flowers honors not just the democracy of city’s “public” botanicals, but also celebrates the spirit of joy, renewal and the natural wonders that each spring brings to our town. A celebratory scent that opens with sparkling notes, almost like popping the cork off of a bottle of champagne.

Berlin was Bowie’s mirror, a cultural mix where the past met the present to rewrite the future. Unconventional, avant-garde, experimental, full of energy and acceptance, incredibly modern and historical, the balance between opposites. The fragrance embodies this spirit, an unconventional Iris, extremely modern and very alive to mirror Berlin and Bowie’s dualism.
Bois d'Ambre is a warm perfume, as enveloping as cashmere. Defined by the strength of its woody personality, it's an elegant reinterpretation of a classic masculine fragrance.

The sensation of soft, warm skin evoked by the creamy richness of sandalwood. Exceptionally smooth and sensual, sandalwood is the noblest of woods, and, in Peau Santal, Miller Harris has enriched every aspect of the material to create the ultimate skin-scent.
Oumma : a study of the contrasts of agarwood (oud), a substance that Stepahne Humbert Lucas views with mystical reverence. A masterpiece of contrasts for the senses.
The smell of freshly hung laundry, the clearness of a cloudless sky. A neat and clean perfume.

Has anyone ever said to you "you smell like something nice"? Musk fascinates by its simple yet cryptic nature: it seems like a simple, almost childish perfume, but its evolution reveals an emotional and sentimental character.
A symbol of all-out femininity, Elmira exudes elegance, mystery, and sensuality.
Unexpected and profound, an intense and elusive composition. A noble fragrance inspired by imaginary horizons.
Tome 3 : l'Être exalts the ambiguity of adulthood with both a dark and bright side. "Be yourself and own what makes you unique," Nathalie Lorson, Perfumer.

Animale Intense is a majestic fragrance, bursting with energy and irresistible character. Combining marine elements with juicy fruits, aromatic spices and a masculine warmth, its alluring power is immeasurable.
Ungaro Gold is for the modern goddess who loves to use her innate powers of seduction.
Joy Forever Eau de Toilette is a fragrance that will mirror the luxury of the original Eau de Parfum with a lighter softer touch and carefree, modern energy.
Nejma teams up with French rapper Booba for its latest fragrance, KoEptYs. Capitalised letters spelling out "KEY", links the artist's street influences to the label's luxurious traditions.
A fragrance inspired by the famous cocktail, "Moscow Mule", an unforgettable, tantalizing, and seductive composition totally dedicated to the city of Moscow.
Beau de Provence celebrates the people of Provence, and all those who love the magnificent raw materials that makes our fragrance so rich!

"The rough aspect of vetiver wood brings to mind the grain of leather". A fragrance created to be the essential piece in an olfactory wardrobe. The quintessence of style, where fragrance is the fabric.

A nod to John Lennon's famous hymn, Imagine celebrates the liberated and offbeat spirit of the British capital, between pop and crown, traditions and eccentricities. Free, bubbly and chic, like a mischievous London girl.
The elegant manners of a woman are always as beautiful as Mirage World Elegant perfume.
A homage to Masira, a kitesurfing paradise and a top-class nightlife spot in front of Oman,
A fantasy. A memory or an extract of the romance between Alexandra and Tom. A sensual short film that carries us a long way off.

A terribly feminine perfume. Faithful to Paco Rabanne's innovative values, where provocation reveals the spirit of the time. Imagine unique, irreverent sensuality to which nothing and no one can resist. This modern-day Cleopatra is the queen of queens, the woman of all victories, the absolute icon. Endowed with every strength, she chooses her hero on the steps of Olympus. A demi-goddess, but a woman above all. Divinely woman.
A fragrance that reveals your wildest dreams.

Presenting the scent of irresistible bad boys from all over the world. Live hard, live loud, live now. It's all Dirty English, the fragrance for men.

Cologne Intense provokes shivers and raises the temperature. Its timeless seduction is just like sipping a frosted tall drink.

The setting of the sun has always had a mystical connotation in Positano and this is perhaps one of the reasons why it's considered one of the most beautiful sunsets in the world. Thus our tribute to this daily marvel with a fragrance that embodies the soul-moving warmth of a summer sunset in Positano.

The goddess of the hunt arches her bow, and the forest quivers in anticipation. Lush nectarine, jasmine and violet swim above caramel and creamy vanilla. An eau de parfum sung like a hymn on the skin.
The miraculous instant in which flowers and snow meet and resonate together. This is the most beautiful and pure fragrance in the world, like a vista of pure white that spreads into infinity.
She is extremely funny and knows exactly what she wants. A versatile girl that already makes her own wardrobe choices. Scalpers Kids Girl is her fragrance.
A shimmering dream, radiating pure opulence, exuding alluring sensuality. Cold liquid gold softly melting on hot skin a sparkling provocative dream of weightless opulence.

Humphrey Bogart was know for his love of cinema, dedicated to his wife Lauren Bacall, but also his third passion, his boat, which he named "Santana" after the warm winds in Southern California. Today, Jacques Bogart is bringing the legend of "Santana" back to life with a tribute fragrance to pay homage to Humphrey Bogart's passion.
Be a fierce woman! You will never go unnoticed with this modest fragrance. Discover and empower!

When Occidental freshness merges with a classic Oriental Oud fragrance… This sublime fragrance mixes spices smokey notes and fruits with precious Woods… As we are all living together on the same planet, I loved the idea of building bridges between cultures and tastes.

The subtle floral aroma with the pleasant presence of citrus wood undoubtedly creates a charming and elegant perfume.

More sensual and carnal, the Repetto Eau de Parfum version exudes sensuality and femininity.

An elegant yet daring scent for the perfect gentleman.
Inspired by the power that every woman carries within her, it is a fragrance that celebrates the awakening of your inner "diva" and invites you to live it to the fullest!
With a heart of powerful rose, the scent pulsates fresh and light notes seasonal to the beautiful northern nature. A captivating fragrance.
Immerse yourself in the magnetic allure of this captivating scent, embodying the essence of a man who commands attention with every confident stride.

For effortless perfection and charm. Eclat Style is the most refined and elegant perfume for men. A timeless, modern and masculine fragrance featuring the exclusive notes that captures the epitome of Parisian charm and elegance.
A&F Revival plays up the essence of spring with aromatic notes.

For some it is love, for others the desires and lust of life, but for most it is the madness of gold, a gold that reflects the souls of those who grasp it. Behind every glance, even the darkest, burns the one obsession.
Masa embodies the precious luminosity of a special diamond through a perfect balance of herbal freshness and ambered woody notes.

A watercolour scent for a new concept of time. “L’Eau Privée, a light and delicate version of Coco Mademoiselle, is a fragrance for the night, like a watercolour or a soft, hazy veil for the skin and sheets.” - Olivier Polge, Perfumer

Just like a Damascus rose that blooms at night, this dark, earthy, and sensual scent intrigues and captivates the senses instantly. Mysterious and attractive, it allows you to discover its fullest charm after a while. The inspiration to create this fragrance was the secret stories told by few to very few, after dawn, in confidence, and in trust.
Glacialis Terra tells the story of a garden of frosted flowers, the freshness of a wood protected from the sun.

Precious resins and oils from long ago are explored in Inquisitive. A measure of citrus and green notes with dark resins awaken and lift the whole composition, giving life to the precious scents of the ancient world.

This perfume is dedicated to how our perspective on time affects the way we live. Well-applied time management can lead to positive results or outcomes in what we are doing. With this fragrance, we intend to portray the flow of modern times, full of innovative changes.
Fresh, zesty ingredients combine with herbs and powersul notes to create a delicate, elegant and mellow fragrance with an irresistible heart.

A sharp black suit. A crisp white shirt. This elegant man is an enigma. Savouring the finest pleasures life has to offer. Glimpsed in the refined décor of a club or a cigar room in a glamorous metropolis, from Dubai to Shanghai, London or New York, he maintains an air of mystery…

We love Stromboli. The omnipresence of the active volcano and the dark, rocks that are typical of the island. You arrive by boat from Sicily and the island looms above you with villages clinging to the slopes. The power of nature really takes your breath away.
A beautiful, traditional scent focusing on jasmine from Grasse.
BLCK is the ideal scent for the refined and the elegant wearer.
Just Jack Neroli is the embodiment of luxury and exclusivity. Treat yourself to a fragrance that will make you absolutely unique wherever you are.

Dive. The deeper you go, the cooler it feels. Swim back to the surface. Open your eyes, the endless sea, infinite blue lies before you. A warm breeze guides the sailing boat towards the horizon. The invigorating memory of a sailing day.

Thé pour un Été is written in delicate transparency and stylish lightness. It takes its name from the age old ritual of tea with its restorative nature. Think of respite from a hot and dry summer's day.

Crisp and crisp. An unmistakably light and elegant citrus fragrance, perfect for hot summer days. The inspiration for this fragrance was sunny Mauritius, its beautiful unspoilt beaches and exotic air.
Måd is arguably the most crowd-pleasing scent, taking highly beloved gourmand notes and spinning them into a fun dessert by blending flowers and spices.

"A fragrance made out of a single element called Cetalox. Usually used in perfumery as a back note, I have decided it would play the lead role because it is one of my favourite ingredients. Another advantage of this particular composition is that it is entirely allergen-free. The result is minimalist, elegant, pure." Romano Ricci, Artistic Director.
With Brave, you can dare to be free with the freshness of the citrus aromas and cardamom along with an intrepid touch of almond milk and tonka beans.

Music for a While speaks to the nature of music as something that unravels in time, but also as something that transports us to a place where life is both beautiful and more alive. This is the story of seduction, a series of powerful impulses and empowered moments in which life is being lived for a while, perhaps, like music.

Marc Jacobs has let his love for classics and mastery of unassuming detail dictate the message of his first fragrance for men, Marc Jacobs Men. The scent challenges the traditional boundaries of men's fragrances: it is familiar in essence but entirely unexpected in execution…

Our Community Fair Trade organic cane sugar comes from Paraguay. The Montillo co-operative hand-harvest the cane and grind it to release the juice, which is turned into crystallised sugar. Trade provides a regular income to over 160 farmers. Unlike commercial sugarcane plantations that use ‘slash and burn' techniques, organic production helps to protect the environment.

Michael Kors' Exotic Blossom is a captivating fragrance that will transport you to a faraway tropical oasis. An indulgent blend of fresh fruits and exotic florals, this blissful scent evokes the feelings of a sun-drenched paradise.

Inspired by the worlds most global and ethnically diverse urban area, Queens. Just like the diversity of this city this composition appeals to such a broad base of men and women, kings and queens, the flamboyant and the restrained.
Enjoy the elegance and pure luxury of Christian Siriano's Silhouette Midnight, an intoxicating fragrance that will accompany you into the night, and leave a seductive trail.
Delicate, warm and elegant, Fig & Sureau is imbued with a gentle serenity, inspiring idleness in a shady orchard.

No other flower stands for love and romance as much as the rose: its gently sweet scent represents the femininity of a woman and has always been a symbol of lovers. This fragrance captures the typically feminine, delicate appearance of the flower and enchants its wearer with its romantic aura.
A bright fragrance wrapped in deep, comforting notes.
Kaloo Naturel is a tender scented water with sweet notes of grapefruit and peach. It contains 98% natural ingredients and it is also paraben free.

When our hearts are full of love. When we feel protected and safe. We hear the whisper of angels. A message of the heart can be expressed in countless ways. As a personal letter, a gentle touch or as a delicate fragrance.
A one of a kind mixture of fresh citrus accords and aromatic scents. Activate your full potential with Patchouli on Fire.

On a hot summer day, morning stroll through the city's alleys steeped in history. From the market stalls escapes a delicious whiff of freshly picked aromatic herbs with some sweet scents. On the skin the green and invigorating trace of the perfume remains for a long time.
The horizon is blue. Bergamot, sunny and bright, meets rosemary. Aromatic, sometimes pungent. On the skin, the salt, which has become crystal. Clear, unmistakable.
Elle Fleur is a bright, modern floral, not a shrunken violet, but a strong floral with a boldly feminine touch.
Azzaro Wanted Eau de Parfum is an invitation to feel the adrenaline.
This scent smells like an enchanted walk in the woods.
More than a musk, this fragrance weaves a skillful blend of rich spices, a warm tobacco note, a fresh touch of green, and a deep woodiness into a unique background for the sensuous musk.

Rome. Ochre-tinted walls. A tumultuous joyful moment in time, sparkling and sensual, realistic and poetic, sexy and fun. The water inspires a game of seduction. Complicity, spontaneity. A new interpretation is born: L'Eau2Kenzo.
The exquisite Rose Muskissime evokes the dewy, fresh rose that can only be found at dawn.
Sweet fruits and fragrant florals are behind Oros Fleur.

"It amazes me that I have been famous for sixty years. When I started everything was changing, and just like music, art and clothes, perfume changed too. These fragrances represent those decades for me. There was electricity in the air and life smelled of excitement," Cher.

Natural Savage is a distinctive masculine fragrance. A soft shadow in the dark of the night. His eyes fixate on the movement in the undergrowth. The dry leaves rustle softly with each step and cover the tracks on the forest floor. A sparkling glow emerges between the trees. His breath is intense, a spicy, musky scent runs through the night. The first raindrops fall silently when he sees his target.
Heartwarming and delicately daring, precious and refined with a double personality…

At sunset, when the sky is tinged with purple after a hot day in the city, the breeze erases worries and troubles and rejuvenates the spirits. It is the magical moment when sea and land meet, creating a gentle cool wind that blows inland. This is Nasimy.
Alluring, magnetic, relentless, and forever unforgettable.
Rich in contrasts, dreamlike in its serenity, Crazy in Love will bring subtle energies and passion to your life. A Montale talisman full of luck.
Enjoy the soft, floral freshness of this delightfully feminine fragrance.
Cross of Asia pays tribute to the Far East. Furthermore it dignifies its perfumed as well as its floral elements.
A study on smouldering tobacco.

Entitled and decadent. The archetypal aristocrat of perfumery, Amber-Rose strikes a seductive pose. This elegant madame has a rich pedigree at the heart of history's most romantic fragrances. Here, she has been intensified and modernised to bring her up to date for the twenty-first century, to tempt and tantalise.

name_perfume: Beverly Hills Polo Club Heritage Oud
description: An energetic and youthful scent with powerful, sensual accords.
Bilingual was inspired by the experience of meeting two different languages, and expanding them into new meanings. Explore the unique feeling of an unusual scent harmony.

Ile Mythique is a fragrance dedicated to the winds that blow above the Mediterranean Islands, around Corsica, Corfu, Crete, Pantelleria or Mallorca, bringing with them the fragrant island air saturated with aromatic herbs, shrubbery evocative of these places. Just close your eyes and breathe in and imagine yourself under the bright Mediterranean sun.
A scent you will love and become addicted to, mystery lovers looking for adventure and excellence.
Escape to the heart of the tropics with this delicate, exotic scent.
Empowering and optimistic, the Ariana Grande Cloud Pink fragrance is inspired by a confidence that reveals both beauty and strength, no matter the storm.
A scent that evokes memories, a song that echoes. Song of Oud is a timeless perfume that's a confluence of the past and future.
A playful scent with an addictive trail.

In one fell swoop, she overturns the outdated image of the sweet, corseted Parisian belle, with her Eiffel Tower and other such clichés! Hot colours and Hot couture, she’s a master of reinvention. Always a rebel against everything, including herself, she forges ahead without fear. Be careful with her, she's a tough one. To be honest, she tires me out! What about you?

Premier Figuier marks an innovative milestone in the history of perfume. Imagine lying under the shade of a magnificent fig tree in the south of France. The fresh leaves, milky sap, warm air, sweet fruit, and even the cool shade cast beneath this tree were all captured for this scent. The magic of this fragrance also lies in the dreamlike quality it evokes of sensual layers of light, movement and scent.
Deep and sensual aroma with a mysterious trail.

Written as an impressionistic diary, it describes the affair between a French naval officer and Kiku, a temporary geisha bride in Nagasaki, Japan. Their romantic destiny allows an intimate contemplation of the impossible exoticism and delicate temperament of Japanese culture and dignity.

Khalil is a force to be reckoned with. Its trail combines intensity and subtlety. Khalil doesn't follow the rules, it is unique. It imagines a future, and makes it its present. Dive into the magic of a wonderful universe where dreams come true.

For him or her, a game of seduction that is both exuberance and subtle vanity. For those who want to attract attention with calm confidence. Between the serious and the light, the real and the oniric, a game of opposites that marries the classic with creativity.

It’s time to step into an enchanted new world, a Dazzling Garden, in fact, where the colours are bolder, the evening sky is sparkling, and the air carries a sweet fragrance like none other.

Journey to the mecca of perfumery and immerse yourself in absolute glamour and sheer luxury with Far Away Splendoria and its exclusive white oud accord. As powerful and intense as traditional oud, only fresher, more feminine and sensual, this is splendour on another level.
Vanille Vanille is an invitation to travel.
Embark on a journey of discovery into the world of the senses on the waves of Love Potion Sensual Ruby and its intoxicating accords.
"The neon hour, the fluorescent hour, which boosts and stirs all those who approach it." - Mathilde Laurent, Parfumeur de la Maison Cartier.

Xerjoff pays tribute to this partnership in the MotoGP season for the second year running by creating a dynamic, elegant perfume that evokes the world of motorsport and racing on circuits all over the world.
A refined and contemporary cologne blends fresh and sunny notes for an uplifting scent.

The elegance of a soft and enveloping fragrance. A zesty flight that combines with an ultra-feminine floral heart composed of a luminous orange blossom and a delicately musky base. The expression of soft and reassuring femininity.
A perfume that evokes freedom and an escape from the everyday grind! An invitation to Berdoues perfume addicts: Calvi Beach will shine a light on your beautiful Summer days.

Boss invites men to explore a unique and romantic take on sensuality with The Scent Pure Accord. A luminous fragrance that continues the compelling story of seduction told through Boss The Scent collection.
An iconic scent that embodies all the pride, passion, and creativity poured into every Clive Christian perfume, now adorned with a platinum-coloured cap.

Ethereal gardenia blends with crystalline musk for a delicate fragrance full of feline grace.

Rose, orange blossom, peony, and white flowers float in harmony as we enter a palace ornated with endless luxury. Peppermint in the Sherbet range is an uplifting fragrance created to savour the freshness, that makes you want to try it. To taste it!

name_perfume: K By Dolce & Gabbana Eau De Parfum Intense
description: K Intense embodies the intrepid character of a self-confident man. The perfume evokes a combination of strong, persistent and bold notes.

Freddie Albrighton, tattoo artist and perfumer.

Shimmering and sparkling with an addictive twist of vanilla to warm your nights.
Rock by Chic & Love is a scent with a bright and cheerful blend.

An addictive scent that highlights your unique charisma.

Oriental complex combining aromatic spices with herbaceous tones of armoise, sage and lavender, gently accented with a floral blend of ylang, rose and jasmine. The background of woody musk tones is supported by patchouli, amber and oakmoss.

The sand-coloured adventure, a never-ending summer under a blazing sun. Comfortable and functional with its wide flapped pockets and half belted waist, the safaris jacket was the essential piece of equipment for explorers and members of the colonial armies.

Kilian celebrates its 15th anniversary with a limited edition collection for the holiday season, with a special design inspired by the Eiffel Tower, a tribute to Kilian's French heritage. Angels' Share is a unique concoction that only angels should experience.
