description: Inspired by "La Marcia Trionfale" from Aida (G. Verdi), Note di Colonia III is the fragrance of triumph, heroism and strength. An enveloping composition that reminds us of the celebration victory on a warm night, with music, dance and fires. A triumphant and bright fragrance with spicy and vibrant accents.
A colourful fragrance, full of vitality and texture, reminiscent of a coral garden in full bloom. A glam sillage that combines mystery and sensuality.
501 PRALINE RÉGLISSE PATCHOULI evokes the deliciousness of sweet pastries and powdered iris.
Golden Sand has an original character evoking a miraculous elixir or a rare magical salve. Montale Golden Sand is a sensual, warm, fresh and entirely original take on the theme of the scent of roses.
Inspired by one of the five districts of New York City, Brooklyn Night has its own personality, characterised by the wide cultural diversity, highlighted by its independent scene.
Paralel was created as a tribute to the adventurous man who makes his presence felt everywhere he goes.
A pungent and sharp aroma gives a strong personality and creates an aura of positive energy to live your day as an "indomitable, haunting and conquering spirit."

"Wedding in Tipasa by Albert Camus is one of my favourite texts: The author vividly depicts summer in Algeria, the rites of the young people in Tipasa, with its Roman ruins and the sea below, exalting nature and the beauty of the bodies in the sun. Imagine diving in the water from the rocks, one morning in Tipasa," Pierre Guillaume.
Reveal your inner rebel. Wear it and feel how dangerously sexy leather can be. Tempting and addictive blooms seductively meld with smooth leather and rich woods.
A luxurious fragrance for musk lovers.

Amyris Femme, born of an encounter between highly prized ingredients in a concentration of fine perfumery: The Extrait. This flamboyant passion comes alive with fragrant white flowers which bring their sensual texture and dazzling light to the fragrance. A magnified, intense, and vibrant aura, like the sun.

The surf crashes against sandstone rocks. Your skin glows in the warm sun under the blazing Australian sky. As you climb out of the water, a gentle breeze blows through from the nearby jasmine and frangipani trees, mixing with the subtle scent of the sea, salt and rock. Take a moment to soak it all up, and dive down under with this evocative scent.
A fragrance can evoke great emotions in your life. Tous Eau de Parfum's freshness, simplicity and purity will captivate you.

The unforgettable Neroli perfume is back with a unique look and in limited edition to celebrate our 45th anniversary. This perfume speaks of smiling expanses of orange blossoms, with bright and light-hearted accords.

Yes I Am Pink First. A perfume by Cacharel for women who have the power to always see the positive side of life! Bold, assertive, Yes I Am Pink First women prefer to add fun to everything they do! A new declaration of femininity.

Red Heart plays in the world of the power of attraction. The love bomb who explores her scent. It is about life itself. The heartbeat and what it is to live powerfully and fully. It is a story of potency and ripeness.

After slaying the week, it's time for downtime. Chill Babe is a feisty scent that brings a sense of personal space and time out. Every babe needs to take a step back once in a while and treat themselves with some much-needed glamour, indulgence, and self-expression … that's the Chill Babe feeling.
Inspired for the modern woman. Fresh and indulgent, Boss Ma Vie Florale is a fulfilling scent inviting the wearer to slow down and take the time to enjoy and treasure every moment of her life.

The two lovers in Sinner Forbidden reveal to each other their most scandalous sides. Alone, each lover is a magnificent person, together, they create an overwhelming sense of power. Intrepid in their passion, they are impudent, shameless, unpredictable and ever-ready for each incendiary encounter.
Like a blend of rhythmic sounds, Rock 'n Raï is a whirlwind percussion of notes. An oriental and musical fragrance!

Emporio Armani Diamonds Eau Légère that reflects the sparkle, strength, brilliance and sexiness of the Emporio Armani woman. This sensory blend gives a woman a self confident and audacious feeling.

Girls can say anything, a perfume that proclaims their freedom. The perfect representation of a modern femininity that dares to express itself openly. A fragrance in which the fern reinvents itself: a new olfactory statement with a bold touch!

The burning kisses of the glowing red sun sting the steppes with hints of dry, hot wood. As the day fades, round notes of leather and flowers fill the air. Whoever then ventures into this forest of brush catches a glimpse of the captive richness of the roots, the velvety depths of this wild land.

May 20, 1927: a man has just realized one of humanity's maddest dreams: flying… The whole world is excited by the exploits of these madmen who are always further defying the laws of gravity. Women throw themselves into it in turn, ready to claim equal talent and courage: Adrienne Bolland, Hélène Boucher and Maryse Bastié all contribute to the formidable history of l'Aérospatiale.

Together, we are more than you and me. We are bonds united by harmony, admiration and complicity. In a true partnership, we wear the same skin without losing its essence. I share what is mine, I receive what is yours and, thus, we create a life for two.

A typical outline of a fougère aromatic fragrance, which diffuses the deep aroma of each of the raw materials used to create this perfume.
You won't be able to resist this deep, gourmand and sensual scent!

Nothing in the world smells as good as the person you love, and when you reach out to Arte Bellissimo Romantic, you supersize that love further.
Wild Gold highlights the wild side of a woman who knows how to live each day with passion.
An elegant and powerful fragrance for the confident man.

Noble and powerful, guaiac wood brings structure to a fragrance with bewitching seduction. Gaïac Mystique expresses avant-garde and stylised power through chiaroscuro, full of mystery and spirituality.

A gorgeous everyday fragrance inspired by the English countryside and flowers.

A fragrance that is absolutely unique and at the same time unmistakable. It smells like a beautiful coast, a pristine coniferous forest or a perfectly fitting leather jacket.

Hayaati Florence transports you to a blooming floral paradise.
An ode to "enfants terribles" and all manner of monkey business, doodles on the blackboard, devious schemes, and pranks galore.

Let yourself be tempted by La Fleur Bouquet - the ultimate scent of aspiration!
Discover your feminine side with Alabaster, a delicate and captivating scent. Just a touch of blended flowers and warm musk, and you'll bewitch the ones closest to you.

Inspired by the freshness of the ocean and the effortless elegance of a confident man.

A hazy atmosphere.The reminder of a fantasy, of an inedible trail she leaves on a dress at the break of day or in the intimate memory of the man who made love to her.

As beautiful and seductive as the night sky and as refreshing as the first rays of dawn, Oud Saffron is the perfect combination of a night and day fragrance for all seasons.

The ecstasy of a Berliner night, the encounter on a dance floor, the tingling rush of skin touching skin…

Gem-like fruits create sparkle throughout with a floral heart that will make you smile. A striking and mesmerizing background fills the air with glowing and captivating notes.

A creation, inspired by Tuscany, and specifically, by one of the most beautiful, complex and mysterious cities of this region, which never ceases to astonish and instil wonder in anyone who visits it and experiences the region. The ideal perfume for the elegant man.

"In Les Infusions de Prada, there is a rare luxury you don't often find nowadays. At first, they appear to be very simple, as if you were tattooing water with an ingredient, but in reality, it is a very complex formula. In a similar way, that water must be at a particular temperature to create the perfect tea, the base composition allows the beauty of a flower, wood or fruit to be revealed in a bright and sensitive way," Daniela Andrier, Perfumer.

A fresh fragrance drawing inspiration from the resurgence of the classic gin cocktails. A clean blend of crisp notes comes alive with freshness that fizzes and excites the senses.

Colour Me Oud is a classic perfume for men, encompassing a blend of traditional ingredients with a modern twist.
Attractive for Women does perpetuate the exotic appeal of a scintillating cocktail.

"Oh la la" surprises with an expressive, floral fragrance composition that infatuates the wearer with passionate sensuality. Behind a half-open door, a hypnotic gaze seems like an invitation. Foudroyant is the olfactory expression of this surprising and hypnotic sensation.

The aromatic fougère combines the headiness of eau de parfum with the invigorating freshness of cologne, into a universal fragrance of boundless exploration.
Not a scent but a fragrance. A fragrance for the skin, very intimate, but also a spiritual dimension, a supplement to the soul.
This decorative bottle holds a fragrance full of heady sensuality, with lingering notes that reveal an addictive combination that creates a desire before succumbing to pleasure.

Unpredictable, impertinent and exceptional Insolence. You never know what to expect from her – apart from the very best. By her mere presence, she changes everything and radiates with undeniable beauty. As she unveils the stunning shape of her favourite fragrance in a gravity defying act, the world all around struggles to regain its bearings. Eau de Shalimar – A fragrant fountain in the garden of Shalimar. Light, sparkling and sensual.

The warm whispers of spices introduce the delicate green melody. The effervescent opening then softens into a heart of powdery notes embraced by smoky leaves. Woody notes provide a polished backdrop for the intricate smoky floral accord.

The Miss Dior jus in an exceptional bottle whose spectacular bow displays a beating heart and a profusion of embroidery inspired by the creations of Dior Artistic Director, Maria Grazia Chiuri. Only 47 bottles were produced in homage to 1947, the year Miss Dior was first presented.

With sensual, insolent beauty, this blatant femininity eludes conventions. Two master perfumers created a fragrance as a tribute to today's Valentino woman. With attitude, sophistication and unexpected characteristics, the bouquet of Valentina blends an irreverent Italian floral oriental in which each facet reveals a paradox.
A bare sensuality. A tease to the sight with a playful opaqueness that slowly reveals the fragrance within the bottle.

Dripping with honey, Bee is the magical journey of finding and falling in love with yourself. It's for those that love warm and spicy scents and the kind of fragrance where you can't stop smelling yourself.

A sensuous fragrance, leading the wearer into the supreme world of musk. Musc Supreme is the epitome of mysticism, which is supported by deeply rich and evocative ingredients, creating a luminous blend.
This multi-faceted scent evokes a patchouli leaf captured in ice.

name_perfume: United Dreams : A.M Together For Her
description: Having a dream is all you need! United Colors of Benetton is as well known for its provocative (and thought-provoking) ad campaigns as for its on-trend fashion designs. Using controversial imagery, the brand conveys powerful messages of tolerance, non-discrimination and human rights.

This Is Love Her! is a story of love at first sight. A couple of lovers who adore one another and find themselves in "a Paris" that they know by heart. They are artists of the present. A love story that sounds like a challenge. A touch, then a kiss. Freedom is shared; heat and sin is a blank canvas on which they draw with the tips of their fingers. This is the fragrance of burning love, inedible and undisciplined.

At the dawn of spring, the Japanese gather to admire the sakura cherry blossom whose beauty captivates and enthrals in equal measure. In honor of the “Hanami” poetic rendezvous, Guerlain is revealing a unique limited and numbered, exceptional edition of Cherry Blossom, the iconic floral fragrance. For its 2024 Millésime, Guerlain has partnered with the French jeweller Philippe Ferrandis, who enhances the emblematic bee bottle with a ring decorated with two Sakura flowers with mother-of-pearl reflections and set off with sparkling crystals.

Cyrus men are invited to embark upon a journey of inner discovery steeped in nature. An invitation to find nourishment in Mother Earth, contemplating the beauty of its infinite landscapes. A captivating, sensual perfume with a timeless olfactory signature for adventurers seeking inner discoveries.

name_perfume: L'Instant De Guerlain Pour Homme Eau De Toilette
description: The story of L'Instant is that of a celebration of unique and moving moments of emotion. The instants are both fragile and marvelous, seemingly suspended somewhere outside of time in a place where one moment can change everything and anything becomes possible.

name_perfume: Zen For Men White Heat Edition 2011
description: Zen for Men White Heat Edition offers icy refreshment full of dynamic and powerful essence.

Let's bring the desert to life and let your creativity run free, because we celebrate endless freedom, individuality and personal happiness! Create your own imaginary world in the middle of nowhere, surf across the sand, and dance in the glow of a thousand lights. Art, self-expression, freedom and party. Anything is possible. Be whatever you want to be. Nothing is too crazy!
Sophisticated and feminine, White Musk Flora has uplifting, notes that create a modern and daring scent.

It is deep, mysterious, romantic, warm, independent, wild, wildly melancholic, pure, honest, spontaneous and sometimes naive, often subtle and refined. Eventually also highly individualistic. The ingredient of the Slavic Soul is boundless courage. However, it is difficult to compromise. White is white, black is black. Moral standards are deeply engraved. In the Slavic Soul, it is the heart that rules! It is the heart that wins over reason!
Our first true floral scent. Flora Carnivora: nature in its primal state.

Envelop yourself in its mysterious allure and unleash a newfound sense of boldness and authenticity. Let this fragrance be your secret weapon as you embark on a thrilling adventure of self-discovery and self-expression.
An enchanting trip to Jaipur, the city in Rajasthan, immersed in the millennia-old scents of vanilla absolute and precious, sensual sandalwood. A composition rich in natural and precious ingredients.
Private Mind delivers a mysterious sensuality. Its internal balance, inspired by spirituality and reflection, is silent. Its introverted nature enchants those who seek to understand it.
If you are like C.B., you are the luminous type: discreet and sensitive. Songe à la Douceur evokes a tender and sincere personality.
Oriental Safari encourages us to travel, where the sun sets behind the sand dunes. It is the warm voice of a man who guides us to advance a little more in the exploration of the unknown.
Soak up an explosion of spices with our bold and exotic Cuban blend. A wild scent!
Rapport Sport features an invigorating blend of vibrant citrus alongside a selection of fiery spices and earthy woods which combine to produce a wonderfully refreshing and bold aroma.
Kurkdjian seeks to communicate a sense of fluidity and freedom swapping his usual masculine and feminine labels for alternating capitalisation.

To commemorate his 20th anniversary, Kenneth Cole has designed an extraordinary mens fragrance that reflects the spirit, style and sophistication of the city. Black For Him is bold and luxurious, like the feeling of slipping into a black tuxedo, a cashmere turtleneck, or a black leather jacket. A scent as timeless as the color itself.
Essence (Shine for Men) is a fresh and invigorating scent for the vibrant man.
Few cities have more charisma and rhythm than the Latin jewel of the East Coast. Wrap yourself in its spirit with Dicora Urban Fit Miami!

Perfumer, Alberto Morillas is fascinated by the fragile beauty and intense, musky smell of the white Osmanthus buds he once discovered on a trip to China. Together with Eric Buterbaugh, they decided to create a fragrance orchestrated with this unique scent at its core, featuring some beautiful and familiar notes found elsewhere in the collection.
An elegant fruity composition built on a background of fragrant green notes, imparts a vibrant freshness of tropical fruits.

“Leather has always accompanied people. It envelops us and protects us like a second skin. Shades of Leather captures its essence and is much more than just an olfactory portrait of this treasure. Leather is strong, possesses character and exudes indomitability,” Jérôme di Marino, Perfumer.

Femininity can be expressed in many ways but still, flowers are associated with women's universe. Flowers are strong and delicate at the same time and this inspired the creation of Absolument Femme, a perfect combination of flowers and absinthe.

The smile to be consumed without moderation! She lives at top speed, takes advantage of every day. In Paris, she has fun with everything and worries about nothing. Life is her playground. Her perfume? Live Irrésistible, where the exhilarating trail allows the Givenchy women to live every day completely.
Farsight, a fragrance to complete the look of the modern man, who always stands out for his charm and chivalry.
Move on your own terms. Dance whenever, wherever you feel like, with Pure Purple.

Under My Skin is my interpretation of the animalic theme. I was charmed by strong animalic scents, and I tried to do my own; but I had to realize that what I like in other’s creations is not necessarily what I like to create myself. The name comes from a conversation with an artist and fragrance lover, who said it is as if the scent emanates from the skin.
So Citrus invites you on a sunset stroll amongst the citrus trees in a fragrant, peaceful and relaxing garden.

Ysatis, the scent of a woman fragrance with a thousand facets in a fascinating blend of Floral-Chypre notes. A dream-like vision of contemporary elegance and the essence of infinite beauty. Ysatis is a divine tribute to femininity. Combining the names of Yseult and Isis, Ysatis is half-woman, half-goddess.

The cold is deep late at night. The enticing glow humming through the windows beckons them. They know where they are going. They know who they are here to see. Inside the warmth, she waits in the scent of orchids and tobacco flowers. She grasps peasants and princes delighting in all their devotions. Of those who fell into the depths of her, they never to return and she revels in every man lost, remaining poised through the rising smoke of her cigarette.
Blended from seven different types of rose from around the world, Red Roses is a surprisingly clean, voluptuous scent.
The women's fragrance that evokes the timeless essence of falling in love. Discover the sensual essence of velvety woods, extravagant florals and seductive musk.
A vibrant citrus scent inspired by a Mediterranean summer evening.

"I wish time would stop now. It was a trip to Laos that made me understand the timeless love between two people and gave birth to my desire to tell you about this journey. Encore du Temps is a dedication to love. It's a flower fallen into a cup of tea," Meo Fusciuni.

name_perfume: Scandal Eau De Parfum Pour Homme
ingredients: ['Jasmine', 'Lemon', 'Tonka Bean', 'Lavender', 'Tarragon', 'Spearmint', 'Ambergris', 'Bergamot', 'Cardamom', 'Cashmeran (Woody musky)', 'Cedarwood', 'Ciste Labdanum', 'Clove', 'Lily Of The Valley', 'Musk', 'Nutmeg', 'Patchouli', 'Petitgrain', 'Rhubarb', 'Rose', 'Sandalwood', 'Vetiver', 'Violet']
description: "A friend of mine said, 'I would grab any man who smelt this way'. I was thrilled, for I knew I had created the effect I wanted, as, without question, it worked," Roja Dove.
A scent of liberty and madness. Untamed, unleashed, and uncensored.

Fragrance X is a celebration of universal love. Love is always around us, it is just a matter of putting it out into the universe. Unmatched in intensity, the fragrance captivates and re-creates the magic of a loved one’s embrace.
Soft and comforting, the delicate fragrance A l'Ombre des Amandiers is the poetic interpretation of the almond blossom.
With Goa, you'll be catapulted back to your younger self when you would sit by the beach and watch the sun set into the water.
A seductive composition based on delicious chocolate tones.
A dynamic and energetic scent which combines floral and fruity notes. The perfect combination dedicated to a modern man.
A sea breeze blows on this invigorating accord, enhanced by the elegance of a heart composed of fresh notes of warm sand, magnified by a richly musky base.
She is determined and fun-loving. She asks you to join the party, even though she hardly knows you. She enjoys every performance in spectacular colour!

Launched in the midst of protests that revolutionised social manners in France and beyond, Balafre has not aged a day. A composition that opens with a cascade of Mediterranean zesty fruits. Lavender's inclusion allows women to make this fragrance – designed for men – their own.
Carnal Rose reveals a singular facet of your personality, the passionate and seductive one.
Velvet Oud is a scent that evokes memories and introduces a new level of luxury to those who appreciate the extraordinary.

The eternal masculine fragrance. This man takes his place in a luxurious and refined world. He reflects his time. Urban and self-confident. Refined and elegant. The epitome of savoir-vivre. He knows what he owns the past and accepts his place in tradition. Man, at his best.
A dance of elation whisked away by love at first sight. Head-over-heels, and the unquenchable desire to embrace the world in laughter unleashed. Passion poised on the precipice of joy.
A beautifully elegant perfume for the naturally fierce woman!
The ideal man is a myth. But with L'Homme Idéal Eau de Parfum, Guerlain has made his fragrance a reality.
This scent evokes what femininity, and ballet, is: the flawless balance between strength and fragility, dedication and lightness.

Put on a piece of music that never fails to raise the hairs on the nape of your neck…that arouses unbridled yearning and desire. Now you're ready to sink deep into a feeling of unbridled passion, personified by the voluptuous individuality of Passionate, a pure perfume that envelops the wearer.
Relaxing, fresh, and delightful.
"I opted for Volynka leather top notes. Its scent is so strong that I wanted to pull it in the opposite direction by pairing it with a delicate flower: violets,” Christine Nagel, Hermès Perfumer.

Want to escape and travel far away ? Oriental and floral fragrance for a wonderful voyage. Around the coconut taste, with a twist of bitter oranges, ylang-ylang from Comores island and indian tuberose. Cedar wood and palm for additional strengh; charm and feminity for a fragrance that does not smell like anything else
The drape of a scent? The scent of a dress? Colour and fragrance fuse and swirl in the air. Couleur Kenzo Rose-Pink - dazzling, chic, and radiance in shock scent.
Tabac Nomade is an explosive composition that will transport you to the wilderness of the desert. In this warm and hypnotic perfume, refined tobacco leaves blend together with precious spicy notes.

Fragonard celebrates the lilac flower in 2024. A symbol of springtime freshness, its invigorating, green and delicately powdery fragrance unveils a floral heart with harmonies of spices. Its base notes pay homage to this opulent flower’s warm and sensual side.

Violet Blonde has the spirit of a classical European fragrance. It is formal, polished, and yet draws you in closer and closer, like a beautifully dressed woman whose refined presence charms, then fascinates and ultimately seduces you.

A tribute to planet Earth and the beauty of its elements. A fragrance that captures the essence of wet earth notes and gives your senses a vital and invigorating experience. The perfect fragrance for the man who wants to bring a spark of energy into his daily routine.
Voluptuous and sensual, L'Interdit Millésime Night Jasmine reveals a jasmine harvested exclusively for Givenchy by night.
Sultry and mysterious, Imari Mystique is an intriguing impression of intoxicating florals seductively laced over a rich and profound base.

In 1920, the Grand Duke Dimitri was exiled from Russia to Paris, leaving in his trail the white steppe and the icy Neva River, furs and crinolines. Charmed by the sumptuous Byzantine style, Gabrielle Chanel adorned her creations with Slavic and gold embroidery. Cuir de Russie is a distant escape that blends birch bark with swirls of blonde tobacco in a musky, sophisticated fragrance. A testament to passionate elegance.
A luxurious scent with a sweet trail.
Ambre Intense is a mixture of rich essences that explode into a thousand-and-one delight.
Freesia and Magnolia echo each other in this warm fragrance with crystalline tones. Enjoy this luminous duo for elegant femininity with a fragile and discreet sensuality.
Dynastie Royale, a scent of eternity with its freshly tuned orange-lemon, and a heart-throbbing beautiful Bulgarian rose.

Seville in spring. Soon the whole city will beat to the rhythms of the Feria. The secret doors of the stalls will open to reveal the ladies of Seville in flounced dresses, their hair scented with neroli. The smell invades the streets as women walk, determined and haughty.

5th Avenue is inspired by the timeless elegance and the luxury of the most famous street in the world. This alluring fragrance epitomizes the pulsating energy and excitement of New York and the style sophistication of the vibrant city woman who calls it home.
Fiorucci ELLA is a striking fragrance that inspires freedom and what is free was born to be special. ELLA is for all women who make their own decisions and makes a mark.

Treasures of the Damascena rose. Fruity, honeyed, and opulent it whisks away into a spicy heart of Sri Lanka cinnamon and ends its journey in the tender, leathery heat of ambery balsams and woods. A fragrance with captivating charisma, powerful yet delicate.
The fragrance rests close to the skin and lasts all day, making it a perfect choice as an everyday fragrance or something to spice up more elegant occasions.

Divine Moon captures the essence of peace. Heady and enchanting, unique yet familiar, it is an intoxicating blend inspired by Tory’s garden and apiary in Antigua. Divine Moon is one of five scents in the Essence of Dreams collection, celebrating the power of dreams.

A woman of adventure, who understands? She holds her own through seas and sands. Uncharted lands are her demands. The wild and tough, she withstands. And when all else comes to an end. Her fragrant scent lingers without end.
Inspired by Domenico Donizetti's opera, L'Elisir D'Amore, this scent brings with it a breath of Italian breeze with fresh citrus aromas. A fragrant, fresh floral perfume.
A sea salt accord inspired by Essaouira, is combined with woody notes from Morocco on a dry down of spices and eastern musk.

Sobold is character, power and rebellion. He is a non-conformist who finds his freedom by creating his own rules. He rejects the establishment and expresses his desires freely. He is an idealist, and even in love, makes no compromise, but still acts with respect and passion.
Icon Instinct is inspired by instincts and emotions. This feminine fragrance is enigmatic, evocatively mysterious and irresistibly seductive.

name_perfume: Flacon Aux Abeilles By Atelier Truscelli 2024
description: The House of Guerlain invites you to its exceptional rendezvous in numbered edition dedicated to the Chinese New Year. Its 2024 millésime is under the sign of the dragon, symbolising the year to come. Dressed in red for the occasion, the legendary Bee Bottle is adorned with a sumptuous dragon created by Parisian jeweller, Francesco Truscelli. This exceptional piece is hosting the powerful trail of Neroli Outrenoir like an imperial dragon.
Revolution is a fragrance that permeates the skin and builds upon human emotions throughout the day. It blends in, leaving an air of mystery and intrigue around the body.

Colonia Intensa Oud combines the unique freshness of Colonia with one of the world's richest and most cherished ingredients, Oud, for an unforgettable fragrance that is both fresh and richly aromatic.
This small plant, a very popular garden flower, is a dark horse that has been confounding perfumers since time immemorial.
A natural scent that provides harmony and wellness.
The symbol of passion, perfection, and above all, love. The queen of flowers was created by the Greek goddess Chloris. Its beauty was then given by Aphrodite and its fragrance by Dionysus.
Colección Privada Mahonia is a woody fragrance for a woman of strong and elegant character.

This summer, reveal your chic and bohemian spirit! This sparkling cocktail of notes of citrus and summer fruits combined with the freshness of mint embarks on you in an olfactory and colourful journey.
This scent is an enrobing expression of profound love.
He is the last man standing, covered in blood and sweat. Squeezing the last drop of power left and pushing that into one final furious punch. His pain turns into your ideal masculinity.
A sparkling yet sensual scent with luminous accords.

ingredients: ['Jasmine', 'Tonka Bean', 'Gardenia', 'Lily Of The Valley', 'Narcissus', 'Rose', 'Vanilla', 'Apple', 'Cedarwood', 'Citruses', 'Dew Drop', 'Musk', 'Peach', 'Sandalwood', 'Vetiver', 'Blackcurrant Bud']
description: Loving Life is a not an ordinary fruity floral fragrance, it's for anyone who loves to be feminine with an edge.
High spirits are here to stay. Mandarine is a fruity and sparkling perfume that offers a handful Dolce Vita to all children of the sun.
An English field at dawn, full of the joys of spring. Filled with young green wheat, crisp and fresh. Zesty notes balanced with soft white notes.

ingredients: ['Sandalwood (Sri Lankan)', 'Cardamom', 'Tuberose', 'Bergamot', 'Lemon', 'Cashmere Wood', 'Pink Pepper', 'Black Pepper', 'Caramel', 'Cinnamon', 'Patchouli', 'Tonka Bean', 'Ylang-ylang', 'Rose (Bulgaria)', 'Rose Damascena', 'Rose (Turkey)', 'Hot Pepper', 'Geranium (Egypt)']
description: Make every move as exciting as a slow dance with a fast heartbeat. Feel the rhythm as glances meet and sparks of electricity fly. Let the Dance Begin encapsulates the melodic harmony of high and low notes flowing in flirtatious partnership.
All In will ignite your passions and give you a lust for life. Immerse yourself in a world of floral indulgence, as you go All In on its sensual energy.
This romantic fragrance says, "I’m fun, fun, fun."
Elvis had an incredible ability to thrill and captivate audiences, just as Legend for Her will thrill and captivate those around her.
Enjoy the crisp, delicious combinations of this floral fragrance.

Inspired by the simplicity of its ingredients, Vera Wang Embrace : Periwinkle and Iris' floral gourmand opens with a radiant entrance which mixes with a tender heart. Gourmand notes create a sense of comfort and addiction at the base of this fragrance.

ingredients: ['Vetiver', 'Ginger', 'Iris / Orris', 'Iso E Super (Cedarwood Note)', 'Sandalwood', 'Lime', 'Mandarin', 'Amber', 'Cinnamon', 'Freesia', 'Green Notes', 'Hedione (light Jasmine)', 'Jasmine', 'Leather', 'Pink Pepper', 'Rose', 'Black Pepper', 'Tea', 'Muscone (Musk)']
description: To reinforce the “rootiness” of this fragrance, 03, has a mood that is organic but mysterious, suggesting something dark and moving just below the surface of things, something you can't quite put your finger on.

"I was inspired by the idea of a confident young woman; a woman who has a strong sense of self and understands her inner essence and identity. She has her own inner compass and her intuition guides her to follow her instincts. I wanted to create a fragrance with a contrast of layers and textures, like this woman who has many facets, expressing her inner strength, yet also possessing an alluring, feminine softness," Stephen Nilsen, Perfumer.

name_perfume: La Nuit De Bohème Eau De Parfum
description: Introduced with a shimmering illumination that captures the carefree Bohemian spirit of Anna Sui, a prelude to the dark dance that is midnight fruit. The tale continues with the soulful rhythm of exotic and sensual blooms. The scent, veiled in an enchanting expression of mystery, extends the journey from dawn 'til dusk and into the deep darkness of night.
A sensory journey in Egypt, a zest start to this fragrance is followed by an aromatic heart while developing in to a subtle, subtle, semi-light half-light fragrance."
II Vanilla is a gourmand composition that makes you feel happy and good. Beware, Vanilla is a temptation: lock it in your wardrobe!

Alluring and addictive at its core, Fantasy Intense introduces an amplified, captivating signature with intoxicating notes. Sensual, yet playfully sweet, this seductive scent leaves a tantalising trail that lingers to entice.
Often imitated, never duplicated, Platin Wood reveals its full force through bold intensification.

A whirlwind of elements unleashed in an essence of powerful contrasts. Intense and energetic, while fresh and elegant. A sensual dance, strong yet delicate, that will take you to the kingdom of seduction.
"I imagined a truly floral fragrance, both joyful and full of energy - just like New York - but also a timeless one." - Sonia Constant, Perfumer

“The rising sun of a new, carefree day. A warm wind filtering through the Californian desert. The perfumed air of a Himalayan temple. Waves of long, shining hair flicker over dust and sand and soft, tanned skin. Freedom is not far. Against the rose coloured sky of dusk, we dream of love and peace and better days,” James Heeley.
A mysterious and intriguing interpretation that reveals royalty and luxury.

Scenery of the "Thousand and One Nights", the Sahara desert is the backdrop to the encounter between a Nuvola and a dUNA. A story of courage, of mutation, of change. A dedication to the short but strong emotions that intertwine in the long journey of life.

Yvra 1500 L'Essence de Distance. A new fragrance, so overpowering, so intense and concentrated that after you spray it on you feel almost unapproachable. The surprising top notes are so thrilling that for a few seconds people around you will respect the 1500mm distance.
Venice is a timeless fragrance with rich magical notes.
To create this fine fragrance reminiscent of springs first blossoms bathed in soft sunlight, master perfumers have balanced a heart of cherry blossom with notes of dewy watermelon and red plum.
A fresh and feminine fragrance that celebrates the power of a woman who is unafraid to be herself.

Symbolic of enchanting, faraway lands, intoxicating and refined, the source of mystery and sensuality, of dreams and wonder, the Orient never ceases to fascinate us with its splendour , mystery and wealth. Alien Musc Mystérieux evokes those images with this scent, where musk reveals first its shadowy and then its luminous facets, like the lattice-work of an oriental palace.
An exciting citrusy scent for the Springfield man who loves life and isn't afraid to show it!
"Aqua Mysteri is wonderfully bright and evokes the orange trees in full bloom at the Couvent des Minimes. " Jean-Claude Ellena, Olfactive Director

Britney feels a deep connection to Maui. Whenever she has a break, she travels to the breathtaking island to relax and rejuvenate with her family. Embodying all the aspects of this beloved paradise. Maui Fantasy Britney Spears captures the warmth of Hawaii's climate and the vibrancy of its sea breeze.

The rallying call for a generation: A fragrance of empowerment. A scent celebrating self-belief. A symbol of the transition into strong, independent womanhood. A declaration of femininity wholly owned. A statement of self-affirmation for a young woman writing her own story, a young woman defining who she is and where she is going. Yes I Am. With a capital "A".

The Ford Mustang is an iconic pony car with great history which keeps tuned Americans and oversees fans to give emotions, passion, and power with the new release. The famous logo in front bumper Pony Emblem or Horse represents masculinity, speed, power, beauty and competition.
A wonderfully fresh mix of sparkling citrus on a delicate heart of herbs and spices highlighted with florals on a background of greens.

Unue is the scent of "firsts". We all have first times; our first love, our first olfactory memory, our first perfume. Unue pays tribute to Selfridges' department store, an English institution, the first department store to highlight the creations of Jeroboam.
This delicate fragrance will take you on an exotic journey of self-discovery. This alluring scent will induce a warming and spiritually grounding effect.
An ultra-feminine scent for the sensual, elegant woman.

ingredients: ['Patchouli', 'Jasmine (Arabia)', 'Juniper Berries', 'Magnolia', 'Ylang-ylang', 'Rose Damascena', 'Amber', 'Ambroxan (Ambergris)', 'Cedarwood', 'Ciste Labdanum', 'Galbanum', 'Lemon', 'Lentisk', 'Musk', 'Tonka Bean', 'Vetiver', 'Green of Tangerine', 'Benzoin (Laos)']
description: To mark its 60th anniversary, Diptyque has chosen to pay homage to the Latin Quarter of Paris, and the heart of the city's artistic and intellectual nightlife. The atmosphere has been recreated, although since there is no one left that can personally recall these places, the key requirement was to reinvent them. Orphéon is an olfactory dream.
The scent of sun-drenched figs,

No matter the destination, the sea is never far off, generously offering its waters, such that you may dive deep into every journey. Travel to the Mediterranean - our sea, encircled by land of sun-drenched scents.
Courageous Rose showcases the sensation of high-quality silk and brings the final touch of sophistication to an individual’s style.

Do you like surprising combinations of tastes? Then try this electrifying scent! On the skin, feel the thrill of a toasted, crunchy scent, twisted with a powdery scent. Dare to bet on intensity! By wearing Eau Corsée, you'll be noticed and it will affirm your character loud and clear with this affordable floral "shot".
Citrus notes combine to create a romantic fragrance, while balsamic notes intertwine with creamy gourmand notes in a warm and inviting dry-down.

Vetiver Bourbon is a rare and elegant composition. It is part of the Museum Collection, which uses classic raw materials and olfactory families from Europe and Asia, reminiscent of the fragrance library of an ancient perfumer.

If the essence of joy could be crafted, poured into a vial, and shared with the whole world, it would smell like this. Like a happy moment filled with umpteen colours and brilliance, the balmy, sweet, and woody touch of Joy makes your senses lighter and gladder than they ever were.
Paris is enchanting and innocently flirty. “It's as perfect for a shopping spree with my BFF as it is for a romantic evening lit by the glow of the Eiffel Tower,” Paris Hilton.

"In Coriandre I wanted to find the olfactory emotions of my youth: the subtle and delicate perfume of my mother and the captivating scents of the countryside around Grasse" Jacqueline Couturier, perfumer.
A sensual aroma of oud mixed with a bowl of juicy fruits.

"To create this perfume, I drew on the stunning Tuscan countryside as my inspiration, more specifically the cypress trees that stand proudly on the hills around Siena. Caressed by sunshine, they assert their strong personality whilst refreshing the surrounding countryside. I have always been fascinated by the sacred cypress tree. In Italy, they can often be found near churches and historic palaces," Alexandra Carlin, Perfumer.
A sensual fragrance that flirts with emotions and awakens the imagination.

Amyris is a luminous fragrance steeped in natural, urban elegance, reflecting a vibrant Parisian lifestyle. In this Extrait de parfum composition, Francis Kurkdjian has infused new energy to the duo featuring amyris from Jamaica and iris from Florence.

name_perfume: Flora By Gucci Eau De Toilette
description: Utterly feminine, yet deeply sensual, Flora by Gucci is characterised by contrasts. Each component of this special fragrance imparts a sophisticated optimism, which is at the heart of Flora's spirit. At the same time, an evolution has occurred which layers on youthfulness, modernity and depth, all of which are essential components of today's Gucci woman.
Imagine 2040, captivating and spicy. A dense and textured feeling which will appeal to lovers of enveloping colognes.

If you look at Mount Amiata from far away, its volcanic shape is serious and delicate at the same time. The upper part is full of beech and chestnut trees, whose fruits have fed the animals and population for a very long time. The Amiata chestnut has been registered as a Protected Denomination of Origin product.
It's a delight to indulge oneself, to live and breathe, celebrating beauty. In the realm of pleasure, a moment for herself, just for herself. It's so delicious, so good to let go. Hmmm, It's so good!
Intoxicatingly fresh, clean and sparkling, Bianca personifies la dolce vita.
An original olfactory score, dedicated to opera music, Get The Feeling is a touching, intimate and well-balanced composition. Like a deep and virile voice, it reaches straight for the heart.
Carbone de Balmain is the perfume of an aesthete. It is like a work of art which reveals itself reluctantly before it totally bewitches you.

name_perfume: The Priceless Queen - Wu Jia Nü Wang
description: As prideful and charming as a rose.

A late-night rooftop party. You are close to the edge on top of the world. The city steams around you and you can't take it any longer. You're ready for a steamy night.
Confident and elegant, a fragrance for the modern person who remains unafraid of attention.
Blossom like a flower in every stage of your life with this beautiful scent.

She walks nonchalantly at a regular pace, just like a queen. Everyone is watching her light turban that opens up like a corolla but she pretends she doesn't notice anything. Every petal of her headdress is like a white wing, and her frail silhouette sways with pride under the weight of her crown glorified by the sun and envied by the flowers that surround her.
Elite Gentleman Quest reflects the search for excellence, made with refined ingredients for an intense and sophisticated experience.

A bright fragrance for the joyful woman who knows how to enjoy life.
A fragrance inspired by the glamorous aesthetics of Hollywood's golden age and the free-spirited fashion of the 1960s.
A charismatic bright young thing. Reveling in the season of extravagance, this alluring scent leads the decadent celebrations through till dawn with its entrancing spirit.

Rise at dawn and escape into the delightful freshness of an early morning in Paris to rediscover a taste for beauty. Stroll through the empty streets and archways of a Paris still cast in the first light of day, before taking a rest.

“Green Orange & Coriander is soulful and sassy. It has a wonderfully clean smell to it and the marriage between green citrus and herb sits beautifully together and becomes very sexy. Allure Homme Sport Eau Extrême incarnates a man who lives his life without limits or compromise.
Spring is all around us, so soak and spritz on Sugar Chic, a delight springtime scent.

Take action with Match Point Cologne and let yourself be carried away by its exhilarating freshness.
Havana Noir is a seduction lesson stripped of artifices, and it is adorned with feline elegance that as it advances, are instinctive and powerful, between enveloping without yielding to eagerness.
A gentle, delectable woody abstract revealing a halo of soft light.
With the pleasure of the Orient and the memory of a Thousand and One Nights, the beautiful Shéhérazade incarnates the 2008 perfume.
Images of a tropical island with soft gentle whispers of rose, jasmine and hyacinth. Coconut-scented nights … you're in a place far, far away. Away from the everyday madness.
This is the scent of honeysuckle on a warm, summer day, experienced while driving down a country road about 45 miles/hour with the windows down.

I always like old and outworn clothes, but a long time is needed to achieve this effect. Once upon a time, I decided to create this type of style and became a designer of the time. I don't want to look back. If you look back, you cannot make progress.
“I wanted to evoke the sensuality and ardor of an impassioned woman. A woman who allows herself to experience a romantic obsession and invites a man to do the same,” Calvin Klein.
Mini Dream is a dreamy fragrance with a fruity top, indulgent heart, and an addictive enveloping trail that will transport you to a cheerful heaven on earth.
Tuberóza reveals the captivating tuberose of Mexico which is accompanied by other floral notes. The strong ambery base is a guarantee for the distinctiveness of the scent.
Vanille Celeste is a burst of vanilla that leads you into a new world full of bloom yet has an alluring and enticing spicy trail.
A soft and enveloping floral blend that gives a sophisticated and sensual personality to this amazing, intense fragrance.

Aswan is an invitation to an exceptional olfactory journey, drawn from the imagination of a perfumer and nourished by the history of the world and its treasures. Aswan is a perfect combination of classic heritage and modernity in a single bottle.

Escape to India with night jasmine. Inspired by a moonlit night in a Mughal garden, this seductive, feminine eau de toilette from our Voyage fragrance collection is a blend of floral and oriental accords.

Davidoff Cool Water Caribbean Summer edition evokes endless expanses of white sand, caressed by gently lapping waves. A world where colours are more dazzling, sensations more vibrant, emotions more intense. An earthly paradise, a destination dreams are made of. Welcome to the Caribbean.

Presented as part of Dunhill’s Signature Collection, which draws inspiration from the menswear label’s finest elements and materials, the Amalfi Citrus eau de parfum captures the zesty spirit of the southern Italian coastline.
The Elixir of success for an accomplished man who makes his dreams come true.
For sophisticated gentlemen who make a strong impression in every situation with their style and confidence.

A rare fragrance. Every man is different and creates his own show, designed to make men feel good about themselves no matter what the occasion. One Man Show Oud Edition is the fragrance for the rarest of occasions.
An impressive and unforgettable fragrance, calling to mind the mysterious hour of midnight and its addictively intoxicating powers.

Santa Maria Novella's Ambra fragrance is a bouquet of sweet oriental notes. The ancient Dominican recipe uses precious raw materials and is still used today. The fragrance is considered to be an aphrodisiac par excellence. Its unique, rich and warm fragrance is provocative and intoxicating, with sweet marine and leathery tones.

The moment within the moment: right now. Things encapsulate our time. In the present where we live. Here and now. The time is for ourselves. Time that lasts an instant, a day or a whole lifetime.

“Carine is a portrait-perfume, a sensual and disconcerting olfactory reflection. It is my most intimate journey, laying myself bare. Opening the door to my emotions, my memories, my thoughts, my dreams, and my fantasies,” Carine Roitfeld.
A memorable masculine scent, clean and modern yet timelessly refined.
Are you a fan of the hit television show, 24, and wish you could smell just like Jack Bauer? If you answered “yes,” then 24 Go Dark is worth getting!

Timeless, sparkling yet intensely seductive, Possess Eau de Parfum embodies the provocative allure of Cleopatra, whose legendary powers of seduction brought Mark Antony to his knees. A natural, refreshing scent to use all summer long.

The unique and intense aroma, slightly sweet and refreshing, combines pure and crystalline notes with a smooth and enveloping character.

In the heart of Paris, Odéon recalls the literary, jazzy giddiness that brought its clubs and cafés to life. A neighbourhood is woven of fiction, of pages to be devoured, of moments to be lived, waiting patiently in booksellers' stands for the early morning when Odéon awakens. Once again, and forever.
X Limited is suitable for men and women who are young and cheerful at heart. The citrus aroma and fresh atmosphere of the perfume reveal the expressive nature of life.

Though Italian perfumers Tiziana Terenzi has timeless expertise on its side (five decades to be exact), it's forever staying ahead of the curve with its unusual, exotic and far-flung scents just like Bianco Puro.
An absolutely chic creation with a mix of bewitching flowers, evoking a soft and sweet essence.
STR8 Original is a distinctively masculine scent with a woody core and dynamic orris base notes that generate a feeling of luxury.
A classic yet contemporary scent, Gotas de Oro Clásica is a combination of notes that evoke elegance and distinction.
"The mystery of the name drove me to create a fragrance that seems to be all things to all people, it itself is certain and assured, whilst creating ambiguity in others," Roja Dove.
Bouquet d'Amour is a graceful and luminous fragrance, sensual, delicate, enveloping and truly elegant.

Issey Miyake's desire for his own water, a non-fragrance, was interpreted as a stunning, luminous fragrance that has now become a great classic. The Eau de Toilette version is crisp and bright as the morning dew.
For a killer night, your scent should be marked as well as your personality
The black desert scent immediately plunges us into a freezing night under the stars.

Dawn. The sea resting after a night storm. Pacified, broken only by the whisper of waves; the silence of the desert coast. A cool sea breeze, the subtle delicate salty flavour of algae heated by the sun; enchanting aromas of flowering shrubs like an elegant necklace framing the coastline.
Rebel Love, a fragrance for girls ready to live life to the fullest and enjoy every moment!
Eau Ressourçante is an excellent ally to help the skin and mind restore harmony and serenity.

Faraway places are experienced by the soul of the traveller who is searching for interior growth. Each stop is an opportunity to go up one more step on the ladder of awareness that leads us to knowledge and true prosperity. Al Contrario tells of the return journey from these quests.
A classic fragrance, which we could not resist twisting in the two opposite directions of its olfactory nature.

With her fragrance, Naomi Campbell Bohemian Garden, all confident, fashion-conscious women can become a part of Naomi's fashion world and experience one of her favourite trends: the Bohemian Style. Inspired by the carefree lifestyle of French Bohème, this trendy style is epitomised by floral prints and opulent, playful patterns.

U.S. dollars have a distinct, if somewhat evolving and ambiguous smell, with hints of inky cotton, leather wallets, metal cash drawers, and hundreds of sweaty palms, in a complexity that evolves and changes over time, as money circulates. We used new, though not uncirculated, bills, focusing on the crispness of the fabric-laden paper and the ink. The result is a light, clean scent with enough of the ink to make it unmistakably money, in American bills.
Agape is a creation dedicated to all those chosen souls in harmony with the universe.
Embrace confidence and embrace your uniqueness with a scent that celebrates the power and beauty of being a woman. Be graceful, be you.
A fragrance for the classic gentleman, self-confident and a lover of opposites.

description: An impactful, transformative feminine composition. Elegant, sensual, and unapologetically empowered.

An irresistible fantasy unfolds in this fruity floral fragrance.

Atlantis is the elixir of love made from the best nectar oils found within the Mediterranean lands.

Negronis are meant to be sipped as the sunsets. With orange solar accords, every whiff of every sip celebrates a moment of the day that serves as a pause. A breath of simple celebration. Eau de Negroni is also meant for skin. It's a sensual, unforgettable blend that pairs with every sip. Like a passionate kiss on a balcony overlooking Piazza Navona, maybe even as the sun rises…

It is the meeting between a man and a woman who are attracted to each other, the emotional impact of the encounter, an irresistible force of attraction, a unique instant, made of powerful emotions when 2 people are magnetised to each other. For a man? A woman? It doesn't matter.

The strength of Obsessed For Men resonates through the heart that mirrors the sensuality of the original Obsession. A modernized scent that has a unique link to the original scent, re-interpreted through the lens of masculinity. The overdose of gourmand notes in the base is addictive and disruptive while remaining true to the Calvin Klein DNA.

Sensual, confident and mysterious. This rich, woody scent is infused with the fragrance of Cypress, an emblematic tree throughout Provence… The wind whispers in its branches and tells the everlasting legend of the Baux de Provence knights who, guided by their star, daringly accepted all challenges.
Be the emperor of the game who spreads the aroma of wisdom and leaves behind a legacy of luxury.

Built through science for a sports state of mind for life, and inspired by male runners, Charge / Chrg is an exhilarating fragrance. Charge your life with the positive energy from your run. Keep going, whatever you're doing.

Simply the sexiest fragrance ever. Absolutely captivating. In 1953, Estée Lauder introduced Youth-Dew as a scented bath oil that doubled as a perfume - and the world of fragrance was forever changed. Until then, women had relied on the men in their lives to give them perfume as a special gift. But Youth-Dew was created for women to buy for themselves… and they did. Even today, its captivating, sexy spiciness ensures that this true classic remains a favourite.

" This is La Petite Robe Noire's glamorous sister; she's the one who's out there on the red carpet at night. You could say that the length has changed, there are different colour and texture; it's an evening gown. My idea is not to create a collection, but rather, the woman who wears it has grown along with the fragrance." Thierry Wasser, perfumer.
A golden interpretation melting to perfection. The iconic signature "D" and the royal lifestyle of Oriental countries.
Ceylon was inspired around the luxurious accord of ouds from Malaysia and India with sweet balsamic notes.
Fabulous, tempting and sensational.
Discovered in 1927 in South Africa and on display in Washington D.C. at the National Museum of Natural History,the De Young Red is the most dazzling cut red diamond in the world.

Holiday feeling in a bottle. This scent has the effect of a fresh sea breeze that immediately lets any trace of stress evaporate. A real spa fragrance that envelops you in pure wellbeing and lets you forget the stress in no time.

Delicate, elegant, and fresh.

The ideal scent for those who like to push boundaries and feel different.
Oceani di Seta evokes a unique portrait of the depths of the ocean, transparent and brilliant. An underwater paradise in one's hand.
This delectable scent takes us on an olfactory voyage into a land of fascinating contrasts inspired by the treasure of exotic Panama: white amber.
Dream of Japan’s wonderfully sweet and vibrant Hanami season and celebrate new beginnings with Rêve de Hanami.

Immersed in the fresh vitality of new life, Hos N.003 carries distinct notes to create a masterpiece of volcanic fusion inspired by the moment of a new beginning and a sense of masculine resilience, emerging from the heart of the ocean in a journey towards uncharted territory.
A dark smokey scent with that will have heads turning no matter where you go. A refined classic scent for the refined gentleman.

A timeless indulgence filled with flavor. Layers of Mahogany Oak, Sage and Cinnamon build this profound blend of Whiskey.

Born from the weightless dream of imaginary flight; like an enchanted vehicle of a solar journey with aerial magic and breathtaking manoeuvers. This sensational fragrance will make you dizzy with its never-ending silken waves.
Surround yourself with a halo of divine purity. "Like a Virgin, touched for the very first time."
A decisive and seductive olfactive creation. A fresh and intense perfume that celebrates the energy and the charismatic virility of the contemporary man.
“I created this fragrance as a hymn to my childhood memories of freshness and the sunlight of the Mediterranean.” – Giorgio Armani.

Max Mara Kashmina Touch, is an elegant perfume inspired by the comforting and soft sensuality of a cashmere wrap.

Synonymous of jewels and preciousness, Trussardi's regal Scent of Gold fragrance has an imperial mood coming from the magnetism of the woody notes and the ancestral conflict between gourmand and smokey accents.

Effusive from its first notes, the bouquet unfurls weightlessly, deliciously fresh yet tenacious. First Instinct for Her, inspired by that first moment of attraction, when two people's worlds collide and a spark is ignited. It is the fragrant interpretation of that exciting first glance and initial connection.
An attractive scent with a pop of colour, geared for the millennial generation. Fresh and trendy, this fragrance will bring an unlimited amount of good spirit.

Set free your intrepid spirit as you take in the wondrous view. Voyager Woman personifies this exciting moment with succulent, vibrant notes of exotic Feijoa flower and fruit – a mélange of sweetly floral and surprising green tropical notes, taking you beyond the limits as you soar to new horizons.
All the spirit of Provence in bright, invigorating notes of lavender.

Jean-Claude Ellena has put together this graceful powdered floral fragrance to evoke the evanescent grace and delicate fluttering of a butterfly around a sunlit clearing awash with Jasminum Grandiflorum and sweet Mandarin. This singular composition has been crafted according to the traditions of French Haute Parfumerie, using only the finest precious primary ingredients.

Greet each day with confidence and freshness. Citrus Tonic emphasises the invigorating signature note of bow wood, an energetic scent that opens the fragrance with an unforgettable citrus lift, perfectly expressing the feel of a man in his element.

"A dot is timeless and a pattern I've always loved, and round shapes are always beautiful. I liked the idea of these hybrid butterfly-ladybugs, which suggest a sort of free spirit and femininity and playfulness. And of course, ladybugs mean good luck," Marc Jacobs.
Ghost Moonlight. A delicate and sensual fragrance - mysterious and seductive.
A delicious scent with mysterious, sensual accords.

A modern and sophisticated creation translated into the combination of Copaíba, wood from Brazilian biodiversity, with fresh spices, such as cardamom and pepper. An exclusive fragrance that makes every moment unique.

A composition of contrasts in which the vibrant note of Himalayan Blue Poppy embraces the enchanting scent of the Datura flower. This aromatic and spicy fragrance symbolises the values of freedom and self-expression of a new emotional generation, committed and connected to the world.
A scent inspired by a cool, unique woman with a lot of personality.
A soft fragrance suitable for all times of the day. Frangipani is a skin scent, a perfume that is like a second skin.
Boss Bottled Tonic, refreshing and not too intense, is described as an ideal scent for work and for everyday occasions.

Named after one of the earliest recorded stallions also known as "Royal Mare", Darcy - Parfums de Marly's latest fragrance - reflects the refined spirit of its namesake. Darcy is a fitting tribute to the ancestor of the thoroughbred.

Aristocracy, blue blood, family names, heritage, Palisander book cases, velvet armchairs… and unwavering respect for values and tradition. A world fading away little by little. Old money, an essence of nobility: sophisticated, subtle and rather decadent.
“With Bergdorf, I wanted to create an incredibly feminine scent that was unapologetically refined, elegant and sensual,” Roja Dove.
What would you bring to a desert Island? With Vaadhoo, lost in the Maldives, you have everything you need.
Moderata is the nostalgia of finding yourself walking in Milan while your own steps draw your emotions on the wet road.
Suna is inspired by one of the oldest places in Barcelona's Mediterranean: the Gothic Quarter.

For a collection exclusive to Harrods, French perfume label Alexandre J flexes its olfactive prowess to create scents that are truly and exceptionally unique, such as Oriental Enigma Eau de Parfum. Inspired by the concept of holding your cards close to your chest, this fragrance is made for those who wish to protect their soul. And what better way to do that than from behind an alluring yet mysterious haze of precious accords?
Life is short, eat your dessert first! A cocktail of sour freshness expressed through the bitter and sour essences of citrus fruits.
For the most refined expression of French elegance and Parisian style, there is Eclat Mon Parfum. Sparkling, modern and reassuringly sophisticated.
A story of unresolved tension and desire. A man who knows what he wants, and remains in control. The mystery unfolds with infinite possibilities….
An oriental floral fragrance for the woman who is refined, elegant and sophisticated.

The Royal Court of Versailles was a world of elegance. The bright colours worn by the courtesans resembled an exotic jungle. During their travels, they developed dazzling colours and bewitching fragrances. At the oriental markets, the rolls of fabrics gave a pale hint of their beauty. To reach Europe, they had to travel through thousands of miles of desert. Then they crossed the seas. At Versailles, it was rumoured that Queens adored these silks for the harmony of their blues.
A captivating illusion that immerses you in the rhythm of the night.
Love, Anne begins with luminous citrus top notes that give way to feminine florals. The fragrance ends with an intimate blend of sensual accords.

A beautiful new star is born… Nuit Velours is a creamy, sumptuous and gently decadent fragrance has been inspired by the beauty of treasured memories that lie within the hearts of us all. An intoxicating blend. Temptation awaits…

It's being in the right place, at the right time. The moment luck strikes and everything just clicks. Celebrate these special moments together. Lucky Me for Him is a spicy, energetic scent made from contrasting and irresistible notes.
A brand classic, this timeless fragrance with character takes you on a journey to the heart of the Orient.

Be fearless. Don't hide your style. Establish your legacy with this authentic scent. Hot In Camo is designed for the resilient, with fearless creative spirit, who fights for his success in style. You'll never find an empty seat next to this fragrance lover, as they are fiercely loyal to their friends and family.
An escale in Sicily, a genuinely summer fragrance with a refined accent.

Slender blue palm trees sway in the musky wind, as the oil of vetiver stirs under a canopy of white flowers. Swallows wildly sweep across the leather, skimming over the ground. An indigo city, an imperial city, an ancient city looms like a mirage of the leathery iris: Moroccan Leather.
A scent of flowers on a dreamlike afternoon. Taking you higher up a fantasy mountain, where you wander and remember nothing.

Elegant, intimate, contrasting. This scent evokes the essence of elegance, a secret whispered under the moonlight.

description: Our sexy new anniversary tribute fragrance gets a fabulously festive limited-edition revamp reminiscent of a tinsel-strewn Studio 54. Bond No. 9 embellished the iconic Silhouette Bottle with a mix of bold tile-shaped Swarovski crystals that dance and shimmer like a disco ball on your vanity. A powerful fragrance for a powerful city.
The softness and voluptuousness of precious materials. The memory of the caravans and the thousand and one nights of the Far East. A wake that drags on for a powerfully bewitching fragrance.
Paris by Fiorucci is an elegant and charming perfume, conveying the aroma of the city of Paris.
A charismatic scent for the brave, strong man.
Be part of the royalty with the exclusive Night Club White Impériale. An incredible perfume for the extraordinary woman.

The combination of overtly sensual notes so innocent yet truly sexy, takes you by surprise. The effect of Initio's High Frequency is like a sound wave that starts off gently and then powers up the decibels on the skin. An overdose in the base detonates the final explosion.

Impulsed by citrus zest and an intense flavor of aromatic wood where balsamic notes meddle in the profound wooded heart. The heat in the base, provides a creamy finish, leaving smooth gourmand notes in it's wake.
Iris de Syracuse is vibrant and elegant floral, inspired by the sunny and steep lands of Sicily.

Honoré Delights is a tribute to Paris and its unique ability to renew itself. Like a “pâtissier”, perfumer Natalie Cetto deconstructed ingredients and played with unexpected texture associations to get the ultimate “gourmandise”.
Mayar has some bitter refreshing fruitiness with some nice white flowers. Perfect for summer.
“If you wear this fragrance, no one will mistake it for something else. People will ask what it is,” Pierre Wulff.

This perfume was made to commemorate and celebrate the birth of this glorious and majestic nation. Tuwaiq 1727 is a symbol of place and time, a witness to the birth of a nation and a precious heritage.

A fragrance to inspire you to build your own stories. To appreciate the moments that matter with the intensity they deserve! Made for the man who appreciates elegance and sophistication, who cultivates simplicity without giving up exclusivity.

Sakura is like a Japanese spring explosion. It transcends you in the foggy mornings in Japan where you are surrounded by gardens full of fresh and fragrant cherry blossoms. A sublime moment when you find beauty in simplicity.

Mindful, generous, positive media activists. Girl embodies the modern generation of women and their unique perspective. A fragrance worn to do good, to yourself, to others and where possible, to the planet. And in its trail, hints at the beginnings of a joyous revolution. Welcome to a changing world!
Roccobarocco Jeans Pour Femme is full of surprises and unexpected sensuality and harmony. For the woman with a passionate and poetic soul.

name_perfume: Comme Des Garçons Eau De Cologne
description: A feel-good, energy-giving scent which breathes life and vitality into every day.

With Ultrared, all the senses are on red alert. Life takes control, inhabited by a thrilling sensuality and overflowing energy. Ultrared Man takes emotions to new heights with all the snap of tall, shiny stiletto tripping down the street, while Ultrared Man releases the flamboyant power of a Ferrari tearing up the road.

The One is a warm, oriental floral with modern sensuality. A fragrance with a strong personality and a contrasting golden sweetness. Created for the ultimate diva, The One is at once tempting, modern and glamorous, embracing a touch of classicism.
A sparkling mix of fresh-cut peonies and exotic fruits in the afternoon sun.

A legend claims that the clash of thunderstorms made the clouds as hard as crystal. When lightning pierced these clouds, glazed fragments were dispersed into the sea. The sea that rocked these fragments created Création de Minuit.

Between the experimentation of couture and the morale of the cut. In the house of Balenciaga, there is the couturier who obeys the rules of style, but also the artist who embraces the realm of dreams… It is in this world that Balenciaga Paris was born.
Writer White is a dry, modern, and masculine scent, which expresses both strength and gentleness of a man, as well as frankness and mystery.

Within the "Les Quatre Saisons" collection, born from an exceptional collaboration between Maison Guerlain and artist Janaïna Milheiro, the bottle dedicated to Autumn is wrapped in a dazzling foliage of pheasant feathers. This unique set adorns the iconic Quadrilobé bottle in Baccarat crystal for a limited and numbered edition.

L'Homme Prada Intense multiplies the idea of a binary dialogue between ingredients. Forming a rich labyrinth-like effect, the fragrance's myriad ‘pathways' create a complex multilayered experience. Juxtapositions abound, while notes collide and converse to express the multiplicity of male identity.

A dose of elegance: pink pepper and citrus zest affirm his presence. A much sought-after harmony: Guaiac wood and smoky cedarwood emphasise his uniqueness. An intimate wake: Cashmere wood and ambergris turn him into the perfect dandy. A stylised perfume for chic, self-confident masculinity.

Imagine freshly bathed skin, doused with a coating of premium Euro-sunscreen, then warmed up by a midday siesta on the beach, the sensual stirrings of a body in heat. That's the premise behind Fire Island.

Celebrating one of nature's most dramatic yet delicate displays, Sakura Cherry Blossom is a scent inspired by those few precious days when the profusion of blooms paints pastel pink clouds onto spring's bright blue skies.
This Narciss Blanc is an equivocal and captivating signature fragrance that is endlessly fascinating.
Gucci Bloom Ambrosia di Fiori invites those who wear it to celebrate their true selves and the emotions they feel.
There was a time when the golden youth went to Izmir as readily as they went to St. Tropez. Izmir embodied Turkey in all its opulence and freedom, without any taboos.
Like stepping into a film, she is transported to a secret garden. Velvety white petals cascade over cool, reflecting pools. She is a heroine and her story has just begun.

The zoologist Cockatiel exudes joy. A sunny burst of yellow mimosa offers a friendly welcome. Dots of juicy red fruit suggest a touch of mischief, like a pair of rosy cheeks beneath a golden plume. Finally, soft notes of gourmand chords envelop the vibrant Cockatiel, like fluffy feathers cushioning the cheekiness of this cheeky bird.
Discover the luxury of Night for the confident Majestic gentleman.
Overcoming obstacles, overcoming challenges, achieving your goals through energy, and movements. Avon Homem Energy, the cologne for moments of dynamism and strength.
This elegant eau de toilette evokes the sweetness of a spring day, and the purity of clean laundry drying in the sun under an infinite azure sky.
Yin is a hearty concoction that will keep you fresh all day.
L'ivrée Bleue is narcotic scent that evokes the exoticism of Gauguin and the jungle themes of Rousseau. A stormy sensualite.

Cubacao is a fragrance that interlaces feminine and masculine aromas. Dark chocolate and white flowers awake a sensual bitterness, a desire hidden in our olfactory memories. From the very first moments, the elegance of infused floral notes blends with the dark gourmand accents that play with virility and sensuality, awakening a desire buried in our olfactory memory. It is a journey of intense sensory escape.

A mysterious name for an intoxicating, almost magical and surely fascinating product.
To celebrate Habanita's 100th anniversary, Molinard pays homage to the voluptuous, sensual, and bewitching character of its legendary fragrance by wrapping its magnificent bottle in a red dress!
A fragrance of power and charisma that highlights the powerful yet poise man within you.

Fiery and mysterious.
A striking scent for the adventurous man with a positive attitude.

Eternal, romantic, and forever.
An optimistic fragrance with a sparkling and exhilarating freshness. A symbol of prosperity.

Created by Christine Nagel for the Hermès girls, Tutti Twilly d'Hermès eau de parfum is a tribute to their free spirit: a blend of daring and lightheartedness, and their multifaceted nature.
Moroccan Green is an irresistible fragrance with a unique scent to accompany you all day long.

Personifying a bold, passionate, loveable woman, totally comfortable leading her own life… Someone who excels as if she were in love. The love story continues in a new adventure,deep and mysterious, passionate and warm, the expression of love in its greatest form.

The illusionist, dressed in a luxurious outfit. It's the Paris of flamboyant shows. From the Opera to the fairground Arts. Love at first sight appears suddenly from the darkness.

Sensual and delicate yet strong, Rose Poudre will envelop you in a seductive, powdery-vanilla aroma.

Clive Christian's magnum opus. A masterful blend of rare and precious ingredients sourced from all over the world incapsulates the essence of refined perfumery. Truly worth of the name No1.

"This full and deep green possesses an esoteric power and a sublime creative light that I interpreted with vegetal incense. Entice your senses with bursts of tantalising citrus and tropical fruits. Evolving into a deliciously complex gourmand heart, it finally envelopes the wearer in a compellingly sultry cloak of rich essences.
