Designed as an ode to everlasting love, Mona and Hassan created The Wedding Collection to wear on their special day. Aptly named after the silk gown Mona wore and the velvet suit Hassan wore on their wedding day, The Wedding Silk Santal | 36 and The Wedding Velvet Santal | 35 were inspired by and are bound by the strength of creamy sandalwood. Timeless when worn alone yet amplified when layered together, these juices are made to be shared and celebrate love in all its forms.
Armateur White Limited Edition. A captivating and irresistible fragrance with great power of seduction.
Set to take its place in the pantheon of great perfumes, Sovereign bewitches and beguiles with the voluptuous scent of ultra-precious Rose de Mai, the fabled hundred-petalled rose.
Enjoy a carefree moment full of delicate and colourful feelings. The Nikos woman is like a nymph with a strong connection to nature. Sculpture Delicate Fleur is a celebration of individuality.

Pure well-being starts with the awakening of the senses, everyday moments of luxury to find softness, balance and beauty. Softly Jil Sander is a sensory invitation to experience a spa ritual at home, to bring out the inner-peace and inner-beauty each and every day.

A charming and delicate rose bush, evoking the suppleness and momentum of a corps de ballet, Ballerina responds to perfect choreography, full of natural grace. Each bouquet of these small, tight, and ordered blooms seem to leap and slide on an imaginary stage, like light and slender dancers.
Haiku Reflection takes you on a journey of inner peace and balance. The simple elegance of this fragrance makes it perfect for everyday wear.

Imagine the desert. Imagine its immensity, its softness and its hardness. The desert, metaphor of loneliness is however populated. Populated with secrets, which define the enigmatic being that it is, and not the simple space exposed to the eye. The language of the desert is wild, pure and intact. Listen to it, feel it, it defies, advances, steals away, and leaves us stunned, bewitched, on the verge of an unintelligible happiness.
Some may call you a rebel, a bad boy, a troublemaker. You don’t care. You thrive when all eyes are on you. Your mantra is: ‘I live by My Rules.’

Kedu is a magic formula that takes us to a unique territory and spiritual heritage. Every year in May, the celebration of Buddha's birthday provides the opportunity for a pilgrimage. Monks gather in Borobudur, in a ritual in which sesame is given pride of place, with flowers and incense. The seeds thrown into the fire have a purifying power, freeing man from the yoke of his passions.
Craze Noir combines bold ingredients to create an intoxicating scent that many will fall in love with.
Passion-inducing and masculine to the core, this enticing scent has a blend of aphrodisiacs so complex that it is never to be revealed, but always effective.
Happiness. Not euphoria, but true happiness that takes shape in moments of simplicity, when you feel safe and loved. Gentleness and peaceful contentment.

"I still remember the gardens of Taj Mahal, built for the Mughal Emperor's wife. During spring, the servants used to spread petals of purple hibiscus flowers in the aisles. They released a sensual and fruity scent, as a testimony of eternal love." Jean-Claude Ellena, Olfactive Director

A dazzling performance of harmonies. Fresh top notes of citrus lead off a symphony for the senses that mellows as the fruity softness combines with luscious Mediterranean melons. The central rhythm is built around delicate transparent flowers. The tempo of the final movement is sweetly lyrical, musks softened by elegant woody notes.

At the crossroad between Robin Hood and Robinson Crusoe, Ivanhoe represents the archetype of a solitary hero. A solitary free spirit with natural charisma. Cyrus men are invited to embark upon a journey of inner discovery steeped in strength and poetry. An exceptional perfume with modern elegance.

name_perfume: L'Eau Par Kenzo Intense Pour Homme
description: Kenzo adds a sensual and magnetic touch, to its purity and freshness, and weaves an invisible bond between a duo of vibrant and dynamic water which enlivens the very substance of the bottle. Two pure and sensual blocks of living water with gentle curves that fit each other to perfection.
A fragrance full of sensuality and magic.

fragrances: Floral Fresher Lily of the Valley
description: This Le Muguet de Rosine is a replica of a garden filled with Lily of the Valley within the gardens of Martimont. It hides at the foot of the walls, between rose bushes and behind rhododendrons. A completely natural, yet incredibly refined perfume.
Voyage à Cannes is a glamorous fragrance that evokes an unforgettable evening stroll along the Boulevard de la Croisette.

Suivez-Moi is a gently mischievous composition that plays on the complicity between fresh citrus, with a delicate heart of Mediterranean florals and gourmand notes. A breath of irresistible seduction.
A sensual, confident scent for the rebellious spirits.
So' Repetto is a sparkling, colourful, and playful scent that will make you want to dance irresistibly.
A puie and sophisticated scent full of contemporary elegance.
A delicate perfume with precious accords to warm up the senses, Via Cavour 1 is named after the street where Xerjoff's Turin store is located.

Faux Semblant is elusive. It oscillates constantly between dusk and dawn, between the gloom of a corridor and the sumptuously lit halls of the Hôtel Particulier. He slips, dodges, hides. He constantly plays with appearances. Its complex personality is expressed in a fragrance created in chiaroscuro where orange blossom, wrapped in woody essences, reveals surprising facets. This is how we discover that this supposedly innocent flower keeps its cards close to its chest.
Sparkling, romantic and enticing; a scent created for the woman with attitude!

19 years after Sunflowers, a fresh scent of summer in a bottle is created. Sunflowers Dream Petals is composed of fresh and luminous top notes. The refreshing opening continues with a floral heart while a base features smooth and sweet wood and musk notes.

Islay Eau de Parfum is a marriage between Floris, the British perfume house, and Kilchoman, Islay's first new distillery in over a century. The scent pays homage to the flora of the romantic and isolated Islay and to the wonderful whisky that the Kilchoman family have lovingly produced on the island since 2005.

Icon is an audacious, stylish scent that embodies the perfect union of strength and sensitivity. Ingredients gathered from the travels of the Dunhill man, a worldly sophisticated traveller, the smell exotic and distinctive. Icon combines the ultimate blend of rare and expensive ingredients.
This perfume is a taste of the future on the lips of the other. At the fifth aurora borealis, we fall tenderly into a space-time rift where we are lulled to sleep until the night of time.

name_perfume: Love : Don'T Be Shy Eau Fraîche 2019
description: "Love is life's narcotic its folly and its freshness. It is something we return to, in spite of ourselves, like any proper addiction," says Kilian Hennessy.
A smooth, charismatic invitation to get closer.
I Am King makes the ultimate statement for today's ambitious go-getter: Here I am, in all my glory. Smell the power. Feel the success.
To meet again. At last. Alone together, no one else, just the two of us. And this perfume that seems to purr “I am kindred-spirit”.

Rose has always played a prominent role in the rich perfume culture of the Middle East. Egyptian Smoke takes us on an immersive journey to this region with a surprising interpretation of a long-revered floral note.

name_perfume: Dries Van Noten Par Frédéric Malle
description: An enveloping warmth. First and foremost a creative response to designer Dries Van Noten's Flemish roots. Belgium's stark winter call for domestic warmth, while its history, as one of the great stages for the trade of precious raw materials, calls for a rich amalgam of textures and motifs.

The thought of foreign countries and strange cultures sparks the desire for voyages of discovery. A feeling of freedom and vitality takes hold of your senses and spurs you on. Victorinox Ella captures these sentiments and lets them blossom in the form of a seductive mantle of fragrance. The Victorinox Ella woman has a positive attitude, is upbeat, open, and joyously eager to discover things.

Armani Code Eau de Parfum conveys a mood of elegant seduction. Inspired by the man who attracts with innate magnetism, who seduces without provocation, and who marries authenticity with an ease of being.
Freesia & Pear is an irresistible fragrance with a unique scent to accompany you all day long.

Expected the unexpected as this is not your typical sandalwood. Exotic intensity abounds from the outset with spicy exotic top notes. In the base, the creamy depth of santalum album, the most prised and valuable variety of sandalwood from India and Sri Lanka, anchors this most exotic of fragrances with a warm and welcoming embrace.

The word "Posì" means potion and/or poison in ancient Greek. The ancients used the word not only for a magic potion, but also to describe the strength of the potion itself because Posì was the most potent of all potions, which could fell a man with no hope of escape.
Thistle & Black Pepper is a conspicuously masculine fragrance that will give you a feeling of self-confidence.

“Encens Chembur was named after the place where my mother grew up in India. Chembur was once a famous picnic area on the outskirts of Mumbai. Today it is overbuilt and not at all the same place. Despite that, there was a familiar smell in the streets: the scents of incense from the Hindu temples nearby. This became the heart of perfume.” - Ben Gorham, Perfumer
A fresh, multifaceted and sensual fragrance. Me, Myself and You is the perfect sent for a sexy and dynamic woman who starts energetic in the evening.

"It's been a long time since I wanted to work on this olfactory duo. Tangerine is an extraordinary fruit for a perfumer, very faceted, both fruity with this delicate bitterness that we like in a citrus and very tangy. The mate is amazing; it offers shades much greener and herbaceous than tea. Between them, they offer this very lively and zesty freshness which leaves on the skin the delicious perfume of a tangerine that has just been peeled." - Alberto Morillas, Perfumer
"Crazy Hot is as sweet and sparkling as the most undeniable attraction," Perfumer Calice Becker created this composition with the aim of embodying the chemistry and attraction between two lovers.

Villain is a heady concoction of madness mixed with a hint of wicked along with several bursts of outrageousness and a tingling spiciness of twisted humour bottled up In intriguing grandeur. This fragrance is the quintessential embodiment of evil that’ll lure every eye that meets It.
Blue Dandy, has an arousing freshness embodied by a duo of citrus and succulent Mediterranean fruits for a seductive signature.

Crafted with the perfume connoisseur in mind, irrespective of age or gender, Opus VIII comprises of the finest ingredients sourced from around the world to create a fragrance that is an evocative exploration of the subconscious dialogue between illusion and reality.

The iris flower, whose name means rainbow in Latin, has a wide array of colours. Its luxurious femininity inspired Maître Parfumeur et Gantier. The iris flower is a symbol of sophistication. In Fleur d'Iris, it is associated with rose and jasmine flowers, the sweet violet and the rich-smelling amber and vetiver.
L'Occitane's Cédrat, a fragrance that opens with sparkling notes in the head, followed by a heart of refreshing herbs and a drydown that any elegant man will appreciate.
When you're about to play the game of charm, you leave nothing to chance! Take control with Magnetista, a modern and irresistible fragrance
Stellar Edition. Our best seller Beautiful Magnolia reminds us to reach for the stars with this celestial limited-edition bottle. Crescent moon and sparkling star charms are not removable.
Rise up, lead from the heart and find your inspiration to achieve your dreams.
Intimate sensuality in an extraordinarily persistent fragrance.

"I think it's similar to what I do in fashion, to get men to break out of their chains of being conservative, and not be afraid to be sexy and smell good. You can still be macho, still be a man and take care of yourself," Sean Combs.

name_perfume: Miss Dior Original Extrait De Parfum
description: "With Miss Dior, I wanted to create a perfume scented with love," Christian Dior. Miss Dior Extrait de Parfum Original intensely deploys this bold trail, which has become a great classic.
An uplifting fragrance that features a blend of crisp citrus notes with a hint of sweetness.
For Beat Café, the perfumer has played with notes as spicy and as warm as Bob Dylan's music. In tribute to the cafés frequented by the Beat Generation.
Poseidon Classic is the essence that symbolises masculine confidence wrapped in an aura of magnetism capable of intoxicating all the senses.

Embrace a moment of true passion. Experience Love Affair. Love is the greatest quest in one's life: Sometimes it is the feeling of unchanging tenderness, sometimes wild sexual passion… Love can take various forms.
Terryfic Oud Extrême surges in an outward flow and rises to climactic heights of excellence. Even more luring, provocative, and voluptuous than the original fragrance.
The mystery of its aura is deepened by nutmeg, cedar and Brazilian rosewood. This life-giving scent definitely leads us into temptation, an invitation to partake of forbidden fruit.
Lady is a sensual, daring and chic fragrance. Fruity notes open this gorgeous scent, that leads into a sensual base leaving a chic veil on the skin.

An irresistible portrait of Mexican passion. In order to become one and externalize an impossible love, two lovers leave human form and become trees and flowers. This is how the pre-Hispanic Totonac people narrate the birth of vanilla. Originally a Mexican Orchid considered the luxury of the Tlatoanis, it perfumed the palaces and sweetened the whole banquet.

Truth Calvin Klein Men is a scent drawn from nature. This aromatic, sensual, woody fragrance is centered around a clean, watery, green freshness that is accented by aromatic basil and fresh cardamom. Sexy. Masculine.
A majestic scent that pays tribute to the beauty and alluring warm aura of the Italian woman.

Wanna smell like an old Stradivarius or a posh French table? Didn’t think so. Rosewood is the known go to for fine furniture and violin makers for centuries. But it has a sexy secret side: its amazing aroma. By distilling its oil we get a sweet, delicate woody scent. Lovingly mix that with light greens and it takes on a whole new degree of intoxicating ethereal sophistication.
For the woman connected to the world, to nature. A wild woman, earth mother, wise. Her essence is calm and she feels with her sin and her soul.

Angels' Share is a co-creation between founder Kilian Hennessy and American rap artist, French Montana. Music drives all good nightlife, just like perfume. Invisible vibes that uplift a party. And so does an incredible cognac-inspired scent. Angels’ Share x French Montana is the expression of this affinity between hip-hop culture and cognac.

Comforting and sumptuous, First Snow is a fragrance of natural beauty. Inspired by the stillness of the first snowflakes, it’s tranquil yet full of promise. Redolent of a Swiss snowscape in the evening light, it transports you to a peaceful winter scene, where you can relax inside with a warm cup of tea, while outside delicate snowflakes hug the branches.
Unexpected, bold and mysterious, Pasha Noir Absolu is a charismatic fragrance for a successful man.

For men who want to live their life on their own terms. They are true originals, believing that rules are made to be challenged and personal potential should be explored to the max. Hugo is just a fragrance. The rest is up to you.
Get those summer vibes all year round with Colour Me Sky Blue. A truly uplifting perfume for women.
Don’t lose your tempo even at the end of a busy day! Tres Nuit pour Homme is a colourful combination of ingredients that never gets boring and always helps you find the right rhythm.
A fragrance inspired by Georges Bizet's opera Carmen, about a passionate and seductive woman.

name_perfume: Eau De Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc Eau Fraîche Pour Lui
description: Feel the energy of Lacoste with L.12.12 Blanc Eau Fraîche. An explosion of vitality, providing an exhilarating comfort.
Damah embodies the extravagance of a period when oriental precious metalwork was highly prized. The perfume within is elegant and floral with musky undertones that delivers a delicate power.

Encapsulate the power of femininity with the luxurious scents of Lipsy Noir. A sensual and fresh combination of succulent citruses, leading into a lush floral heart and ending with intense accords to exude pure luxury.

Ivoire is the name I give to a dream. The name of a woman of sovereign beauty draped in ultra-pale silk. We crossed paths for a moment on the staircase at the Opera, before she disappeared into the night," Pierre Balmain.
A bold and sulphurous fragrance that will transport you on a fragrant journey to sensual places.
Eau It's Fresh, represents the sunny days of Spring. A woman enjoying a shining sunny day, surrounded by fresh, colourful flowers.

Don’t let anything stop you and get a proper energy boost in any situation. CR Tweed will bring you an instant dose of new vigour on a sensory level and give you enough energy to handle everything with confidence and ease.
Crafted for the taste that reflects the region, Qafiya 01, is a unisex fragrance aimed for use during the day. An inviting scent, it is designed to illuminate and bring forth your desire to succeed.

They may not remember what you said or did, but they will remember how you made them feel. Let Arte Bellissimo Exotic and its rich, seductive accords express your intense passion and veiled charisma to intrepid admirers.
Excentrique Moi is truly remarkable and unique, just like moi.

A scent inspired by the Cangcang Bamboo Forest Temple. The bells are ringing late. The spring rain is steady, the bamboo forest is full of vitality, Similar to the clear ink technique of traditional Chinese painting, it has a sense of cleanness and clarity.

A more fragrant formula and enhanced plant extract transforms Kenzo's Beneficial Waters collection into Perfumed Beneficial Waters: Fizz. The scent is captured in this moisturizing mist. Its main ingredient, plant water, is rich in nutritive elements that are readily absorbed by the skin.
An explosive fragrance for an unexpected and harmonious result. So why not a cologne ?

Eclat Toujours is a scent for men that takes you away to an irresistible world of romance. Intimate moments of shared love found in elegant accords. Scents that are as alluring as they are sensual. This is romance as you always dreamed it, like your love whispers to you.
Demeter captures the Christmas spirit and evokes memories of Christmases past, any time of year. Delight family and friends with this comforting and refreshing scent.

Mayrit takes us to the Arabic days of Madrid. A heroic and strategic fortress that was tirelessly defended by its robust walls against the enemy. An opulent fragrance which represents the tenacious, perservering and enigmatic city.

Created in 1902, it was a revolutionary scent, its sophisticated sharpness cutting through the world of opulent orientals and weak colognes of the era. Created exclusively for the Dukes of Marlborough at Blenheim Palace Oxfordshire, the birthplace of Sir Winston Churchill, and the upstanding gentleman that is Blenheim Bouquet.
A sweet and bold paradox of citrus and flowers, making this fragrance particularly mysterious and sensual.
Dinamico is inspired by the millennial man’s energetic nature, charismatic and exhilarating personality to take on any adventure in life. A scent with an energising and captivating freshness.

212 VIP WINS evokes the strength and nonconformity of a new generation that doesn’t give up easily. It's the celebration of sportsmanship, strength, friendship, triumph, and the determination of youth.

“I have always been inspired by the world around me, the places I've been to, the places I dream of. New York is a symbol of glamour and excitement. It is where I live and where I am inspired to create some of my most sophisticated collections,” Ralph Lauren.
Dive into a sparkling ocean with a delightful blend of sea salt florals and a tangle of mint.
A refreshing and sweet scent with a lush, earthy trail.
For the exotic scent of pink lotus petals enveloped in golden amber, master perfumers have blended lotus and amber with succulent plum and creamy sandalwood.

My childhood experiences have left deep impressions. My hometown Lerici on the Italian Riviera does not have the name “the pearl in the Gulf of Poets” for no reason. As a child, I could open my window and look out onto the sea and the beach. The air I breathed has always stayed in my memory. Sea Moods reveals and represents this memory.

Tommy captures the diversity of America and Tommy Hilfiger's own widespread following. So put on your backpack and your walking shoes and take a trip across the country with us as we explore sensations and scents that are so very much a part of the American landscape.
This structured oriental fragrance begins with a citrus accord, followed by a floral heart, while the base evokes the richness of the Orient.

The aromatic youth and masculinity of basil are combined with citrus and fruity notes that are enhanced by a spicy heart of nutmeg and cardamom, full of character and strength. The oriental chord of Tonka and guaiac wood enhances the most enigmatic aspect of the perfume.

Radiate brilliance with this sophisticated floral, fruity fragrance with solar flower notes. Warm, complex and with just a little kick of spices as a nod to your daring side. Let your brilliance shine through.

A brisk citrus note washes over you like a draft of glacial air. A deep breath fills your lungs with a fierce and smoky scent. Yet this is roads’ end, where the sun is always high, and rays of powerful notes spear through your leathery cloak of doubts, to kindle a mist of previous accords, shimmering like a swarm of fireflies.
Our Springfield girl lives all in GREEN.
A true classic created for the woman of contemporary tastes, the light, fresh scent is distinctively feminine.

Jaisalmer is Hinduism, named after the ancient city of Jaisalmer, situated in the desert, in the north-west part of India, in Rajasthan. Jaisalmer means "Golden City", where traders transported ebony to Egypt, a note found in this perfume.

The only perfume that mixes the warmth of the Mediterranean Garden, the remote nature of the lakes of the Himalaya, and the sumptuousness and abundance of the Topkapi Palace in Istanbul. All embraced in pure gold and distilled into a wonderful essence that will make us feel exquisite contrasts.
Inspired by unforgettable nights that will be a part of your memory.
A lively fragrance that captures the vibrant spirit of London.
Designed to captivate the senses, Vanilla perfume | 28 is a masterpiece in nuance and refinement.
RV Pure Woman is a fragrance inspired by the power of attraction of a strong woman. Energetic, vital, and strong femininity that is coherent with the important values of being a woman.
Wave 2 for Him is an energetic summer fragrance, created for adventurous and bright young men.

Knowledge is about freedom and empowerment. This library is not dictated to by being categorised or labeled as ‘private' or ‘exclusive'. It is about the pure beauty of truth and knowledge – simply modern classics.
Juicy fruits fuse with alluring black petals and spicy woods to form a scent that's mouth-wateringly attractive.

"Soul is freedom and elegance and I choose pure amber as the top ingredient, which for me is the only essence that combines the two elements. Its natural colour reflects the beauty and oneness of warmth and emotion. It's the Essence and Soul of Costume National," Ennio Capasa.
A fragrance under a shower of gold. A very couture accent blending elegance and modernity. An entire scent composed around tuberose, a rare and precious flower, both voluptuous and unforgettable.
Inspired by the sweet taste of rose water in lokum, the Turkish dessert, Rosefire Eau de Parfum combines rose with the source accord for a floral Oriental fragrance.

For some, it’s the soothing smell of the candies that their grandmother used to give them when they were children. For others, it’s a sweet, gentle flower. For Camille Goutal, it’s also the name of her grandfather’s home in Aveyron and the smell of his candy shop. A childhood memory that, enhanced with a touch of rose, reveals an elegant, delicious violet.

Gray is a definite compliment to your stride of confidence and intellect. The long-lasting, classic Gray, is perfect for the buttoned-up shirt or chic semi-formal. Whatever you desire, dapper is the way to go.

A sophisticated perfume for a woman who is not afraid to mark her presence wherever she goes, safely and confidently. "You can go as far as your mind lets you go. What you believe, you can accomplish! " - Mary Kay Ash
A floral blend. Almost unisex. This fragrance has been a winner for many years. Good things don't need to change.
A lavish perfume that expresses passion and is given flight by notes of feminine power and purity. Gia honors the art and power of individual creativity.

name_perfume: Eau De Lacoste L.12.12 Rose Eau Fraîche Pour Elle
description: Feel the energy of Lacoste with the Eau de Toilette L.12.12 Rose Eau Fraîche. Reinvent the rules of the game, feel free to move with assurance thanks to the unexpected lightness of this unique scent. An explosion of vitality, providing an exhilarating comfort.
Era, the essence of passion, provocation and power.
701Eucalyptus Ambre Bois Blanc evokes the joy and tranquillity of a relaxing Sunday walk.

Whoever wears this sensual and powerful fragrance must be prepared to please, but, above all, to please themselves. It magnifies the personality, which doesn't whisper but shouts its enthusiasm for life, for joy, to give joy, to be admired and to admire oneself.
Aerial and luminous, Spiritual oscillates between warmth, power and transparency. Draped in a floral freshness, this eau de parfum delicately blossoms on a light note of vanilla.

Yesterday's fragrance. Today's legend. Composed in 1912, Fol Arôme perfectly reflects the exuberant Paris of the Belle Époque. One century on, Guerlain invites you to take a delicious and unforgettable plunge into a flamboyant bygone era with Fol Arôme.
Rare Flowers Solar Narcissus brings out a brilliant light and solar comfort, evoking the feeling of walking through a sparkling garden with rays of sun shining down and radiating on your skin.

The sophisticated Adidas Intense Touch fragrance reflects the intense touch of the extraordinary. It's made for everyday athletes who are inspired to follow in the footsteps of their heroes, to leave their own mark and achieve the impossible.

"In Les Infusions de Prada, there is a rare luxury you don't often find nowadays. At first they appear to be very simple, as if you were tattooing water with an ingredient, but in reality, it is a very complex formula. In a similar way, that water must be at a particular temperature to create the perfect tea, the base composition allows the beauty of a flower, wood or fruit to be revealed in a bright and sensitive way," Daniela Andrier, Perfumer.
Asad is a warm, spicy fragrance with a sweet trail.
Pomegranate by the Demeter Fragrance Library had to be great, and this one is, capturing all the freshness and deep, sweet, citrus flavor of this exotic fruit.

The same timeless Fierce perfume, but in a special edition bottle and packaging for Valentine's Day. Effortlessly sensual and sophisticated, Fierce is an undeniable feminine take on our signature scent. Striking the balance of classic and contemporary, this perfume captures the essence of desire.
The 1881 fragrance is a unique blend of leather, patchouli and moss that captures and represents the current generation of modern gentlemen and marks a significant year in the Nobleman family tree.
Inspired by mesmerising waterfalls that descend into turquoise waters creating a sweet dewy mist.
A perfume for xtrem men.
Oud blends bright fresh citrus with rich agarwood. A subtle harmony full of contrasts for a unique fragrance.
A refined, contemporary scent for self-assured men who command respect, inspired by David Beckham, the archetypal 21st century gentleman.
A sensual blend of creaminess, femininity, wrapped in luxurious velvety notes.
Cuba Gold is a timeless classic which is a tribute to masculine elegance and charisma.
A new day provides new opportunities to tackle more challenges. Varens City New York will refresh your mind so that you can boldly follow your instincts. Embrace your everyday adventures!
Velvet Fire is a charismatic scent that awakens and ignites. Its sensual combination of woody notes ignites and enlightens the wearer, like the caress of the sun.
Pretty Machine is like breathing fresh spring air. The air is fresh and the trees are freshly flowering. It's like sitting under a lime tree, freshly flowering in the middle of spring.

name_perfume: Essence Of United Colors Of Woman
description: Playful, colourful, modern, and timeless. The essence of Benetton encapsulated in a fragrance is totally Benetton.

Eau d'Ipanema is a perfume with a Latin American soul, shifting easily between tropical fruits and sultry floral notes. There is a sunny, carefree cast to the fragrance – gently spiced fruit and flowers to make you smile, coming to rest in a late afternoon Ipanema beach glow.
A revitalising fragrance with an intense and sensual trail.

A tribute to the supreme femininity of the golden goddess. Rose Goldea evokes the seductiveness, fascination and impassioned loves of Cleopatra. The Serpent, a symbol of eternity and life, is powerful and captivating. They shared the same divine aura, the same great desire for power.

"For Commodity Velvet, I was inspired by the image of vibrant pink Turkish rose petals floating gently on a mysterious, dark background of richly warm vanilla and black amber with a delicious hint of toasted almond floating in the air. For Velvet Personal, I used the delicacy of Turkish rose petals mixed with the freshness of coconut water and rich vanilla. I finished with warm white woods and eliminated the black amber to create a softer fragrance," Jerome Epinette, perfumer.

Fresh and cool, Royal Water is an invigorating celebration of personal spirit. Regal, refined, yet refreshingly approachable, just like the beloved Princess who sparked its creation. A universal scent.
Among millions of creatures, the most radiant is the one whose appearance is uncontaminated like the Yanomami tribe… it is also the greatest green space on Earth which deserves such an inspiration.

Signorina Eau de Toilette the celebration of a chic girl's most joyful facet. The ideal fragrance for a romantic young woman who expresses her graceful sensuality through a natural elegance. An exceptionally fresh scent signature with the vivaciously cheeky soul of Signorina. Because a Signorina is a different Signorina every day.
A powerful but surprisingly refreshing scent that will envelop you with its enchanting accords.

Eau Fraîche Délicate was born from a desire to express the personality of a free-spirited and magnetic woman. José and Edmond Eisenberg drew inspiration from the lush gardens of the Mediterranean coast and the vibrant energy of its inhabitants. The result is an airy, floral, and fruity perfume that embodies the impetuous nature of a proud and free woman, fully embracing her life.
Chairman illustrates success both in a man’s professional and private lives. It celebrates men who have a natural aura and make their way in life with confidence.
An elegant blend of soft powdery notes, delicate florals and gentle musks create this refined and ethereal fragrance.
A juicy, sensual fragrance for the elegant woman.
Club 6 Class is for those who have style and an engaging personality. With its modern and determined attitude, Club 6 Class allows you to live new experiences of luxury and power.
U.R. Sweet, the essence of attraction.

No matter how far apart we are, we stay connected and leave a lasting memory. Because fragrances are emotional memories. This is especially true for LOV|U Connected, which is simply unforgettable and seems like a surprise message from a loved one!

With great flourish and a fanfare of flutes, drums and trumpets, Emperor Severus served caviar to the most revered guests in garlands of roses. This fragrance is a celebration of opulence. Complex, harmonious and surprising.
L'Amour Rose Saint-Tropez is an ode to love and magic, celebrating the essence of the dreamy paradise for which it was named.
A fragrance that balances freshness and warmth, perfect for men who are not afraid to take risks and are confident in their seduction potential - the powerful weapon of conquest!
Lively and vibrant, this fragrance insists that life is for adventure. Get out, live, and laugh taking every opportunity for fun.
Cedro di Diamante pays tribute to the citrus essence by capturing the warmth of the sun rays, while accentuating the natural characteristics of the citrus with hints of cedar.

A captivating fragrance created from the thrilling fusion of a deliciously fruity scent, an exclusive Mugler rose, and powerful, modern wood. The dazzling combination of pleasure and self-affirmation.
The very quintessence of musc, Pure Musc is the purest, most essential version of the For Her signature.

He is regal, impossible, impenetrable, and extremely intelligent. Bewitched by a dark desire, he fulfills my penchant for discovery and my love of the unexpected. He favours grand statements, always with an air of style and adventure.

name_perfume: Hermann À Mes Cotés Me Paraissait Une Ombre
description: We all have shadows, even at night, in the dark forest. You may call yours by another name, your invisible friend, your conscience, your soul, maybe even your complementary ego. Your shadow could have a name, like Hermann. Or your shadow could be your perfume. This is your companion. You can argue with your companion, you can challenge your companion, you can test the boundaries of your own attitudes. Maybe you'll get a response. Maybe not. But at least you'll have an interesting conversation.

A fruity aroma in the top notes permeates through the air, then deepens and softens with the emergence of floral and leathery notes for a precious scent. The addition of precious oud further intensifies the rich fruity notes.

A fragrance as light and soft as a velvety breath.

But beware of its delicate appearance: it is said to be dangerous! Its intoxicating scent gives an aura of magic, leaving a mysterious trail behind the ‘beautiful woman’ who will wear it,” Lucas Sieuzac, Perfumer.

The waves of the sea smash the shore, creating new shapes and colours from a thousand shells on the shimmering sand in the morning sun. On the deserted beach, they drift carelessly and free.

Sea Foam, a true splash into the ocean.

Be swept away by the freshness of the unique combination of Cypress, with its aromatic woody notes, in contrast with the invigorating bitterness of the Grapefruit essence.

Dare to embark on an Oudyssee. Write your legend.

A sensual blend of precious and rare compositions enveloping the wearer in an aura of beautiful mystique.

description: Kilian Paris revisits one of its most popular and iconic perfumes: Love, Don’t Be Shy, to draw a new dimension of its complex perfume personality towards the richness of Oud.

Stallion Leather is a love letter to nature, beauty and strength, based on floral, spicy and leather notes that evoke memories of Balaclava, a fabulous racehorse that Carolina Herrera rode daily as a teenager and has since considered her lucky talisman. Bottled in an evocative sculpture with hints of honey, this eau de parfum is a symbol and an ode to success. Stallion Leather, like all Herrera Confidential fragrances, was born of Carolina Herrera's own family history. The bold blend of warmth and sweetness, of floral and leather notes, is a tribute that Carolina A. Herrera, Creative Director of Beauty, pays homage to her mother's bold personality. "The inspiration for this fragrance comes from Balaclava, a racehorse my mother owned as a teenager in Caracas. It was her father's birthday present to her on her fifteenth birthday, and she considered the horse her most precious jewel". The beauty, strength and agility of Balaclava, as well as the nostalgia of youth and the winning spirit of the horse, are the key concepts of Stallion Leather, a fragrance that belongs to Herrera Confidential's Gems collection. Here, the gem is a symbol not only of Balaclava, but of Carolina Herrera's fascination with Arabian horses in general, a world that has influenced the Herrera aesthetic since its inception. Carolina A. Herrera has designed Stallion Leather with perfumer Jordi Fernández (Givaudan). Together they have created a luxurious ambery and leathery floral eau de parfum, a perfect balance of strength and sensuality that fits with Carolina Herrera's iconic fashion collections.

Inspired by the pink-orange skies of Tahiti sunsets, L'amante Intensity is cheerfully vibrant, fresh and lively, for bold and passionate women.

Bond Street continues to be the preferred destination from major celebrities and has become a must for anyone visiting London. It is unrivaled in its combination between history and elegance. Hugh Parsons dedicates the new fragrance to this street, which is among the most important and elegant in the world.
It is a real olfactory journey in which mystery, sensuality, sweetness and seduction gets involved. This subtle blend is a real ode to sensuality.

On the warm sand of a Corsican beach fringed by a eucalyptus forest, dozens of pieces of driftwood are washed up by the waves. Shaped by the elements, infused with sunshine and sea water, they inspired the Guerlain Perfumers to craft a woody vanilla fragrance with an intensely addictive sillage.

AURUM is a bright fragrance that describes the first rays of the sun, the light at dawn, and those precious minutes of quietness. The waves make peace with the clear morning light and sway in a steady rhythm, drawing lines on the surface of the sea.
As fragrant as the morning dew.
A joyful combination of citrus and juicy tropical fruits, shine on a heart sensual flowers, while spirited woody notes provide a smooth, veiled sillage.

For Diptyque, only chypre, the legendary accord with a thousand facets, could pay worthy tribute to Paris, the city of a thousand faces. An Eiffel Tower, roses, flowing calligraphy, a peacock with its tail fanned, volutes, lines intertwined. To illustrate Eau Capitale, Diptyque drew inspiration from Parisian architecture and iconic Art Nouveau buildings.

For "I Don't Need A Prince By My Side To Be A Princess", I wanted to amp-up the girl power with a unique scent calling out all fierce females. Prince Charming, take note, this Princess ain't waiting at home for your comeback call!
A warming scent to envelope your senses.
Created especially for the woman who celebrates elegance and distinction. For that woman who likes to always look distinguished. Your style is your hallmark.

Mademoiselle Jacadi Petite Cerise is like a sunny afternoon under the cherry trees. This gorgeous creation, with delicate and addictive notes, is suitable for children's skin, but will also appeal to adults.

Dedicated to an era in Miami when champagne baths were on the charts and the TV show Miami Vice was all the rage.
Delight in the sensuous tranquility of walking among plum trees under a moonlit sky. In one exhilarating moment, an irresistible breeze takes you sky high, breathlessly floating among swirling stars.
Take your senses on an addictive journey with this breathtaking distinctive scent!
Opium. The legendary fragrance for the women who adore Yves Saint Laurent. A luxury fragrance, a sheer sensuality for a voluptuous, provocative and bewitching scent.
Fresh, sparkling, always in motion, Ocean di Gioia is a tribute to the lively, powerful force of nature that is the ocean.

The greatest ability of the human soul is the ability to feel. Without it, a person cannot exist. Life loses meaning and becomes empty and faded. Feelings by Ramon Molvizar talks about a father's love for his daughter, the joy of a chance meeting, a warm smile, friendship, and sincerity.

Like Botticelli with her Venus, Rose Musk conveys the elusive beauty of the rose and its elegant sensuality, made more human by musk's animalised sensuality. The queen of perfumery emerges from the sea and is pushed towards the earth by the divineness of the winds. And we almost feel its scent reach us and enchant us.
All the charm and romanticism of an imaginative bouquet of English blossoms, composed with boldness and just a touch of eccentricity.
Club De Nuit Untold is a happy fragrance, full of energy.
Santorini is a unique fragrance that expresses confidence and strength. Inspired by the elegant island of Santorini, it's a surprising and unforgettable scent.
Four Thieves is the perfumer's medieval herbal concoction reimagined.
"A fragrance for men who are pure at heart, for men seeking the essential," Lolita Lempicka.

Mischievous and delicate, Aqua Allegoria reveals the delightful side of the redcurrant. First, notes of bergamot, zests of fresh fruits, lemon and mandarin release a light mist, then the redcurrant reveals its tangy sweetness wrapped in white tea and raspberry leaves for a perfect finish with the sweet acacia flower. Delectable!
Few things can match the magnetic charm of antique leather which is rich, intense and mature. This fragrance marries the spellbinding qualities of leather with sheer sophistication.

Gold Oud is a tribute to the most precious and glowing metal of the Dubai market. The perfume describes the arrival in the most astonishing souks. It also represents a snapshot of a merchant's stall who is able to catch visitors' attention through the stories he tells. A gold that sells itself through captivating Arab fairy tales; a gold that becomes unique and of immeasurable value.
Thé Fantaisie takes pleasure in doing things off the beaten track, far from conventions. Originality, with a hint of mischievousness and lightness as a way of life!
This scent embodies the spirit and philosophy of Pineider, a masterpiece contained in a bottle that is a reminder of the past. A fragrance that becomes a message that speaks to you.
MyScent 150 is a synergic union between two souls: one more masculine – rich and spicy; the other, feminine – warm and engaging.
Keiko Mecheri continues her narratives with the essence of psychedelia to create a vivid composition that radiates the fantasy of an endless summer.

Pretty, delicious and enchanting. No7 for women includes top notes of sparkling fruits. Delicate bouquet of white flowers and toasted nuts are composed together as the middle notes. Adding beautiful depth to this fragrance, woody notes, together with gourmand notes and warm woods are added to the base notes.
Black Divine: drops of intoxication.
Italiano Donna is a floral, woody scent for the sensual woman.
Inspired by the rose gardens of David Austin, Rose Patience captures the unique, intense and elegantly clean scent of the old-fashioned rose fused with lemony notes.
Harmonious. Elegant. Soft. Soothing and crisp like the breeze on a tranquil spring day. A fragrance inspired by the blue open sky and warm rays of sunshine.
Earthy, deep, and natural.

A perfume of contrasts, it evokes at first the warmth of the sun naturally enhancing the aromas of an Indian garden à la Shalimar, even suggesting Indian decadence and sensuality, before a breeze gently caressing the murmuring fountains, the quiet orange groves and the herbs, comes to refresh the sensations.

A chypre, floral and gourmand fragrance. Warm, floral intense notes in heart. Sweet and dry, powdery in trail.
Betty Barclay in Love is one to stir the senses with its bouquet of fruity and floral notes.

name_perfume: The Icon Eau De Parfum For Women
description: A seductive scent full of subtleties for the free and bold woman.

A Victorian fragrance with a newfound lyricism, Love in Idleness is constructed around the Grasse Violet flower. The scent of this elusive bloom has been captured authentically.
Inspired by salty surf, warm sun on bare skin and sea birds singing as the ocean whispers. Suspended moments of storytelling and laughter with friends.

Yulong Tea is a unique aromatic combination of black tea and green tea extracts that will take you on a sensory journey through one of the most renowned landscapes of the Yunnan region, the Yulong Mountains.
This scent exudes seduction, magnetism and a natural glow. The Femme Magique woman is confident and vital: simply charming. Wake up the magic in you!
A cocktail of engaging notes inspired by acid house beats.

Inspired by Saif bin Dhi Yazan, the legendary king of Yemen, Yazan is a statement of simple sophistication.
Exude effortless elegance with this avant-garde bouquet of white lily. Perfect for vineyard picnics and bottomless brunches.
An intensely masculine fragrance that takes seduction into a whole new dimension.

Take a deep breath, the perfume unwraps itself, softly, like a shadow, think eyelids half-closed. First, an opal breeze surface in this olfactory tranquility brushing against the skin, a caress. Then smokey notes for meditation embraces body and soul finally, as this radiant halo settles, the flavoured notes come to wrap you in an ecstatic aura of comfort and elegance. The hint of a smile.

An authentic, intense and expressive fragrance, just like the artist, who never goes unnoticed. The perfume is perfect for extroverted, stripped-down men who know what they want and are seductive by nature.

He succeeds at everything he puts his mind to, whether dressed in black tie formal wear, jeans, and sneakers, or nothing at all, and all with effortless nonchalance, leaving nothing behind other than a fragrant trace of L'Homme Idéal Extrême.

Who we are as a society today => a patchwork of individuals, different, but united by a bond of shared dreams.

The Tuscan Archipelago: a wonderful world of dream places that have lived through all the cultures of the Mediterranean. Places that are so different one from the other but yet have the sea and beauty in common. The notes of the Archipelago fragrance reflect the natural atmosphere and the poetry of these unique landscapes.

Strong, striking, and dense.

Blissful. Like the first taste of a decadent dessert.
A precious fragrance, built around a trio of woods combined with exotic and rare spices, for an experience that will transport you to the borders of India.
Feminine and kind, this is an enveloping creation about nature and elegance inspired by the Tuscan countryside.

Sweet, sensual, and wild.

We wanted to create a scent the takes you to another dimension where dreams, stories and fantasies come to life. In the end, it keeps its promise and becomes a symbol of truth, yet with some intriguing shades.

Faith for Fantasy is like a shimmering sparkle in the night sky, with special and fascinating ingredients that invite you to dream and unfold on your skin in a very individual way. An intergalactic fireworks of fragrance nuances.

Pomelos is a fresh although intense fragrance with plenty of fruity notes.

An extraordinary masculine fragrance inspired by Lionel Messi of the famous football club Barcelona. Remind yourself of the atmosphere of a football match and be a proud fan of FC Barcelona with this Eau de Toilette!

Own the throne in an intoxicatingly and charmingly playful scent fit for royalty.
An intense fragrance that invigorates the senses with the most precious woody and ambery notes.

A royal scent that suits a confident and elegant soul.
