Silver threads of sensuality. Have you noticed that some days, some moments can only be captured in Silver? The soft sensual cool of Silver, surreal in its enchantment and mystery, blurs the edges and makes a woman seem touched by some mysterious force. Now you can magnify the magic.
Inspired by the Arabian Horse, Mis'ch has beauty, endurance, and strength. Mis’ch is airy, clean, and solar.

Roses for men! The perfume's aim is clear: to transform the famous Grasse Rose, a symbol of voluptuousness and unqualified femininity in perfume, into an assertively virile fragrance for men. The result is a model of its kind: alternating feminine/masculine with the disturbing ambiguity of the Centifolia rose.

Velvet Passion was inspired by unique textures in fabrics. Spray this sophisticated and striking fragrance with irresistible notes that are highlighted in all its elegance and charm, leaving a velvety veil on your skin. Velvet Passion is for you to fall in love every day.
Rich, yet soft, fresh and sweet, Enigma Aoud holds a mysterious, deeply compelling aroma.
Exquisite Musk recreates with sophistication the texture of ambergris with an oriental signature by blending musk and animal notes.

"I am an unrivalled contrast. I am a sillage in majesty, my flower is the queen of the perfumery. Honeyed, warm, fresh, its numerous facets make it inexhaustible. Here, its spicy notes are highlighted. We fall for me because of my honesty, we love me for my balance. I am for women and men, my rose is genderless. Devilishly voluptuous, I am a monument of the perfumery. I am Rose Poivrée," Jean-Claude Ellena, Perfumer.

"I tried to capture the smell a thousand times, a thousand times it escaped me. Drawn by its complexity, its sumptuousness, I took this perfume with me when I travelled to discover it." - Jean-Claude Ellena, Perfumer

Strolling along the narrow streets of the medieval town of Penne d'Agenais in the Lot-et-Garonne region of France, an intoxicating smell of honeysuckle stops you in your tracks. "It was as if the flower was exhaling, breathing out its sweet scent, calling for me to pay attention to it. We were mesmerised by its pure beauty, its hypnotic fragrance, its precious petals, its luscious leaves. It was as though it was casting a spell over me," Lev Glazman, co-Founder.

"Nudiflorum is an olfactory intimacy. It's an interpretation of a feeling of being touched. A slender touch of a bare skin that penetrates through the surface and becomes a part of you. Natural, primitive, and sensual. This cross-breed of naked fur flowers creates a feeling of a delicate collision of skin on skin." Alessandro Gualtieri, Olfactive Director and Perfumer.
The first global scent for Le Labo since its creation, the scent is exotic and sensual with an eastern woody influence.

name_perfume: Pasha De Cartier Édition Noire Ultimate
description: An energised and invigorating scent that is as modern as it is charismatic.
Mandragola. A fragrance strong in character and irresistibly sensual.
Aromatic Essence expands the Eternity love story to all types of lovers, desires and relationships.

Vetiver is the rugged adventurer. The perfect partner for the Great Outdoors: Himalayan peaks, California road trips, the streets of the global metropolis. Murdock Vetiver is distinctive, clean and no-nonsense, with an appealing zesty edge. Sound familiar?

In the mid-30s, when musicals were all the rage on New York's Broadway, Ernest Daltroff created a new fragrance for the United States. The symbol of a time when the cabaret divas of the Moulin Rouge were stealing the limelight from the beautiful elegant women of the Champs-Elysèes, French Cancan evokes a certain liberation in customs that echoes the end of prohibition in the United States.
A fresh, sparkling scent, loyal to Caron Pour Un Homme.

With Noir Divine, Stendhal creates a unique and fascinating perfume. A subtle nod to the famous novel by Stendhal, The Black. This fragrance is a mix between oriental and fruity notes, between sensuality and modernity. For a woman of character to wake that leaves no one indifferent …
A subtle, single-note cologne that captures all the pleasant experiences and memories.
A true collector's item for the fans of the original joyful and sparkling scent.

Brighten up a dull morning with the tantalizing fragrance of Sophia Violet, where the effervescence of youth adds that sublime feeling of invincibility even in the toughest of times. Top it off with citrus and fresh green notes and you've got a completely uplifting experience in a fragrance. A true companion in times of strife it may be, but then again why wait for a dull day when you can keep them at bay with Sophia Violet!

Davana & Vanille Bourbon is sweet and syrupy and multi-faceted. Warm woody notes are counterbalanced by rich, balsamic, spiced gourmand accents that brings an almost tobacco-like character, and a rich floral heart softens the luxuriously sugary tones.
Sultan Men Black is a cool and refreshing light floral scent with a masculine and mysterious magnetism.
“Creating a fragrance is like creating a great work of art. You have to feel the product, sense it,” Fred Hayman.
A delicate and delicious dazzling of the senses.

With this unique fragrance, nature itself takes centre stage. Capable of transporting the magic of the red sand of the Sahara to the skies above London and sending rubies to the planet Kepler-2b, 1,040 light years away, nature is the ultimate force.
Ungaro Pour L'Homme III is a fragrance for the man who loves to seduce. The Ungaro man is a passion seeker on an eternal quest for new sensations.
Be remembered for your masculine, crisp and energetic scent. A blend of glacier citrus water, silver sage, ginger root will inspire the senses for more.

Garden of Zen will have you dreaming of faraway Asia with its citrus-floral scent. This unique scent evokes a warm summer evening, the sun still blinking furtively through the leafy roof in the garden.
A fire broke out in the Curling Bros. barbershop in Westlake, N.Y. in 1891. A charred bottle was found half-full. It smelled like this.
A modern fusion of delicate and powerful notes, So…? Floral Crush is feminine and daring. With the So…? Floral Crush fragrance there’s no wallflower in sight!
Being the first one to introduce exotic and precious goods coming from Russia and beyond, the fragrance reflects a multicultural influence.
As sweet and as satisfying as sunbeams dancing energetically on the skin, Solar is a spray of pure joy. An uplifting and joyful scent sure to elevate any individual.

"Celeste makes one think of infinity, of mentally rising in the sky, of freeing the mind. At this point it is natural to think of that Elevation also sung by U2: 'You make me feel like I could fly so high'. Cuir Celeste wants to enhance our subjective feelings, it is not the scent that is worn to seduce or throw messages. As the starting point for its creation was the image of the aviator jacket, similarly Cuir Celeste wants to be the stimulus to fly with the imagination." - Benoît Verdier
Ghost Daydream sparkles on our muse, Malaika's skin, the fragrance glistens and reflects as it transports her to a dreamy sanctuary, a moment's escape from the everyday.
The idea for this fragrance was to refine a rough precious Assam oud by shaping it with seven facets.
We Rock! For Men represents the energy and bright lights and dancing the night away in the nightclub.
Accelerate your adrenaline with 300 Km/H Electric. Supercharged in seconds, made to last for hours with energised turmeric, lavender, and vetiver.
Central Park South captures the mesmerizing ambience of this precious street of dreams that simultaneously connects the most exquisite urban pleasures with the lure and profusion of nature harnessed.

Fruit d'Amour is an a scent for the lovely, caring, mischievous and exciting modern princess. A lovely floral fragrance, built around the most iconic flower, the rose, with an impertinent and cheeky fruity touch. Fresh and teasing, like only Ungaro can be.
A sensory, timeless and universal fragrance. A unisex scent, without artifice, with the pleasure and luxury of simple ways as a guide.
Pure Soul is made for the artist, who with every stroke of her brush reveals the wonders of her mind and the beauty of her soul.

name_perfume: Tardes De Domingo En El Hipódromo
description: Inspired by Tardes de Domingo En El Hipódromo's emblematic scenery where Madrid's aristocracy and high class gathered.

With his charisma, passion and sensuality, he leaves an impression on women in the world. Man of Passion is a fragrance for the self-assured man, who is has a sensual seductive and irresistible charm.
Let's reconnect with our primal instincts with Nature Insolente.
A bewitching, captivating and powerful fragrance that will make you discover the amazing black lemon.
Inspired by sensual luxury, White Musk is evocative of a new phase of life, full of life and heat.
"An incredible fragrance for a self-confident man of true character," Bernard Ellena, Perfumer.
Whether it's looking for the perfect perfume for that special someone, or giving yourself the gift of a Parisian spritz, this fresh and floral fragrance is sure to delight.

Eau de Dolce Vita is an original Eau in the wake of the classic Dolce Vita scent. Lighter than its predecessor, it reflects unique ways of wearing fragrances: the ability to vary the effects to match mood and moment, and experience different intensities on the skin.

The olfactory writing of Kouros Silver is a translation of the evolution of masculine perfumery, which once was very hygienist yet is now multifaceted - freshness, power, sensuality … the challenge was to respect the sensual and powerful DNA of the original fragrance while bringing innovation and a modern vision in tune with today's men's expectations.

As a tribute to her ancestors who made Maison Rancé world-famous, Jeanna Sandra Rancé has recreated this classic fragrance, under the name of Rue Rancé, the road in Grasse where the Rancé Family lived and had its perfume houses for centuries.
This refreshing and sensual fragrance is for the dynamic soul who is energetic, and forever on the move.
Evokes an imaginary beehive.

From the depths of the seas comes the inspiration for Black Pearls, a soft, sensuous, modern oriental fragrance. The clarity and elegance of flowers and citrus express the initial image. Sheer sensuality comes out in the heart and a last impression of velvety richness is created through at the end.
An enchanting and mysterious perfume that makes use of beautiful and rare ingredients.
With Synchrony, Björk and Berries envisioned a city’s aromas via architecture. What makes a city come alive, more precisely, what fragrance would these spaces hold?
Are you an adventurous, outgoing man? Then Ajmal's Shiro is a definite must-try!
Light grey, foggy, not dark. Icy, cold with a sense of freshness. A scent with two souls, unexpected.
Strength and texture. Not the essence of leather, but an interpretation of it. Cat-like sublimated with shades of gourmand notes balanced with greens and woody accents.

For a fragrance which always gets so much notice, it is remarkable how little is known about it. The root of the vetiver, once dried out, exudes a warm and almost intoxicating perfume. Like a shawl of India, vetiver is on the list of exotic items coveted by women of high society.
Sweet Honesty is an innocent warm and dreamy scent that will wrap you in a whispery veil of petal-soft florals.
Bahia - At once flamboyant and vibrant, the samba capital is emblematic of Orange. Suave and juicy, it stands out as the captivating note of this album.
Find inspiration with the Biografia Inspire Homme, this fragrance brings a touch of unusual freshness. If you love woody fragrance, you'll love Biografia Inspire Homme
This fragrance is original, vibrant, and magnificent, which distinguishes itself and is ideal for every occasion.
A fresh and fruity top note develops into a beautiful, balanced floral heart. The composition is completed with warm and soft woody notes. A delightfully delicate fragrance.

"APOM (A Piece of Me). A bit of oneself that one leaves on others. Apom is an inspiration that came to me from the beauty of men and women, from the harmonious colors and flavors of the Middle East so often told to me by my grandmother, and that I rediscovered during my travels to Lebanon. Apom is the power and softness of citrus blossoms and warm woods." Francis Kurkdjian.

Located in West Village, NYC, was the Stonewall Inn, a shady bar frequently visited by drag queens and outcasts. In the early hours of June 28, 1969, the area became the birthplace of the Stonewall Uprising, one of the most significant social turning points in modern history. Some even write: the first pride was a riot.

This designer believes that the task of fragrance is not to overshadow the individuality of a person, but to help reveal his identity just as flower-bud blossoms towards the sun. This 'sun' is undoubtedly Angel Schlesser Homme, the classic men's perfume.
What greater joy than to explore our wildest dreams. Breathing the beautiful summer dawn, and the smell of flowers surrounded with gold.

ingredients: ['Oud / Agarwood', 'Vanilla', 'Patchouli', 'Cedarwood', 'Guaiac Wood', 'Sandalwood', 'Amber', 'Incense / Olibanum', 'Jasmine', 'Lily Of The Valley', 'Mate', 'Peony', 'Rose', 'Bergamot', 'Lemon', 'Mandarin', 'Musk', 'Saffron', 'Black Pepper']
description: Feel the exuberance of oud intertwined with the sophisticated power of vanilla bahiana from Brazil in an engaging and striking fragrance.

11 11 is a simple yet bold blend inspired by the teachings of Kundalini yoga and the colour white. It is a sheer, clean and uplifting fragrance with an ethereal vibe. You've never smelled anything like it.
A captivating sensation. Satisfy your sweet cravings with a fresh hit of crisp, dewy apple, blended with the delicate flavour of fine florals, ending on a delicious creamy caramel accord.
A conversation between Sky and Earth. A palette of greens reflecting a lush vegetation. A celestial and solar explosion of citrus and exotic woods. An Infinite freshness.

He's artistic, intellectual, bookish yet audacious, and he wears Chez Bond, a fragrance named after a street that's home turf for New York's wealthiest merchants and entrepreneurs. It's cool and strong with invigorating and sparkling essences warmed up with a smooth, seductive and lingering base.
Sunscreen, salt-on-skin, ocean airs on the coast of Queens where privet hedge flowers blaze by pastel condos.

An opulent and modern composition around Indian tuberose whose fresh and spicy opening blends baies and petitgrain. In the heart a feminine radiance of Turkish rose, Sambac jasmine, iris that facets tuberose by bestowing a powdery touch. The trail unveils a sensuous warm chord of vanilla, benzoin and precious woods.
In the Rain, recalls the intense woody and green smell that can arise after a downpour leaving a powerful wake.

Mysteriously sophisticated, innocently seductive, coveted, yet forbidden. This young beauty intoxicates with innocent allure. She emerges with a blend of forbidden flowers and touches of berries. Her confident femininity blooms with a tantalizing bouquet of hypnotic flowers. Underneath this exotic floralcy, lies a layer of addictive notes for an everlasting impression.
A homage to the brave drivers who pioneered F1®, the risk-taking drivers with nerves of steel who risked it all with every race.
Blooming Blue is an exotic fragrance that fuses spicy and mellow ingredients, delivering a pleasant, rustic scent that adds a certain zest to your personality.
The iconic Moschino Teddy Bear fragrance is back! This second unique edition is sculptured in glass, revealing the exclusive fragrance inside.

Gucci Première celebrates the star in every woman. Whether she is holding court at a film opening or business meeting, all her moments are golden. She turns as many heads in an impeccably tailored suit as a couture gown. Grace sits with attitude, beauty with power. She enjoys her achievements and wears her authority with ease. Wherever she finds herself, she is met with admiration. She is a modern icon.

Loewe Aire Anthesis is inspired by the fresh and pure air all around us: elemental, uplifting and life-giving. It features the unique Loewe accord, a raw and authentic, ambery scent based on the rockrose, a delicate yet hardy wildflower native to Spain.
So…? Dark Romance is definitely not for the faint of heart. The rich blend wraps you in an air of mystery while its flirty accords add a burst of sass. An attention-grabbing scent.

name_perfume: Today Tomorrow Always The Moment For Him
description: Go back in time with your love and experience a precious moment with each other. Today Tomorrow Always the Moment for Him lets you relive that feeling over and over again with just a whiff.
A sensual accord inspired by the essence of fragrance flowers that blooms only at night. Strong and delicate, mysterious and bold.
Light, fresh, but utterly unique. Chanson d'Eau for women will capture your heart with its delicate, sophisticated composition.

name_perfume: The Remarkable Success Of Mr Harrod
description: Fortune favours the brave, and Mr. Harrod is living proof. His is a flourishing business and a florid love life. His appeal is evident: to the numerous young ladies, Ladies, and along the way a few lasses. And like all real Gentlemen, he is most welcome wherever he goes. In the case of Lady Blanche, love’s power reinvigorated with time, as only absence knows how. The old-flame still flickers: another fire to stoke? “If only…(sigh)”

Wander down the garden path, and see what lies beyond the moonlit valley. This is a fragrance for women with heart, soul, and an ever-lasting romantic streak. A technicolour experience that unwinds like a journey to some far-flung land.
Puccini The woman is sweet and fruity, the magically evocative notes immediately awaken your deepest senses.

“There’s not only one black tea in the world. I wanted to bring out the various facets of this complex aroma to make my own accord using an extract of black tea as an infusion together with a maté tea absolute. What I love about black tea is its subtlety. The way the airiness plays against the earthiness and the bitter, fresh notes play against the floral aspect, all with a light touch,” Geza Schoen, Perfumer.
Coralina is a ladylike floral inspired by the coral-coloured stone indigenous to the Dominican Republic.
Speick Men is an unmistakably energetic and balanced fragrance.

Sergio Momo and Max Casacci, co-founder of Subsonica and music pioneer, have combined the sacredness of sound with the most precious ingredients of perfumery to create an unparalleled universe that explores the power of rhythm and scent, transporting the wearer to new celestial heights.
Amber Gris has deep, intricate, multi-layered and entwined notes that will captivate you.

White gold, submerged in a regal perfume for people who like to make an impression. It has a very spicy aroma, fresh at the beginning, ripening into sweetness. A perfume and jewel together, in a voyage of the senses.

"My inspiration was the purity of the few pure and natural essential oils available in the late 17th century. The simple, magic almost healing ingredients in Acqua Di Colonia are entirely natural. They evoke the familiar scent of European barbershops and pharmacies," Lorenzo Villoresi, Perfumer.

name_perfume: Tom Tailor Be Natural For Him
description: In a world that is turning faster and faster, we focus on the essentials. Light and carefree. Naturally. An olfactory journey to ourselves. Be Natural for Him brings out your own personality and combines the lightness of nature with the bubbling energy of life.
A perfume of extremes playing with ice and fire, shapes and shadows, innocent and sensuality, matching the intense luminosity against the hidden side of an iceberg on fire.
Sweet Honest Forever, a fresh, floral fragrance that celebrates the joy of a lasting romance!
Welcome to the future, and it smells amazing! Stay fresh and smell irresistible all day long with Axe Provocation eau de toilette for men.
Inspired by the most appetising summer nights.

The natural zest and tender flesh of the citrus and the slight aniseed aroma of fresh basil fuse perfectly to create Mandarine Basilic. This burst of freshness and the energising, hearty green notes blend voluptuously with an elegant resin note.

Among ancient civilisations, the Egyptian one is certainly one of the most fascinating. A well-expressed example of its greatness is the city of Luxor. Luxor by Xerjoff is an oriental and fresh perfume that evokes the splendour of a civilisation which still enchants us with the beauty of its forms, colours and paintings.

Sheer Lovely: a soft, sheer, gentle rendition of the favourite classic. Perfect for the season. Perfect anytime. Inspired by Sarah Jessica Parker, the woman who embodies an easy-going yet beautiful lifestyle.

Floating on a spicy-sensual-floral aura, she is at home wherever she goes. Confidence and self-contained. Caring and generous. Knowing and natural. Her fragrance reflects her wide-open embrace of life in essences from all over the world.
A perfume inspired by the first exhibition of neon art at the gallery La Maison Rouge, featuring fluoro art from the 1920s to today's love of the Day-Glo.
White cotton is as timeless a fabric as the breeze that flows through summer days. TrulyTimeless by Kate Spade evokes the clean freshness and warm glow of early morning light.

You are beautiful when you don’t think you are. When you don’t know to be the leader of your movements; you are the stage, the writer and the actor of your beauty. You are beautiful when you trust your gut more than your mind, when you get careless but always with watchful eyes. Love and belief in yourself.

From the Shorai Garden, you can see the ‘Cupolone' (as the cathedral's dome is called) and part of the historical centre of Florence. The cover artwork on the case is by painter Teppei Sasakura and represents the union of Florence and Kyoto on the 50th Anniversary of their becoming twin cities. Cinquanta was created to celebrate this anniversary.
This gentle and luxurious scent evokes the dance of pure white flowers.

The fragrance generated by the Australian sandalwood offers a scent that conjures meditation. The perfume evolves from a warm base of musk and blossoms with a sustained heart of green herbs. Its sunny top notes display Mediterranean essences of green citrus and woody notes.

A name that evokes the beauty and splendour of the Queen of all Jades. Noble and majestic, a woman of great seductiveness who conveys elegance and sophistication. A ravishing fragrance that expresses the majestic elegance.
Evoke is designed to attract the glamorous young woman who is vibrant and full of life.

name_perfume: Teint De Neige Eau De Parfum
description: Teint De Neige Eau de Parfum has the unmistakable scent of scented powders; the scent of face powder in a soft, delicate and enveloping fragrance.
Sensual and seductive, a scent for the woman with style.

ingredients: ['Lily Of The Valley', 'Rose', 'Ylang-ylang', 'Jasmine', 'Orange Blossom', 'Palisander Rosewood', 'Violet', 'Amber', 'Vanilla', 'Cashmeran (Woody musky)', 'Citruses', 'Mandarin', 'Musk', 'Peach', 'Sandalwood']
description: Harmonious like a flower that has just blossomed. Sensual like a magic encounter. Inebriating like a rich floral bouquet. Soft and seductive like red silk. A woman and her fragrance: D Rouge.

When darkness falls, Noho lights up: Nuits de NoHo. It's her fragrance – confident, daring, sensual, yet always ladylike. A new kind of nighttime femininity: Irreverent and unapologetic. A contemporary gourmand skin-scent that's the ultimate in sexy avant-garde urbanity.
Morning light falls through a spacious garden framed by silver birch trees. A breath of fresh air blows, the iconic scent of English lavender pervades the air. A charismatic smell.

A strong and timeless icon, Cabochard is a tribute to bold, spirited women. It makes a strong impression, embodying audacious, determined and occasionally capricious femininity. There is never any question of sharing the limelight.

Gucci Bamboo Limited Edition is the original woody floral fragrance, tinted a jewel tone to celebrate the scent's new chapter. Soft and intense at once, the scent blooms with exotic flowers, while the base balances the femininity with a woody contrast to create a statement of strength and sophistication.
Turathi Red is a radiant and sophisticated fragrance for passionate women.

The Mercedes-Benz man. An independent spirit. Comfortable with his success, he doesn't follow trends. He aspires to be the best. Confident and true to himself, he has nothing to prove and everything to live for. His perfume? Mercedes-Benz for Men. A modern, masculine fragrance born from the fusion of elegance and technology, from the attraction of power and the art of seduction.
This intense yet breezy fragrance, created for the refreshing and vibrant man, instantly transports you to the azure waters of the Amalfi Coast.

A floral scent, fruity and hedonistic. The heart is full of white flowers, the base is sensual and recalls vivid freshness with memories of gourmand notes. A generous statement offered to cheerful and joyful women.
"Fragile but whole. Its name hints at a break but before the fissures show, its first two syllables conjure Orpheus, a poet who could charm even stones." Serge Lutens.

Grossmith continues the tradition of celebrating royal events by introducing King’s Salute, launched at Fortnum & Mason on the coronation day of HM King Charles III, on 6th May 2023. The scent evokes the King’s love for his Highgrove Garden, where lavender and thyme are found in abundance.
Full of bright contrasts, Gingembre Pétillant was inspired by the intricacies of Middle Eastern traditional scents.
This perfume is a blend of mesmerising and appetising accords.

To dance is to make art. A body discovering other bodies, other spaces, and becoming aware of itself. A daily sacrifice to satisfy the vital impulse to dance and feel. Powder, flowers in the dressing room, wood, bodies, air.

MaxMara is all about the must-have. The compelling, the intriguing . . . the enduring. Never too modish, yet never ever out of style. It's timeless, as elegant as it is versatile, both refined and eminently wearable. And its engaging sense of practical glamour has now been captured in a fragrance. MaxMara, the first fragrance in fifty-three years, is mysteriously sensual. It's classic yet contemporary. Intriguing, yet decidedly reassuring. As vibrant as bright silk. As soft as cashmere. It's fresh, luminous and feminine. The MaxMara fragrance expresses a charismatic personality. It assumes the individuality of its wearer, without compromising its own distinctive and unmistakable style.
The picture of dreams come true as woman and fragrance become one.

This perfume marks the creation of the first Urban Floral. Traditional floral fragrances are rounder, heavier, and quieter. DKNY Women reinvents this category, building on the success and appeal of feminine floral, while weaving in clarity, crispness and sleek edginess - the essence of urban femininity.
Expressive and full of life, Cedarwood Eau Fraîche is a unique fragrance that gets under your skin. For adventurers and night hawks, connoisseurs and charmers.

Fashion influencers, bloggers, and twins Natalie Lim and Dylana Suarez have been lovers of scent for their entire lives, and now they have a fragrance of their own. Inspired by the glamour and luxury of disco and the dialled-back landscape and earthy hues of the desert, their signature perfume is an edgy, sensual and genderless scent.
An energising scent with bright, luminous accords.

name_perfume: Gucci Bloom Eau De Parfum Intense
description: Blossom your most intense inner light from the mystery of the night with Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Intense. Inspired by the magnetic forces of moonlight, this powerful fragrance is a catalyst for the creative spirit, encouraging everyone to blossom into their most authentic self.
The sun is the limit with Jil Sander Sun Men Sport.
Lago is full of attraction and stands for the element of water. A sensual experience.
Both secret and captivating, Bois de Oud's warm and musky blend makes it a unique fragrance that leaves an indelible memory.
This summer, live your life by the waterfront with this youthful and exciting fragrance from Cacharel!

A modern encounter with the ancient, preserved for eternity in hardened honey. The patient work of a quill pen brings light to a dark chamber. Day for Night is the ultimate amber scent: the fossilised made newly mysterious as the natural becomes precious. An unforgettably resonant, rich amber scent.
This scent is the perfect combination of freshness and warmth. Its light scent will leave all those around you in awe.
Dive into the depths of the abyss, to discover the beauty hidden in the immensity. Ambre des Abysses is an unexpected combination of sumptuous ambery nuances and the freshness of aromatic notes.

Indomitable, Princesse Rebelle is a Rock'n'Roll princess. The epitome of freedom and seduction, she only responds to her instincts as a wild child. A hedonist who consumes life and enjoys happiness without restraint. Of royal blood, naturally classy, she contrasts with her provocative personality. Her scent is just like her, she is spectacular, greedy, irresistible!

Un Jardin en Méditerranée (A Garden in the Mediterranean) is a short story, a travel log evoking a Mediterranean garden using impressionistic writing, a mosaic of notes gathered from the garden of Leïla Menchari, who is the director of decoration at Hermès.
The Library of Fragrance captures the Christmas spirit and evokes memories of Christmases past, any time of year. Delight family and friends with this comforting and refreshing scent.

Iris Porcelana is a contemporary take on iris pallida, the most precious and graceful flower of high perfumery. The secular yet modern craft of French porcelain inspired our perfumer, who patiently designed this fragrance with the same delicacy and know-how. The result is a smooth and second-skin scent, intensely addictive.
A fragrance that gives men the assurance and self-confidence at all times. In order to know what to wear in all circumstances. They need fragrances with really distinctive universes.

Run faster. Jump higher. Go further. Overcome your limits until they disappear altogether .Do you dare to enter this unique urban adventure? Power of Seduction Urban pushes you to conquer the streets, following your own rules. With speed and adrenaline in its DNA, this fresh, masculine, and youthful scent absorbs the power of the big city and makes everything it touches unstoppable.
Delight in a sense of wonder with this clean blend of precious notes.

fragrances: Floral Fresher Lily of the Valley
description: Lily of the Valley evokes all things spring. Bashful and innocent, this is a perfume of new beginnings.

The Lune Féline Extrait is an intense special edition that enhances all of the features of the original fragrance. Expect a fragrance that walks closer to the dark side of the moon with this dramatic take on one of our most beloved scents.
Alternately floral, vegetal and animal thanks to its notes, Jardin Secret invites us to explore all facets of life at its wildest.
A scent inspired by the city of Marseille and the vibrancy of the Orient.
Like being wrapped up in an oversized hoodie stolen from your crush, you know the one, Beau Bleu offers a warm, comforting embrace with a genderless fragrance.
This gourmet and solar fragrance can be savoured like a luscious sorbet.

Diana Vreeland was called the Empress of Fashion. Mrs. Vreeland stated that fashion was not just about clothes, she lived for the fantasy of fashion. This is where she left her mark and no one past or present has been able to challenge her style or distinct point of view.
Surround yourself with a fragrance that will make you feel wonderful all day long. Dream Bright Gold is an expression of optimism and happiness.

Zafar is an intense expression of Arabian perfumery. Three years of sourcing materials went into this composition as nothing but the rarest and most exquisite ingredients were used to create this magical perfume.
A fragrance of vibrant freshness that expresses assertive virility.

The Dynamic Move Amber man is a doer! He takes matters into his own hands and looks to the future. Progress instead of standstill. He goes through life dynamically and is sure of himself. Energetic, mysterious, self-confident.
Life is breathtaking and gives us moments full of great emotions; it can all lead us to happiness if we follow this advice fulfil this purpose: "enjoy the little things".
A radiant Miss Dior, who throws herself headlong into a never-ending whirlwind of life and love.

The finest bergamot brings vibrant freshness and sparkling intensity. The citrus and orange tones add extraordinary sensuality and unexpected happiness. Citrus Elixir brings a boost of natural energy to any fragrance.

Beyond the weathered beach hut and soft white sands, a garden full of bright wild flowers, despite the crisp, wintery air. A timeless, modern, and unique fragrance.
New York: The city that never sleeps buzzes with an intoxicating mix of the addictive depth of a cocktail-inspired scent to awaken ambitions.

An intensified experience, try Amor Amor Electric Kiss. Day, or night.

Be unabashedly seduced by the dual scent of Black Musk Eau de Toilette. Our new, dark and desirable fragrance plays with your fierce inside and your sweet outside. Don't be afraid to be… neither bad nor good!

A noble, sophisticated and alluring scent.
Inspired by the frozen Arctic icescapes, this edition encapsulates a fresh jewel of Parfum made of 100% natural ingredients.

How many times have you let yourself be taken by surprise and found yourself enticed by a fragrance wafting from a café terrace, captivated by the scents of a secret garden - or perhaps beguiled by an unforgettable perfume worn by a stranger in a crowd? A spell in the guise of a perfume that murmurs Remember Me.
Charlotte aux Fraises is a delicious scent that will seduce just like the cake bearing the same name.

Between light and dark, this fragrance has captured the spirit of Asia. Sensual and passionate, it is obsessive and mesmerising.

A lush and effervescent burst of fruit that sparkles as the fragrance opens. A fresh, luminous heart explores the delicate naturalness of a radiant floral bouquet. The sensuality of the base of softened with gourmand notes caressing then senses for an intense silky emotion.

Inspired by the very essence of Gabrielle's radiance, the fragrance shines with intensity, inviting all women to reveal their true selves, to follow their instincts by expressing their freedom and speaking their mind. The voluptuous scent works its magic to reveal each individual identity. Solely, it heightens the dazzling charisma of the woman who wears it with warmth and luminosity.
Imagine 2030, with serenity. A sweet and bright freshness.
Eau de Lancaster is the perfect scent for a night on the town or a leisurely weekend getaway. Try Eau de Lancaster for a classically nostalgic fragrance experience.

Floral and Joyful, Eau de Sisley 1 is a sun-kissed dress, brimming with the mystery of a summer garden. Joyful, romantic, tenderly feminine, Eau de Sisley 1 has the sensuality of a delicately chosen bouquet.

A delightful composition with a “forbidden” theme based on a forbidden garden of fruity-floral aromas that will have you wanting so much more.

description: "This is of course a perfume about Englishness and London in particular. Having lived in France for so long I thought it would be great to do a perfume that I consider to be typically English. I think an eau de cologne worn by a girl can be so chic," James Heeley.
Emerald is a sacred gem of Aztecs and Incas, also highly valued by the Egyptian pharaoh. The purity of its green color symbolizes renewal, the rebirth of nature and the splendor of spring.

Private Blue is a fragrance for all brave and ambitious men who want to fulfil their dreams.
This powerful scent was created for the confident man driven by challenges.
A new season sweeps through the city while tiny white flowers collect in clusters on bushy evergreens, filling the air with a joyful scent: Osmanthus Blossom.
Doux Saphir is elegant and light. A fragrance of freedom, it encourages self-expression.

When desire is far removed from reason. All senses are awakened with sparkling citrus top notes. Elegant floral fragrances succumb to aniseed aromas, while woody notes and musks prolong the lure of an unforgettable trail.
Fall under the spell of a fragrance that captures the excitement of new romance.
A bold and provocative fragrance to awaken the senses.

The air is filled with a cloud of dust as the Route 66 man pulls into the gravel parking lot of a bar on his Harley. Things are in full swing. The scent is for all those who

want to embody both sensuality and masculinity simultaneously.
An invigorating scent for the girl on the move.
Imagine yourself on a tropical island! So exotic and sensual.

Heaven Can Wait is a modern rendering of a Parisian classic: understated, discreet and noble. It subtly and irresistibly draws you in. The result is something we now appreciate more than ever: a private heaven.

Sensual, intense. Oudelicious takes you on a sensual journey where sparkling fruits are blended with an unexpected trace of cooling spices following into a mesmerizing heart of masterfully blended ingredients leading the way to an enduring dry down dominated by a luxurious oud accord for an elegant and warm lingering finish.
Preziosa is a fragrance that speaks the language of sumptuous and luxurious grace.
We all have a memory in Provence, child or adult. This region is synonymous with lightness, letting go and holidays. Haute Provence / 89 is our tribute to it.
It's a classic at its best. Ambrette seed and styrax. Harmoniously combined natural materials make this traditional perfume a totally unique olfactory experience.
This scent undertakes a mystical journey with its stimulating aromas. A reflection of the brand's dedication to creating luxurious, elegant and sophisticated scents for all.

The Make B. Urban Ballet represents the entire duality of the collection. A fragrance created from the delicate touch of transparent flowers with the strength of the black tulip chord that results in a woody floral full of contrasts.
Top notes include pineapple leaves, tangerine and pepper; heart notes feature cyclamen and orchid, and the notes comprise sandalwood, palissandre wood, vanilla flower and patchouli.

Insensé reveals the emotions of a man when he desires a woman. His eyes sparkle with humour and joy. He is generous, outgoing and spontaneous. He is an idealist, proud to be free and non-conformist. Insensé represents a new and modern vision of masculinity.

An immediate impression of bravery, a lasting sensation of surprising tenderness and care. Legend encapsulates the valour and vivacity of Queen Boadicea’s brave adventures. A pure perfume that enraptures with its subtle defiance.

An aromatic start for this charismatic man who turns heads as a star would. A flight of spicy notes emphasise a toned body and an assertive masculinity. He's holding a cappuccino in hand. standing like a Roman god in a cosy atmosphere of woody notes. He walks confidently with killer eyes, leaving behind him a vanilla trail, like a great seducer with devastating charm.
Splash generously or spritz lightly with Coconut Pineapple body mist to transport you to a tropical paradise.

Bright and vibrantly clear, a sapphire gives us a feeling of peace and infinity. Fragrant, cool and captivating, serene and inviting, mesmerising and magical, Diamonds and Sapphires is a fragrance of depth and character, like the woman who wears it.
Sheer sensuality, crystal transparency, luminous brightness. Versace introduces Bright Crystal, a precious jewel of rare beauty characterised by a fresh, vibrant, flowery scent.

Vespri Orientale is a tribute to the passion and use that Orientals make of these precious essences. Marrying typically Italian citrus ingredients was like broadening the horizons of a story full of fantastic elements. And of emotion. In the style of The Thousand and One Nights, a tasty Mediterranean evening, a meeting of East and West.

The myth of the hippie culture on the island. A psychedelic trip brought by brightly coloured flowers; flowers that do not exist, but that attract you irreparably and invite you to discover the essence of your bohemian soul.

Aqua di Giò Profondo is more than a fragrance; It is a captivating immersion in the depth of the soul, which embraces the values of freedom, sensory and modern masculinity to reveal an increasingly intimate dimension.
The power of sacred geometry found in nature, infused with the rare and powerful natural oil of oud wood. Raise the ordinary to the extraordinary.
This scent combines green and floral notes to provide a delicious sensation of freshness, sophistication and elegance.
Strong, masculine, powerful. Musk + Storm is an intoxicating blend of fierce and seductive notes that will take you by storm.

Intertwined with refreshing bergamot, it reflects the awe-inspiring power and beauty of Mother Nature, which harmonizes body and spirit.

Boreas, the God of Ice, froze the flowers in an icy armor to hold their delights captive. Touched by his breath, the fragile petals were transformed into diamonds with sharp, brittle edges. The Sun God furious in realizing what Boreas has done and sent two of his sunbeams to warm the Earth. The ice melted and the flowers shook off their petals, releasing rose water that was gathered up in Liyoli.

Others will say that it is already too much and will try to ban it in the name of normality, where vanillas smell of vanilla.

Delicate and fresh, the creamy fruits open this fragrance. Followed by an unveiling of a powdery heart and an array of sensual notes settle on the skin.
Breathe in the freshness of summer with Oath for her. A fragrance that will mesmerise you!

An international name synonymous with travel for business or pleasure. A concept that represents every man's travels. An invitation to a smooth boarding en route to his ultimate destination. Take a break before taking your seat, enjoy a peaceful moment, the inspiration to getaway. Realize now that you have boarded, happiness is only a flight away.

To embody the lavish splendor of Palazzo Reale, I decided to use spices and scents that recall precious materials of the time like woods, balsams, and resins. Pistachio Brûlée lets you opt for something fresh, feminine, or sweet, all depending on your mood.

Tiny and fragile though it is, it nevertheless releases a perfume with incredible presence evoking the breathtaking landscape of thousands of cherry trees in bloom. The subtle, irresistible scent followed me everywhere," François Demachy, Perfumer-Creator.
Profound dilemma. Animalic suggestion. Autumnal light. Danaë, indolent like a serpent, dancing. Chaos! Crépuscule des Âmes is the twilight of the souls and a perfume to enslave the senses.

Darkest Damask Rose. Rich and textural, wrapped with smoky woods. Spiked with spices and decadent with gourmand notes. Magnetic.

Wear it on the go with a suede bomber jacket paired with modern sneakers and a fine Nappa leather backpack during a long weekend away with friends.

Designed to recreate the magical alchemy between the finest natural ingredients, this, combined with ethereal vibrations that are capable of bringing out precious exotic ingredients in warm and sensual tones along with strong and purposeful chords to create harmonious, elegant and highly refined blends to interpret and enhance the preciousness as part of the Colourfull Collection.

A memory from the holy forests of Indochina, and the velvety, milky scent of sandalwood burned in temples. Yves Coueslant, one of Diptyque’s founders, has never forgotten this fragrance from his childhood.
A sweet, playful scent with an irresistible trail.

Tiare, wild and rare, embodies the South Pacific. A small gardenia unique to Tahiti, it's the flower of beauty and love.

A blend of iced ingredients for an explosion of freshness, Hugo Iced is a unique blend of invigorating icy ingredients, the ultimate fusion to empower the wearer to take on the creatures of a daring and expanding world. It creates unlimited opportunities for inspiring and life-changing experiences, whilst evoking the uniquely bold and irreverent nature of Hugo.
Jette Red. A provocative and sensual fragrance for the woman who dares to wear Red.

Your eyes widen and twinkle as the true meaning of ‘you’ blossoms and develop: may this moment mark the awakening of who you are, who you will become.

The fragrance illustrates the charm of the Arabic-Moorish atmospheres and evokes the luxurious daily life of the Sultans who loved to welcome merchants in their palace with the most precious materials. Among those, the famous Sandalwood sought after for its richness and for its enveloping warmth.
A fragrance, that true to its name subtly plays with extremes and radiates a solar aura!

“I composed this fragrance by imagining myself arriving at the Eden-Roc hotel by sea. The salt, sun, pale rocks and luxuriant vegetation. A legend of luxury and oxygen, of extreme sophistication and exquisite simplicity. A perfume comes to life when it is worn. A place when it is lived in. So let us wish a very long life to Eden-Roc!” François Demachy, Perfumer-Creator.

This can be felt through the warmth and sensuality of Tonka Bean and Pachouli. This singular composition has been crafted according to the traditions of French Haute Parfumerie, using only the finest precious primary ingredients.

Made for more than going out, Siano is designed for the outgoing. Rich, decadent and undeniably enticing, this fragrance is a statement : It is bold, it is defining. Sweet like nectar, effervescent and enlightening. Siano is being out with your friends and owning the room.
Infusion d'Oeillet is a dream of memories with an intense and voluptuous allure.
Enhanced by a dazzling myriad of natural ingredients, this duo explodes on the senses, while the revisited patchouli develops a luxurious trailing scent.

Emerging from the rebirth of masculine identity. A modern Adam. Beyond conventions. A unification of strength and fragility, physique and intellect, power and emotions. An uplift of attitudes and senses.

It is a daring fragrance-revolution that imposes its own, pernicious powers of seduction. With a feline grace and emerald eyes, the Hypnotic Poison woman is an irresistible sorceress. A femme fatale, she knows how to cast spells and enslave men to her seductive charms.
Sheikh is a great scent, the perfection of a well-balanced perfume that will cater to all the needs of the user who wants more than what the ordinary user needs with life.
Mon Parfum, a fragrance for the stunning, sophisticated and sensuous woman. Women will delight in saying "This is my perfume"!

Poggia comes from the Italian verb for "to rest". A term used in sailing and maritime circles, it means to bear away, to voluntarily move the bow of the boat away from the direction in which the wind blows, giving the boat itself a greater thrust and stronger acceleration.

name_perfume: Beau De Jour Eau De Parfum
description: Beau de Jour presents the perfectly groomed gentleman who considers every detail. He exhibits the best version of himself to the world, but beneath the surface is something deeper, refreshing, and sublime in all its layers.
The man that every man wants to be… confident, charmer, relaxed… dressed with style… with a luxurious lifestyle… Perry Ellis Platinum Label.
Chrome is a fragrance that is luxurious and contemporary. It is the perfect fusion between traditional and innovation.
The thrill of that first glance, the excitement of an unfamiliar feeling. A fragrance imagined and experienced like a modern-day fairy tale.
In today's world, the desire for essential things in life is increasing. Caline Pure Moments is symbolising exactly what values like, love, friends, well-being. A fragrance to respire!
A timeless saga of romance.

So…? Brit is an exciting fragrance that is an ode to the British “it” girl style with a ferocious edge and acute sense of fun and excitement. Defying the dull, she colours of the world with her bright personality and eclectic fashion, towards ideas. Not afraid to experiment, she adores missing high fashion with high street, sequins with Wellingtons, Primark with Westwood, Shoreditch chic with Kensington class.
Subtle, fresh, clean. A surprising and unobtrusive scent aimed at the younger man.
Atelier Des Ors poetically magnifies each of its creations in a glittering ballet of stardust. An intensely distinguished emotion.
Classy Girl is a unique and pleasant fragrance with a mood-enhancing aroma.

Cabotine Cristalisme opens with a unique fruity accord and is blended with elegant floral notes. The true feminine heart contains a perfect floral bouquet. The depth of the blend is achieved with a seductive wake of gourmand, and woody notes, which release the passionate character of the woman.

The delicate seduction of rose, musk and sandalwood, infused with playful notes of peony, magnolia and peach, with trails of fresh bergamot, and anise exude ultra femininity. Created especially for her, this precious Eau de Parfum truly makes an alluring choice that is pleasing by nature and appearance.
A fragrance full of mystery, personality, and sophistication. For the woman who is confident and shy at the same time. She is strong without being strong. She is you.
Coriandre is an audacious creation that celebrates the contrast between warm and cool notes. Its initial burst of invigorating freshness surprises with its somewhat masculine personality.
“Usher for Women represents a woman of mystery and confidence; a woman who exudes sexuality,” Usher.

Is it any coincidence if Edith Piaf sang that she saw life as being rose? This flower, with its pink colour, as a symbol of both romanticism and daring, has always played a part with Nina Ricci. Nina Rose makes for condensed optimism. The world of Nina Rose is at once tender and sparkling while being tinged with irreverence. It tells of an impertinent, vibrant femininity. Cool couture.
Ilía Plena invites you to always transform yourself in search of your best version.
Created exclusively for Harrods, this fragrance blends notes of valuable spices, tea and flowers with dark sensual woody notes.
Luxurious and refined, Blumine is an exciting, scent that captures the energy, passion and boldness of the woman who wears it.
Experience a new spring, observe the harmony of a park and feel the morning dew. Impatience is a dream in the French gardens.

Trussardi's Sound of Donna is dedicated to a fresh, new generation of millennial women; She's different from the classic Donna users in lifestyle; She's rebellious but chic, carefree, alive and sensual, with an underlying sense of glamour.
A sensual scent with a luxurious, powerful trail.
A charismatic fragrance for a purposeful, balanced, artistic young man who lives in dynamic rhythm but does not lose the taste of freedom.
A sweet, sassy and casual fragrance, meant for the young and young-at-heart. Have fun and live life to the fullest!

A woman in love is swept off her feet, overcome with emotions and desires that only love is capable of inspiring, to translate the emotions of this woman in love, Yves Rocher has created an exceptional, modern, and unique fragrance. Quelques Notes d'Amour is the unusual encounter of a floral accord, and woody essences combined with the sensuality of gourmand notes.
A sweet and summery scent to escape for a while.

For 7Flowers Peony, Jette was inspired by a legend, which tells of the night before mid-summer, when unmarried girls pick seven varieties of wild flowers from seven different meadows, then place them under their head pillows. At night they are to dream of the man whom they will marry.

Midnight Rose begins as a fragrance of gentle early morning roses sprinkled with fresh morning dew. Threads of warm dark-hued Oud anchor the composition with a veil that gracefully moves it towards the mysterious. Thus these early roses transform into a glorious night garden named Midnight Rose. A magnificent scent that lingers long after midnight.
A rich, refined perfume from the Indian tradition, made with Mysore Sandalwood.

Created around noble notes, the appeal of Hajj reveals sweet fresh spices, with a stimulating background of warm notes. This fragrance with its original scent transmits all the richness of oriental perfumes. Enclosed by hints of various woods and succulent citrus, this balanced line give the perfume a fragrance which evokes wisdom and spirituality.
Futura La Femme is a fragrance that combines traditional aromas with unique fruity notes for a truly unforgettable scent.
Thaty is a fresh and versatile fragrance. The pleasant predominance of lavender notes, combined with touches of greens make Thaty the perfect fragrance for use on all occasions.
Lirano captures all the freshness and liveliness of seawater, with the graceful notes of lilac, jasmine and hay. An exquisite, very subtle, never ordinary fragrance.
Feel fresh and invigorated for hours by completing your day ensemble with a few sprays of Urban Motion fragrance for men by Puma. It represents dynamics and fast rhythm.
The Excelsior Bouquet opens on metallic and sparkling top notes. The heart reveals its elegant signature, leading to a woody and spicy trail.
An intriguing fragrance with a powerful trail, Quasar Vision is inspired by men with vision who are ahead of their time.

Rose Alcane. Did it ever exist? Has it only ever been harvested by friendly hands this sidereal rose? One could imagine it so textured, so vivid, so real. Beautiful flower in a cowhide. A rose for girls and boys who do not love roses madly but who do not hate to be surprised. Through beautiful floral mechanics, the miracle of alchemy transforms, right under your nose, a super fresh rosebud into a metallic flower.

Created in 1999, LP No. 9 for Men casts a spell of powdered darkness with its complex heart of spices. The fresh top notes soon give way to the unusual floral and spiced heart. The seductive base notes create sensual layers of warmth and mystery.

Explorer Platinum captures the thrill and beauty of a journey to higher altitudes with a powerful woodsy fragrance. The journey to the summit is challenging and unpredictable, but perhaps the most exhilarating and inspiring.
Embodying the spirit of lasting love while captivating the essence of the ocean. Eternity Summer continues to evoke the feeling of a day spent on a far-away beach.
"What marked my childhood the most was the Mediterranean and the colour blue, the omnipresence of water and sea in my life," Loris Azzaro.

Inspired by the creations of Mr Yves Saint Laurent, Le Vestiaire Des Parfums Oriental Collection is a range of five fragrances that each evokes oriental inspirations that has deeply nourished the Couturier. In Exquisite Embroidery the animalic ambergris evokes a dark and opulent fabric embroidered by a delicate yet opulent rose.

name_perfume: All You Need Is Love Pour Homme
description: Light, fresh, but utterly unique. All You Need is Love pour Homme will capture your heart with its delicate, sophisticated composition. Absolutely ideal for everyday wear.
Avaritia, the essence of insatiability, opulence, and unquenchable desire.
The scent of refuge in nature, a family cabin hidden away in the Arctic Tundra where bonfires burn under the midnight sun, and tomorrow is a million miles away.

Exotic Journey is a journey for the senses, as exciting and exotic as a tropical island on your skin. Landing in paradise, Hawaiians place a garland of white tiare flowers around your neck. The surfers are always waiting for the perfect wave, mesmerised by the sunset and enjoying the Aloha lifestyle.

name_perfume: Eau De Passion Franck Olivier Men
description: This masculine fragrance is characterised by aromatic and woody notes. A diverse bouquet of powerful and engaging notes makes up the heart of this fragrance, which makes it hard to pull away from. The end result is simply sublime, giving this fragrance a powerful and mysterious sillage.

name_perfume: I Am Scotch And Soda Men
description: Inspired by relentless optimism and the power of self-expression, this scent captures the free spirit of Amsterdam.
A masterpiece in masculinity - timeless, effortless, and truly unforgettable.
The pure scent of rainfall has been captured. Hints of flowers and fruit together with sheer musks embrace the moment when droplets cling to flower petals and the world feels quiet, soft and bright.
"Enveloping and sensual, tempting rose expresses all the beauty and delicacy of the rose," Clément Marx, Michel Almairac, Perfumers.
Lyrd Sparkling Neroli is inspired by the beauty found in everyday life. Explore a world of floral delights with this fresh, vibrant fragrance featuring exciting, lush and liberating notes.
ck One Summer captures the electric energy and free spirit of a desert ritual. Bright. Fresh. Fresh. Welcome to the desert.

Beneath the fluttering blush of Liberty’s Decadent Blooms print lies a feast of roses and peonies, so generous that even the most gentle of taps could ignite a kaleidoscope of scarlet confetti. Be beguiled by this rich and mysterious floral scent with notes of hot saffron, patchouli and smouldering wood, guaranteed to make a statement.

Do It For Love translates Linda Fargo's exuberant style and contagious charisma into an unusual blend: a vetiver au feminine, in which vetiver's bold energy is rounded off with a sensual, floral kiss.

England Cashmere wafts like a breeze through the dunes of a desert. The fragrance seduces with classic Middle Eastern incense notes topping a heart of mysterious oud and the sweetness and depth of amber. The lingering soft musky base notes leave a final memory of the sweet seduction.
"'If I told you that I love you, would you hold it against me? My father wrote this note to my mother, which he ran in the newspaper and signed 'Love, Relentless.'" — Tory Burch
This is a juicy fragrance with an earthy, sensual trail.
Fine raindrops fall softly and slowly from the sky. The fresh green of plants and meadows glisten, wetted by the sky's last gentle drops. A light mist rises, leaving a faint breath of clear air.
A warm, welcoming embrace of the senses creating a timeless harmony.
A unique essence, one which was inspired by the most iconic fruit, Turkish Cherry. Beyond the essence, the red bottle eludes to a glamorous diva moment.
An irresistible fragrance with refreshing notes of peach and pineapple followed by a sensual touch of jasmine.

Nothing can harm you. Nothing can drag you down. When your strength is unlimited, it comes from the deepest, most fearless heart. Looking hard into the eyes of your future, you are steady and master it. It kneels before you, in awe. The allure of Rose Rebelle Respawn is boundless. Sophia Grojsman's iconic fragrance returns, its femininity and daring irrepressible.

Passion Fruit is a modern fragrance with a touch of fresh naturalness. It is part of the Museum Collection, which uses classic raw materials and olfactory families from Europe and Asia, reminiscent of the fragrance library of an ancient perfumer.
Distilling the youthful purity of the scent's original concept in a lighter and fresher interpretation.

name_perfume: Profumi D'Amore : Un Amore Eterno Parfum
description: Un Amore Eterno, from the Profumi d'Amore collection, evokes a different chapter of a love story, from the very first moment to the ending, with a love affair that lasts forever. A passionate love letter in a fragrant form.

A bow is a traditional gesture of respect in the past centuries, in most cases, it was made by women, but also in the courtiers in Europe, men and women, made it facing a noble. Nowadays, the bow is reserved for princes and princesses, the aristocratic society, keeping alive and on some occasions, this tradition.
Wonderful and rare.

"Through Dylan Purple, I felt the need to give back to Italy what it had given me in the past: a simple, pure, unadorned happiness. I created this fragrance as an invitation to travel," Christophe Raynaud, Perfumer.

The chic simplicity of soap bubbles and cleanliness captured in a bottle. An ultra-fresh fragrance like no other. Some néroli, a light floral touch, a sillage empowered by radiant musks that bring velvet and comfort by melting on your skin. Et Voilà! A perfume imagined as a feel-good gesture only for you, a must-have for your everyday routine!
Seduction has been brought up to date with Gala De Dia. A fragrance for the woman who knows how to keep up with the times; a woman who can turn the day into a fiesta for the senses.

A delightful fragrance inspired by Catherine Middleton, the future wife of Prince William. Daisy Sapphire, a simple, sophisticated and beautiful spring flower with a striking bright yellow centre surrounded by white petals.
Slowly I wake up, your arms around me, The Mountain Standing Still.

A juicy bittersweet opening combining for an enchanting opening to this fragrance. The narcotic bouquet of white flowers make for a beautiful blooming heart, while comforting notes in the base round off to create a deliciously warm feminine scent.
Created for lovers of wide-open spaces with no interest in the superfluous and a heart as gentle as a peaceful oasis. Désert embodies natural virility.

East and West collide. Between decadence and sophistication. Opulence and creativity. Inspired by the magnificent beauty of Babylon and a futuristic east, this scent evokes the most exclusive ingredients sublimated like diamonds from the Place Vendome.

As the sun set on the beach, they were all together again. Full of emotions, they could not stop talking. Had it really been so long? They shared many memories and another round of French 75s with laughter and tears in their eyes. No one wanted the night to end. As the sun rose, it was a sparkling moment of absolute friendship.
Celebrate the night away with this luminous scent for the sensual woman.

name_perfume: The One For Men Eau De Toilette
description: The One For Men concentrates on elegance and sensuality. A fragrance that is both classic and modern, vibrant and engaging. A real man's fragrance that women will adore.
Bring out the free, powerful, and exotic lover you are with Mastani.
The unexpected can be surprising. Every contagious vibe of a sunset party in an irresistible male fragrance.

As the sky grows dark, emerge from the long shadows with a fragrance that’s surprising, stunning and spontaneous. Wear it for vibrant wafts of fragrance all night with a long-lasting scent that evolves with you.
This is a sweet and rich velvety scent.
A fragrant love story, full of ecstasy and passion, told with a sensual combination of subtle floral notes with vibrant accents of fruity freshness.
For tobacco lovers.
Amber Italy is a wonderful scent with a captivating trail.

This menswear essential, with its legendary sleek design, now showcases its olfactory image and likeness. Daring Saffiano explores the powerful contrast of urban tailored leather with a sensual grain’s sheen and rose geranium leaf. The mark of an authentically forceful identity.
Lying down on a lawn feeling small in the immensity of the world a green accord in the nose, a flock of butterflies passes by while moving fluffy clouds reveal gashes of blue sky.

Divine celebrates a unique version of femininity: plural, sensual, free, and more necessary than ever. Outrageously chic. Audaciously daring. Divinely feminine. “Be yourself! But not like that!” Since the beginning of time, society has been telling women how to behave and be a woman. Glorifying every aspect of femininity, and embracing the richness of being different, the Gaultier Divine women are freeing themselves from the clichés of gender and celebrating their uniqueness. Sexies, rebellious, human, divines, these living, breathing goddesses seamlessly combine uniqueness and otherness in a single corset. That’s the effect of this utterly inimitable, sunny eau de parfum once it gets in contact with the skin. Surprising, addictive, captivating, simply divine.

Refreshing and profound, Eau de Guerlain is the "Rite of Spring" that heralds the arrival of a hot, fragrant summer. By giving it his name in 1974, Jean-Paul Guerlain chose simplicity and pushed this Eau to perfection. Clear and luminous, it brings to mind the sunny region of Provence and fresh summer fountains.
Summer rains are like compliments, they arrive without warning.
l’Éclat travels along with different notes of a fragrant universe, leaving behind a uniquely scented footprint that is elusive as well as captivating.
The power of paradox. Ready to face any challenge, this eau de toilette with a radically different aromatic trail highlights the wearer's originality.
A sensual ritual. Warm fruits and exotic flowers combine to create the rich, velvety scent of Sake.
A refreshing yet sensual scent for the elegant woman.

You like your impulses. They make you think less. You're a fast decision-maker, a man of the now, a man of instincts. You like the extreme, it makes you feel alive. It makes you feel at home. Absolute Intense is your fragrance.
Bottled paradise, where islands meet clouds, enveloping your senses in ecstasy and revealing the soul of Dominant.
A charming and elegant allure.

"I sculpted this composition so that it provides contrasts, evoking a landscape of orange trees warmed by the sun and the rippling water of the Alhambra canals. The soul of this creation lies in the South and releases a delicate scent of orange blossom spiked with myrtle and cypress," François Demachy, Perfumer-Creator.

Vetyver by Chantecaille. A fresh, free, ripe and clean fragrance. Just as appealing for men as for women. It is an incredibly chic and distinctive easy-to-wear fragrance. A bright, morning fragrance, it elegantly lingers through the day, deepening as a warm, sexy, evening fragrance. Ultra-fine and elegant.
The perfume is deep and powerful like the engine of a Ferrari, with red tones which add to the strength of the fragrance.
A fragrance that celebrates the floral richness of the region and the way it has inspired French perfumery through the ages.
A scent that smells like a light, bright and playful citrus celebration.

As the sun sets, jasmine wakes while others sleep, revealing dainty, star like, petals to the twinkling night sky. The breeze of the night sweeps its rich aromatic and sweet floral scent to surrounding areas bringing hope to those that are sleeping and reminding them of its many different meanings: Renewal, love and purity.

"Alien Man opens a unique era to reveal a masculine alter ego, almost divine yet so human, on a quest for light and the absolute. This hero is the promise of an irresistible adventure combining strength and completeness." Thierry Mugler
Bella Donna Rosa is a delicate, invigorating scent aimed at women who go their own way confidently, cheerfully and calmly.

A Forgotten Rose Oil is inspired by the art of alchemy and fragrance-making, formulated to be layered and blended together to create a unique, personalized fragrance combination. Built around a hero ingredient linked to the distinctive codes of the House, each scent can be magnified, muted or fused with other fragrances from the luxury collection to create a one-of-a-kind sillage

name_perfume: Dark Amber & Ginger Lily Cologne Intense
description: Dark Amber and Ginger Lily's combination of unique spices and flowers has been designed to cleanse the senses and encourage calmness, relaxation and positive thought, making it the perfect scent to use from early evening through to night.

In 1926 Fragonard perfumery was born in the pretty town of Grasse, renowned for its fields of flowers and its microclimate. In 2016 we are celebrating Fragonard's anniversary, and taking the opportunity to present you with its Fleur d'Oranger Intense.

Dance, dance, dance! Flash. Until the night is young, until the shiver goes down the spine. Music, beats, head over heels all around. Vertigo, can you feel it? The fragrant juice of the nights out: bold, seducing, mind-blowing.
Cerruti Image embodies a fragrance, an ethic, a lifestyle and a statement for the future. It also captures the spirit of Nino Cerruti and the modern man's sense of adventure and quest for freedom…

“I wanted to create a scent that was very feminine, with a very soft, romantic background like Tolstoy's legendary heroine. I was also inspired by the legend of a special flower train which went from the South of France to the Winter Palace to deliver fresh flowers, bringing warmth and the scent of sunshine to Russia. I always imagined how that train would have smelt and the trail it would have left behind and how it would have stayed in one's memory, much like the scent of Karenina would have stayed in the minds of the man who loved her,” Roja Dove.

name_perfume: Tea Time À Paris : Macaron Amande
description: Treat yourself to a fragrance that will make you stand out in every situation.
Besides perfuming the body, Nativa Spa Quinoa splash also helps in hydrating the skin throughout the day.
This Eau de Rocaille has a radiantly fresh and delectable fragrance.

As a child, Yves Coueslant, one of Diptyque’s founders, spent his summers in Do Son, in Along Bay. The sea breeze carried the heady and spicy scent of tuberoses. Do Son has the delicateness and persistence of a memory from a childhood in Indochina: the memory of a flower, between lightness and delight.
A pleasant, expressive fragrant that will perfectly emphasise your femininity and sensual nature.
Infinite Touch is the link between present and past, it becomes emotion, evokes memories, transforming into an olfactory creation that transcends all barriers: it is timeless, unisex, and unique.

ingredients: ['Vetiver', 'Tonka Bean', 'Juniper Berries', 'Ambergris', 'Cypriol / Nagarmota', 'Amber', 'Incense / Olibanum', 'Vanilla', 'Bergamot', 'Caramel', 'Coriander', 'Geranium', 'Iris / Orris', 'Jasmine', 'Lavender', 'Lemon', 'Mandarin', 'Musk', 'Patchouli', 'Pink Pepper', 'Rose', 'Tobacco Leaf']
description: New York City in the spring may be the most magical place in the world. For once a year, the electric bustle of the city is balanced with delightfully mild temperatures, gentle sunshine, and a fresh breeze that draws even the most cynical city dwellers out into New York's beautiful and far-flung public spaces, now teeming with the energy of new life.

The fire that lights a passionate fable. Oud wood that, when burnt, spreads a halo of aromatic smoke which awakens the power of seduction in the soul. Fire is what triggers the spell, captures desire and transforms it into passion.
Capture the wonder and lightheartedness of summer with Biotherm's Eau Soleil.

A cherished value, a universal principle at the core of what it means to be a decent person, respect sits at the heart of this fragrance by David Beckham. Respect is a multi-faceted fragrance that evokes the richness of the forest after a bright autumnal day.
"I wanted to create a fragrance that sent a message of freshness, that made you feel good," Lucas Sieuzac, Perfumer.

Man.Aubusson is a classical fragrance with a contemporary edge. The core notes evoke sophistication and elegance, leading into a dark and masculine signature. The Man.Aubusson gentleman is masculine, sexy and elegant, this scent was created for the man who never goes unnoticed.
Dzing ! is a unique perfume from both an olfactory and conceptual perspective. This perfume is a magical evocation of a circus.
The fresh blossoming notes of Cloud 9 express the optimism and unfettered joy of the beginning. Tradition with sparkling hints of modernity is the way to go.
An explosion of vibrant citric and colored radiant fruits. A tonic full of joy and life.
If there is a will, wisdom finds a way. Find your way with Sheikh Al Shuyukh Luxe Edition.
Cheer up La Martina Esmeralda, an irresistible fragrance.
An incredibly fresh and exquisite fragrance that thrills the senses and evokes an overwhelming feeling of delight and pleasure.

Authentic, decisive, determined: that's Tabac Man Silver. The fragrance for modern men who never back down, single-minded achievers who go their own way. Men are spurred on by ambition, driven to make their lives the best they can be.

The violet, one of the most exotic flowers from the African continent, became very popular in the early 19th century where it was cultivated in greenhouses and worn only by the very rich. Now a classic, the Santa Maria Novella violet fragrance has a sweet, intensely feminine and romantic odour that is made more subtle and less sweet than most other violet fragrances by the addition of a very green base note.

"In Venice, when a ball is held, an air of mystery prevails. Elegance hides behind masks just as jasmine conceals its almost animal potency behind a floral facet. I find that this scent has the powerful, nocturnal and sensual charm of a Venetian ball," François Demachy, Perfumer-Creator.

Boss the Scent Intense for Him is a unique seductive eau de parfum for men. Masculine, powerful, and memorable, the intensified fragrance features a higher oil concentration and amplified aphrodisiac ingredients to enhance the power of his seductive journey.
Take a deep breath: SUU…in this fragrance, Masaki's concept is related to life, after the water in 'mat; aqua', the element that inspired the designer for this feminine perfume is air.
A spontaneous burst of wild fruit combines with the exotic abandon of oriental notes for a rush of immediate infatuation.

A burst of sunshine with a nod to the exotic. This fragrance celebrates happy and carefree times with its uplifting and engaging personality. A confident pure perfume that does not overpower, but has an underlying coolness that is utterly irresistible.
Epitomising the modern, ruggedly sexy man, Jovan Black Musk captures a sultry attitude with effortless style.

There is no effective defence against the persuasive force of this precious fragrance. This narcotic potion is the most fatal of the collection, enclosed in a precious creation that will leave no escape for those who smell it and wish to seduce.
Immaculate and dazzling air! The purity of cotton echoes the virgin white of jasmine and the milky sweetness of musks and almond milk.

Isle of Man is a resolutely masculine fragrance, a celebration of the fearless and intrepid for those who laugh in the face of death-defying odds. It salutes the free spirits and adrenaline addicts who know that truly living means pushing boundaries. You're never more alive than when life is on the line. Inspired by motor racing, it stands for entire philosophy, living intensely, each second as if it were the last, even if it means coming dangerously close to the edge.
Princess Fleur d'Oranger is built around the playful notes of orange blossom for a delicate and sensual trail.

Sensual and feminine, Patchouli Blanc transports the very first Réminiscence perfume into an original and innovative olfactory territory. This fragrance, composed around white, the colour of absolute purity, is an elegant and modern perfume, leaving a warm, sensual and infinitely feminine trail on the skin.
Provocative and cheeky, seductive, she is a snake charmer tempting her prey with her magnetism. As she ends her mating dance with a bite.
Icon/Private 02 has an irresistible sense of grace, strength and sensuality. The true essence of the sophisticated, modern woman.

Born in the beautiful Northern Italian sunshine, our Bergamot offers a lavish, citrusy, soft aroma. Conjuring the warmth and elegance of the Tuscan landscape, this timeless scent imparts a sophisticated, sundrenched serenity for both women and men.

Black Forest is a revolution in the world of perfumes. Both men and women can enjoy this unique fragrance. Black Forest is indeed an unusual fragrance, created for people who want to show their power.
It smells like your best jersey feels.

name_perfume: Mesmerizing Oudh Accord & Gold Eau De Parfum
description: The burnished sienna façade of Talatal Ghar palace commands the golden twilight. Inside, a heady infusion of resinous olibanum, styrax and opulent oud swing majestically from gilt-edged incense burners. Labyrinthine galleries are fit for a King in their intricate resplendence. Delve into the myriad mysteries of Assam.
A modern interpretation of the aquatic freshness of this water flower, the nymphaea Stellata, which exhales its soft and delicate fragrance at dawn.
Urban Elixir expresses a unique vision of masculinity. The man of today embraces machismo and expresses how he presents himself to the world.
A warm and sensual fragrance, suitable for any occasion.
Extraordinarily relaxing and aphrodisiac. Tuberéuse Hédonie rouses the mood and invites the body and mind to let go.
Life is delicious, and it’s yours for the taking. Playful and feminine, Tease is a delicious floral fragrance for those who embrace life and crave every experience it has to offer.
Radical Brown is for the dark, seductive and handsome man who enjoys a daily touch of luxury.
A mineral breeze evokes a sense of crystalline purity: the pink salt of Punjab sets against delicate blushing blooms of rose petals, like a glint of moonlight on the miners’ skin.
Mimosa Tanneron is an ode to tenderness, sweetness, and the sensations of blossoming love.

Pretty Petals is a sensual fruity scent punctuated with very appealing mouthwatering notes . Joyful, sparkling, luminous… Dreamt up as a call to happiness, it's a delightful mix of emotions… For the women who are radiantly captivating and sexy.

A Girl In Capri translates the vibrant fluidity sensation that makes us dream about Capri; cliffs that plunge in a sea of endless blue… the sun that shines through the lemon trees' leaves and invigorates our souls.
Forest Spice is just the perfume you need to spice up your day.
Penetrate the mysteries of seduction! This new chypre accord is worn like a second skin. A mesmerising symphony that reawakens feminity.
Inspired by the most seductive summer nights.
Extreme by Horseball is for the elegant man who wears it is both virile and dynamic.

Sleek and sophisticated, silver is associated with design technology and ultra-modernity. Cold Silver for men translates this cool, clean elegance into a virile fragrance that immediately asserts its presence. An unmistakably masculine signature.
An explosive and torrid scent inspired by the lascivious rhythm of a South American dance, the skins brush against each other and seek each other out, in a sensual game of body to body.

Carefully crafted to create memorable journeys through sight and scent. We invite you into the Library of Flowers where moments are captured in artful perfumes waiting to be released upon happy whim. The perfect pick me up to nourish the senses and inspire the gardens of the imagination.
The perfect companion fragrance for ambitious and self-aware women who confidently assert their style and goals. It is an intensely transparent mix of floral notes that evokes romance.

Classic and clean, VS Him Platinum is a powerful scent with an unexpected softness.
