A solar scent with a refreshing trail.

“Fashions have done more harm than revolutions,” Victor Hugo., French Writer.
A classic, time-honoured fragrance. Enjoy the spicy aroma of vetiver wood with bergamot, rosemary, cypress and nutmeg.

Cartier's III L'Heure Vertueuse is a collection of olfactory moments capturing pure emotion of a stroll through a magic garden to breathe the enchanting perfumes of miraculous plants. It is a unique moment, an aromatic caress of the fresh, gentle green notes.

Seduction is the perfume of purity. Where convergent spirits meet and dive in transparency and deep intimacy. It is the perfume of the loyal lovers, covered by the overflow of love and the warm breaths of a chance meeting.
"Wild Geranium is happiness. It's a colourful, whimsical escape to a field brimming with wildflowers," Aerin Lauder, Founder.

Like an emotion you respire in it traces out a scented sillage between Italy and the Levant, between Latin palaces and heady, oriental fragrances.

Michael Kors Glam Jasmine embodies the woman who amplifies her evening with color-concentrated looks in rich, deep hues like plum and berry. The fragrance, like a fashion statement, is overly feminine, designed for a woman who like turning heads.
Hugs and kisses guaranteed. This is not your ordinary fragrance. Séxûal Sugar has aphrodisiacs. It does the flirting for you.

An unforgettable and intoxicating fragrance that conjures up a realm of infinite possibilities.

name_perfume: I Am Scotch And Soda Women

The iconic voluptuous scent in a 2023 collector bottle.

Cuba Winner is a real winner for anyone. It offers a strong masculine scent that is perfect for evening wear.

The first great success of the House, the timeless Eau d’Hadrien.

Mademoiselle Arbel in New York, is a fragrance that represents the New York woman, determined, active and elegant, leading a hectic life and open to the world.
A fragrance that celebrates the bewitchment of Aoud. Cooled by delicate citrus and fresh woody notes, you'll delight in the hints of exotic spices from India.

For the first time, Uermi is inspired not by a textile but by a garment, so damn iconic to become a paradigm of elegance, class, and luxury but also adventure, transgression, and desire: the tuxedo. A woman’s imagination runs wild, superimposing images of the ideal gentleman to an irreverent James Bond. Imagination does not stop there and keeps composing flashes of timeless charm: a white shirt, a glass of Bourbon, an aromatic cigar.
A solar and sparkling escape scent intended for girls with a dynamic character. An eau de toilette that stylishly emphasises their spontaneous and active personality.

The golden sand dunes of the Namib: home of distinctive myrrh trees. The alluring scent of its resin travelling on the hot air, mingling with the warm almond and lush vanilla notes of the tonka bean. Noble and intoxicating.
Magnetico has an unwavering charisma and magnetism. But be warned, it is a real scent of seduction with a feline look that will attract the eyes of those around you.

name_perfume: This Is Him! Vibes Of Freedom
description: Vibes of Freedom is an invitation to get away. To cast off. A breath of fresh air that fills you with energy and lets your mind sail free. Press pause. The vibrations of the city give way to those of nature. Because the Zadig & Voltaire man can do without the city, but he cannot do without its vibrations.
An enveloping and sensual scent that sublimates all the voluptuous personality of Madagascar vanilla is used to create this luminous, enveloping and sensual perfume.
Amber Oud White Edition is the fragrance that you need, the scent that is the soundtrack of your life.

Late morning. A romantic drive along the winding corniche down to Monte Carlo. A panorama of blue skies and ocean. The sun reflects off the sea and the air is filled with the scent from the aromatic landscape.
Success is an attitude.

"A jigsaw puzzle is a game of patience and enigma like the love between two beings building their life together. Time for you to seize the missing piece to your happiness!" Martine Micallef, Olfactive Director.

The name Eau d'Orange Verte evokes all the freshness and fragrance of a citrus garden.A generous and universal fable. A lively, sparkling, natural and playful style. A pleasant sensation of everyday well-being for the whole family.

A refined and sophisticated fragrance for an Essential man. The opening notes are a mélange of citrusy and spicy nuances that convey energy and verve. The heart is characterised by a blend of modern aromatic accords, while a charming and harmonious evolution, that finds its completion and enhancement through woody notes tighten in an unforgettable embrace.

The collection pays tribute to the grandeur of Chinese culture through the multiple facets and mystical essence of the unique scents.
This fragrance energetically expresses the enchantment of the Portofino bay, a picturesque and majestic place.

A warm, sweet, and sophisticated fragrance.
An instant winner, Wabar presents with dynamic juicy fruit notes against a lush, romantic floral bouquet dusted with just the right amount of gingery spice

With her help, Louis escapes in disguise. Many years later, he still cannot forget the sweet scent of her skin. She feels sane although Louis, the love of her life, is now acclaimed by all France as Louis Bonaparte: Napoleon III.

Birkholz presents Munich, an exclusive fragrance creation for the Douglas branch in Munich. This feel-good fragrance blends the woody freshness of Black Weed with the oriental sensuality of Secret Rendezvous. The result is a masterpiece that will keep you coming back for more.

Atkinsons Pirates’ Grand Reserve is an intense, bold eau de parfum, created in homage to the English gentleman pirate Sir Francis Drake. As adventurous and intrepid as the legendary explorer himself, its heady, intoxicating scent of aged rum and delicious dark chocolate will bring out the inner buccaneer in you, while your softer side may just respond to the sweet gentle notes of jasmine and heliotrope.

We are inspired by women who radiate light, who are proud of what they are. They know how to give happiness and inspire others. This is how this fragrance was born, by the unique light of women and the beauty of crystals.

An expression of complex simplicity. The fragrance was inspired by the sacred Hinoki wood that originated in Japan. White Hinoki intoxicates and delights the senses with a feeling of extreme tranquility. Its vibrant aroma is enchanting and transports you to a faraway place that is submerged in nature.

An exceptional nectar created for modern-day adventurers, nature lovers, and thrill-seekers. The promise of a powerful juice inspired by the strength of the ocean. Irresistible.

He's a man who has it all, excessively. Wealth and beauty, with his whole life ahead of him a desirable heir with every advantage that surpasses perfection. Clearly well cultured and an aesthete, his life is a work of art on par with his destiny and so is his body. A perfect physique, calm composure, and an angel's face to boot. The handsome heir cuts a fine figure, naturally with a gift for attracting women, effortlessly.
Aspire takes inspiration from the warmth, passionate women determined to follow her path. Aspire Debut. Be anything. Be everything!

At dawn, stars disappear taking with them the last whispers of a whirling party. I remember the sounds, the scents, and the colors of a dream evening. Twirling notes of an orchestra praising thousand and one legends are still ringing in my years. At first light, I recognise in the morning dew, its evanescent elegance, it's immortal beauty. Rose Sheherazade
Coach Floral Blush, is an airy, and colorful scent.

Inspiring. Individual, yet hyper-connected to the world, both real and virtual. A free spirit who seeks authenticity, you are the author of your own existence. You decide who you want to be. And you want your fragrance to engage you at every level. As a self-confident statement of your style. As a creative, sensory experience. As the lasting memory of the many exciting moments in a vibrant life. Be Jaguar. Shape your reality. Take a Stance.
Free your spirit with this bold and fresh scent for men! Be bold and succeed!
Just Jack J is a unique fragrance with a blend of contrasting ingredients.
Edgy, and deep, the man behind this fragrance is very masculine.

name_perfume: Always In The Mood Miss Gina
description: Our racy and carefree new Crescent Row fragrance is tinged with flirty notes of citrus. Everyone wants her … and many have tried. Oh, the things they'll do!
Désirée is a playful blend, as inebriating as the beauty of a young girl, creating all the harmony and liveliness that her gentle eyes can express.

A delightful blend of sensuality, freshness and vitality for the young and modern woman. The fragrance Cabotine Rose has a light appearance and at the same time represents the successful ingredients of the world-famous Cabotine initially launched many years ago.
An irresistible interplay of roses. L'Intense exalts the rose, capturing it with more intensity, more magnificence than ever. This scent exudes and reflects the personality of its muse.

The moon plays a leading role in conducting the rhythm of life in the Middle East, her ethereal appearance hailing the beginning and end of all festivity. Yet in Arabic, invoking the moon is also an allusion to romance. "my moon" is an adoringly grandiose term for one's beloved that speaks of beauty and eternal devotion.

fragrances: Floral Fresher Lily of the Valley

description: The tingle of citrus, the beauty of the lily and the softness of musks are present all at once. A lily floating in the air, in all its white purity.

"Perfume is the dream that carries me," the Perfumer.

A dazzling olfactory creation as captivating as a bouquet of colourful blooms.
Golden Gardenia is all about discovering your best self and delighting in that moment. Surrounded by the strength of others, you have the confidence to be true to who you are.
Moroccan Neroli captures the very essence of neroli in all its floral and aromatic intensity.
Layton by Parfums de Marly is a sensual and scented composition infusing ease and nobility into the festive and harmonious atmosphere of the Versailles court.
Dressed to kill, looking fierce, and turning heads when she enters a room, JLuxe is inspired by Jennifer’s love of fashion, luxury, and animal print!

Raaqi was inspired by the sophisticated and refined modern man. He exudes class in everything he does. When he sprays Raaqi, he knows that his scent is the perfect match for innate grace and distinction.
Feline and sensual, L'atout Charme will attract like a magnet. Let yourself be charmed by this intoxicating and incredibly feminine scent that intrigues and challenges.
A blooming and happy woman whose beauty is natural and sensual. She radiates and enjoys life. She is a serene person, in tune with herself. Her world is the family home.
Timbuktu is a unique perfume that combines ancient mysticism with the profoundly modern. It takes inspiration from “Wusulan,” a ritual used by Malian women to scent their hair and skin.
A fragrance with a strong personality and a true diva trail.
Like an enchanting walk through the desert, Vaninight transports you to the 1001 Nights. At the heart of the fragrance is an original gourmand scent that wraps you like a cashmere embrace.
A sweet-and-sour fragrance with passionate start, a sparkling heart and refined and majestic heart trail that will stay with you…

“I am at the seashore, I’m having a nap. Wild everlasting flowers are growing in the sand. The sun is blazing, the air is filled with a warm, salty tang and the scent of pine resin.” With these words, Annick Goutal captured a moment of happiness with her husband in Corsica. Sables was born from this emotion.
Intimate and embracing, this fragrance is the perfect symbol of a harmony of opposites.
Desire a revival of freedom and wider perspectives? Choose the lingering scent of the perfume Eau 21. Ready to embark? Ladies and gentlemen, this perfume takes you to the ocean.
The fragrance Lait de Biscuit, arose from Sophie Chabaud's desire to relive her childhood memories as well as to awaken the child which every adult still has in them.

name_perfume: Today Tomorrow Always The Moment For Her
description: Relive your most precious moment of love with Today Tomorrow the Moment for Her. This fragrance captures your most special moments with your love in a bottle and transports you back in time so you can live them endlessly.
Giovanna Baby Blueberry is an enchanting and delicate fragrance with engaging and sophisticated notes.

Amber Sky, the elegance of a great Amber, sophisticated to the core. The memory of a lascivious sunset on the heights of the Bosphorus, between East and West. The versatility of citrus notes sublimates its woody and gourmand notes. Its powerful breath reveals its beauty through an obsessive ascent, at the edge of sensuality.

Véga or the "star of the lyre", is the brightest constellation of the Boreal sky. A name that evokes mystery and exoticism: as much a theme in fashion in this Paris of the roaring twenties, capital of cosmopolitan elegance.
Elegantly blended, this composition of traditional Arabic oils provides a lingering, memorable fragrance experience.

As bold as it is attractive, Naughty Fruity is a multi-faceted eau de parfum that delights the senses and embodies features that are both a delicious and illicit contrast of aromas.

Waves of white foam break on the rocky shore. The smell of sea salt is in the air. A cool, almost stirring breeze. Above you, the sun in the blue sky. In front of you, the infinite sea. Powerful and relaxed at the same time. Natural, alive, pure.
Passion is the dominating emotion that we all surrender to at least once in our lifetime. This fragrance pays homage to this very emotion.

"As blond as a Swede, as yellow as corn silk, as gold as the sun or a golden boy or whatever else you can imagine! Let's do what children do. First, a child looks at an object. He picks it up. If he brings it to his nose, as he would this soft suede scent, it's in search of consolation. That's exactly what I want my fragrance to do!" - Serge Lutens

Walking through the narrow streets of Barcelona's Gothic quarter, if we let our sense of smell guide us, we will easily reach Carrer Petritxol, where the "granjas" offer us hot chocolate and its aroma fills the street. The smell of hot chocolate mixed with homemade sweets or melindros, making our taste buds vibrate.
Our perfume has a cocoa heart which is the main ingredient of this melted milk chocolate scent, a thick and sugary chocolate mixed with a creamy and sensual milk and cream accord that reduces the bitterness of the cocoa powder. Vanilla absolute is incorporated to enhance the gourmand note of the perfume and soften the power of the cocoa. A contrast of light and dark, of sweet and bitter notes that make our senses throb.
Sublime Japanese Cherry is a tempting and inspiring perfume that combines the exotic and the intoxicating to create a fragrance that lingers beautifully.
A soft, sensual, and velvety scent that is also luxurious and sumptuous. To have White Musk that means you have the perfect complement to every outfit, occasion, and mood.

Wonderfully rich and refreshing on the skin in such a pleasant way.

Ikks Young Man is a fragrance for young daredevils who dream of adventure and travel.

No name. No direction. Just an immaculate label, the promise of a story to write as your own. A blank page upon which your feelings may flow. Deprived of any indications or preconceptions, you are plunged into an unknown world. Each inspiration gives rise to a new sensation, a new image. You must only close your eyes to view the film of your own emotions.

name_perfume: Miss Dior Eau De Toilette Originale
description: Miss Dior Original is the first fragrance by Monsieur Dior. An avant-garde creation that revolutionised perfume and embodies the perfection of the couturier’s mark. "I created this perfume to clothe every woman in exquisite femininity, as though each of my gowns were emerging, one by one, from the bottle," Christian Dior.
Aurora is inspired by the unique beauty of the gently raising morning.

Silver Oud is an olfactory representation of Stendhal's 19th century French novel, The Red and the Black, and its intelligent and ambitious protagonist, Julien Sorel. The fragrance is a manifestation of the tension between idealism and realism, the contradiction between thought and feeling and the power of mimetic desire.

Hide and seek in an English garden. A bright sunny day. The air is limpid, the lawns are lush. Birdsong on the breeze and the scent of trees in blossom. The world feels fresh. Fresh for temptation, fresh for love. A provocative look, a teasing smile, and she's gone! Vanished into the maze, behind the box hedges, she's in there somewhere, laughing, light-hearted, lovelier than ever.

Glamorous, seductive, provocative, and daring. Charlie Gold is a classic fragrance, which creates a feeling that something exciting will happen when you wear it. It's a notion in a potion! Go, party girl!

Imagined as a floral dream, Girl of Now Rose Petal blossoms into a dazzling fresh, floral and fruity fragrance. A joyful trio at the intersection of this spicy and sweet trail paves way towards a sensory, romantic dreamland.
When the gardenia flirts with the jasmine, this is the expression of the seduction of the white flowers devilishly engaging.

This sparkling fragrance begins with a fresh citrus mix, infused with tender fruits. The heart is an intense, vibrant bouquet enriched with oriental notes. Gradually the base notes emerge, a hot cocktail of warm woods entwined with silk accents.

My Insolence is a completely new orchestration of Insolence with warm, floral notes. A delicious encounter that reveals your emotions and private feelings. This self-discovery encourages you to finally reveal a facet of your femininity.
The fragrance itself is exceptional and will leave on your skin a sensual sillage. An intensely feminine must

name_perfume: Green Tea With Mint / Thé Vert À La Menthe 2005
description: Our sparkling green tea fragrance with the addition of spearmint in the top notes. Bitter orange, cedar and thyme are as invigorating as a Spring day. Appreciated equally by men and women for its tonic green aroma that creates sensations of well-being and freshness.
Celebration for Him, a vibrant fragrance that instantly attracts attention. It's time to celebrate love!

No matter how high you set your goals, you can achieve every single one of them. Boum Metal will give you the proper dose of resolve you need. It only takes a few drops for you to find the courage and take another step towards your dreams.

Sven Strasser describes his elegant composition as a walk in his garden at 1pm. Carefree and cheerful.

Brilliant and uplifting, Al Barez Oud is an exceptional fragrance that has an inspiring composition of citrusy top notes and a deep mossy notes, further enhanced by the addition of precious oud.
Un Poivre is a disarmingly chic fragrance.
Egeo Hit is pure fun. An irresistible fragrance full of shine.

Woody, the spicy main character. Top notes feature bergamot, citric leaves and tangerine, patchouli, sandalwood, musk, and oriental resins compose the base.

Light solar florals spin together like rays of sunshine gracefully surrounding you in an aura at once pure and comforting. This joyous scent finishes with textured woods and gourmand notes, imparting facets that bring warmth, while still maintaining the airy freshness of the top and heart.

Kadõ (華華/華華) meaning "the way of flowers" or "the art of bringing flowers to life") is the traditional Japanese art of flower arrangement, also known as Ikebana. Through the freshness of the seasonal rainwater, a wave of aromatic tea and floral sweetness enchants and leads us on a journey through the traditions of the Land of the Rising Sun, to seasons well marked by cultural and ancestral patterns."

A unique creation designed to honour and commemorate the momentous milestone of HM Queen Elizabeth II's Platinum Jubilee. Inspired by the beautiful gardens surrounding Her Majesty's residences in the UK, this fragrance reflects the Queen's 70 years of service and the many she has inspired during her extraordinary reign.

Be the Light. Jil Sander Sunlight Eau de Parfum Lumière explores a new facet of this feminine radiance, simultaneously softer and brighter. Fresh and sunny, it sparkles with an infectious blend of energy and generosity.

Embrace yourself in the fresh spiciness of No.4 Sport.

We worked with the aquatic notes of the Aquazone® molecule, emphasizing a mineral hue and a signature of totally innovative strength, ” Alberto Morillas, Perfumer.

A fragrance to mesmerise your being. A splash to reveal your essence.

A wildly explicit fragrance of fleshy ripe mango, sun-kissed skin, and creamy woods. Inspired by sultry tropical nights dancing to cumbia, hot make-out sessions under wet jungle vines, and the unforgettable scent of a thick dripping mango picked fresh from the tree. A little exotic getaway in a bottle.
A cocktail of fresh and sparkling citrus accords. Salty and refreshing, just like our Mediterranean summers.

Megalium, an ancient fragrance passed down through the ages, from a time when rose water flowed from fountains, and balsams perfumed the lavish private lives of the Romans from their bathing rituals to their chambers and boudoirs. Opulent and memorable, Megalium is a modern interpretation of a robust time-honored perfume.

The Majestic Vanilla pays tribute to the first Oriental fragrance of the 20's. Emancipated women displayed a certain masculine style in the intimacy of smoky boudoirs, this "boyish" style is reflected in this perfume.
Life doesn't happen in the slow lane. Let yourself go, live life to the fullest and go far with United Dreams Go Far.

In a gesture typical of his bold and generous spirit, Jean Patou created Joy as a reaction to the 1929 Wall Street crash. It was offered as a gift to his cherished American customers; a hymn to life in what was a difficult time for many of his clients. Joy has since become one of the greatest fragrances in haute parfumerie.
Parfum d'Hermès is a sophisticated scent, unforgettable for it's richness and beautiful composition.

For its 50th anniversary, Etro has created a very special fragrance called Udaipur in honor of the "white city" that lies on Lake Pichhola in Rajasthan. Udaipur touches on several themes, such as the magical world of a royal palace garden, a spice market beguiling the senses in the early dawn, and the elaborate love story behind 1001 Nights.

Carefully crafted to create memorable journeys through sight and scent. We invite you into the Library of Flowers where moments are captured in artful perfumes waiting to be released upon happy whim. The perfect pick me up to nourish the senses and inspire the gardens of the imagination.
Puma Sync fragrance for men is a fresh and dynamic fragrance that like music liberates you to express yourself. Pump up the volume, pump up the fun and pump up your life with Puma Sync!
A sexy and refreshing scent for the active man.

An elegantly tender and almost aesthetic scent, inspired by the paintings of Casper David Friedrich. Soft as a breeze. The grace within this elegant scent presents itself immediately. Classy, steadfast and full of grace. Overlooking the open sea, a scent into eternity.
A refreshing scent that reflect the essence of the living with nature.

A night in the Sahara Desert. Even if the sun has now gone down, the sand is still warm. Slowly, it's cooling down, caught up by an upcoming fresh night. The camp is being set up while tea and dates are brought to the table. In the distance, one can see an oasis or a mirage… or maybe is it just the dream of a perfumer? Tender Oud is the story of a dreamed Orient: Alberto Morillas has created the scent of sand, stretching as far as the eye can see and gathering all the scents of those who have trampled it.

20-20 sublimates the spicy nuances of Black Pepper with the aromatic notes of Clary Sage to introduce a timeless and delicate floral heart of Peony and Lily, enriched by the refinement of Vanilla Orchid.

This is a story of by-gone times about a lovers’ secret encounter. It represents the contradictions between sense and sensibility, prudery and passion. The lovers are driven by desire but their education holds them back.

Be yourself. Don't worry about what others think of you. Listen and, when you have something to say, speak up. Create something, anything. But make sure it represents you. Step forward for what you believe in. Together we can do it. Welcome to Tribe, a community of all for all. United by the same values, we celebrate the genuine and fun side of life. We stand up for what matters: diversity, equality, transparency, sustainability. We do not give up, we are not willing to wait. We are free, we support each other. Benetton Perfumes gives voice to a whole generation with We Are Tribe, a men's fragrance that invites you to stand up and take action. Strong, courageous and committed, it aims to become a symbol for anyone who wants to feel part of something bigger. A youthful wave of marine freshness mixed with the character and masculinity of woods and amber. A source of inspiration that will help you achieve all your goals.

Heroic new heights. A challenge beyond. Woods heat things up, nature's forces unleashed. Kick-off for an epic duelling duo: the vibrant and vital versus heightened sensual power. Dangerous charm wins. A conquering hero. Every time.

name_perfume: Tenue De Soirée Eau De Parfum
description: On the catwalk, the then model Annick Goutal shook up her wardrobe with something new: a gourmand and floral chypre. Tenue de Soirée has the feminine charm and sophistication of her finest attire.

Fragrance is very important in the Middle East, it can personify special moments and most of the time it is still handmade at home, a tradition that has been passed down from generation to generation.
A fine fragrance, reminiscent of spring's first blossoms bathed in soft sunlight.
The sweetness of jasmine and tiare flowers encounters the energy of amber.

Fig craze. Beneath the bluish leaves of an age-old fig tree, carried away by passion, the heart takes leave of its senses. Gentle folly from the fig tree: fruit, leaf and bark blend together in green and woody fragrances.
Gigolo evokes the seductive magic of the Orient. This is a mysterious, enigmatic and captivating scent.
An essence that expresses sensuality, passion and joy for life.
Maserati by La Martina is a strong, sharp and selective fragrance. It is full of energy, instinctive unique and indomitable.
"You don't have to be born beautiful to be wildly attractive," Diana Vreeland.
Magnetic and intoxicating. Be drawn in by an alluring blend of crisp pear, violet and warm amber.
When Angel's oriental notes meet the lightness of floral water and a sparkling accord, sumptuous alchemy resonates with radiance and delight.

Just when we thought it had revealed all its secrets! Layton, with its chic heart note sensually topped by an intoxicating cocktail of gourmand and precious wood, already had everything: strength, virility, and an extra dose of seductiveness. Who does not dream of wearing on their skin the very quintessence of their favourite fragrance?
A spicy scent that interprets exotic notes in a charming and unique scent.

“Orris Noir was partly inspired by the elegant dignity and beauty of Queen Rania of Jordan. I had in mind a very spicy Oriental, but not one other type that enters a room before I do! The black iris is a very dark purple, almost defiant and mystical, but once its fragrance develops on the skin, it is not remotely heavy. It leaves a complex yet comforting drydown.”
The creation contained in this Extrait de Parfum was born from a journey of exploration, which the mind accomplishes through memories that come together in the childish dream of a fairy country.
An urban, vital, and refreshing fragrance that celebrates joie de vivre!

1976 Eau de Parfum is a fragrance of juxtaposition in an era of light and shade. A fragrance of youth, where light and energy were born from a period of change in the late 20th century. A positive outlook from a generation claiming London for their own. Fashion, art, music and culture created a hub of style.
City at night in bold colorful fumes: pineapple glow, magenta dianthus, iris twilight, tobacco, and black amber. Pair with loud music.
Sigismondo is a perfume with a virile and powerful aroma, able to charm and conquer those around you while remaining seductive and sensual. Ideal for women and men of a dominant character.

A mystical and seductive fragrance set to make the heart race and lure the wearer into a fantasy realm. A decidedly male fragrance created to reflect the fresh notes infused with a spicy heart, balanced with a base providing warm and long lasting appeal.
A fragrance that is both warm and cool. Unique, fresh and delicious.
As sensual as a second skin, Beso Dorado associates mysterious accords and energetic ingredients to create the scent of a summer evening.
"Déclaration d'un Soir will make the heart beat faster and to drive men to speak their minds." - Mathilde Laurent, Perfumer
A fresh, minimalist yet long-lasting fragrance that unfolds its delicate, woody chord while worn, bringing back the simple, small moments of happiness and well-being.

Be you. That's what this fragrance line proclaims. This B.U. perfume is designed for young and dynamic girls, leading unconventional lifestyles. A perfume that reflects freshness, modernity, independence and confidence.

A long lasting symbol of life, fertility and purity, the Mediterranean Sea continues to be a timeless source of inspiration for Bulgari, serving as the diving board for Aqva Amara. With its powerful personality Aqva Amara is an aquatic, noble and masculine scent that brings to mind the power and deepness of the sea.

ingredients: ['Lily Of The Valley', 'Lemon Zest', 'Musk', 'Iris / Orris', 'Orange Blossom', 'Orchid', 'Ylang-ylang', 'Rose (Bulgaria)', 'Jasmine (Sambac)', 'Ginger', 'Star Anise', 'Vanilla']
description: Inspired by intense, attitude-filled women who are not afraid to take advantage of life.
Imagine a frolic through the wood, the magic, and mystery that surrounds: seductive scents, flowers that scatter afoot, spicy woods reaching to the sky. The magic is no longer a mystery!
Peak offers an invigorating and long-lasting scent that is refreshingly sophisticated and vibrant. It is inspired by the idea of reaching the summit and is a reflection of ambition and drive.

name_perfume: Tododia Ameixa E Flor De Cerejeira
description: Natura brings an exuberant fragrance inspired by the combination of plums and cherry blossoms, which perfumes your skin and shows your femininity.
Kenneth Cole Intensity adds mysterious, seductive and spicy notes to your fragrance.
A fragrance enhancer with a transparent radiance that gives any perfume a certain, as the French say, " I don't know what."

Climat, the irresistible mildness of the tropics. A young woman strolls in the garden of a vast plantation surrounded by the bewitching scent of Lily of the Valley and Narcissus. Suddenly a storm breaks and the damp, still-hot earth soon gives off the deep scent of heliotrope and vetiver. Taking refuge under the wooden gallery of a small house, the young woman breathes in with delight the sweet fragrance of the tuberose. Then she reluctantly says goodbye to this garden at the end of the world where the sun is already coming out again.

Powerful and striking, true Divas go in search of their dreams, they stand out and attract attention wherever they go. They are real women who, due to their beauty and unmistakable attitude, win the confidence of everyone around them. Every woman has a Diva inside her.
A fragrance inspired by gold.

The Duckers Into The Jungle is an adventurous and exciting journey in search of the last splendours of nature. It has the same exotic and erotic appeal of a big cat in its natural element: the jungle.
Max Mara Gold Touch is a unique & sophisticated fragrance that evokes the sensation of clean simplicity.

Rose above all and rose again ! In all its forms, in essential oil or absolute, from Bulgaria and Turkey, an ever greater and more intense Rose. "Queen of flowers" for perfumers, it is richly conceived to satisfy the pleasure of the passionate.
Get into the boho style with the vibrant and spicy freshness of this young and light scent.
A complex and fascinating creation, ultimately feminine yet adventurous and full of spirit. Unforgettable and irresistible.

Designed exclusively for a glamorous woman, full of character, it will brighten her nights and make her feel very sexy. Gold Seduction is like an explosion of gold transformed into perfume, making this perfume sophisticated, elegant and irresistible.
Bursting with dazzling mystery, DIAMANT leaves a luminous trail of desire behind all those who wear it. Discover the perfume of this pure feminine jewel …
Demeter's Almond perfectly captures the lightly toasted, sweet fullness of the California almond.

It's an ever-imaginative scent, with a hint of green in the warm scent. The fluffy herbs are full of moist touch, and a little floral fragrance is used for pretense and camouflage. What is left at the end is a green, woody fragrance full of vitality, which restores you to a living forest.
Rare Passion is the best way to switch things up and create a different aura auround you.

Perry Ellis America is a sophisticated balance of power, warmth, and energy. A versatile, sporty scent aligned with modern trends, yet timeless and classic for that spark of nostalgia. Appropriate for any occasion and any season, Perry Ellis America is clean, fresh, and fashionable.
A fresh floral heart of silky datura and tuberose underlines the delicateness and the sweet glow of the stellar osmanthus flowers.

A fresh, radiant, and bright fragrance brought to life by the combination of citrus notes. The fresh spices blend with the intense aroma of white flowers and fragrant herbs, finishing with an enveloping base with a light touch of gourmand and sensual notes of musk.
Nectarine Blossoms is a very sensual and addictive scent which both you and those around you will fall in love with!

The marine element of Silence the Sea makes you feel like you are diving underwater and moving among green algae. At times it smells placid and then turns earthy, and I've often imagined myself underwater, touching the plants, visualising marine life and the smell of dampness and dirt washed away with a salty cleanse. It sounds a bit odd, but it's an unusual and wonderful scent.
Polo Sport is the fitness fragrance. A clean, crisp scent that keeps you cool and refreshed. A scent created for today's active, health-focused man.
STR8 Faith is an original fragrance with a unique aroma.

“The inspiration for L'Eau de Chloé came from natural rose water, which has never been used in a fragrance in such a high proportion. This is something quite unique and maybe even an entirely new olfactive territory to explore. The natural rose water brings something special which is quite difficult to explain, like a perfect rare symbiosis…” – Michel Almairac, Perfumer
In the most emblematic natural landscapes of Latin America. Aires de los Andes is the olfactory representation of the cold and fresh air that is breathed in the Andes mountains.

Summer Flare is inspired by the enchanting novel "Daisy Miller" by Henry James. The story of the young Daisy, an American, unfolds on her European summer holiday. It then explores themes of innocence, infatuation, respect and reputation, and the encounter of different cultures. The novel masterfully portrays the amoral, hedonistic yet charming quest of the good life set along the beautiful shores of Switzerland's Lake Geneva and the capital of Italy, Rome.

In perfume, as in music, there are themes that never go out of style. Accord 119 brings together in its wake a sumptuous diva, patchouli, and a rising star with irresistible freshness: blackberry. On the skin, it is an unforgettable concert!
Viaje a Ceylan Woman reflects the passion for discovering, exploring and experiencing new places. A unique sensory experience.

London's Kings Road has long been associated with the latest fashion trends, as well as signature classic styles. This scent is a perfect fusion, a classic fragrance with a contemporary twist, ensuring that Kings Road is the talk of the town!

Translated literally, the name of this fragrance means "longing", and evokes the Havana that exists only in a dream: an air charged with mysterious anticipation, a rhythmic energy pulsing in the street, joyful laughter echoing against the cobblestones.

Montblanc Individuel celebrates the soul of a man that sets him apart, that makes him unique. Some would say it is his character. His nature. His idiosyncrasies. His personality. But there is something more. Something indefinable, yet instantly recognisable. With Individuel, the Montblanc man is recognised by a confident sense of self that sets him apart. Going beyond conventional wisdom, he distinguishes himself from others through strength, determination and taste.

An olfactory shock with all the appeal of a great classic. An uninhibited, unexpected path. A powerful, fresh composition, masculine and confident. A radical creation for a man who is authentic and true. A provocative name with a “Dior” ring to it.

The richness of noble flowers, the enveloping warmth of woods. With Imagine, Thierry Wasser, Master Perfumer of the House, has distilled the fragrant quintessence of Guerlain's imaginary world to compose the exclusive eau de parfum that will be the scent of the Christmas season for years to come. For its 2022 Millesime, the Bee flies to the stars in a magical creation imagined by Parisian jeweller Francesco Truscelli and crafted by L'Atelier Truscelli from the expertise of haute joaillerie. A sumptuous piece of jewellery, hand-set with sparkling crystals and adorned with a trail of shimmering stars.

A floral woody fragrance with intense and warm notes inspired by the celebration for the love of life. "Love brings more beauty to the world. Therefore, without fear, without brakes, in full. " - Mary Kay Ash
Let yourself be seduced by the magnetic personality of this perfume.
A fiery fresh perfume that conjures a journey of scents leaving an irresistible trail of sophistication, this fragrance is smooth and fresh, with an intensity to match your strength.
The scent of London's swinging 70's. A heady scent from the 1970s, L de Lubin was a favourite of disco idols on the dance floor.

When Andy Warhol was planning to move near the Hamptons, he admitted to having chosen Montauk for the outdated and slightly kitsch architecture of the Memory Motel. This eponymous perfume is our burning tribute to those restless, turbulent times.
This fragrance is for the artistic man who envisions the world like nothing we've ever imagined.

Alfa Romeo Blue is dedicated to a charming, daring man with a free spirit and a lover of challenges. An invitation to travel and to experience new adventures. An expression of a free-spirited but truly masculine energy.

This fragrance, which name refers to the art of ”blending”, is an ode to harmony. In cooking, as in music and perfume making, the best compositions emerge from the right combination of ingredients and notes.
A line that draws on the strength and delicacy of women to translate into forms, and fragrances that show the contrasts of their dualities.

Earth and fire, air and water. A harmonious fragrance where the clear essence of cedarwood, warm and intense, blends with the deep strength of the volcanic rock. A generous scent which liberates the vivid power of a landscape where all elements are mixed together.

ingredients: ['Night Blooming Jasmine', 'Lily Of The Valley', 'Amber', 'Neroli', 'Iris / Orris', 'Orange Blossom', 'Lemon', 'Musk']
description: A marvellous enveloping perfume making this floral blend a symphony of elegant fragrances and memories.
Earth is inspired by the elements that connect nature, propelling life above and below the ground, from the atmospheric to the tangible, the visible to the invisible, unifying inner and outer worlds.
The adventures of Poliana Festa plays with that delicious time, the time to make the party. Let's share joys and celebrate our happiness. Living life always looking for the bright side.
Let yourself be embarked on the twirling wake of an infinite night.

Clean Blossom embodies a strong, feminine and beautiful woman, who has nothing to hide. The Clean Blossom woman is like a delicate flower petal falling from the sky into a natural spring, dancing on the water.
A wild touch and unique personality.
An intense fragrance, surprising and full of emotion for special occasions.

Impression In Black was created for the talented man, who knows how to recognize the benefits of his journey and values people around him. He creates his own story and has learned that time is a determining part of success. He strives to achieve his goals, learns from mistakes, and evolves at every opportunity.

An elegantly pure gesture of violet leaf is the first hint that this is a leather exploration like no other. The overall impression is one of shades of featherweight leather; treated here in a nuanced, ombre effect of tones that move from light to dark. This is a blend that culminates in decadent shades of black leather contrasted with a hint of radiant floralcy.

"As above, so below". Hermeticism is the ancient esoteric doctrine and the dominant pillar of alchemy. William Shakespeare was doubtlessly among the most prominent adepts of this philosophy and widely used Hermetic techniques in his works.

Sweetness, sweat on the upper lip, and freedom. Sneaking time to ourselves. We don’t know what will happen next. That means we can stretch out and take up this entire moment. Come play! We would have so much fun.

You like the woody, smoky and spicy scent of Tumbao perfume from Cuba and you want to escape all year round, returning from your travels or prolonging the dream. This perfume of travel makes discover or recover the emblematic scents of Cuba with warm notes, high colors.
This unique scent embodies a creative woman who assumes her flaws and mistakes, all the facets of her personality, which encompass her charm.

What happens when ice meets fire, when extremes come into contact? When an ice cube melts onto hot skin, when, suddenly, the ice breaks? Then the crystals pop and crackle; a tingling covers your whole body. Hot turns cold, cold turns hot and the sensation of erotic attraction sends shivers shooting up and down your spine. Mexx knows how to stimulate the senses with a unique fragrance captures this exciting encounter. Mexx Ice Touch man.

They had been dating for a while now, and the wheel to impress had been turning faster and faster. Both knew it was now time to switch gears, it was time to leave the superficial entertainment mode and enrich their liaison with purity and depth. The waiter served mineral water, but to them, it was like champagne now.
An exceptional perfume for exceptional women, as desirable as a precious jewel. It contains 23-karat gold that powders the skin like golden stars. Luxurious for your skin.

name_perfume: Falling In Love With Neroli & Iris
description: Found in the Mediterranean, in the epicenter south of Seville, Spain, where warm breezes sway through the coastal citrus groves. A crisp and inviting citrus scent that transports you to the heart of Neroli capturing the happiness of love in a bottle.
The dominant sensation of our version of Raspberry is bright, fresh and spicy citrus. It seems impossible to smell this and not smile. We've captured the memory of a perfect summer day in a bottle.
Comfortable and grounded in love. The scent is reminiscent of a big warm hug, enveloping you with the comfort of a Perfect Love.
Patchouli & Fresh Rose captures the essence of woody patchouli with the freshness of Rosa Centifolia, resulting in a long-lasting, pure yet sparkling and luminous scent.
Forming part of our Contemporary Classics range, the Blossom & Peach fragrance by Yardley is inspired by a diverse variety of flowers. A fruity, spicy floral blend.

A fragrance of contrasting sensations, opening with a splash of freshness like a powerful sea breeze that subsides into very natural harmony. Energising, and stimulating, it expresses healthy sensuality; an authentic and serene virility. Its complexity, however, suggests a subtle personality, full of nuance. The fragrant trail is particularly lasting and memorable.

The dinner had already been more than what was promised and they were in a good mood to dive into the night. It was still warm, and the people in the street had gathered outside the bars to feel the pulse of this chic area. The lights and chrome of passing cars was like sparkles in the black sea. They decided to make this night, their night!
An ode to sweetness and indulgence, this sparkling fragrance embodies all the freshness of childhood.
The embodiment of joie de vivre, bubbly and sensual: Impertinent sophistication!

High up in the branches of a tree, a pair of birds sing and dance with boundless tenderness. Sparkling citrus notes mingle with sun-drenched exotic fruit. Agapi (Greek for Love) is a colourful, joyful and carefree fragrance, like the inseparable lovebirds.

name_perfume: Pure Grace Nude Rose Eau De Toilette
description: Pure Grace Nude Rose is an airy rose scent inspired by the bare colour of nude rose petals and the clean, fresh feel of our beloved Pure Grace. Effortless simplicity is expressed in this beautiful composition.
This elegant fragrance has been created from mysterious ingredients; expertly blended with precious woods, and animalic nuances
A unique form of natural masculinity awakens through this refreshingly sensual accord.

Infinite Aqua was inspired by a drive along the Pacific Coast highway, the sheer expansiveness of the ocean, and the exhilarating feel of salty sea air on the skin. This fragrance delivers an intense feeling of infinity and invigoration.
Folie is a synonym of unpredictability, fantasy, originality, and willingness to dare. Stimulating, cheerful, joyful to the excess, it exalts the spirit and inebriates the senses.
Sensual and mysterious, Oud Elixir can be worn alone or layered with any perfume signature to enrich its sillage with an unforgettable powerful spell.
Expressive and sweet. Rosy Bloom Its notes inspire you to be your true self and let yourself blossom.
Le Mole is a unique fragrance suitable for men and women who enjoy the joys of living a full and exciting life.
Full of positive energy that will accompany you all the time, so that all our plans will be carried out easily. Choosing the perfume you dive into the depths of music.
This man is classy and elegant, simple but yet sophisticated. A man with such class can only perfect his style with Whisky for Men.

Under the moonlight a new garden blooms. The bundles of light that pass through the flowers reveal previously hidden colors, and in the dew that falls on the leaves, the coolness of the night is announced. It is at this moment that the Lady of the Night flower awakens and becomes the jewel of the garden.
Inspired by the 1970s British rock band Joy Division, which Sheikh Majed listened to as a teenager discovering London, Unknown Ecstasy is a fragrance with a truly modern twist.

Olfactory director Laura Slatkin was inspired to create this seductive fragrance after reading a story about Cleopatra. Cleopatra, ever the temptress, is said to have infused her candles with perfume to gently scent the wind and seduce her suitors before they even set foot on shore. With its irresistible scent, Golden Nectar captures the essence of this supreme seduction.

The name of this fragrance was chosen to evoke its originality. This is not a classical “patchouli” perfume. Lucien Ferrero’s guiding idea was to metamorphose this essential oil into light and elegant volutes that rise high into the firmament, making it ready for a tea with the angels.
A sensual and vivacious fragrance to blend with your vibe.

L'Eau Corail is a lively fragrance, full of contrasts, both fusing and smooth like the velvety of the peach skin. Its long trail brings you towards tropical islands drowned by sunlight and turquoise blue waters.
An energetic men's scent with effervescent and elegant notes.

Giovanna Antonelli, one of the greatest Brazilian actresses, is known for her contagious smile, relaxed attitude and elegance. This scent reflects her intense and powerful essence and is perfect for modern and happy women.
Lettre de Voltaire bears the legacy of an eternally bohemian Paris.
An eau de toilette for men who like change and wide-open spaces, for leaders seeking new sensations.
A refined and spicy fragrance.
Singular and robust, Esencia Elixir blends woody notes with herbs and smoky leather for a captivating impression.
Drinking absinthe under an aurora borealis. A fougère accord revisited with a surprise element of icy absinthe.
A refreshing scent inspired by the beautiful Nordic summers.

The word NUN is from Ancient Egypt and means the primordial water, and the god Nun. According to the legend, this water gave birth to the Lotus, a flower that hides during the night, and blossomed in the morning when the sun shone, revealing the sun god Atum, the sun god of rebirth.
A masculine fragrance that stands up to its challenge. Perfumer-Creator François Demachy wanted it to be timeless yet surprising, bold in its simplicity.
Evocative of wonderful fairytales, Banderas Jardin Encantado creates a perfect and mysterious setting for a new fairytale. A fragrance dedicated to elegant people who still love dreaming.

CH Under the Sea presents a salty and bubbly fragrance evoking a mermaid spell through the most vibrant ingredients. Romance, magic and elegance play in this submarine oasis where fantastic creatures meet.
Naomi Campbell At Night a fragrance that captures the multifaceted personality of the iconic model and reflects and draws inspiration from Naomi's sensuality, elegance, and glamour.

"Everywhere I travel in the Mediterranean, there's a sense of timeless beauty and effortless style. The beautiful blue of the sea and the vibrant contrast of green leaves with the fragrant colourful flowers create the most unforgettable memories. The Mediterranean is a very magical place and a great source of inspiration in my life and my work," Aerin Lauder, Founder.
This scent awakens the senses and sweeps you away to a sun-kissed citrus fruit orchard, for a feeling of intense joy.
Like our Rose Hair & Body Oil, Melrose Place's fragrance is infused with hints of citrus, flowers, and woody notes.

Shimmering and radiating pure luxury, breathing captivating sensuality. Closed in a luxurious bottle finished with gold, the fragrance plays in light shades of sparkling champagne. The bottle repeats the smooth arches of classic euphoria, dressing it in a captivating golden hue.
Cap d’Antibes is an invitation to discover the dry and shady gardens of the South. It is the scent of vacation and of nature in its glory.

It comes and goes, it never stays still and you only have a few seconds to seize your chance. It is unpredictable and appears when you least expect it, but if you decide to seize it, anything is possible. "A chance came up, I seized it." Mademoiselle Chanel knew that her real chance was the one of her own creation, a state of mind, a way of being.
La Nuit Trésor Nude is a luminous and authentic perfume, a symbol of sincere love, without filters.

Every woman has her love story. Love stories come in all shapes and sizes. Burning romance, unconditional friendship, unbreakable family ties. Sofia invites you to share your love story. To embrace the passion once again, and celebrate your journey: past, present and future. Most importantly, Sofia stands as a reminder to all women, that love should not alter who you are. The best love is one that builds you up, enhances your finest traits, and brings you one step closer to your dreams. Love life!
L’Eau d’Issey Pivoine celebrates nature in all its beauty, starting with water, of course, but also ushering in lush, vibrant florals.
An elixir of flowers with mysterious notes and modern elegance.
Indigo Valley is a soul-invigorating scent that inspires the boldness for new journeys and lifelong memories ahead.
Orange Blossom is an irresistible fragrance with a unique scent to accompany you all day long.

Imagine the freshest, most perfect watermelon, on a perfect summer’s day, and you can imagine the opening notes of Watermelon Blossom. That should be enough to make you smile, but because Watermelon Blossom is an Imaginary Flower, the perfect watermelon on the perfect summer’s day is not enough. It is just the start.

"The theme of Sel Marin is of course salt, air and water. I wanted to capture the scent of skin after a day on the beach. This is why smelling this scent on paper gives you only half the story. It needs to be smelt out in the fresh air to really make it come alive," James Heeley.
Boss Pure captures the sensuality and freshness of the pure unstoppable power of water.
Gold envelops and seduces with its warm notes.
Capture life as it is. No more, no less.

This perfume is inspired by a piece of amber resin found by Serge Lutens in the souks of Marrakech and laid forgotten for years inside a thuja wood box. A focus on the identity and authenticity of unique ingredients.

Tradition and innovation, this was Sergio's motto, to give new shapes but never lose the sense of what you are doing. Raw materials quality, articulated olfactive pyramids that over time develop their exuberance, simple and innovative packaging, but effective in not distracting attention to the true nature of the project.

A scent of stature and authority with an underlying tone of true jubilation. The rich concoction of ingredients nod to exotic far off lands whilst balancing a sense of regal tradition. Empire is altogether buoyant and full of character with a dusting of gravitas in its dry down.
The ideal scent for the energetic, stylish and charismatic men.
La Martina Rio Negro, a fragrance with an authentic and seductive spirit.

name_perfume: Je Suis Le Plus Grand. M.A.
description: If you are like M.A., you are one of the regulars: delicate and precise. This fragrance is for the involved, fair and conscientious personality.

Have a break and a bit of fun on a sunny weekend. Head towards Arcachon where the air is full of emotions and always smells nice. Sip a citrus cocktail on the beach then pick up some seashells. Put on some Monoi oil and run on the pristine beach. Dive into the blue sea and enjoy a sweet coconut. Admire the orange sun and the air just before summer. Head back to the hotel where you marvel at a bouquet of jasmine awaits you, then start all over again the next day and every weekend after that.

Mauboussin Pour Elle is the promise of absolute love. With its bewitching essences, it is a true love potion. Totally fascinating, ultra-feminine, it has been designed to excite all your senses (yours, his), and light up desire.
Live your life by the waterfront!
Black Line is an explosion of spices over an ambery woody rose, creating a timeless scent.

The luxury fragrance opens with a blend of fresh citrus and opulent flowers, slipping firmly on a bed of aromatic spices with great character. A breath of rare woods rounds out this rich, luxurious scent.
The magically evocative notes of this powerfully positive fragrance immediately awaken your deepest senses, giving you the impression of living life in your own secret garden, away from reality.
The soft scent of chocolate mixes with the citrus notes, wrapping you in a unique and irresistible sensation.

Or des Indes is like the rustling of silks woven with gold threads in the palaces of the maharajas. Opulent and brilliant, it leaves an undeniably majestic imprint on the skin.

The rose of course, but a black one! Amber Gris weaves its intoxicating notes into a rich, warm, and sensually everlasting scent.

Miss Mon Amour can turn the most boring conversation into the most exciting and extraordinary one. She is so authentic and quirky that her presence is addictive. Cheeky and feisty, she always has something to say. She is the queen of the party.

Rose Land Love evokes an image of giddy, beguiling womanhood. Wearing this perfume, Sistelle women will experience the world through rose-tinted glasses. Packed with optimism and joie de vivre, this fragrance celebrates sparkling, resplendent femininity.

Classic and versatile like a fresh white T-Shirt, 000 is ready for any itinerary. Let it shine on its own or dress it up with your other favorite scents. It’s the epitome of the casual, yet elevated aesthetic.
A classic in perfumery, the 1902 Tradition Rose Eau de Cologne is an essential fragrance. Thanks to its modern aspect, it is in line with the contemporary tradition of the collection.
Treat your senses with a Freshly start.

"Poison Girl Eau de Toilette makes the most of its effects. It's a suggestive composition that retains its tender charm but also throws out cutting remarks. It blows hot and cold," François Demachy, Perfumer-Creator.
Discover this floral leather fragrance: a true concentration of ecstasy with a lingering sensual scent.

Glow is Jennifer's signature scent. A pure expression of her personality, a new perspective of her potent sensual allure. The scent of your skin when you just step out from the shower: fresh, clean, sexy.

“Rose d'Arabie captures the voluptuous hedonism of the Orient. I wanted a fragrance that resonated like a desert melody. I imagined an intoxicating rose, which could take you directly to its unabashed sensuality,” Giorgio Armani,
Escape from your everyday. Indulge yourself in Daisy Daze. A warm glow takes over, spreading positivity, optimism, and good vibes!

With Tomorrow for Men you'll be ready for anything. Suit up in style, whatever the occasion, with a wardrobe of fragrance!
An enigmatic scent with enchanting, irresistible accords.
Cloak yourself in this warm, cheerful perfume, a spark of joy on a bleak winter day.

An enchanting offering from the Parisian scent makers, the decadent fragrance is presented in a captivating glass and gold bottle that will take pride of place in your collection.
Rooted in classic ingredients, Bergamot by Rag & Bone introduces a curious twist on an iconic scent. A fresh cologne contrasting vibrant bergamot with warm woods.

According to the legend, amorous intentions placed on the wings of the Ghibli will arrive as surely as Cupid’s arrow. I know that my messenger will be true because believing in a myth is sure to revive it and thus our love will be alive and well!
We are one, and we are many. The infinite freedom of self-expression. A clean, genderless, vegan fragrance that bares it all.

name_perfume: Black Rose Tea Eau De Toilette
description: “When I first saw the Teaology line, I immediately thought about a refined perfume to evoke stillness and serenity, which would be able to recall the tea ceremony and its beneficial effects. Black Rose Tea was born," Nathalie Lorson, Perfumer.

The strength of a sudden impulse, the magic of love at first sight. Folie d’un Soir dares us to reshuffle the cards, just like Annick Goutal, who didn’t think twice when she decided, one night, to spread her wings and leave Paris for London.
A mysterious, yet luminous fragrance, that suggests but does not immediately reveal its true character. A modern interpretation of the eternal Orient and A Thousand and One Nights.

A beautiful creation composed of a multitude of facets, FÉMININ PLURIEL was designed to evolve with freedom and sensuality, unbound from fleeting fashions. A challenge to time and a search for timelessness, the recognisable quality of major classics.

A cocoon of sap, soft woods and balms. Between fresh green sap and soft, enveloping balsams, the structure of Irizia Pearl evokes the pulsations of concentric olfactory spheres, forming a cocoon, of which it is the fragrant allegory.

description: Vanille Fatale is a force of nature personified. A beguiling tempest that takes over like a rush of blood to the head. The impossible becomes real, too good to be true, her-or his-unrelenting hold is fixed, refined yet raw, polished yet primal.
The feel-good power of colour and scent combined. The colour green revitalises the mind and body. Like the power of nature and trees, it will bring you balance.

Who is she deep down? A modern woman, without a doubt. Instinctive, driven by her enthusiasm and passions. Inspired and inspiring, enlightened and enlightening. A French woman - as utterly French as Repetto - who knows how to express her wealth of feelings and emotions through dance. Her graceful, pure movement is nothing other than an expression of freedom. Her energy, a declaration of life.

Close your eyes and imagine you are in the vineyards of Les Sources de Caudalie … where, at every moment of the day in summer, the colours change the light stretches out and nature envelopes the atmosphere.

Flight of Fancy is about the allure of exploration and the thrill of discovery. It encourages young women to follow new paths, expand their horizons and follow every beat of their heart. This fragrance invites them to open their minds and their senses to discover and truly start living their dream.

name_perfume: Carven Pour Homme Eau De Parfum
description: Carven Pour Homme is reinvented in a version that is magnetic and bewitching. Warm and enveloping, this fragrance is the quintessence of sensuality.

description: Inspired by ice-cream in Italy during the World Cup. Experience a rainbow granita!

Ana Furtado translates in this fragrance all its shiny and positive elegance. Ana Furtado Radiante , the classic female elegance with its own brilliance. A combination of fruity notes with a floral body and a background of noble woods result in a vibrant chypre.
Experience paradise with this tantalising fragrance, you'll feel completely at ease as if lounging under a tropical palm tree oasis.

Composed around an irresistible woody oud, this precious eau de parfum offers an unprecedented balance between refinement, radiance and opulence.

Sensual and feminine, this fragrance takes a fresh form, infusing a sense of fluidity into the sensuality of cashmere. The result feels like pure, liquid luxury. Donna Karan Liquid Cashmere is as sublimely lush as it sounds.
Inspired by ancient cosmologies and what is known as the “highest heaven”, Empiryan transports the senses to an ethereal state of calm and sacredness. A divine scent.
Awaken your magical self with Lyra Joy.
Love Potion brings calm and love to the Majestic woman who wears it.

Army of Lovers is a fragrance created as a tribute to Laurent Mazzone's love of the Swedish band. Dangerously eccentric, furiously glamorous

Soft Tension by Andrea Maack is a sensual scent inspired by a thick mysterious fog. Like a white desert, the fog is a place to get lost in and let go. Charming, elegant, and mysterious, the snake so majestically represented on the bottle, slowly approaches its victim and hypnotizes with its diamond eyes and breathtaking charisma. Its desire is vibrant, the danger is approaching and the seduction is taking place.

Kiss me on the Lips is reminiscent of the tingling feeling and the butterflies in your stomach when you kiss for the first time. This unforgettable, highly emotional moment is captured in this fragrance composition.

A decadent and lavish green floral. Inspired by a vegetal poison, it suggests as much as it arouses desires.

I had to lighten but not disown the fragrance, transpose but not betray it. Create the future while honouring the past,” Thierry Wasser, Perfumer.
A leathery and metallic perfume with a rebel character that transmits the social and manufacturing force of the Industrial Revolution.
"It seems like men's fragrances are either a citrus bomb or all patchouli. This is a hybrid, Hybrid is my favorite word, sexy and unexpected," Michael Kors.
A fragrance that evokes an exhilarating walk through the citrus groves of Sicily surrounded by aromas of neroli and orange blossom.
Rose, geranium and agarwood blend perfectly to create the definition of a prestigious oriental rose.
The chessboard stands ready. The spring breeze brings with it the refreshing scents of the surrounding groves. Checkmate!
Fiorucci Majestic Paris is an unforgettable fragrance that brings the delicacy and intensity of the flowers of the city of light.

Patchouli Intense is an intensively addictive bohemian perfume. Gourmand notes are imbued with a spirit of freedom taking you to unknown lands.

L’Interdit Eau de Parfum Intense takes the thrill to new heights. Deeper and darker than ever before, this fragrance intensifies transgression and turns it into a compelling obsession. L’Interdit is no longer an invitation, but an addiction.

Panarea: a small, magically bewitching island, both gentle and wild; a treasure trove of natural beauty and elegant glamour. The appeal of an age-old volcanic landscape which regenerates the body and mind in direct contact with the wild spirit of the Mediterranean marquis. A restorative breeze on the skin.
Lose yourself in a mist of aromatic and natural rejuvenation with 202, a complex masculine fragrance.

In 2011, in response to a request from an Emirati prince who wanted to give his wedding guests a sacred essence, Richard Fraysse began a new chapter in the history of the House. Paying tribute to its founder, a great traveller who explored the world in his search for the most inspiring essences, he orchestrated a composition based on Oud wood.

UEFA Champions League Champions invigorates your spirit so that you can decide the game with courage. With every spray, the eau de toilette inspires exceptional performance. Spicy and aromatic at the same time, the scent captures the tension-laden tingling of game-critical moments. Be confident and passionate, give it a try!
Take the fight with Born to Fly, a fragrance that invites you to explore. Daring ingredients blend to lift your spirit and take you on a journey.
This summery cologne contains bright fruity notes along with sensual musks, wrapped in roasted oak for a slightly citrusy, slightly woodsy scent that works well for both women and men.

description: The fresh breath of pure white flowers in a bottle.

Swiss Army Classic is the winner among classic men's scents: very masculine, fresh and aromatic, with just a hint of sensuality.
Enchanting casts a spell that will captivate and charm even the most hard hearted. Sorcery and alchemy combine to create a sophisticated scent with an utterly spellbinding finish.
Malbec Gold is perfect for the man who wants to stand out, enhancing his aura of sensuality and his magnetism.

Her limitless generosity defined her, but she preferred to stay hidden. With fire and passion, she secretly devoted every moment of freedom to the cause that could make an everlasting difference. Her actions would irreversibly alter the established order.
As a creamy floral, Belara® Eau de Parfum is a perfectly balanced, sheer fragrance with an invigorating blend of luminous florals and creamy warm notes.

'Yes, it is my tribute to modern femininity, an irresistible combination of grace, strength and the spirit of independence,' says Giorgio Armani.
An addictive and decadent fragrance, reminiscent of the magical fleeting feeling of the golden hour. A fragrance inspired by warm sunsets over lush fields of daisies.
Just one spritz of this deliciously addictive scent will tantalise your scent tastebuds.
Divina is a solar floral and fruity fragrance that represents happiness with a beautiful, sun-warmed composition.
Discover the power of a perfume. A captivating fragrance, from the bestselling Today Tomorrow Always collection.

An olfactive postcard from an island vacation, Isola Sol is a sublime art piece that embraces that magical moment the sun is at its highest in the sky, turning the scenery into a watercolour of orange and blues.
Irresistibly fruity and fun, for a feeling like you've just slipped into your little red dress.

Jimmy Choo's Exotic is a heady and sexy scent. It is for a strong playful woman with an alluring magnetism who has the ability to stop people in their tracks and leaves them with a lingering sense of wonder. She is a free spirit with the style confidence to wear bright colours and animal prints.

Made for the brave and strong woman who, above all, loves herself. Each day she meets someone who values all her qualities. Someone who says how beautiful she is, both inside and out. Someone who loves her exaggerated and contagious laughter. Someone who encourages her to overcome her challenges. Someone who loves her above anything. This meeting happens in front of the mirror. Discover how wonderful, fearless, and powerful you are.

Moncler Sunrise pour Femme is a tribute to the majesty of nature, to exploration and to heightened senses, capturing the simple yet thrilling emotion of the breaking dawn in the heart of the mountain range.
Havana is an intoxicating fragrance that has been formulated to evoke the swaying and rustling of Cuba’s one hundred different species of palm trees.

Nostos in Greek means the return. Here, perfume is the vehicle of the return to which one aspires in vain. Like an intense and deep incense that would have burned for three thousand years, the perfume celebrates the Homeric epic of that most beautiful of heroes, whose anger and its unpredictable consequences made the Trojan War: Achilles.

Lyrd Artisan introduces you to a world of authentic fragrances expertly crafted by master perfumers: captivating gender-neutral scents with unexpected combinations of the finest ingredients that are exquisite alone, but even more fascinating together.

CH Birds of Paradise, with its fruity floral aroma, embodies the essence of a tropical oasis with its blend of neroli, coconut, and creamy vanilla. As a member of the esteemed CH scent family, Birds of Paradise embodies the allure of an exotic getaway, evoking a sense of sultry excitement with every spritz. Indulge in the magic mist of this captivating scent and embark on a fragrant journey like no other.
A bewitching fragrance that will transport all little princesses into a magical world!
Less is more.

The classic scent is rarified with rich, sublime depth as the amplified concentration of its floral core is lavishly heightened to utmost opulence. To mark the 25th anniversary of Saskia Havekes' floral atelier Grandiflora, Saskia's perfume will reflect the interpretive essence of the store itself, reflecting how it has been for her, working her 25 years of floral magic surrounded by both the enduring and the ever-shifting redolence of nature's most remarkable perfumes.
This joyful scent smells like a bright, sparkling, sweet party pleaser.
Everyone loves your Facebook pix from the party last night. You're a key player in the Playboy network. Unleash the Playboy spirit in you!

A composition that creates confusion. It caresses the skin and makes your mouth water like an indulgent treat, awakening you with its freshness. Eau des Sens owes its originality to the very idea behind its creation: bringing together all the dimensions of a bitter orange tree, its branches, leaves, and fruit.

"What is nobler for a perfumer than sandal attar? Without a doubt, it is the most essential oil in the history of perfumery, with a refined elegance, an unparalleled sensuality, and an intimacy that I invite you to try." Lucien Ferrero, Perfumer.
Bois Bélize Intense is an invitation to travel to distant lands of the Americas. An extremely elegant scent with an original signature.
Night brings back the moment of desire and its musky flavour. When the night belongs to those who lust and love.

Sumptuous nights out, theatrical performances, masquerades and passionate scenes set the stage for this powdery fragrance on a woody base. A place to let your imagination run wild and be carried away by the bright lights, the music, and the heady aroma of this fragrance.

The wearers of this fragrance are highly charismatic characters, movers and shakers and at the heart of the action, right in the thick of things and under the spotlight, natural attracting attention wherever they go. An exquisitely sensual, carnal and passionate perfume.

Colors de Benetton Blue - a scent that promotes diversity, multiculturalism, beauty and optimism.

On the way home, the scent of the fig trees perfumes the early evening and the fresh, clear sea air already signals the wistfulness of the end of summer.
Yearn Woman by Ajmal is a delightful infusion of woody, fruity, and floral notes that will entice the senses of the wearer and all who cross her path.
A multi-facetted scent with a dark yet royal sense of luxury and joy.

Gucci Envy for Men - an erotically masculine and exceptionally enhancing scent. For the confident man who knows who he is.
Rare ingredients, daring olfactory statements and creation that knows no bounds. This collection reflects the freedom that only true luxury can provide.

Eudora Velvet believes that there is nothing more unique and true than being yourself. To inspire you, Velvet Authentic has been created.

A reflection of her romantic spirit and modern artistry. Taylor lives her life with an open heart and by sharing her personal stories through music, art and fragrance, she helps inspire her fans to follow their heart, to be their own artist, to do incredible things.
Beverly Hills Polo Club Sport 1 has an assertive style combining elegance and relaxation for a virile and timeless charm.

Acqua di Parma's Colonia Club offers the perfect balance between classic and contemporary. A fresh fragrance inspired by the iconic Colonia from 1916.

A burst of citrus top notes gives way to the wonderful freshness of a surprisingly light accord; a perfume that will appeal to both men and women who are looking for something exclusive, unusual, and unique.

Brisa Cubana is a vibrant scent inspired by the hedonistic spirit of an unforgettable Cuban vacation with friends.
Crisp addictive notes are wrapped in the sensual embrace of warm creamy base.

A fragrance created to accentuate and exalt a woman's personality. A superb story of femininity and self-assurance, cloaking her in a fragrance aura of delicatesse.

ck IN2U Her is the fragrance of a generation that has the freedom to connect, explore and enjoy without expectations.
