Thought-provoking and mysterious as a riddle, Kaiak Max brings a sense of warmth to spice up the breeze of the night. A mysterious fragrance that is revealed little by little. Ideal for the sophisticated man, who looks for outstanding fragrances and personality, but does not give up the freshness.

Bois Farine is based on the Ruizia Cordata tree in the forest of coloured wood found on the island of Réunion. The tree's tiny red flowers surprisingly have a starchy scent, redolent of flour. This scent is recreated through a clever olfactory illusion of dough like and nutty notes.

Yvra 1965 L’Essence de Flamboyance in honour of Porfirio Rubirosa is a seductive fragrance dedicated to the most famous playboy of the 20th century. Rubirosa was a jet-set pioneer, charmer, race car driver, and talented polo player. He was widely seen to be in the same class as Don Juan and Casanova and was married to the two richest women in the world.

name_perfume: Cool Water Woman Sea Rose Summer Seas 2015
description: As summer is drawing near, Davidoff reveals Cool Water Sea Rose Summer Seas, a luminous celebration of freedom and escape across the open sea. Time has come to weigh the anchor, let the wind swell the sail, and reach for this perfect moment of liberty and weightlessness.
Symbol of seduction, wisdom and fertility, the tempter of the Garden of Eden irradiates an entrancing fascination.
Warm, sensual and spicy, this irresistible scent has the aroma of just-baked biscuits.
Evocative of a romantic summer night, Love seduces the senses with a sensual floral fragrance.
The understated fragrance for today's civilised man. The most potent, long-lasting form of men's fragrance. For an unmistakably masculine presence, day and night.
Mirsaal With Love. A scent that speaks to your heart.
An addictive scent for the new generation of men and women. Designed to be worn as an individual expression of confidence, passion and determination.

name_perfume: L'Atelier Des Subtils Eau De Citrus
description: Fresh and energising.
A refined, masculine scent that speaks to a man's sense of elegance and simple sophistication.

At dawn, when the morning dew is present, the freshness of the fruity notes immerses us in a summer garden. Fleur de Cerisier is a fragrance that awakens the senses and the most beautiful of promises.

Get lost in a dream with this irresistible parfum. Inspired by blue skies, infinitely reaching and never-ending, Daisy Dream Forever embodies the youthful reverie and ethereal charm of Marc's dream girl. An elegant addition to the Daisy Dream family.

Using Candy's addictive nature, the fragrance elevates a distinctive musk scent by multiplying its presence on the skin. Prada Candy Kiss evolved from the idea of creating a loop of sensations out of a single signature note wrapped around the body.
Juicy, sensual fruit notes combine with refreshing liveliness - like a soft, soft hug.
"I wanted to reinvent Caron's iconic tabac by infusing it with the gourmandise of a deliciously modern chocolate accord," Jean Jacques, Caron's in-House Perfumer.
He has done more. Seen more. Lived more. Now he wants more. He is no ordinary man. This is no ordinary fragrance. Experience the ultimate luxury. Davidoff Silver Shadow Pure Blend.

It's a fresh and delicate Lady. She opens her eyes and slowly stretches. She is merry and talkative this morning. She sketches a twirling step, like wet petals of an imaginary flower. Looking up, she watches the sunrise. All her gestures are light. She gently closes the door behind her. At this moment, pearls of dew are still spread onto her skin.
Follow your dreams.

A daringly elegant, unforgettable fragrance! An initial sparkling yet tender sensation of sophisticated sweet indulgence followed by the bewitching character of the violet, softened by a sensual, voluptuous touch.

"They say that with five notes you get the lightness of a perfume, but I wanted to double the bet. And, defying the canons of perfumery, I asked freshness for intensity. So I fleshed out the classic citrus accords with intense notes. Because more is always more," Ramón Monegal.

The Land, Sea and Air trilogy represents a deeply significant return to the elements. Sea is the channel for our instinct, our attentiveness, our sensitivity, and our appetite for adventure.The trilogy is a tribute to layering: infinitely customisable, the trio can be worn separately, in harmonious balance, or in your own desired combination.
Autour de Minuit is a sensual, delectable fragrance to be spritzed on the neck to create a seductive, intense addiction. The notes in this perfume are shaped to reveal its mystery and addictiveness.
Jasmine flowers growing on an apricot tree. A tribute to white flowers warmed up by hot sand.
So delicate and pure for little girls.
Fougère Royale reveals masculinity through a powerful burst of freshness. The scent of an urban man who likes to take care of himself.

This seductive scent is a love letter from Juan Famenias Floris to summers spent in Minorca with his beloved wife Elizabeth. As the sun sets, the small Balearic island enters a new phase, wrapped in intrigue and magic. Immerse yourself in the experience and fall under its spell.
In Vetyverio, vetiver does not become totally feminine or masculine, it goes beyond. Like inlaid wood, vetiver reveals unexpected facets: sometimes fresh, other times smoky or subtly floral.

Inspiration was found in the enchanting décor of Cristal Room, Baccarat, Paris where sophistication meets modernism and a touch of daringness. For Crystal Room, the sophistication is brought by a timeless blend of lipstick and white face powder duo upon a distinctive floralcy. This unique association is reminiscent of Marie Antoinette, sparked with the unexpected raspberry rose macaroon accord. The rose macaron note brings a sugary “and almond-like rose not to the fragrance.” – The Perfumer
One of the favored motifs of the Art Nouveau era, the decadent beauty of the peacock is reflected in this exquisite fragrance. Perfect for those with a flair for flamboyance.

Get ready, here she comes! And instantly the rumor has it. Disbelieving eyes start to widen, and astonished mouths gasp. She fascinates, entertains, and provokes. And no one is left indifferent. While the whispers gather in her wake so does the sensual trail of an aphrodisiac perfume. Oscar Wilde once said, “The one thing worse than being talked about, is not being talked about”.
Happy life for the loving and caring woman who is focused on her family.

ingredients: ['Incense / Olibanum', 'Iris / Orris', 'Rose', 'Patchouli', 'Amber', 'Lily Of The Valley', 'Musk', 'Peony', 'Pink Pepper', 'Sandalwood', 'Violet']
description: Cabaret Femme is the metaphor for a stage where the woman reigns, more beautiful than ever, over an admiring public. This perfume pays tribute to the pure seduction that invites every woman to imagine a new world; a universe of dreams … Life is a Cabaret. The Cabaret Femme fragrance has been created for the woman who knows what she wants in life.
Journey is a light, sheer floral that attracts the woman who has a zest for living life's adventures, every day.

With its classical approach that emphasizes the vivacity and sparkling freshness of citrus fruits, this fragrance stands out thanks to its very modern composition and its refined floral notes. In a perfect alchemy of raw materials, the fruit dictates the colour in delicious complicity with a flower used as a light veil. Rose-pink grapefruit and rose, the subtle nuances in the worlds shift in the twinkling of any eye and… of a nose, the better to reinvent a form that has endless different resources.
With Wild Neroli, speak to the wind, kindle a desire, a passion that drives you towards your dreams on a path lined with flowers that are free and wild like your spirit within.
A fresh, bold scent for the sophisticated man who likes his freedom.

Radiating with light, Alien is an ode to the creative strength of each and every woman. Like a new invitation to all that is extraordinary. Alien Mirage. In the vastness of a scorching desert, a mirage entrances us with its freshness after a storm, giving life to an extraordinary flower bearing a message of hope.

Black XS Potion reconciles opposites, conjuring up an alchemy of bodies and hearts. The ultimate love philtre, Black XS Potion is the olfactory secret that beguiles and offers the promise of unending passion.

Misiarte embodies the spirit of joy and success, able to protect just like a powerful amulet created by the sympathetic magician Misiarte: the positive euphoria of seduction and boldness in a drop of perfume.
Assertive and eccentric, she has a strong personality, doing what she loves without giving up life's pleasures!
Fashion Oud is an ambery fragrance that conscientiously blends powerful notes for an alluring aroma. Wrap yourself in the exotic scent to suspend time and lose yourself in the depth of here and now.
An contemporary and elegant fragrance with the magnolia flower at the center of its composition. A fragrance of enveloping notes
An enchanting mystical fruity floral scent to refresh your day.
This perfume embodies the ardour and recklessness of an impertinent, fearless and infinitely attractive young man.

fragrances: Floral Fresher Lily of the Valley
description: Pur Muguet is delicate and slightly powdery, a composition described as a piece of nature worn like invisible jewellery.
Inspired by the spontaneous modern man that isn't afraid to express his individuality, this energetic fragrance has a masculine attitude that shows why he is unforgettable.
A soft, comforting fragrance created with the combination of rose and cotton, this body splash can be applied all over the body and reapplied whenever you wish.

We are all born with a spectrum of power, feminine to masculine, and it is up to us to tap into it all. Through our lives and upbringing, we learn society’s “rules” for identity. How can we unlearn the binary, embrace our individuality, and ease the boundaries of gender to let our true natures blossom? Unleash your inner god and goddess. Harness your power from wherever you find it.

A scent that bears his name – the name of a man who loved life: Zino Davidoff. A man who knew all about enjoyment and how to value the beauty of the moment. This scent reflects his philosophy: how to consciously experience moments of true beauty and true pleasure.

ingredients: ['Orange Blossom', 'Blackcurrant Bud', 'Musk', 'Lily Of The Valley', 'Rose', 'Green Notes', 'Apple', 'Pear', 'Spicy Notes', 'Woody Notes']
description: Experience a scent that exudes delicate, exotic and sublime femininity. White Hibiscus is the hero, with its floral expression and subtle watery notes. The flower embodies classic, romantic sophistication. The perfect accompaniment for the young Parisian woman.

Sailing is a sport with a fascinating history, its roots dating back to the fight against sea piracy. It reawakens the great sense of relaxation and adventure given by contact with nature and also gives a strong boost to sociability and self-esteem. Our journey leads us to discover one of the most historic and prestigious sailing clubs in Italy, which has its headquarters in the magnificent Gulf of Naples.
Feel the softness of La Panthère beneath your fingers and breathe in the warmth of its fragrance.
An ecstatic, euphoric leap into the abyss. Built of a fast-beating heart of rich and heady florals – Chasing the Dragon Euphoric is a fresh floral and joyous fragrance.
The opulence of Ambre Muscadin is adorned with mystery. Bold, charming, and naturally elegant, this fragrance radiates the charms of the Orient.
A fantastical interpretation of Imari, Imari Fantasy is a hypnotic fragrance that will mesmerise and bewitch you

A muse, an inspiring force. This is the Sublime woman. Her luminous face reflects the clear sky, her smiling eyes drink in all the joys of the world. Her movements are soft and fluid. Her every gesture reveals an innate elegance. Everything about her proclaims her love of life, her irresistible thirst for beauty and harmony.

A surprising Bois d'Arménie, plucked straight from the Guerlain perfumer’s imagination. Feel your soul rising with the clouds of incense. Feel your heart beating to the rhythm of guaiac wood. Languish on a carpet of benzoin and succumb to the fevered embrace of patchouli.

Give in to Temptation.The best way to resist temptation is simply to give in. An object of desire, indulgence, irresistible. For the urban indulgent woman who enjoys the impulses of luxury shopping. An expression of sheer satisfaction that results only when a craving that can no longer be resisted is fulfilled.
"Blue Seduction is a contemporary, stylish and masculine fragrance that reflects a part of my personality and that of my culture." – Antonio Banderas

The Majestic Vetiver harks back to the laid-back lifestyle and the creative energy of the French Riviera. It is in this Mediterranean setting that Gatsby's story was written and that the first Chypre perfumes appeared. Like a whisper of Belle Epoque, the Majestic Vetiver is tinged with an aromatic breeze.
For this creation, the enveloping sensuality of patchouli essence is sculpted with the honeyed sweetness of benzoin.
This elegant perfume for men brings a combination of woody and green notes. Perfect for the sophisticated personality to express confidence and status.
Leave a lasting impression with Forever Rose Gold, a timeless and spellbound scent.

Enjoy the refreshing vibe of Darjeeling's tea estates with this uplifting and subtle scent. It is the kind of refreshment you'd want on a sluggish Sunday morning or when the Monday melancholy strikes.
Exotic, powerful, warm, and subtle, this charismatic scent is irresistible, and magnetic for the most adventurous man.
Mythic is an explosion of enchanting, delightful accords.
An exquisite scent that expresses a mysterious sensuality.

“I wanted to capture the ambiance and sense of excitement and mystery that fills the store, in essence, bring alive the magical soul of Harrods and bottle it,” Azzi Glasser, Olfactive Director, and Perfumer.
Chrome Bois Precieux is an invigorating and incredibly refreshing scent with elegant and precious notes for refined gentlemen.
Light, fresh, but utterly unique. Elite Pink for romantic women will capture your heart with its delicate, sophisticated composition. Absolutely ideal for everyday wear.
Do you want to know a secret? Maybe Baby. This warm inviting fragrance captures a playful tumble of white blossoms. Like a wink across the room or a lingering gaze, “am I dreaming?
Remember the enchanting earthy scent after the first rain of the season? Take a trip down nostalgia lane and experience the same joy with this luxurious fragrance.

name_perfume: Oud Velvet Mood Extrait De Parfum
description: The creation of the Oud Mood collection is a tribute to the type of perfume that makes you feel as if you are wrapped in a rare, delicate material, one that is in perfect harmony with a warm, gentle, refined state of mind.

The city sleeps, but nature never does. This fragrance is an olfactory glimpse of nature's flourishing flora in close proximity, cheek to cheek, with the human experience of city life as the sun rises on a new day.
An exceptional perfume that reveals the magnetism and charisma of all seducers.

Not long ago, a perfume connoisseur threw down a gauntlet to me. He asked, “Why don't you combine two of your favorite scents, woods and flowers, to create a new and original fragrance?” I accepted the challenge. I chose the rose, the most mythical flower in the history of perfumery, and imagined its tenderness and romanticism combined with the strength and solemnity of oud to compose a unique hand-in-hand fragrance. – Ramon Monegal

Reflecting the times, Paul Vacher created "Snob". Sumptuous with a big personality, it is a fragrance for all trendy women, perfect for parties and gatherings. Snob has a floral bouquet of flowers to give a sensual effect. Spices bring the heart that is sublimated by precious woods surrounded by musky notes.
An exuberant and crystalline fragrance that immediately reveals a seductive blend of sparkling and feminine notes.
A fresh, sparkling fragrance that's also alluring and enveloping.

The desert, with its golden dress and night whisper, is the source of inspiration for an opulent oriental composition built around a Rose/Leather duo. Throughout, spices set the tempo while the floral bouquet illuminates the heart. On the skin, precious woods and balsams are softened by a powdery leather accord.

“In this creation between the sacred and the mischievous, I wanted to play on the contrast between the rarity, mystery, and darkness of oud wood, and the smiling irreverence of cherry," Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer.
Fresh sensuality and elegant femininity. "Nude is for me the essence of seduction and at the same time the true you. No boundaries, nude," Ennio Capasa.

A sunny and refined scent with notes of citrus wrapped and softened by citrus blossom and red fruits. Musk balances the original roughness of the citrus, while ambery notes give depth and body to the fragrance.
Asteria is a dazzling sensual perfume that stands out in the crowd like a superstar.

Seductive, oriental and daring: Woody Mirage from the Douglas Privée Collection is the perfect scent for all women who are drawn to adventure. A surprising, yet unimaginably captivating olfactory encounter that underlines the sensual, elegant, confident character of the Woody Mirage wearer.

name_perfume: Re-Charge Black Pepper Eau De Toilette
description: The off-road trek from mountainous Masaola to a savannah grass canyon. A spice-spiked breeze kicks heated earth. Loose rubble tumbles into deep gorges, shot through with streams. Conquer the adventure with our iconic fragrance.

Inspired by one of Rome’s most esteemed emperors, Augustus represents trailblazing strength and sophistication. Perfect for any occasion, the fragrance will instill you with a unique, laid-back confidence as you move from poolside to nightlife.
A sensual and captivating nectar revealing the magic of the East thanks to an armful of precious woods and vibrating spices wrapped up and sustained by a pinch of warm gourmand.
You will be mesmerised by the exclusive luxury of this fragrant jewel.
Dulled feelings reawaken, Classic 1920 is a fragrance that sets desire and mystery to rhythm.

French Leather Rose is deceptively casual, but not quite nonchalant, like leather that rises up beneath the rose. A sparkling accord that captures the heart and soul of an intoxicating Paris. Having a table of choice in a favourite café. The smell of suede. Talent. Just one cigarette. Lime. Knowing how to combine opposites. The glimpse of a shoulder. Kissing.

Inspired by the rhythm and vibrancy of Latin music, a sparkling citrus melody of lime and grapefruit leads to an exquisite heart of the blue agava flower. A sensual blend of vetiver, cinnamon and the primitive rawness of cacao, make an unexpected and surprising harmony.

Sana is a fragrance dedicated to a warrior of our times: an independent and combative woman, able to use both her sweetness and character as weapons to defeat the enemies of our society: intolerance, prejudice, hypocrisy. Sana is therefore a bouquet of great charisma inspired by a new concept of femininity: gone is the past model of a damsel in distress. Instead, it crowns the strongest personalities forged by our present world. The sweet base notes remind us of the kindness and delicacy that can still be found even in the most warlike woman.
Mrs Always Shay is a determined dreamer, nurturer and playful. Intelligent, brave and edgy she is your best friend.
Vanilla contains an exotic powdery fragrance composition with a tempting sensual aura. A beguiling fragrance for the self-confident and spontaneous woman of today.
Belle is a great scent, the perfection of a well-balanced perfume that will cater to all the needs of the user who wants more than what the ordinary user needs from life.

A flashbulb bursting fragrance inspired by the always famous shade of Ruby Woo. A luscious fresh start bite of mouth-watering notes pops, greeting your screaming fans as you step on the red carpet. A colourful heart follows as you navigate the media blitz. A gorgeous deep trail leaves all who beheld you spellbound and desperate for more.

From the fortunate and creative encounter with the great Russian artist, Kristina Orbakaite, a unique and unrepeatable moment of inspiration was born. Kristina is the essence inspired by the uncompromising joy of being yourself, dedicated to those who are able to pursue their dreams because if you really believe you can do it!
Puccini Extreme for all seductive and modern men.

Close your eyes and imagine being catapulted into an experience, where we could hear the colors, touch a fragrant flower, drifting from the rustling of the green leaves. Look beyond the leaves, the thick vegetation: everything looks green. Décou-Vert is released into the air and the green leaves room for a multitude of colors, a palette of vivid and vibrant flowers and green leaves. A surprising fragrance that will take your breath away.

The Iceberg White woman is not naive, far from it. Her luminous radiance comes from a personality reflecting inner serenity and self-confidence. She is a game of opposites: strength and softness, sensuality and sophistication. Her femininity is not a weapon of seduction, it is the very expression of who she is.
"For this creation, I was inspired by a beautiful story, the one of the Princess of Nerola who vowed a boundless love to the Amara Orange tree," Quentin Bisch, Perfumer.
Luminous, sensual and decadent, Euphoria Essence is inspired by a gleaming dream of light sensuality and mysterious splendour.
A lively and delicious scent with the focus on ginger to create a surprising and utterly mysterious scent.
You know that fun, free feeling when you play all day? We bottled it up into this sweet, joyful scent. Because play is life!
The hyper-energising interpretation of an eau de cologne: green herbal energy, white blossoms and cold stone. It will make the concrete flourish!
You never cease to amaze, so be a muse and shine with the radiance of the fresh fruity and floral accords of this dazzling fragrance.
Perhaps the magic would be written on my face; perhaps I myself was at the end of my search. The epitome of charisma.
801 EMBRUNS CÈDRE PAMPLEMOUSSE is a contrast between the warm and cold notes. An elegant scent, suitable for the refined gentlemen or sophisticated women.

Fieno is a bouquet of woody floral notes evoking freshly cut hay. The fragrance notes evoke the colours and silhouettes of the Tuscan countryside. Citrus top notes mingle with floral nuances and woody base notes.
The irresistible aroma of our Unicorn Fruit body butter, transformed into a more concentrated personal scent. Think: a captivatingly sweet, full-bodied scent for sweethearts with a seductive side.
An adorable and playful scent, an amusing and fun figurine is the promise of a colorful sage… a fashionable doll… So Cute.
A sensual and elegant Eau de Toilette that transcribes the warmth and power of the Patchouli essential.

"I wanted to concentrate on a rose for men, far from the romantic and delicate femininity that is so often associated with rose based perfumes. But I do also realise that it is worn by women. I liked the idea that the rose does not exist without its thorns, and that is where all its power lies. I was therefore inspired by this aspect of the flower to reveal something new, both floral but also woody and spicy." – Alberto Morillas, Perfumer

A unique fragrance that hides behind its simplicity an unparalleled beauty like the vision of a single flower that, strong of its unique being, stands alone in an immense expanse of grass. Intense, warm and enveloping as the passion of a first love, this scent is sweet with gourmand hints. A fragrance whose beauty and elegance are contained in its simplicity!

The wind picks up the grains of sand and tosses them back into the turquoise waters. Piercing iridescent blues dance on the crests of the gently rolling waves, casting reflections that bounce back and forth like diamonds in unison. The deep mass of cobalt gives way to a wealth of botanical greens and the sun's luminosity intensifies the fragrance of the ocean's salt. Arabia is here and here is Arabia.
ck One Platinum Edition is a young, optimistic and confident scent – it captures and celebrates a break from convention and the status quo. Free of gender norms and rules; it can be worn by all.
An esoteric and mysterious number, symbol of completeness. A connection which creates an alchemic, inedible, lasting effect in time. A perfume which narrates the revealed and the hidden.
Les Fleurs Rouges takes inspiration from Turkish delight, a delectable dish from one of the world's oldest settlements.
An exotic fragrance with woody notes, spices and musk.
A masculine fragrance with a fresh and sporty touch full of fresh energy.
The encounter of Oud wood with the preciousness of vanilla bahiana from Brazil, an ingredient never before used in the perfumery and which undergoes a handmade pollination process.
A perfume inspired by the spicy smells that fill the air around Comporta when we go out for dinner at Comporta Café, Sal, O Gervásio or Dona Bia.
A hypnotic perfume created for an extremely sophisticated and enchanting woman. Its delicate presence enchants captivates and charms. The enigma of appearances!

Accented with citrus from Italy and California and citrus blossoms from Grasse. Enhanced by spicy leaves blended together and shaded by fragrant florals from Provence. Rounded off by woody accents from the Atlas Mountains, by grasses from Bourbon Island and bushy herbs from the Seychelles.
Luna Absoluta highlights the magnificent black orchid and its singular beauty which expresses sensual, intense and powerful femininity.

Carbon Speed was created especially for the man who accepts challenges and leaves his trademark wherever he goes. The feeling of freedom takes over the fragrance Carbon Speed. Feel the energy, freshness, and adrenaline that come from speed.
An opulent fragrance that embodies the beauty, spirit and passion of opera, Grammy award-winning artist Renée Fleming.

The fragrance is designed for the millennial girl, a free feisty soul with thoughts, actions, wit, and soul that radiate a distinctive flamboyance. They are fashion conscious, playful, outgoing and have a refreshing approach towards all things life has to offer.

Faith is the fragrance of a woman who has many facets, just like a glittering diamond. She fascinates and keeps you guessing, but her heart is always true. When she wears Faith, it makes her dazzle like jewels in the sunlight.

Supergreen is an allegory to Van Gogh's painting the “Green Wheat Field”, which sets the scene for a Saffron-colored sunset, while conveying the scent of freshly cut grass and of yellowing hay. The fragrance opens with minty spices, strengthened by a drop of citrus while the floral heart delightfully embraces the finale of Incense and aromatic woods.
Timeless and elegant, Cerruti 1881 is a fragrance for a sensual and refined woman. She is confident with a free spirit, seductive with the promise of hidden sensuality.

She freely expresses her natural elegance because, for her, elegance is not something that you wear but that you carry inside. You just have to reflect it because in the naturalness of your style, there is elegance.

She knows what she wants, and what she does not want either. Nothing of maybe, or yes or no. Courageous, she runs the risks without fear of making mistakes, talking or loving. She learned from life the importance of being herself, and became the best version of herself. Inspiring and enthralling. This story nobody has, it's just her, it's yours.
Spirit Of The Brave opens a new chapter with a name that echoes the huge success of Only The Brave. It introduces a new kind of masculinity and bravery that is more unconventional and playful.
A modern interpretation of the rose that expresses the tenderness and sensuality of the woman who wears it.
An airy neroli note filled with sunny citrus and delicate white flowers evokes the scent of summer holiday relaxation.

CH Insignia is crafted as a symphony of rose and oud notes. The composition, while focusing on this oriental combination, is announced as multilayered with fresh Italian citrus, spices, flowers and woods.
An original and unique alchemy of precious accords.
It is not only a patchouli scent but also an exotic bouquet, a blend of dark wood and bright flowers.
Essences Insensées has been inspired by the Tiaré flower, harvested on the island of Tahiti and known for it's green notes and airy freshness.

Surreal Ocean brings a mysterious combination of pink marine coral with the creamy touch of the petals of gilded gardenia and the precious intense glow of the sparkling pearl. Dive into this temptation!

Twenty Nine takes the fragrance from our ever-popular Almond Oil Soap range and creates our first specifically shared fragrance. A distinctive and unusual aroma, this warm blend of oils is ideal for use at day and night.
Drakkar Intense embodies a great thirst for danger. A scent with an irresistible and addictive power.
Ready to get emotional? Welcome to Wake Up Feel Good, a sensational fragrance to enhance your mood. Choose your mood, bump it up, and let's go!
A fresh green fragrance inspired by eating watermelons. Full and moist. Crunchy, quenching watermelons.
A fresh, bold and alluring scent inspired by the spirit of the ancient heroes of mythology. Vicky Tiel's Achille is a true representation of masculinity, passion and vigor.
212 Men is New York: youth innovation at a dizzying pace. The feeling of being at the centre of the world. The 212 man is like his fragrance: cosmopolitan, sensual, spontaneous and sensitive.
Anitta Fatale is a perfume essentially made for powerful, striking and engaging women. Your bottle is inspired by its curves and movements. The fragrance awakens the fatal side that every woman has.
Inspired by the shimmering hues of the amethyst gemstone, this floral fragrance captures the myriad scents of iris and rose gardens caressed with morning dew.
Discover a luminous and fresh fragrance that reflects transparency and delicacy!
While this soft colour delivers a message of sensuality, the fruity, floral fragrance is an urban scent with a voluptuous delicate trail for the modern, urban woman aware of the latest trends.

In the early 1900s, a small band of explorers set out to climb each of the 46 peaks in the Adirondack Mountains. With only 12 set trails, the mountaineers were the first to forge new paths through uncharted terrain, inspiring thousands to follow in their footsteps. Rooted in the essence of adventure, Batch No. 46 captures the energy of the great outdoors. This rugged scent symbolises courage with a fearless drive to reach new heights.
The precious woody notes of this fragrance are beautifully complemented by sweet and fruity notes. A sublime scent for women and men.
Black is a supreme exponent of the metropolitan concept. Black is about shapes designed to be lived, shapes designed to be admired, shapes designed to be dressed.

"No matter where we gazed at her from, the moon had the same silvery glints as his hair, reflecting the years past. It was time to go home, to find his roots again," Maître de Claude, Perfumer, 18th century.
Musc Noir pays tribute to the powerful mystique of a woman's inner beauty and her innate sensuality, reinterpreting the codes of the iconic For Her scent with an element of intense mystery.
Let the invigorating and luxurious scent of Divine Royal bring out your most empowering and inspirational femininity.

Mandarina Duck's for Her and for Him traces an authentic generational identikit, where HE and SHE become THEY, a group of people united not only by age, but also by shared values and aspirations. They don't believe that an open mind is a skull fracture. They are ironic, active and great travellers, able to enjoy life and concerned about the fate of the planet.

"This fragrance reminds me of the month of September, a special time of the year, a moment of transition, a period marked by the end of Summer, and the beginning of Fall when the air gets cooler and wetter. If Patchouli Figue was a fabric, this fragrance seems to weave a cashmere stole on the skin," Marie Schnirer, Perfumer.
X is the crossroads in our life, where nothing is the same.
A unique floral freshness underpinned with smooth depths. A modern approach to style.

The fresh notes of Cologne enfold and blend with the fragrance of this precious ingredient, a mystic oil with balsamic notes and special smoky facets, that blend with the fresh, clean notes of pure cologne.
A tangy, woodsy scent reminiscent of a fresh breeze.

“That morning the air was cool, still damp with dew. The harvest was finished, the baskets were filled with sparkling roses just begging to be caressed. On a whim that morning, I scooped up a handful of dropped sepals, being careful to avoid the thorns. I raised my fingertips to my nose, the smell intoxicated me. An instantaneous olfactory journey, unique in the fields of Grasse, at day's end," Fabrice Pellegrin, Perfumer.
A dark and mysterious scent that celebrates the people of the night.
Prada Luna Rossa Black resembles an elegant tuxedo, worn on the shoulders of a strong man. He seeks sophistication in every situation - no matter how casual the intentions.

"A massive, beautiful oak tree once grew in front of my house, blocking our view of the Mediterranean. Eventually, it grew ill and was felled. The scent of the cut wood etched itself in my memory. The soul of the old tree lives on in this fragrance. The name Samarcande is an homage to the city through which spice caravans once passed on their way from East to West." - Jean-Claude Ellena, perfumer
Polo Red Parfum is an unforgettable journey into the desert.

During one of her walks along the Adriatic coast, Elisa Gera, the life and soul of Acca Kappa, fell in love with the originality and refined perfume of the Mediterranean seedling and chose to transform it into a precious fragrance, Giallo Elicriso: a masculine scent that exudes all the goodness, sensuality and magic of the Mediterranean.

description: An enchanting scent of intriguing contrasts. Enjoy a summer stopover in exotic lagoons with this floral bouquet.

Agatha Ruiz de la Prada has launched a perfume for dreamy and creative women. Imagina is a fragrance full of glamour, presented in a unique, sophisticated and innovative bottle that is inspired by a crystal ball.
'Why don't you' - Celine Barel was inspired by Mrs. Vreeland's quote, “If it isn't a passion, it isn't burning, it isn't on fire, you haven't lived!” to create Perfectly Marvelous.

Virginia Woolf's novel about a man who lives three centuries without aging beyond the age of 30 is an absolutely marvellous fantasy. Jardins d'Écrivains interprets Orlando as a vapour trail imbued with an irrational dream and a divine sense.
Oud Mira was inspired by an absolutely amazing trip Tiziana and Paolo took to discover the wonders of Marrakesh and its breathtaking El Fna Square, a world heritage site.

Chrome explores the Mediterranean and sun-kissed DNA of Chrome. It brings home the feeling of faraway lands and basking in the light, and offers an unexpected encounter between heaven and earth. An unexpected and luminous freshness for a man who looks for adventure, escape and well-being.

"To create the first leather in the Collection Extraordinaire, I decided to approach this classic note in a different way, by exploring the subtle leathery accents of plants. I immediately selected cistus, which comprises an exquisite musky, leathery note. Vanilla absolute then emerged as an obvious choice, with its spicy, slightly animalistic inflections that recall warm leather,” Julien Rasquinet, Perfumer.

name_perfume: Spf Like Marine Waves For Her 2018
description: A floral heart of magnolia, feminine and sensual, are wrapped together with exotic notes to wrap you in a warm enduring scent of seduction.

Vivir is an exclusive edition, created to celebrate the vital force that overcomes all adversities. A meditative juice that is warm like a hug, energetic and vital. Every note in this Extrait de Parfum is both a homage and a portal to the states of the soul.

“The spirit of following your heart whilst being nobody’s fool, Reckless is the scent of the woman who is willing to take risks to get what she wants. Carefree but never careless, her sunny disposition finds her creating her own rules of enjoyment and indulgence,” Roja Dove.

name_perfume: L'Air Du Temps X Alix D. Reynis 2023
description: A revisit of the emblematic signature of Air du Temps, comforting, refined and mdern. A natural floral bouquet where each flower expresses itself with accuracy and balance, in harmony with a spicy eugenol note and the creaminess of sandalwood.
Yara Moi's nickname is white Yara. It is a sexy fragrance with a delightfully exotic dry down.

Wildbloom Rouge embodies a youthful spirit with a sensual spark for the stylish woman. She is a romantic dreamer, finding and creating beauty in all that she touches. She emits confidence and desire with her contagious high-spirited personality. This scent is for a sensual woman with a shimmering, chic personality.
Celebration honey in a delight of saffron, dates, rose and dry fruits.

Memories of cruising the Mediterranean Coast on a hot summer day in 1992. From Valencia to Palermo, stopping at Barcelona, Marseille Genova and Napoli. Idyllic childhood memories etched in my memory and the sea was my only witness. Hours and hours standing on deck, relishing the fragrances the breeze brought to me.

Šfarìa is the word for thin, powdery snow; a term evoking the typical fineness of softly falling snowflakes, as they descend from a lead-grey sky and silently reach the ground. When these cold snow grains blend with the balsamic, resinlike hints of Pine and Fir and with aromatic Artemisia, a new full-blooded fragrance is born and gets indelibly written in our sensory memory.
A unique blend of amber and leather. Enjoy the warmth of this classic fragrance.

“I fell in love with the perfumes of the Middle East when I was working there: the way the Aouds are worn and then sublimated by the scent of Bakhoor. The greatest compliment I ever receive is when my Middle Eastern clients ask, ‘How do you know our smell?',” Roja Dove.
Let us enjoy life, let us enjoy new things. Let us live with simplicity, with lightness.

name_perfume: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Green Stravaganza
description: Born in Roma Green Stravaganza takes you on a bold adventure to the cool gardens of Roma where you are free to live and express your unique ways.

Journey back to 1930's Japan, precious interiors, patinaed lacquers, and sumptuous silk fabrics. A fruity chypré enriched by delicious Japanese plum and is illuminated by May rose and Tsubaki aka Japanese camellia.

"I almost fainted with happiness the first time I saw a Coromandel in a Chinese shop," Mademoiselle Chanel confessed. She had a gift of capturing styles and mixing them with great skill to create new forms of beauty. She thus covered her walls in Paris with precious Coromandel screens, teaming Asian flowers with the classic style of her apartments to give them an aura of oriental mystery and sophistication.

Because you are beautiful. This fragrance envelops you with a gorgeous, youthful beauty. Séxûal Fresh opens with iced citrus and cooling spices. A pure bouquet in the heart deepens to a sensuous dry down of sensual and precious notes.

Exotic is a sparkling marriage of the juicy notes in the start of this fragrance, highlighted by the floral facets in the heart; the woody base is bonded to a musky and a gourmand accord, creating a noble trail.
Sung Homme is a scent for the self-confident man, a classic scent to reflect the success, style and individuality of the spirited man of today.
For those that see perfume as so much more than scent The perfect perfume for the well-traveled, well-heeled individual.
Built through science for a sports state of mind for life, and created with the male footballer in mind, Strike / Stk is a dynamic scent. Strike with the power of sport in your life.
Dunhill Driven Eau de Toilette is a tribute to the multiplicity of the Dunhill man. The fragrance is a unique composition that delivers uncomplicated elegance and is the embodiment of sophistication.
Citrus and woody, Hollister Night smells like warm summer nights, all year round.
Eliana Glamour fragrance is a scent that translates her femininity and glamour through the surprising combination of flowers and fruits with the touch of vanilla.
Invigorating top notes of Italian bergamot and essence of basil and ylang-ylang, caressed by an angelic heart of lily-of-the-valley, languish on a base of musk, guaiac wood and vanilla.

name_perfume: Very Irrésistible Givenchy L'Eau En Rose
description: A surprise for the senses. The rose reveals a side to its personality that we have never experienced before, an ethereal burst, as crystalline as sorbet, at the heart of an utterly feminine fragrance, L'Eau en Rose.
What does it mean to be a Bombshell? It's embracing who and what you are. It's being empowered in where you stand and using your voice. It means being totally, unapologetically YOU.
Polo Supreme Cashmere has been created for the most refined gentleman with a timeless style and discerning taste, with an enveloping sensation of softness and warmth using the finest ingredients.

Winter Palace is a fresh and spicy scent that is a powerful contrast between fire and ice. Inspired by the hypnotic energy of China and its imperial palaces. Winter Palace is a scent of contrasts - Fresh and powerful, summer as winter, sweet but spicy.

In Tubéreuse, Mona di Orio creates what she calls a “twilight tubéreuse”, greener and fresher, but still intoxicating and rich. This composition becomes more approachable than its more femme fatale counterparts, Tubéreuse nevertheless seduces. Perfect for tubéreuse fans that want a lighter, friendlier, more verdant interpretation of the flower.

The Expression of a new generation's positive values through a tender femininity that becomes temptation. A fragrance with a soft and luminescent soul that expresses all the power and the energy of love. An olfactive synthesis of a spontaneous sensuality.
Inspired by the sparkling of bright citrus, Cabotine Lemon stands for the ultimate harmony between different fresh and sparkling notes.
Wega is an olfactory score that plays a tune as pure and magical as the music exuding from the stars.
Scent is a special scent from the Majestic range of perfumes.

Baghari was the last fragrance that was added to the Robert Piguet fragrance collection before the untimely death of Robert Piguet in 1953. First created in 1950 by the perfumer Francis Fabron, who was noted for his specialty in aldehydic fragrances and is well noted for many classics like L'Air du Temps and L'Interdit, today, fifty six years later, Fashion Fragrances & Cosmetics is bringing back Baghari to the future.
A rich, sensual base is refreshed with leafy green notes with touches of sweetness from a floral bouquet before being warmed by a woody base.
A timeless blend of white blossoms that symbolise the perfumed Arabian nights. A truly sumptuous, exotic elixir.

A scent of iris fills the air, caressing Florence on a beautiful sunny Sunday. Groups of friends and families descend from Piazzale Michelangelo to admire the revival of nature. The announcement of a new spring resonates in the clear sky of Tuscany.

Known for its distinctive scent, ambergris is even more precious when 'aged', as its qualities are enhanced after floating for years under the sun of the Pacific Ocean. Affinessence has chosen the exceptional quality of this scent, using it generously enough to express its powers of irresistible attraction.
Audacity and elegance. Strength and serenity. Cacharel pour l'Homme is a burning fresh fragrance, intrepid and refined.
A delicate floral aroma extracted from the Eurasian clove lights up with the warmth, pungent aromas of spices, and myrtle tropical evergreens.

ingredients: ['Floral Notes', 'Orange Blossom', 'Ambrette Seed', 'Jasmine', 'Paradisone (light Jasmine)', 'Civet', 'Dew Drop', 'Musk', 'Pink Pepper']
description: Add transparent orange blossom water or crystalline flower petals and dew to any fragrance, or just rock it solo!
Michael Kors Sporty Citrus communicates irresistible appeal of the confident, casual woman who puts herself together with a polished ease – and always has fun doing it.

A tall and unruly jasmine grows alone in the middle of the night. The thin moon shines in the sky, and the clean musk, as cool as water, evokes a high-altitude night wind, making provocative and sensual desires invisible in an instant, leaving only aloofness and indifference.
Lighthearted, this fragrance gives joy to life in its purest form. A fragrance that invites you to an endless summer day full of carefree pleasure.
A sensual, aromatic masculine scent for the urban man who’s in a league of his own, this is a warm, confident fragrance that will leave a lasting impression.

“Beach Hut Man tells the story of an iridescent aromatic idyll that unfolds in the fragrant wild garden of a beach hut, where the sweeping sand dunes meet the sea,” says Chong. “It liberates the senses and unleashes emotion as it explores the intoxicating sublime of the shoreline during the mesmerising moments of sunset.”
Ruthlessly risky. The home of the Mafia produces the finest limes in the world. This Casanova of a fragrance is sharply tangy, a fizz of acidic citrus on the tongue with a shot of salt and danger.

"Imitation is a personal account of how one moment and one experience can alter a child's perception of the world. I am a child seeing snow for the first time in 1970, in New York. I am looking at this experience through a snow dome, exploring a city that is full of tension and displacement. As I walk through Lower East Side with its intense colours and smells and amalgamation of Latin and American cultures, I see an artistic community living on the fringe of society in an iconic era," Christopher Chong, Olfactive Director.

"Gold has a rich history of being associated with gods, power, beauty, and wealth. It’s strong, sleek, and polished. Its purity exudes luxury and demands a rich sensuality when capturing its essence in liquid form. With its grandeur, Gold was truly established around a feeling of indulgence and the ability to draw attention from across a room," Donna Ramanauskas, Perfumer.
Exactly Rose - A pure rose in the tradition of sultry and floral oud rose, but with a yellow hue.
Varens Desire - A definite "haute couture" perfume. Delicate and softly evolving.
Inspired by the graceful Japanese crane, or Tsuru, our perfumers composed a captivating fragrance that lets you take flight on the wings of happiness and soar across a golden horizon.
Vibrant and contrasted, Diplomate is a fragrance that expresses the essence of the captivating and audacious charming man.

"Ambre Nuit orchestrates the encounter between two extremes. It is, in a way, the olfactory expression of Beauty and the Beast. The fragrance teams the dark, animal facet of amber with the delicate, velvet of turkish rose, in a powerful duo,” François Demachy, Perfumer-Creator.
A joyful light floral scent inspired by nature’s blooms at their most tempting.
The inspiration for Elizabeth Arden Always Red was to create a daringly red scent that would evoke the new Elizabeth Arden Always Red woman and capture her bold, passionate and sensual qualities.
This man is dynamic and sensual, competition runs through his veins. Whisky Sport is this man's fuel to glory.

A celestial fantasy awaits you as you dive into its mystery, enveloped by the sweet, illustrious aromas. With an unforgettable sparkling entrance, you'll be empowered by the radiant divinity and sheer brilliance of the floral bouquet of blossoming petals in the heart. Making the supreme statement, the drydown adds temptation and warmth together with intoxicating sweetness that extends the celestial heaven scent dream with its mystical sensuality.
A scent reminiscent of an old barbershop but with an urban touch.

name_perfume: Flacon Aux Abeilles By Tomáš Libertíny 2022
description: Guerlain presents a unique exceptional piece of the perfume Le Jardin de la Reine, imagined as an ultimate celebration of the House's symbol, the bee, which has always been a source of inspiration and commitment: a work of art entirely created by bees. In collaboration with the Slovak artist Tomáš Libertíny, the House is offering an unprecedented creation: the emblematic Flacon aux Abeilles is drawn into a poetic and timeless universe.

Luminescent skin of a reptile, fiery scales of sunlight ripple across the surface of the Indian Ocean, fading slowly to gold and finally sapphire as the sun sinks and disappears. The sea exhales, its gentle tide caressing the beach of a paradise. Whether you desire to shroud yourself in an air of mystery, or blatantly flaunt your true colours, Chameleon becomes you.
A floral heart of compelling notes, with zesty subtle hints in the base.
This is a refreshing scent with energising, powerful accords.
This creation inspired by the island of Reunion opens up to a universe of greed and irresistible sweetness. The breath of a warm and sensual caress.
Sweets and glittering lights, here is a fragrance that smells as good as a party!

Olfactive facet 703 is a unique, warm and sensual fragrance. This smooth yet complex arrangement finds its heart in sweet gourmand with aspects of vanilla and caramel. Delicate notes of citrus and lavender gently rest on a base of warm musk.

Secretly nestled in an exquisite richness, with honeyed notes that prolong the pleasures of taste. A soft, powdery and inimitable personality, sometimes impertinent and tempestuous. Between fervour and whisper, this irresistibly addictive fragrance remains an exploration that promises the skin a sensual melee…
This gourmand extrait features a more caramelised vanilla than ever and keeps a deep intimacy with its musky base notes.

Vetiver is a classic fragrance, so charming, so elegant and glamorous. The start is totally sparkling with a burst of citrus. Floral notes in the heart dance languorously while a cocktail of woody and aromatic notes surround the scent to give freshness and strength.
This crisp, sporty fragrance represents the elements that have shaped Michael Jordan's life from his yearly boyhood to his dazzling basketball career.
Gypsy Rose is an addictive floral amber fragrance that leaves a lasting impression.

An unambiguous fragrance trail, conceived like a beckon, arousing the appetite, and casting a spotlight on whoever wears it. Whether your personality is discreet or, to the contrary, completely intense, this perfume is made for those who wish never to go unnoticed again.

“I have always been inspired by the world around me, the places I've been to, the places I dream of. England has always inspired me, from its elegance to its incredible heritage and tradition,” Ralph Lauren.
A scent that smells like victory, vibrance, luxury.

"A tinctorial wood to colour fabrics red, 'brazil wood' gave its name to the country. With its power of suggestion, "bois de braise" sparked my imagination and I chose paprika to illustrate it. By mixing and matching, I recreated its scent, which is more secretive and discreet than its taste," Jean-Claude Ellena, perfumer.
Luxury Nº16 is a daring and refined perfume for the elegant gentleman who knows and appreciates the finer things in life.

Captain Fawcett’s Triumphant collaboration with actor, comedian and all-round good egg Rufus Hound has resulted in a rather splendid perfume. In truth, this is simply a delightful alchemic concoction and as such, one of Fawcett’s finest. Huzzah!

The Icon Attitude is the modern man’s companion in moments of triumph, a symbol of confidence for he who refuses to be a mere spectator in the game of life, but a player who trains harder than the rest for the victory of success.

ingredients: ['Pepper', 'Rosemary', 'Cedarwood', 'Woody Notes', 'Jasmine', 'Lily Of The Valley', 'Clary Sage', 'Aromatic Notes']
description: The Tuscan Archipelago: a wonderful world of dream places that have lived through all the cultures of the Mediterranean. Places that are so different one from the other but yet have the sea and beauty in common. The notes of the Archipelago fragrance reflect the natural atmosphere and the poetry of these unique landscapes.
A hypnotic and tempting fragrance with spicy notes to make the scent irresistible.

A sun-filled interpretation of vanilla's intriguing and fascinating notes. The sweet essence of vanilla is extracted from the pods and combined with notes to create an enveloping and warm composition. An artistic combination celebrating Madagascar's precious essence.
Elegant florals and spicy citrus take your breath away while warm, sensual dry down keeps you wanting more.

name_perfume: La Nuit Trésor Dentelle De Roses 2021
description: Lancôme's iconic La Nuit Trésor has been adorned with a veil of Haute Couture lace for 2021. Encapsulated in this beautiful bottle, this unique olfaction is composed of an overdose of rose and carefully dressed in an intense fruity velvet dress.
Citron Glacé lets you opt for something fresh, feminine, or sweet, depending on your mood.
For a gentleman who exudes an aura of oceanic depth and the intense waves it expels.
Fabulous Magnolia is a fabulous clash of the senses impersonated by the luminous and fabulous Magnolia whose scent instills Eric’s childhood memories.
Oudh Al Boruzz Atheer Cambodia is a perfume that is as full of ancient mystique and opulence as it is of modern-day sophistication.
A fantastic journey inspired by an epic poem.
Pétales de Magnolia is reminiscent of a sunny spring: every leaf and every flower exudes pure happiness and is an ode to the gentle caress of the wind on a body numbed by winter.
Strong and truly masculine, the bottle exudes an image of power and virility. It will appeal to men seeking something real and seductive.
A vibrant and colourful splash of colour in a bottle.

Everything is strange and explosive in the eyes of a contemporary artist who perpetuates the great tradition of French perfumery, softening his light footprint in the heart of the capital. Inspired by nature, praising its garden, Clair Matin was born from this strange story: a perfect pink wild rose in bloom every day offered a fresh and tangy scent.

ingredients: ['Pear', 'Lily Of The Valley', 'Patchouli', 'Bergamot', 'Freesia', 'Jasmine', 'Musk', 'Pink Pepper', 'Rose', 'Vetiver', 'Woody Notes', 'Ambrette Seed']
description: Celebrate the freedom to feel confident in your own skin with Luna Confiante!
Just as the waves crashing, your personal strength and fresh energy can't be stopped. Musk + Marine is the right fragrance for you.
Aire Freedom is aimed at the modern and connected man who has style and a unique way of reinventing everyday life.
If you are a man of strong personality, determined, and want to explore your feelings and sensuality, let yourself be carried away by Coffee Man Sense.
Coloured glass hold this perfume of light waves, which will submerge your aura in a precious atmosphere.
Light, fizzy and ebullient, this fragrance is refreshing, clean and cool. The perfect choice for a hot summer day or any time you need a happy lift.
Scorzaforza is an intense and powerful fragrance, the result of a disruptive wave of citrus notes, with an aura of enveloping elegance and refinement.
Roberto Cavalli's Gemma di Paradiso is a multi-faceted scent honouring the richness and the extraordinary light of the most precious emerald.
Connect with the purity and balance of nature through the harmony of this aromatic and refreshing fragrance formulated with natural essential oils.
Rose Passion is a joyous ode to the vivacious allure of the free-spirited modern woman living and loving life on her own terms.

It all started in Paris for Memo. In this unforgettable city, which is the birthplace of our perfume house. In its streets, its avenues, on the terraces of its cafés, in the splendour of its museums, where each memory is unique. Here creation is fully expressed, like a statement: Rose Paris Rose is one of them. Made to freedom, to love, to the rose, to the light, to the gold of the statues of Paris, to the beauty of the bridges of the Seine. An olfactory journey into the heart of an eternal Paris.

For women who want to make a difference. Tropical flowers evoke a lost paradise where precious woods and musks accentuate the feeling of well-being. Pure notes of fresh air gently transport us to faraway beaches.

Le Baiser du Dragon is the mirror image of a wild and radiant femininity which transforms the wearer. Just like an invisible jewel, the perfume reveals the assertive personality of this woman; the perfect balance between sensuality and mystery, style and spirituality. A mythic feminine vetiver, its unexpected and distinctive signature takes one by surprise. The flacon is a symbolic object, cut through with a mysterious black dagger, reminiscent of the exquisite perfume dabbers of bygone days, and stamped with a Chinese ideogram symbolizing longevity.

"The amazing thing about ginger is how it combines freshness and spiciness in one ingredient. I've always loved it, so when I smelled this new 'fresh ginger oil' from the Ivory Coast, I knew I had to make Molecule + Ginger. It's so clean, so pure, with a sharp effervescent quality that plays beautifully in the landscape of Molecule 01," Geza Schoen, Perfumer.
Hatkora Wood can easily be claimed as an object of perfumed art.

It's a question of conviction. A matter of self-confidence. It's about drawing the necessary energy for self-accomplishment from deep within. Defining your values and proving your own commitment to yourself.

A king of the party but a young prince at heart. On the pulse of the nightlife scene to everyone and everything. A signature scent you'll recognise on the dance floor and one you won't forget when you leave.

You walk in this forest as in a sacred place. Cradled by the softness of the moss, your steps obey an old instinct, a deep intuition. At the bend of the trail, your eyes finally meet this powerful tree you know, but whose name you do not remember. Your soul, freed from gravity, subtly separates itself from the ground and lingers to savor the scents of nature.

name_perfume: Le Rose Vous Va Si Bien
description: Roses are not ordinary and they make us extraordinary. Each one has its own meaning, that’s why we love them. Romantic, seductive, passionate, liberated, shy, audacious, in love, joyous. We have the freedom to choose what we want to become, with this fragrance that suits us so well. A delicate trio of rose, peony, and magnolia convey with passion all our emotions. All wrapped in woody and powdery notes for even more femininity.
A fragrance to dream, seduce and bewitch. Impossible to forget!

The name 24, Faubourg corresponds to the address of the flagship Hermès store in Paris, rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré. A romantic saga, rich and inspired. Sensual, radiant writing; the expression of a sunny and generous personality. An explosion of white flowers opened by the sun. Enveloping warmth; captivating sensuality.

Gold adorns Knize Ten Gold Edition, the special composition Heinz Gottschalk launched to celebrate the 75th anniversary of Knize Ten. The dry woody character of the historic fragrance is softened by more decisive floral notes, balanced out by spices and citrus to give it warmth and body, the fruit of a truly special vintage year.
Exotic Vanilla exudes the exotic scent of vanilla and, as a light perfume, is perfect for every season and every occasion.
Rafia Gold is a sensual fragrance that suits the wearer who desires more than just a perfume. It will leave a lasting impression after its release.
A light, refreshing scent for summer.

XXY starts with a warm and fresh accord before swiftly moving to a more floral heart. The fragrance then takes a surprising turn with the addition of spices forming the central axis of this symmetrical composition, pivoted by dry woods. This striking contrast is underpinned by a soft gourmand. A very feminine start and heart contrasted with a truly masculine base; the composition challenges the conventional division of man and woman.

An intense addition to the Vince Camuto men's fragrance collection, Vince Camuto Terra Extreme features an addictive blend of warm sandalwood and sensual orange flower wrapped in an exclusive aged rum accord.
The extraction of the true essence may appear difficult and torturous, but the end result is one of love and sacrifice.

A fine, white sandy beach, clear turquoise water and the pleasant feeling of the sun's rays on your skin. This warm, floral and sunny fragrance whisks you away on a trip to paradise and spreads a pure summer feeling.
An artistic perfume that will captivate you from the first spray.

"Mandarin is all about the instant hit. It’s so alive, the way it radiates off the skin with citrus zestiness. Then as it begins to fade, Molecule 01 syncs in, bringing a warm, erogenous feeling. And then the mandarin is almost gone and you are left with the elevated simplicity of Molecule 01," Geza Schoen, Perfumer.
L'Eau d'Issey Eau d'Été refreshes with a varied fruit cocktail. Now all we have to do is take a bite out these exotic fruits by Issey Miyake.

In Cuba, during summer, there's a specific point in time when the scorching heat of the day is about to break. The clouds suddenly thicken, the light darkens and people come out in the street to look up at the sky. The air is filled with the smell of very hot asphalt, but within minutes the rain takes over.
Believe in dreams. Believe in love. Sugarful Dream.

The fragrance is inspired by those who like to take centre stage and don’t mind if the drama doesn’t stay on stage. They are risk-takers and live in the moment, celebrating small wins along with milestones.
An aroma as fresh and clean as a hero's conscience.
Sapphire captures the royal spirit of the stunning blue gemstone. A brave fragrance. For a presence of poise and sophistication.
This alchemy of timeless scents in a modern composition was created in collaboration with Miguel Matos.

name_perfume: Re-Charge Black Pepper Eau De Parfum
description: Terracotta-hued sculptured buttes juxtaposed by deep limestone karsts. The inky waterways of Pangalanes canal encircled by a carnelian sunset shading baobab trees. Russet sands whirl with vigour over spicy desert earth. Unleash your wild side with epic abandon.
Rhubarb in the Sherbet range is a memorable fragrance created to savour the freshness, that makes you want to try it. To taste it!
An evocative, sensual and enveloping scent.

A subliminal journey through time, to rediscover the splendor of fairy tale temples, of gardens embroidered with mosaics and marvellous fountains. A major amber scent, completely reinvented in zero gravity. A beautiful escape on the magic carpet of dreams.

Colour is all about you. For this reason, KissMe Nude Autoral is the explosion of colour transformed into a fragrance, inspired by the most beloved colours of Eudora lipsticks. Nude Autoral, the colour of elegance brings a touch of sophistication to your daily life, inspiring a cologne this oriental gourmand fragrance.
Fiddah was created with sensuality in mind – the top is very subtle, caring and gentle. In the heart, a sexy and warm accord is synchronized with a sensual and lasting effect in dry down.

The pristine waters of a tranquil pond, crown jewel of the Huwon Secret Garden in Seoul. Majestic white waterlilies dress the surface, glowing in the morning light, releasing a clean floralcy that stirs and enchants.

An increase of dazzling citrus gems blend easily with the magnificence that communicates freshness and depth, delivering a more luminous EDT statement. This takes both the carnally rich floral aspects of the namesake Black Orchid Accord and the brilliant light of the original EDP into a new territory that has its own way to mesmerize.
This is an original singular scent with a soft, warm signature.
Golden bundles of wild achillea frame remote ruins alive with nature. Sparkling with bright citrus entwined with the tangy sting of nettle, the greenness balanced on a base of soft accords.
Refreshing iced pear granita unfolds perfectly into a unique blend of electric magnolia and gilded amber. Avon Free for Women is the fragrance for a unique generation

name_perfume: 34 Boulevard Saint Germain L'Eau Du Trente-Quatre
description: Imagine the boutique at 34 boulevard Saint-Germain in the springtime. The air is cool, the sun is shining through the door and windows. The air fills with the smell of fresh spices, blond and luminous wood, and green, acidulated notes. All these scents come together in L’Eau du Trente-Quatre, in the style of a springtime olfactory mood that is only waiting to venture out of its bottle.

In the city, the festivities for the Solstice were being prepared and the people were animated by that confident euphoria that precedes great events, full of expectation for the blessing of the new harvest, the fruit of their hard work in the fields. Luck, they said, was coming to town and so they lit up the darkness with fires and the streets with the colour and hypnotic perfumes of flowers.
A refreshing scent for our kid boys to accompany them in their outdoor adventures.

Rocabar refers to the saffron-coloured wool horse blanket with red and blue stripes made in the Hermès workshop, also known as the striped rug. An adventure novel, a travel log about nature. An enthusiastic, bold style. A fragrance for wanderers drawn to wide-open spaces.

The two lovers in Sinner Forbidden reveal to each other their most scandalous sides. Alone, each lover is a magnificent person, together, they create an overwhelming sense of power. Intrepid in their passion, they are impudent, shameless, unpredictable and ever-ready for each incendiary encounter.
A powerful perfume dominated by spices for an unforgettable trail.

My Honey is the perfect fragrance to fall in love with. Its fruity, sweet notes remind you of being in love for the first time, the feeling you get when you think of your first true love. My Honey is the perfect declaration of love, to your loved ones.
For Piguet, Rue du Cirque in Paris, was where the magic began. For the wearer, it's where love begins. The effect is like a crush in a bottle.
Jardin Blanc is a stroll through a Mediterranean garden illuminated by the last rays of the sun. A delicate bouquet of white flowers soothes like the flow of a stream.

Relaxed elegance defines this avid sportsman. A balanced harmony of woody, spicy and watery notes exudes the energy of a man who is successful in all facets of life and knows how to enjoy his time off.
Allow yourself to be carried away with Bien-être Tendresse d'Enfance, soft and comforting fragrance like a childhood memory.

The stars migrate in the sky, with the creation of Velorum, the brightest star in the constellation. From this magical effusion, echoes of distant samba rhythms, with swirling waves of the mighty ocean, open a new dream journey through the mysterious wake of the stardust scent.
Experience the freshly ground Moroccan spices in a 1,000-year-old open air market.
From its creation, this fresh chypre with citrus notes has become a classic for women looking for elegance, freshness and well-being. Like a breath of air emerging from the bottle.

In a trice, creativity sweeps over us, taking control of our lives. Setting us free. Live In Colours is the joy of creative freedom. Of thought. Of emotion. Of being. The moment within the moment: from now on.
This fragrance is for the man who does things his own way and always brings something new to the table. He is unique, and he knows it.

name_perfume: L'Eau Par Kenzo Neo Edition Pour Femme 2019

A stroll down the sunny boardwalk brings fond memories to the front of your mind. Sandy toes, sweet treats, and smiles on the shore are brought to life. This scent is meant to inspire you to relive and recreate the memories of your youth with the power of fragrance.

The aquatic carpet for St. Petersburg, the city of White Nights. The bright mother of bridges, canals and gardens. The Neva river is the soul of the city. Desire Blue defines the search for inner self. It is the fragrance of discovery and balance for the man who seeks it, contemplates it and then consciously chooses to understand it. Always individual, he is masculine without reserve and wise without arrogance. Desire Blue: The scent of peace.

Experience the fragrance Santal du Pacifique in its purest form. Subtle touches differentiate the extrait from its eau de parfum and bring forth an unmatched intensity and depth, making the original scent richer, more opulent and utterly captivating.

The scent of the desert wind blowing over the pepper and spice trade routes, steeped in their fragrances, merges with fresh citrusy notes for a unique, refined effect. Memories of the Orient and of markets overlooking the Mediterranean.

Orris flowers growing in a tropical fruit garden. The roots of these flowers have been infected by a plague of tropical fruits after falling in love with the colour and shape of its petals. This is not your typical iris perfume.
An extravagant fragrance inspired by the rarest flowers from the French Rivera. Bright lemon blended with a lush combination of florals create the imagery of a perfect summers day.

When we reach the Ramblas we find a florist's shop decorated and full of roses. The rose is the queen of flowers because of its ability to combine with all the olfactory families. Pliny the Elder in the 1st century commented that the waters of these flowers were the most valuable. We discover in our florist's shop a bouquet of flowers in which the rose predominates for its splendour and aroma, and is combined with a bouquet of luminous flowers such as orange blossom and peony, a refreshing aqueous accord enhances the most transparent facet of the perfume. Within this floral heart are spicy notes that enhance the sensual and delicate notes of the rose petals. Discovering how on 23 April, Barcelona is filled with flowers and books, how there are hundreds of flower stands on every corner, spreading the scent of roses is a unique and incomparable experience.

Sophisticated and versatile in its composition, Emulse is for the men and women who stand out and aren’t afraid to command any room that they enter.
The extreme citrus freshness of mandarin orange and Italian lemon combine with the strength and purity of the water. Watery and radiant chords that immerse us in a wave of intense freshness.

A sunny new women's fragrance that embodies the slow-paced, pleasurable lifestyle unique to Cadaquès. A perfume that conjures up images of lovely tanned skin offering itself to the sun, that captures the atmosphere alive with delectable aromas so characteristic of the delightful summertime languor that pervades the body and mind.
From slopeside to fireside, experience a winter chalet with Frostmelt, which warms the season's frost.

The extraordinary garden and the vast expanses of Sicilian citrus groves, laughter in the sunshine, picking and tasting a juicy orange in the shade as trees sway in the breeze. The fragrant statement is sparkling.

There's more than one way to live a sensational VIP life. The My VIP Story opens up a world of inspiring experiences, encompassing the coolest locations and the most exciting encounters. The fragrance reveals a wild and daring vision of masculinity, for a bold and elegant man ready to take his style to the next level.
Explore the warm and enchanting notes of Glicine, with a range of notes that reimagines the fragrance in a uniquely feminine way. This floral scent embodies a sense of refinement and sensuality.

He is an achiever. A trendsetter. A mover and shaker. Successful, style-conscious and driven, the Bentley Momentum man is inspired by the challenge. From New York and Shanghai to London and Dubai, whether he's traveling around the world or taking in the magical vista of an urban landscape, this urban trendsetter knows how to turn each instant of his journey into an exceptional moment. Always going further, on the road and in life.
Pomona Vitalis is a voluptuous perfume celebrating vitality and joie de vivre. The scent pays homage to Pomona, the radiant and rosy cheeked goddess of gardens and orchards.

“The original moss was created around the fresh crispness of a walk in the woods and a brook filled with moss-lined rocks covered in dew. For Moss Personal, the same breath of fresh air mingles with vibrant bergamot and crisp eucalyptus recapturing nature’s pure freshness. To finish, cedarwood mingles with the warmth of amber and a lingering trail of musk creating a softer, more delicate experience for the wearer,” Donna Ramanauskas, Perfumer.

name_perfume: La Nuit Trésor Fleur De Nuit
description: Close your eyes, feel the blossoming of romance and prepare to be mesmerised by the most sensual and blooming love. Dare to enter the exclusive secret night garden of La Nuit Trésor. An enchanting place where only the most beautiful flowers grow and the most precious love stories bloom. This floral and ambery update of the legendary fragrance of love seduces the heart with an irresistible mystery.
This comforting scent has a rich base which will add a layer of warmth to your appearance.
A scent that smells like a passionate, luxurious and unforgettable night.

Whiter than white, a musk with an immaculate floral heart. Between delicacy and sensuality, the musk reveals its skin-soft whiteness. Sculpted by the hand of Guerlain's perfumer, the musk monolith breaks apart to reveal a radiant, faceted, white floral heart.
A delicate fragrance inspired by the morning dawn and dedicated to a sensual, exuberant woman whose femininity truly stands out.
Inspired by the Italian riviera, Vince Camuto Riviera is for the man who represents invigorating energy and finds comfort in the sea.
Courage starts with a risk. Break free from expectations. Defy boundaries and anything in your way. Dare to Defy.

A scent that will forever hold the poetic portrayals that were received from our dedicated Xerjoff clients who took the time to test and trial the creations within the exclusive White on White set. A perfume whose aura echoes the poise and passion that was attained from your input when selecting the scent.

La Bohème is a multi-faceted fragrance that is both sparkling and sunny, for a woman of character in search of freedom and escape. The subtle alliance of fresh and floral notes gives the perfume bohemian femininity.
Sunkissed Goddess is an invitation to live summer’s scent and sensations all year long.

The shiny enthusiasm anticipates the sensual appeal of an embracing and sublime opening. Sumptuous petals exhale with enchanting harmony and promises of wonder and sophisticated elegance on the skin. The final stage entrusts the power, making the trail unmistakable and magnetic.
Mercury No. 80 is a composition for people who go their own way in a combative and ambitious manner: ecstasy meets sensuality in this perfume.

Vanille Plurielle is not an aggressive gourmand scent as one might imagine. Sublimated and highlighted with thousands of roses, some barks of citrus and incense drift to give this marvellous perfume a carnal and aphrodisiac wake.

"I wanted to celebrate the 90s with my Vanilla Eau de Toilette! Vanilla was already known and loved for its smell by consumers, and was associated with childhood, hot sunny days and carefree life. So at the beginning of the new century, I also wanted to look at the past and its real, simple and genuine values of life. I propose an immersion in total vanilla, which is the feeling you'll experience when wearing the eau de toilette version," Alyssa Ashley.
An explosive scent for the elegant, confident woman.
This is a gorgeously blended, remarkably versatile, and enjoyable fragrance.
Lover in Dark will become the new addiction you simply won’t be willing to give up. Its magic spell will enchant you from the first spray!
Boszporusz captures the flavor of Marmara Sea both with sea notes spiced with spices. Flowery notes add the final touch to this fresh and sparkling fragrance. Inhale and enjoy this wonderful scent.
Hayaati is an elegant, warm and spicy masculine fragrance.
