description: This perfume is a recreation of the original, created by Perfumer Bienaime in 1912, Quelques Fleurs was the first true multi-floral bouquet ever created. Over 250 different raw materials and more than 15,000 flowers are necessary to create just one ounce of Parfum.

A beautiful creation composed of a multitude of facets, designed to evolve with freedom and sensuality, unbound from fleeting fashions. A challenge to time and a search for timelessness, the recognisable quality of major classics.

“Fortnum & Mason - it is impossible not to be enveloped by the richness of this iconic symbol of British luxury. I love its understated elegance - the subtle gestures that are distinctly British - distinctly Fortnum's. I have reflected this in the composition, a luxurious Amber base, rarely used in perfumery, forms the foundation of this creation, whilst an exquisite blend of Leather, Aoud, and precious Woods intermingle with the note of Rose – the flower of England. The sunburst – an emblem of the store – adorns the label and box, evocative of the timelessness and warmth that pervades every floor.” - Roja Dove
Hot Fragrances Brown, combines power and virility thanks to its decidedly modern design.

Laboratorio Olfattivo has taken up the challenge of dealing with one of the noblest flowers of the kingdom of nature: the rose. Revealing a hidden facet of its aroma, reshaping the contours of its petals, bringing to light a new aspect, without ever betraying its legendary scent, especially to the fans of the rose to make it different from all those already used in perfumery. This was the creative effort that kept the perfumer busy for two years and that that led to the creation of the first pink Laboratorio Olfattivo: Rosamunda.

Lovely glamour, a hymn to the pink signed Bourjois. Rose dazzles a new splendor in this fruity floral fragrance, modern and playful, "lovely" yes, but hot! Bourjois which looks a green and fruity sparkling bouquet blossoms with delicate notes and persists in the pleasure of a sweet musky trail that envelopes.
A bewitching scent with a deliciously intriguing trail.

Scholar’s Mate is an ode to partnership, a harmonious testament to the intense connection that occurs between those who share a common goal. The scent delights in the possibilities awakened through mutual care and affection, aware of the gift a true friend and confidant can be.

The Hindu Kush, is a wild mountain range that draws the border between heaven and earth. This is unique resinous scent, cultivated on a land nuanced with incense. Your spirit rises, your body tingles.

Do you remember the last time you smiled or cried with your loved one? Perhaps it was an instant, or the rapid passage of emotions that leave their mark: Meraviglioso Instante will play on your skin like a memory!

It only takes a second for passion to take hold. Inspired by the most potent, fiery form of love, La Nuit Trésor Intense has an addictive power, composed of indulgent notes that bewitch the senses and offer renewed seduction to the iconic flower found in the trail of La Nuit Trésor, the Isparta rose. This red rose is a scarlet melody of a trio of olfaction delights.

Ralph captures the energy, spirit and personality of today's young woman with a colourful, floral fragrance: sparkling green leaves, zesty citrus, charismatic and seductive flowers and soft blue musk.

The classic cologne has hit home with gentlemen everywhere, polite and poised like a sharp side part and a taper cut. Citrusy and crisp, fleeting in its solidity, it has been fitted with a younger and less formal suit, appropriate to Sunday relaxation.
A variation on the theme of ecstasy. Balmain created the counterpart to Extatic Eau de Parfum: a crystalline, refined, and totally Parisian eau de toilette with strong addictive power.

Euphoria is a journey without limits. Inspired by a new-found freedom, about living one's dream. Sexy and unique with a look of modern freshness. A masculine, sexy, mouth-watering, fragrance, with a tempting signature, making it assertive, clean, and comfortable.

Surprisingly charming, Lomani Amazing opens with a sparkling and fresh start. In the heart, florals reveal a refreshing feeling as flowers after a spring rain. Reassuring and sensual, the base notes create an eternal signature.
Monoi is an original and magnificent fragrance with vibrant solar notes.

A fragrance as chic and radiant as the Avon woman, this artisanal created was crafted with feminine intuition. A unique narrative balancing emotions of joy, eloquence, and spontaneity, Iris Fétiche inspires new world femininity with its exceptionally floral richness.

A bright, sunny and dazzling scent that evokes what a sunflower would smell like if it had a scent. Nick's Sunflower, is an interpretation of the Sunflower’s scent bringing summer's bright and warm perspectives.
A fruity floral feminine perfume combining elegance with sensuality to reveal the woman's romantic side.

Lightning Mcqueen is a small red race car that discovers the true meaning of family and friendship. Live according to the philosophy "The journey is more important than the finishing line in life". With this fresh scent, you will experience exciting adventures.
Conceived during a trip to a Mediterranean garden in the Estérel region, the fresh and fragrant fig flower gives off sensations of light and gluttony.
Imagine a minimalist and avant-garde allure. Calfskin leather evolves into a second skin, with a completely white outfit as pure and virginal as light itself.

The broad range of topography, and the different related smells that can be found throughout Ireland, provides an almost endless opportunity for iconic scents. We simply chose the ones closest to our heart - warm, soft, green and watery, clean and fresh. Think of an unspoiled meadow with a river running through it.
Bonne Étoile is the evocation of sweetness, an invitation to the tenderness of childhood, the age when the senses awaken, where a child's laughter enchants and dreams reign.
Feel invigorated with this sweet and gentle scent.
This strong and captivating fragrance makes sure your enigmatic presence never goes unnoticed.
Experience the joy and optimism of your dreams of true love, through a fresh note of neroli buds. An exciting promise of a beautiful love story to come, captured in a bottle.
The One Gentleman, inspired by a man who is worldly, successful, impeccable and elegant.

Roger and Gallet invites you on a cultural journey to the Andalousian gardens of the Alhambra in Granada, Spain. Under the Casa Real Palace orange trees, discover the contrast between the sunny freshness of the leaf and the fruit, the sweetness of the flower and the mysterious sensuality of the wood.
A perfume like soothing music, but an unwritten script. Infatuated notes intertwined to compose a scentual melody. The grandeur of purity, the embodiment of innocence.

name_perfume: Delicious Rhubarb & Rose Eau De Parfum
description: A slice of crimson summer cake. Freshly picked roses on the pantry table. Scattered crumbs of puff pastry and bright ribbons of rhubarb stalk, Delight your senses with an irresistibly sweet recipe with a citrus twist.
Outfox your prey with this warm and sexy potion. Best worn with a barely-there come-hither stare.

name_perfume: Loewe Pour Homme Eau De Toilette
description: LOEWE Pour Homme is a fragrance inspired by earth, the simple pleasure of sensing the ground beneath us, a feeling of connection.

The white camellia, a flower whose perfect shape makes one forget its lack of fragrance. It was the emblem of Coco Chanel, appearing here and there in her creations; on the brim of a hat, a buttonhole or a piece of jewellery. In 1925, she created a fragrance in its image and called it Gardénia.

The gates close like a forbidden secret on the City. An ugly wench reigns supreme and deep in the emperor's heart. Irregular and made of silk weaved by a clumsy child. A secret is simple when inhabited. Invisible flint for sparks of the mirror. This glorious ensemble of strange harmonies in regular quarters invites us to a feast. A costume ball of ghosts has already started, the shadows are dancing and take on their destiny!
This incredibly light, crystal-clear fragrance releases an aquatic floral note accompanied by a bouquet of rose and jasmine, resting on a woody base.
Tres Jour Pour Femme, a beloved fragrance that has an addictive presence and a unique appeal.
Love at First Sight is the instant passion of flower scents mingling and intertwining. The intense caress of the freshness of jacaranda succumbs to the honeyed kiss of acacia.
Inspired by the Arabian Gardens of Paradise, Rose Seljuke is a tribute to the luxurious gardens of the Royal Palace of Babylon, the archetype of all gardens on earth.

"In creating Milk Personal, I wanted to capture the intimate nostalgia of a Fall family vacation spent making delicious s’mores around hot wood fires. This fragrance is a creamy, sheer interpretation of an ambery composition that is soft and rather innocent. To accentuate this tenderness, I used my cold milk accord and soft amber, paired with a heavier base of woods, gourmands, and resins,” Christelle Laprade, Perfumer.
An invitation to self-expression. A stage for all - inclusive of all genders and diversities. An amplifier for all tribes and communities.
Perpetual Silver Pea is the fragrance for generous, sensitive and elegant women. An exquisite scent that exalts absolute femininity.

007 for Women is a fresh, daytime companion to the classic and mysterious evening scent, 007 For Women. This Floral Oriental scent is lighter yet deeply feminine with notes reminiscent of Pink Champagne which capture the true spirit of the Bond Woman.
Tom Tailor's Urban Life Man is aimed at the independent, modern man who represents the modern lifestyle of the big city authentic, confident and diverse in focus.

Inspired by the precious glow of pure crystal, an enveloping Eau de Parfum of signature depth and richness heightened by distinctive lotus flower, velvety orris concrete and the smoothness of white sandalwood.

If you are independent, easy-going, confident and light-hearted, Charlie will bring out the bright and lively spirit within you! Crisp, lively and clean – a breath of fresh air that will leave you feeling like you just received a fresh bouquet of flowers!
